rows: w_abandon

to leave someone or something behind without intending to return 及物動詞，直接接受詞；abandon a person 指棄人不顧，abandon a vehicle 指棄置車輛。 放棄計畫、活動或信念 to stop pursuing a plan, activity, or belief 常接 plan、attempt 或 hope；也可用 abandon doing something 表示放棄做某事。 完全沉浸於某種情緒或活動 to allow an emotion or activity to take complete control of oneself 用 abandon oneself to，to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞；偏文學語氣。 無拘無束；忘情 complete freedom from restraint or worry 不可數名詞，通常用 with abandon 或 with reckless abandon，描述毫無顧忌的行為。
w_abate
to become less intense or severe, or to make something less intense or severe 常描述風暴、疼痛或怒氣逐漸減弱；可不接受詞，也可用於 abate a nuisance 等正式用語。
w_abdicate
to formally give up a throne or a position of power 君主退位可直接用 abdicate，或接 the throne；不宜用來泛指一般員工辭職。 放棄履行職責 to fail or refuse to fulfill a responsibility 常用 abdicate responsibility，語氣帶有批評，表示不承擔本應負起的責任。
w_aberration
an occurrence that differs from what is normal or expected 可數名詞；常用 an aberration 或 a statistical aberration，表示異常個案，未必代表長期趨勢。
w_abet
to help or encourage someone to do something wrong or illegal 帶負面含義，常見於法律片語 aid and abet；不適合用來描述一般正面的協助。
w_abide

to tolerate someone or something unpleasant 此義通常出現在 cannot abide；後面可接名詞或動名詞，語氣比 dislike 強。 遵守規則、決定或協議 to accept and act according to a rule, decision, or agreement 此義必須用 abide by；by 後接 rules、a decision 或 an agreement，不能省略。 停留；居住 to remain or live in a place 屬古老或文學用法，日常談居住通常用 live 或 stay；此義不加 by。
w_abnormal
different from what is usual or expected, especially in a concerning way 常修飾 results、growth 或 behavior；描述檢測數值時指偏離正常範圍，不等於已確診疾病。
w_aboard

on or onto a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle 作副詞時後面不接受詞，常見 go aboard、climb aboard；有受詞時 aboard 作介系詞。 在船、飛機或火車上；登上 on or onto a ship, aircraft, train, or other vehicle 直接接交通工具名稱，例如 aboard the plane，不需要再加 on。 加入團隊或組織 as a new member of a team or organization 常用 welcome aboard 歡迎新成員，也用 bring someone aboard 表示延攬某人。
w_abolish
to officially end a law, system, or practice 常接 law、slavery、tax 等制度性事物；不用於取消單次會議，後者通常用 cancel。
w_abolition
the official ending of a law, system, or practice 通常不可數，常用 the abolition of；談歷史時，the abolition of slavery 指廢除奴隸制度。
w_aboriginal
relating to the indigenous peoples of australia 指澳洲原住民族時通常大寫為 aboriginal；應尊重當事人的族名與自我稱呼。 自最早時期便存在於當地的；原生的 existing in a place from the earliest known times 此義較少見，多用於歷史或學術語境；不應將原住民族概括譯成「原始的」。
w_abrasive

a material used to rub a surface smooth or clean 可數或不可數，常見於清潔及加工語境；sandpaper 是一種 abrasive。 有研磨作用的 able to wear away or clean a surface by rubbing 常修飾 material、pad 或 cleaner，指能藉摩擦磨除表面物質。 態度粗魯刺人的 rude and harsh in a way that irritates other people 形容人或說話方式，常見 abrasive manner 或 abrasive personality；比單純的 direct 更負面。
w_abrupt

sudden and unexpected 常見 an abrupt change 或 come to an abrupt end，強調轉變缺乏過渡。 言行簡短而生硬的；唐突的 brief and unfriendly in speech or manner 常用 be abrupt with someone，表示對某人的回應生硬，可能令人覺得無禮。 陡峭的；坡度驟變的 very steep or changing level sharply 常修飾 slope、rise 或 descent；描述地勢時比 steep 更強調突然變陡。
w_abscond
to leave secretly to escape capture or avoid a duty, sometimes taking something 不及物動詞；abscond from 指逃離某處，abscond with money 指攜款潛逃。
w_absence

the state or period of being away from a place 常用 absence from work 或 during someone's absence；leave of absence 指准假的離崗期間。 缺乏；不存在 the lack or nonexistence of something 用 the absence of something；in the absence of evidence 表示在缺乏證據的情況下。 失神發作 a brief seizure involving a sudden loss of awareness 醫學上通常用 absence seizure，指短暫失去對周遭的意識；不可與一般的心不在焉混為一談。
w_absenteeism
the practice of frequently being absent from work or school 不可數名詞，常見 employee absenteeism 或 a high rate of absenteeism；具體原因可能包括健康或工作環境問題。
w_absolute

complete or total 常修飾 certainty、silence 或 disaster；此義通常不用 very 或比較級。 權力不受限制的；專制的 not restricted by laws or other authorities 常見 absolute power 或 absolute monarchy，指權力缺乏法律或其他機構的制衡。 絕對的；非相對的 measured independently rather than in relation to something else 常與 relative 對比；an absolute increase 指實際增加量，a relative increase 通常指相對比例。 不受條件限制的原則或事物 a principle or thing regarded as independent of conditions or circumstances 可數名詞，常見 moral absolutes；哲學中的 the absolute 則指絕對者或終極實在。
w_absolve
to declare someone free from guilt, blame, or responsibility 常用 absolve someone of blame 或 absolve someone from responsibility；被動形式也很常見。
w_absorb

to take in liquid, gas, heat, light, or another substance or form of energy 及物動詞，常接 water、heat 或 light；不需加介系詞。 吸收並理解資訊 to take in and understand information 常接 information、knowledge 或 details，強調理解所接收的內容。 使全神貫注 to hold someone's attention completely 常用 be absorbed in something 表示專注於某事；in 後可接名詞或動名詞。 自行承擔費用或損失 to bear a cost or loss without passing it on to others 商務中常用 absorb costs 或 absorb losses，表示由自己消化支出，不轉嫁給他人。 吸納；併入 to incorporate something into a larger group or system 常用 absorb something into something；被動式 be absorbed into 指被納入更大的組織。
w_absorption

the process of taking in a substance or energy 不可數名詞；常用 the absorption of nutrients 或 light absorption，介系詞 of 引出被吸收的事物。 全神貫注；專心投入 complete attention to an activity or subject 常用 absorption in，後接活動或主題；與物理上的吸收義分開理解。
w_abstain

to choose not to vote for or against a proposal 可單獨使用 abstain，也可用 abstain from voting；棄權不同於投反對票。 自願戒除；避免參與 to deliberately avoid consuming something or taking part in an activity 用 abstain from，後接名詞或動名詞，常見 abstain from alcohol；語氣較正式。
w_abstention
the act of choosing not to vote for or against a proposal 計算票數時可數，如 two abstentions；棄權者未對議案投贊成或反對票。 有意的戒除或避免 deliberate avoidance of a substance or activity 較正式，常接 from；談長期戒酒時 abstinence 也很常用。
w_abstruse
difficult to understand because of complexity or unfamiliar ideas 常修飾 theory、argument 或 text；不同於 abstract「抽象的」，抽象內容不一定難懂。
w_absurd

so unreasonable or illogical that it seems ridiculous 常用 it is absurd to do something 或 an absurd claim，表示強烈不認同其合理性。 人生看似不合理或無意義的荒誕狀態 the apparent irrationality or meaninglessness of human existence 此義通常用 the absurd，常見於哲學與文學；theatre of the absurd 指荒誕派戲劇。
w_abundance

a very large quantity or plentiful supply 常用 an abundance of 加名詞，或 in abundance 表示數量充足；不要寫成 abundant of。 元素或同位素的豐度 the proportion of a particular element or isotope in a sample or environment 科學用語，常見 relative abundance；指所占比例，須依情境區分原子數比例或質量比例。
w_abundant
present or available in large quantities 可放在名詞前，如 abundant evidence；也可用 be abundant in a region，表示在某地大量存在。
w_abuse

the improper or harmful use of something 常用 abuse of power 或 substance abuse；此義名詞末尾發 /s/，動詞末尾發 /z/。 虐待 cruel or violent treatment of a person or animal 常見 child abuse、physical abuse 或 emotional abuse；此義通常不可數。 辱罵；惡言相向 rude or offensive language directed at someone 不可數名詞，常用 verbal abuse 或 a stream of abuse，指攻擊他人的言語。 濫用 to use something wrongly or harmfully 及物動詞，常接 power、trust 或 drugs；動詞末尾發 /z/，與名詞的 /s/ 不同。 虐待 to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently 直接接受害者作受詞；可用 physically 或 emotionally 說明虐待的形式。 辱罵 to address someone with insulting or offensive language 常用 verbally abuse someone；此義強調用言語攻擊，不是單純提出批評。
w_academy

a school providing general education or specialized training 可數名詞，常見 military academy 或 police academy；英美教育制度中的 academy 未必相同。 促進科學、文學或藝術的學會或學院 an organization that promotes science, literature, or the arts 常出現在正式機構名稱中，如 an academy of sciences；不一定是提供學位的學校。
w_accede

to take up a high office or become a ruler 用 accede to the throne 或 accede to office；to 是介系詞。 同意請求或要求 to agree to a request or demand 正式用法，常見 accede to a request 或 accede to demands；不可直接省略 to。 正式加入條約或協定 to formally become a party to a treaty or agreement 法律與外交用語，常用 accede to a treaty；名詞形式是 accession。
w_accelerate

to move faster or cause something to move faster 可及物或不及物；車輛加速可直接用 accelerate，減速則用 decelerate。 加快進程；促使更快發生 to happen more quickly or make a process happen more quickly 常見 accelerate growth、accelerate development，強調進行速度提高。
w_accentuate
to make a feature more noticeable or prominent 常修飾外觀、差異或問題，與 emphasize 相近，但常強調某項特徵變得更顯著。 重讀音節或詞語 to place vocal stress on a syllable or word 語音學用法，比日常的 stress 較少見；不要把「加重音」與「帶口音」混淆。
w_accessible

possible to reach, enter, or use 常用 accessible to 加使用者，或 accessible by 加交通方式；無障礙語境常見 wheelchair-accessible。 容易理解的 easy to understand 常修飾 explanation、writing 或 introduction；accessible to beginners 指初學者也看得懂。 容易聯繫或親近的 easy to contact or talk to 形容人願意溝通、方便接觸，常用 be accessible to students；與 approachable 相近。
w_accessory

an item worn or carried to complement clothing 可數名詞，常用複數 accessories；包括皮帶、圍巾、手袋等搭配服裝的物品。 設備的附加配件 an extra component that adds to the usefulness of a device 常用 accessories for a camera 或 phone accessories；通常指主機以外的附加物。 幫助犯罪或掩飾犯罪的人；從犯 a person who helps someone commit or conceal a crime 法律用語，常用 an accessory to a crime；accessory after the fact 指犯罪後協助逃避追訴的人。 附加的；輔助的 additional or supplementary rather than primary 技術語境常見 accessory equipment 或 accessory muscles，表示補充主要功能。
w_accommodate

to provide enough space or lodging for someone or something 常以建築物作主詞，接人數；也可用 accommodate guests 表示安排住宿。 配合或滿足需求 to adjust arrangements to meet someone's needs 常用 accommodate someone's needs 或 accommodate a request，指調整安排以提供便利。 使適應；使相容 to adapt to a situation or make things compatible 正式用法中可用 accommodate oneself to something，to 後接名詞。
w_accompany

to go somewhere with someone 直接接受詞，用 accompany someone；不要在此結構中加 with。 伴隨發生或出現 to happen or be present together with something 常用 be accompanied by；描述兩件事一起出現，不必然表示因果關係。 為歌手或演奏者伴奏 to play music in support of a singer or another musician 用 accompany someone on 加樂器；不是單純同時演奏，而是提供伴奏。
w_accomplish
to successfully complete a task or achieve a goal 常接 task、goal 或 mission，強調經過努力而完成；不要用 accomplish to do。
w_accomplishment

something successfully achieved through effort 此義可數，常見 a major accomplishment；履歷中的 accomplishments 指具體成果。 任務或目標的完成 the successful completion of a task or goal 此義不可數，常用 the accomplishment of a goal，焦點是完成的過程或事實。
w_accord

a formal agreement between groups or countries 可數名詞，常用 reach an accord 或 sign a peace accord。 意見或行動的一致；協調 agreement or harmony in opinions or actions 通常用 in accord with，表示與某事一致；of one's own accord 是固定片語，意為自願地。 給予權利、地位或待遇 to give someone a particular right, status, or treatment 正式用法，可用 accord someone something，或 accord something to someone。 與某事一致；相符 to be consistent with something 用 accord with，主詞常是說法、資料或行為；不可省略 with。
w_accountability
the obligation to explain one's decisions and accept responsibility for their results 不可數名詞；accountability to 指須向誰負責，accountability for 指須對何事負責，不譯成「可說明性」。
w_accountant
a person whose job is to prepare, examine, or maintain financial records 可數名詞；accountant 不一定具有會計師證照，certified public accountant 才明確表示註冊會計師資格。
w_accrue

to increase gradually over time, especially as interest or benefits 可不及物，如 interest accrues；也可及物，如 accrue interest。常描述隨時間產生的增加。 利益或權利歸於某人 to become available to someone as a benefit or right 正式用法，常用 benefits accrue to someone，to 引出獲益者。
w_accumulate
to collect or build up gradually over time 可及物或不及物；accumulate experience 指累積經驗，dust accumulates 指灰塵漸漸堆積。
w_accumulation

the gradual collection or buildup of something, or the amount collected 過程通常不可數；指一批積聚物時可用 an accumulation of，例如 an accumulation of dust。 將利潤留存以增加公司資本 the retention of profits to increase a company's capital rather than distribute them 財務語境可用 accumulation of profits；一般財報更常見 retained earnings「保留盈餘」。
w_accuracy

the degree to which information or a measurement agrees with the truth or correct value 不可數名詞，常見 check the accuracy of；測量中 accuracy 指接近真值，precision 則常指重複測量結果的一致程度。 數值結果所要求的精確程度 the level of exactness specified for a numerical result 常用 to an accuracy of，後接位數或誤差範圍；四捨五入的位數本身不保證測量接近真值。
w_accurate
correct and consistent with facts or the true value 常修飾 information、description 或 measurement；副詞為 accurately，名詞為 accuracy。
w_accusation
a statement that someone has done something wrong or illegal 可數名詞，常見 make an accusation 或 an accusation of theft；指控不等於已證實有罪。
w_accuse
to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal 用 accuse someone of something 或 of doing something；不能寫成 accuse someone for。
w_achievement

something successfully done through effort or skill 此義可數，常用 a remarkable achievement；可指一次成果或長期努力的成就。 目標或標準的達成 the successful attainment of a goal or standard 此義不可數，常用 the achievement of a goal；academic achievement 指學業表現或成就。
w_acid

a substance that donates protons in a chemical reaction or forms hydrogen ions in water 可數或不可數，常見 citric acid「檸檬酸」；酸的定義依化學理論而異，此處採常見的質子酸概念。 迷幻藥 lsd the hallucinogenic drug lsd 非正式且不可數的名稱；閱讀時依上下文判斷，不可把化學語境的 acid 一律理解成毒品。 酸性的；味酸的 having acidic chemical properties or a sour taste 常見 acid soil 或 an acid taste；一般描述酸鹼性時 acidic 也很常用。 語氣尖酸的；刻薄的 sharp, bitter, or hurtful in tone 常修飾 remark、comment 或 tone，表示話語尖刻，不是感官敏銳。
w_acknowledge

to admit or accept that something is true, especially something you would rather not admit acknowledge 帶有「雖然不見得樂意，但承認事實如此」的語感，因此在論述中特別好用：先 acknowledge 對方說得對的部分，再提出自己的看法，會顯得客觀而有說服力。它比 admit 中性——admit 常暗示承認過錯，acknowledge 只是確認事實。 acknowledge that + clause acknowledge + noun it is widely acknowledged that + clause widely acknowledged 普遍公認的 acknowledge the risk 承認風險存在 readily acknowledge 坦然承認 確認收到；回應 to tell someone that you have received something, or to show that you have noticed them 這個意思是「讓對方知道訊息已經送達」。商務書信中 acknowledge receipt of your email 是固定客套語；網路通訊協定中的 ack（acknowledgement）也是同一個字，指接收端回傳的確認封包。 acknowledge receipt of 確認收到 an acknowledgement packet 確認封包 admit concede deny refute acknowledgement acknowledged admit
w_acoustic

relating to sound, hearing, or the properties of sound 常見 acoustic waves「聲波」或 acoustic insulation「隔音」；學科名稱是 acoustics。 以自然共鳴發聲的；原聲的 producing sound naturally rather than through electronic sound generation 常見 acoustic guitar 或 acoustic performance；原聲樂器仍可透過麥克風擴音，與電子產生聲音不同。
w_acquaintance

a person one knows but is not close friends with 可數名詞，通常指交情比 friend 淺的人；an acquaintance of mine 表示我的一位熟人。 對人或事物的認識；了解 knowledge of a person or subject gained through experience 常用 acquaintance with；make someone's acquaintance 則表示初次結識某人。
w_acquiesce
to accept something without protest, often reluctantly 正式用語，常用 acquiesce in a decision 或 acquiesce to a demand；強調沒有反抗，不一定真心贊同。
w_acquisition

the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge or skills 此義通常不可數，常見 language acquisition 或 acquisition of skills；習得語言不限於有意識地學習。 取得的事物；被收購的公司 something obtained or purchased, especially a company bought by another company 此義可數；商務中 an acquisition 可指收購案或被收購的企業，須依上下文判斷。
w_acre
a unit of area equal to 4,840 square yards, or about 4,047 square metres 可數名詞，常用於土地面積；one acre 約為 0.405 公頃，不是長度單位。
w_acrimony
bitterness and hostility in speech or behavior 不可數名詞，常見 amid acrimony 或 without acrimony；常描述爭執、談判或關係破裂。
w_activate

to make a device, system, or process start working 及物動詞，常接 account、alarm 或 a feature；activate an account 指啟用帳號。 使物質活化，以提高反應性或吸附能力 to treat a substance so that it becomes more reactive or more effective at adsorption 化學用語，常見 activated carbon「活性碳」；adsorption 是表面吸附，與 absorption「吸收」不同。 使物質因照射而產生放射性 to make a substance radioactive by exposure to particles or radiation 核物理用語，常見 neutron activation「中子活化」；此義不同於啟動一般設備。
w_actively
in a way that involves deliberate effort or participation 常修飾 seek、participate 或 support，表示實際投入行動；actively involved 指積極參與。
w_acuity
the sharpness of a sense or of mental perception 不可數名詞，常見 visual acuity「視覺敏銳度」與 mental acuity「思考敏銳度」；不宜直譯為物體的尖銳。
w_acute

very severe or intense 常見 acute pain、an acute shortage，表示程度嚴重；與醫學上病程短的「急性」義須分開理解。 急性的 beginning suddenly and lasting a relatively short time 醫學中與 chronic「慢性的」相對；acute 描述起病與病程，不表示所有急性病都比慢性病嚴重。 敏銳的 able to notice or understand small differences quickly 常見 acute hearing 或 an acute awareness of，強調察覺細節或問題的能力。 銳角的，即小於九十度的 measuring less than ninety degrees 幾何用語，an acute angle 指銳角；直角是 a right angle，鈍角是 an obtuse angle。
w_adamant
firmly refusing to change an opinion or decision 常用 be adamant that 加子句，或 adamant about something；形容人或立場，不以此字泛指材料堅硬。
w_adapt

to change oneself or something to suit new conditions or a new purpose 適應環境用 adapt to；改造物品用 adapt something for a purpose。不要與 adopt「採用」混淆。 改編作品 to change a written work for a different medium or audience 常用 adapt a novel for television，或 be adapted from 加原作；for 表示改編的用途，from 表示來源。
w_adaptable
able to change to suit new conditions or purposes 可形容人或事物，常用 adaptable to change；表示具備適應能力，不等於已經適合某件事。
w_adaptation

the process of changing to suit new conditions 通常不可數，常接 to；生物學中也指物種適應環境的過程。 改編作品 a version of a work changed for another medium or audience 此義可數，常見 a film adaptation of a novel；of 引出原作。 感覺器官對刺激變化的適應 the adjustment of a sense organ to changed stimulation 生理學中常見 dark adaptation「暗適應」，指眼睛逐漸適應低光照環境。
w_addict

to cause someone to become dependent on a substance or activity 動詞常見於 be addicted to 結構，to 後接名詞或動名詞；不要接原形動詞。 對藥物或其他物質成癮的人 a person who is dependent on a drug or other substance 可數名詞；醫療與助人語境常改用 a person with an addiction，以先描述人而非以病況作標籤。 對某活動極為著迷的人 a person who is extremely interested in an activity 非正式用法，如 a coffee addict 或 a crossword addict，通常是誇張說法，不一定指臨床成癮。
w_addition

the process of adding numbers or combining quantities 數學中的 addition 通常不可數，與 subtraction「減法」相對。 新增的人或事物 a person or thing added to a group or collection 可數名詞，常用 an addition to；a new addition to the team 指團隊的新成員。 添加；增添 the act of adding something to something else 常用 the addition of；固定片語 in addition 表示「此外」，in addition to 後接名詞或動名詞。
w_additive

produced by adding components or effects together 常見 additive effect，指作用相加；若總作用超過各部分之和，通常稱 synergistic「協同的」。 添加劑；添加物 a substance added to a product to improve or preserve it 可數名詞，常見 food additives 或 fuel additives；不要泛譯為任何新增物件。
w_adequate

good enough or large enough for a particular purpose, but no better than that adequate 的語感很微妙：它確實表示「達到標準」，但同時暗示「僅止於此、談不上好」。因此在績效評語或產品評價中，adequate 其實是一種保留的說法。若要真心稱讚，用 excellent 或 strong；若要中性表達「夠用」，adequate 剛好。介系詞用 for。 adequate for + noun adequate to + verb be more than adequate adequate for 足以應付…… adequate resources 足夠的資源 barely adequate 勉強及格 adequate testing 足夠的測試 sufficient satisfactory inadequate insufficient adequately adequacy inadequate sufficient
w_adhere
to stick firmly to a surface 用 adhere to a surface，to 不可省略；通常由黏著的物質作主詞。 遵守；堅持遵循 to follow a rule, belief, or plan consistently 正式用法，常用 adhere to rules 或 adhere to a plan；不同於 follow，adhere 需要介系詞 to。
w_adherent
sticking firmly to a surface 較正式或技術性的形容詞，常見 adherent cells「貼附型細胞」；搭配 to 說明附著位置。 信奉者；支持者 a person who supports a belief, movement, or leader 可數名詞，常用 an adherent of a philosophy；語氣較正式，常見複數 adherents。
w_adhesive

able to stick things together or covered with a sticky substance 常修飾 tape、label 或 bandage；adhesive tape 指膠帶。 黏著劑 a substance used to stick materials together 可數或不可數；選用時常描述 a strong adhesive 或 a water-based adhesive。
w_adjacent
next to or very near something 常用 adjacent to；可指共享邊界，也可指非常靠近，不必一律理解成實際接觸。
w_adjust

to change something slightly to make it work better or fit properly 及物用法常接 settings、height 或 position；通常是小幅修改，不是完全重新設計。 適應新情況 to become familiar with and able to manage new conditions 用 adjust to，to 後接名詞或動名詞；也可說 adjust oneself to。 核定保險理賠金額 to assess an insurance claim and determine the amount payable 保險專業用語，常用 adjust a claim；執行這項工作的人稱 claims adjuster。
w_adjustment

a small change made to improve something or make it fit 可數名詞，常見 make an adjustment to；若有多項修改，使用 adjustments。 適應新環境的過程 the process of becoming accustomed to new conditions 此義通常不可數，常用 adjustment to；a period of adjustment 表示適應期。
w_administer

to manage an organization, system, or activity 正式用語，常接 program、fund 或 estate；強調負責制度或事務的運作。 給藥；施予治療 to give someone a medicine or medical treatment 常用 administer medication to a patient；to 引出接受治療者，不等於管理藥局。 主持測驗、宣誓或儀式 to formally conduct a test, oath, or ritual 常見 administer an exam、administer an oath；施行宗教聖禮也可用此字。
w_administrative
relating to the management and organization of an institution 常見 administrative staff、administrative duties 或 administrative costs，通常指組織運作的事務。
w_administrator

a person responsible for managing an organization or system 可數名詞，常見 school administrator 或 system administrator；後者在資訊領域譯作系統管理員。 依法指定的遺產管理人 a person legally appointed to manage and distribute an estate 法律用語，常見 administrator of an estate；與遺囑中指定的 executor「遺囑執行人」有別。
w_admiration
a feeling of respect and approval for someone or something 不可數名詞，常用 admiration for 或 in admiration；不應把此常見義譯成「引人讚賞的物件」。
w_admire

to respect and approve of someone or something 常用 admire someone for something；重點是內心的敬佩，不一定有說出口的稱讚。 欣賞地觀看 to look at something with pleasure and appreciation 及物動詞，常接 view、painting 或 architecture，表示駐足觀賞。
w_admission

permission to enter a place or join an institution 常用 admission to a university；醫院的 admission 也可指收治入院。 入場費 the price charged for entering a place or event 此義通常不可數，常見 free admission 或 admission is ten dollars。 承認，尤指不利於自己的事實 a statement accepting that something is true, especially something unfavorable 可數名詞，常見 an admission of guilt；an admission that 後接完整子句。
w_admonish

to speak firmly to someone about something wrong they have done 正式用語，常用 admonish someone for doing something；語氣通常嚴肅，但不一定大聲斥責。 告誡；鄭重勸告 to warn or strongly advise someone to do or avoid something 用 admonish someone to do something，或 not to do；也可用 against 加動名詞。
w_adolescent

relating to the stage of development between childhood and adulthood 常見 adolescent development 或 adolescent health；青春期的範圍並非在所有語境中都固定為十三至十九歲。 行為幼稚的；不成熟的 showing behavior considered immature 帶批評意味，常修飾 humor 或 behavior；形容成人時並非指實際年齡。 青少年 a young person developing from childhood into adulthood 可數名詞，較 teenager 偏正式，常見於教育、心理與醫療語境。
w_adoption

the act of beginning to use a method, policy, or idea 通常不可數，常用 the adoption of a policy；科技語境中的 user adoption 指使用者開始採用產品。 收養的法律程序 the legal process of becoming the parent of a child 可數或不可數，常見 adoption agency 或 put a child up for adoption；此義與採納方案不同。
w_adorn
to decorate something or make it more attractive 可用 adorn something with something，或讓裝飾物作主詞；語氣比 decorate 文雅。
w_advance

a forward movement or improvement 常見 an advance in medicine 或 technological advances；in 指取得進展的領域。 預付款 money paid before it is earned or before a service is completed 可數名詞，常用 an advance on someone's salary；in advance 是片語，意為事先。 價格或價值的上升 an increase in price or value 財經語境用法，常見 an advance in share prices；一般語境多用 increase 或 rise。 前進；取得進展 to move forward or make progress 可不及物，如 technology advances；也可及物，如 advance a cause「促進某項事業」。 提出觀點或論證 to put forward an idea or argument for consideration 正式用法，常接 theory、argument 或 proposal，不是把物體往前移。 將事件提前 to move an event to an earlier time 常用 advance a meeting to 加新時間；為避免歧義，實務溝通最好清楚寫出原時間與新時間。 預付；預支 to pay or lend money before it is due or earned 可用 advance someone money 或 advance money to someone；須依情境判斷是否需要歸還。
w_advent

the arrival or beginning of something important 通常用 the advent of，常描述新科技或新時代，而非一般人的日常到訪。 基督宗教聖誕節前的將臨期 the christian season of preparation before christmas 此義大寫為 advent；常見 advent calendar「將臨期日曆」，各教派禮儀安排可能不同。
w_adventure
an unusual and exciting experience, sometimes involving risk 具體經歷可數，如 an adventure；泛指追求刺激的活動時可不可數，如 a sense of adventure。
w_adverse
harmful or unfavorable 常見 adverse effects、adverse conditions；與 averse「不願意的、厭惡的」不同，後者常接 to。
w_advert
to refer to or draw attention to something 罕見的正式用法，用 advert to；日常談「做廣告」應用 advertise，不用此動詞義。 廣告 an advertisement 英式英語常用的可數名詞，相當於 advertisement；美式英語較常說 ad。
w_advertise
to promote a product, service, or event publicly 可及物，如 advertise a product；也可用 advertise for staff，表示登廣告徵人。 公開宣揚；使廣為人知 to make something widely known 不限商業廣告，如 advertise one's wealth；常帶刻意讓人注意的意味。
w_advisable
sensible and worth recommending 常用 it is advisable to do something；形容行動可取，與 available「可取得的」無關。
w_advocacy

public support for a cause, policy, or group 不可數名詞，常見 advocacy for patients 或 advocacy of reform；重點是積極主張、爭取支持。 法律程序中的代理辯護工作 the work of presenting arguments on behalf of someone in legal proceedings 法律語境，常見 advocacy skills；不只指支持某種理念，而是代表當事人陳述法律主張。
w_advocate

a person who publicly supports a cause or policy 可數名詞，常用 an advocate of reform 或 an advocate for patients；名詞重音通常在第一音節。 某些司法制度中的出庭律師或辯護人 a lawyer who represents someone in court in some legal systems 法律職稱因司法制度而異；一般學習時應依語境區分律師與普通的支持者。
w_aesthetic

relating to beauty or the appreciation of beauty 常見 aesthetic value 或 aesthetic appeal；不要與 anaesthetic「麻醉劑；麻醉的」混淆。 特定的美感風格或審美原則 a particular style or set of principles concerning beauty 此義可數，如 a minimalist aesthetic；aesthetics 則通常指美學這門學科。
w_affection
a warm feeling of fondness or care for someone or something 通常不可數，常用 affection for 或 show affection；不等於 affect「影響」。
w_affiliation
a formal connection with an organization or group 常用 affiliation with；學術論文的 institutional affiliation 指作者任職或所屬機構。
w_affinity

a natural liking for someone or something, or a similarity creating a close connection 常用 an affinity for a subject 或 an affinity with someone；不是刻意培養的忠誠。 物質或分子結合、反應的親和力 the tendency of substances or molecules to bind or react with each other 化學與免疫學用語，常見 binding affinity；抗體對抗原的 affinity 指結合的強弱。 由婚姻建立的親屬關係；姻親關係 kinship established through marriage 法律或人類學用語，常見 related by affinity；與 consanguinity「血親關係」相對。 共同特徵所顯示的生物親緣關係 a biological relationship indicated by shared characteristics 常見 evolutionary affinities；不能只憑單一外觀相似便確定演化上的近親關係。
w_affirm

to state firmly that something is true or valid 常用 affirm that 加子句，或 affirm a commitment；正式語氣，比 casually say 更鄭重。 維持下級法院的裁決 to uphold a lower court's decision 法律用語，常接 decision、judgment 或 conviction，表示上訴法院確認原判。
w_affix

to attach something firmly to something else 正式用法，常用 affix something to something；可指貼郵票、蓋章或加上簽名。 詞綴 a word element attached to a base to change its meaning or grammatical form 語言學中的可數名詞；prefix 是前綴，suffix 是後綴，兩者都是 affix。
w_afflict
to cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty 常用 be afflicted with 加疾病，或 be afflicted by 加問題；語氣正式且程度較重。
w_affliction
a condition or event that causes serious suffering 此義可數，常見 a chronic affliction；不可數用法則泛指痛苦或苦難。
w_affluence
the state of having a great deal of money and material wealth 不可數名詞，常見 growing affluence 或 a life of affluence；不要與 influence「影響」混淆。
w_affront
to offend someone openly or insult their dignity 及物動詞，常用 be affronted by；語氣較正式，強調尊嚴受到冒犯。 冒犯的言行 an action or remark that causes offense 可數名詞，常用 an affront to someone's dignity，to 引出受到冒犯的對象。
w_aftermath
the period and consequences following a serious or unpleasant event 通常用 the aftermath of 或 in the aftermath of，常描述災害、戰爭或危機之後。
w_aggravate
to make a problem, illness, or difficult situation worse 常接 injury、symptoms 或 a problem；與 alleviate「減輕」方向相反。 惹惱；使煩躁 to annoy or irritate someone 此義較口語，受詞通常是人；正式寫作若只表示惹惱，可選 annoy。
w_aggregate

a total formed by combining several amounts or items 常用 in aggregate「合計」或 in the aggregate「整體而言」；也可指集合而成的整體。 混凝土中的骨材，如砂或礫石 material such as sand or gravel mixed with cement to make concrete 工程用語，常作不可數名詞；fine aggregate 指細骨材，coarse aggregate 指粗骨材。 彙總；聚集 to combine separate amounts or items into a total or group 常接 data、results 或 demand；可用 aggregate something across regions，表示跨地區彙整。
w_aggression
hostile behavior or an attack intended to harm or dominate 通常不可數；人際語境指敵意或攻擊，國際關係中的 military aggression 指軍事侵略。
w_aggressive

ready to attack, threaten, or confront others 常修飾 behavior、tone 或 animal；不要將所有堅定表達都稱為 aggressive，assertive 可表示自信而有分寸。 積極進取的；強力推進的 pursuing a goal with strong energy and determination 商務中常見 aggressive marketing 或 an aggressive strategy；可能是中性描述，也可能暗示過度冒進。 迅速發展或擴散且危害嚴重的 growing or spreading rapidly and causing serious harm 醫學上常修飾 cancer 或 disease；描述疾病進展，不是病人的行為。
w_aghast
filled with shock, horror, or dismay 通常置於 be、look 等動詞後，常用 aghast at；不常直接放在名詞前。
w_agile
able to move quickly and easily 常形容運動員或動物，強調快速、靈活的身體移動。 思考敏捷的；應變靈活的 able to think or respond quickly and flexibly 可形容 mind、team 或 organization；軟體開發中的 agile development 通常譯作敏捷開發。
w_agility
the ability to move, think, or respond quickly and easily 不可數名詞，常見 physical agility、mental agility 或 organizational agility。
w_agitate

to campaign publicly for or against a change 常用 agitate for reform 或 agitate against a policy，主詞通常是倡議者或團體。 使焦慮；使不安 to make someone anxious or upset 常見 be agitated by 或 become agitated；指情緒受到擾動。 搖動；攪拌 to shake or stir a liquid or mixture 技術或操作語境，常接 solution 或 mixture；依操作情境決定是搖晃還是攪動。
w_agony
extreme physical pain or mental suffering 常用 in agony 或 the agony of；不要用來描述普通的小困擾，除非刻意誇張。
w_agrarian
relating to farming, farmland, or rural society 常見 agrarian reform「土地改革」或 an agrarian economy「農業經濟」。
w_agreeable

pleasant or enjoyable 可形容人、天氣或經驗；an agreeable person 表示性情討喜，並非凡事都同意的人。 願意接受的；可接受的 willing to accept something or finding it acceptable 常用 be agreeable to a proposal；也可說 if that is agreeable to you「如果你覺得可以」。
w_agriculture
the practice or industry of growing crops and raising farm animals 不可數名詞；從事農業的人是 farmers，不應把 agriculture 本身譯成農民階級。
w_ailment
an illness or health problem, often a minor one 可數名詞，常見 a minor ailment 或 common ailments；通常不用來強調重大急症。
w_aircraft
a vehicle capable of flying, such as an airplane or helicopter 單複數同形：one aircraft、two aircraft；範圍比 airplane 廣。
w_airtight

not allowing air to enter or escape 常修飾 container、seal 或 bag；存放食品時 an airtight container 指密封容器。 無懈可擊的；毫無破綻的 having no obvious weakness or possibility of being disproved 比喻用法，常見 an airtight alibi 或 an airtight argument。
w_aisle

a passage between rows of seats or shelves 可數名詞，常見 an aisle seat「走道座位」；s 不發音，不要與 isle「島」混淆拼字。 教堂的側廊 a part of a church alongside the nave, separated by columns 建築用語，與中央的 nave「中殿」區分；日常的 walk down the aisle 則常指步入婚姻。
w_alacrity
cheerful eagerness and readiness to act 不可數名詞，通常用 with alacrity；不只是身體動作快，還包含樂意配合。
w_alarm

a warning signal or a device that gives a warning 可數名詞，常見 fire alarm；set off an alarm 表示觸發警報。 因察覺危險而產生的驚恐 a feeling of fear caused by possible danger 此義不可數，常用 in alarm 或 cause alarm；不同於發出聲音的警報器。 使驚恐；使擔憂 to make someone frightened or worried about danger 及物動詞，常見 be alarmed by；do not be alarmed 常用來安撫對方。
w_alert

attentive and ready to notice or respond to danger or change 常用 remain alert 或 alert to signs of something，to 後接需要留意的事物。 警報；戒備狀態 a warning of danger or a state of readiness 發出的警報可數，如 a weather alert；on alert 表示處於戒備狀態。 提醒；警告 to warn someone about a danger or problem 用 alert someone to something；通知相關單位時也可直接說 alert the police。
w_alibi

evidence or an explanation showing that someone was elsewhere when a crime occurred 可數名詞，常見 provide an alibi 或 check an alibi；提出說法不表示已經證實。 推卸責任的藉口 an excuse used to avoid responsibility 非正式延伸義，常帶懷疑或批評，不一定與犯罪有關。 為某人提供不在場證明 to provide an alibi for someone 較少見的動詞用法，常見於犯罪敘事；一般表達可用 provide an alibi for。
w_alien

unfamiliar or very different from one's experience or values 常用 alien to someone；並非一律指外國，也可指不熟悉的觀念。 外來的；異域的 originating outside a particular country, environment, or world 生態學中的 alien species 指外來種，不一定都是具有破壞力的入侵種。
w_alienate

to make someone feel isolated or no longer supportive 常用 alienate someone from something；也可直接接 voters、customers 等原本可能支持的群體。 轉讓財產所有權 to transfer ownership of property to another person 法律用語，受詞通常是 property 或 land；與使人疏遠的常見義不同。
w_align

to arrange things in a straight line or correct position 常用 align something with something；排版中的 align left 指靠左對齊。 使目標、行動或觀點一致 to bring goals, actions, or views into agreement 常用 align something with something，或 align oneself with a group 表示支持該團體的立場。
w_alike
similar in appearance or character 通常放在 be、look 等動詞後；可說 the twins look alike，不說 two alike twins。 同樣地；相似地 in the same or a similar way 常見 think alike；接在兩類人事物後，如 children and adults alike，表示兩者都包括。
w_allay
to reduce fear, worry, or suspicion 常接 fears、concerns 或 suspicions；不是消除所有問題，而是使不安緩和。
w_allegation
a claim that someone has done something wrong, before it has been proved 可數名詞，常見 an allegation of fraud；不可把 allegation 本身當成已證實的事實。
w_allege
to claim that someone has done something wrong without yet proving it 常用 allege that 加子句，或 be alleged to have done something；新聞中的 allegedly 表示據稱。
w_allegiance
loyalty to a country, group, person, or cause 常用 allegiance to 或 pledge allegiance to，to 引出效忠對象。
w_allergic
having an allergy or caused by an allergy 用 allergic to 加過敏原；an allergic reaction 指過敏反應，不等於所有食物不耐症。 非常反感的 having a strong dislike of something 口語比喻用法，常用 allergic to hard work；不表示實際的免疫反應。
w_alley
a narrow passage or street between buildings 可數名詞，常見 a narrow alley 或 a back alley；不要與 ally「盟友」混淆。
w_alliance
an agreement or association formed for mutual support 常用 form an alliance with 或 an alliance between；可指國家、政黨或企業之間的合作。
w_allocate

to officially give a share of something to a particular person, purpose, or process allocate 是「有計畫地把有限資源撥給特定用途」，因此常與預算、時間、人力、記憶體搭配。句型是 allocate a to b 或 allocate b a。在程式設計中，allocate memory（配置記憶體）是核心術語，對應的釋放動作是 free 或 deallocate。 allocate a to b allocate + noun + for + purpose allocate resources 分配資源 allocate a budget 編列預算 allocate memory 配置記憶體 allocate time to 撥出時間給…… assign apportion withhold allocation reallocate distribute
w_allowance

a regular sum of money provided for personal needs or expenses 可數名詞，常見 a travel allowance 或 a weekly allowance；通常是定期或依特定用途發給。 允許的額度；配額 an amount that is permitted or allocated 常見 baggage allowance 或 daily allowance；數值通常與規則或標準有關。 考量特定情況所作的調整或寬容 an adjustment made to take particular circumstances into account 常用 make allowances for；可指金額上的折讓，也可指理解他人的困難。
w_allude
to refer to something indirectly 必須用 allude to，不能直接接受詞；與直接詳述不同。
w_ally

to be disloyal to someone, or to unintentionally reveal something 常見 betray a friend/trust，也可指無意中流露情緒，如 his voice betrayed his nervousness。
w_bias

an unfair or systematic tendency to favour one thing over another, often without realising it bias 有兩層用法。日常語境中指「不公平的成見」，帶有道德批評；統計與機器學習語境中則是中性的技術詞，指「系統性偏離真值」。這個區別很重要：說一個模型 has bias 未必是指控它有偏見，可能只是在描述它的誤差結構。介系詞用 towards 或 against。 bias towards/against + noun a bias in + noun confirmation bias 確認偏誤 selection bias 選樣偏誤 a bias towards 偏向…… guard against bias 防範偏誤 prejudice skew impartiality biased unbiased skew
w_bibliography
a list of the books and sources referred to in a piece of academic work 常見於學術論文結尾，列出引用或參考的文獻資料。
w_bile
a bitter fluid produced by the liver that aids digestion, or (figuratively) bitterness and anger 字面指消化液，比喻用法則指心中的怨恨或不滿，如 vent one's bile。
w_bilingual
able to speak two languages fluently, or involving two languages 常見 a bilingual education、bilingual speaker，可修飾人或政策制度。
w_billow
a large mass of something, such as smoke or cloth, that swells or surges 常見 billows of smoke，形容如波浪般翻湧的煙霧或雲團。 翻湧；飄動 to rise, swell, or move in large waves or masses 常見 billow out/up，形容布料、煙霧因風而膨脹翻動的樣子。
w_bind
to tie or fasten securely, or to create a legal or moral obligation 可指實體上的綁緊（bind a wound），也可指契約或承諾具約束力（legally bound）。
w_biography
an account of a person's life written by someone else 常見 an authorized biography，指詳述某人生平的書面記述。
w_biologist
a scientist who studies living organisms 指從事生物學研究的專業人士，常見於學術或科學新聞語境。
w_biology
the scientific study of living organisms and their processes 常見學科名稱，如 study biology，也可泛指某生物的生理機制，如 human biology。
w_bite
the act of biting, or a small amount of food eaten 常見 take a bite、a mosquito bite，指咬合動作或被咬造成的傷口。
w_bizarre
strikingly unusual or strange 常修飾難以理解或超乎常理的事件，如 a bizarre coincidence，語氣中性偏驚訝。
w_blade
the flat cutting part of a knife or tool, or a leaf of grass 可指刀具鋒利部位，也可指細長草葉，如 a blade of grass，須依語境判斷。
w_blame
responsibility for a fault or wrong 常見 take the blame、place blame on，指對錯誤或過失的歸咎。 責備；歸咎於 to hold someone responsible for a fault or wrong 常見 blame someone for something，也可用 be to blame 表達誰該負責。
w_bland
lacking strong flavor, or lacking interesting or distinctive qualities 可形容食物味道清淡，也可形容個性或風格單調無趣，如 a bland personality。
w_blank

an empty space on a form or document to be filled in 常見 fill in the blank，指表格或文件中留待填寫的空白欄位。 空白的；茫然的 having nothing written, printed, or recorded on it; showing no expression 可指紙張未書寫（a blank page），也可形容表情空洞、毫無反應（a blank stare）。 腦筋一片空白；故意忽視 to make one's mind suddenly go empty, or to ignore someone completely 常見 blank on something（想不起來）或口語 blank someone（故意不理睬）。
w_blanket

a large piece of soft fabric used for warmth, or something that covers a wide area 常見 a wool blanket，也可比喻指全面覆蓋的事物，如 a blanket of snow。 覆蓋；籠罩 to cover something completely, as if with a blanket 常見被動語態 be blanketed in/with，形容雪、霧等大面積覆蓋景象。
w_blast

a sudden violent explosion, or a strong rush of air 常見 a bomb blast，也可指強風或聲響，如 a blast of cold air。 爆破；猛烈抨擊 to cause an explosion, or to criticize harshly 字面指用炸藥破壞物體；比喻用法指言詞上強烈批評，如 blast the government's policy。
w_blatant
completely obvious and done without any attempt at concealment, especially of something wrong 常見 a blatant lie、blatant disregard，強調毫不掩飾地做出不當行為，帶明顯負面評價。
w_bleach

to make something white or pale by removing its color 常見 bleach one's hair、bleach the fabric，指透過化學方式去除顏色。 漂白劑 a chemical substance used to whiten fabric or remove stains 常見於家用清潔用品，如 chlorine bleach，指用於去漬或殺菌的化學藥劑。
w_bleak
lacking hope or encouragement; depressing, or (of weather) cold and grim 常修飾 future、outlook 或 landscape，形容缺乏希望或景象淒涼的狀態。
w_bleed
to lose blood as a result of injury, or to extort money from someone 字面指身體傷口流血；比喻用法 bleed someone dry 指榨取某人的金錢，語氣負面。
w_blend

to mix different substances or elements together thoroughly 常見 blend ingredients together，也可比喻指風格或元素的融合，如 blend tradition with modernity。 混合物；混合體 a mixture of different substances, styles, or qualities 常見 a blend of coffee beans，也可指抽象概念的融合，如 a blend of humor and drama。
w_bless
to ask for god's favor and protection for someone, or to be fortunate to have something 常見 bless someone with something，也可用宗教儀式中的祝禱，如 bless the food。
w_blight

a plant disease that causes withering, or something that damages or spoils an area 字面指植物病害，如 potato blight；引申可指造成破壞或衰敗的因素，如 urban blight。 破壞；使衰敗 to cause severe harm or damage to something over a long period 常見被動語態 be blighted by，形容地區或事物長期受到某種問題的損害。
w_blink

to shut and open the eyes quickly, or to flash on and off 常見 blink one's eyes，也可形容燈光間歇閃爍，如 the cursor blinks。 一瞬間；眨眼 a very short instant, or a quick opening and closing of the eyes 常見 in the blink of an eye，表示極短的時間，語氣生動口語化。
w_blockade

an action to seal off a place to prevent goods or people from entering or leaving 常見軍事或政治語境，如 a naval blockade，指以武力或手段阻斷通行。 封鎖 to seal off a place to prevent entry or exit 常接受詞為地點，如 blockade a port/city，強調阻斷進出的行動。
w_blond
(especially of hair) light-colored, typically pale yellow 多用於形容男性頭髮顏色；blonde 則常用於形容女性或作名詞，兩者拼法有性別區分傳統。 金髮男子 a person, especially a man, with light-colored hair 作名詞時指金髮的人，傳統上 blond 指男性，blonde 指女性。
w_blonde
(especially of hair) light-colored, typically pale yellow 傳統拼法用於形容女性頭髮，現代英語中兩種拼法也常交替使用而不嚴格區分。 金髮女子 a woman with light-colored hair 作名詞時傳統上指金髮女性，現代用法也可泛指任何金髮的人。
w_bloom

a flower, or the state of flowering; a period of peak health or beauty 常見 in full bloom，也可比喻指人生或事物最美好的階段，如 the bloom of youth。 開花；茁壯發展 (of a plant) to produce flowers; to flourish or reach a peak of development 字面指植物開花；比喻用法指人或事物蓬勃發展，如 her career bloomed。
w_blossom
(of a plant) to produce flowers, or to develop and flourish 字面用於植物開花；比喻用法常見 blossom into，指人或事物逐漸成長茁壯。
w_blouse
a loose-fitting upper garment worn by women 通常指女性穿著的寬鬆上衣，材質多為輕薄布料，區別於男性穿的 shirt。
w_blur
to become or make something unclear or difficult to see clearly 常見 blur the line between（模糊界線），也可指視覺上失焦，如 tears blurred her vision。
w_blurt
to say something suddenly and without thinking 常見 blurt out，強調未經思考、衝動地說出話語，語氣帶輕微負面或尷尬意味。
w_blush

(of a person's face) to become red, typically from embarrassment or shame 常見 blush with embarrassment，形容因害羞或尷尬而臉部泛紅。 臉紅 a reddening of the face caused by embarrassment or shame 常見 bring a blush to someone's cheeks，指臉部泛紅的現象本身。
w_boast
an act of speaking with excessive pride about oneself or one's achievements 常見 make a boast，指帶有炫耀意味的言論，語氣略帶負面。
w_bode
to be a sign of something, especially something bad, that will happen in the future 常見固定搭配 bode well/ill for，表示對未來發展是好兆頭或壞兆頭。
w_bogus
not genuine or legitimate; fake 常見 a bogus claim/company，語氣直接指出某事物具有欺騙性，屬較口語的用詞。
w_bohemian

a person, especially an artist or writer, who lives in an unconventional way 常指過著非傳統、追求自由生活方式的藝術工作者，帶浪漫色彩。 波希米亞風格的；不拘傳統的 relating to or characteristic of an unconventional lifestyle, especially among artists 常修飾 lifestyle 或 style，形容自由隨性、不受傳統束縛的生活態度或風格。
w_boil

a painful, inflamed swelling on the skin containing pus 醫學或日常用語，指皮膚上因感染形成的腫脹，與動詞「煮沸」義無關。 煮沸；沸騰 (of a liquid) to reach the temperature at which it turns to vapor, or to cook something in boiling water 常見 boil water、boil an egg，也可比喻指情緒激動，如 boil with anger。
w_bold
confident and courageous, or (of text) printed in a heavy typeface 可形容人勇於冒險的性格，也可指印刷字體的樣式，如 bold text，須依語境判斷。
w_bolster
a long, firm pillow placed under other pillows for support 常見於床上用品，指置於一般枕頭下方作支撐用的長條枕。 支撐；增強 to support, strengthen, or improve something 常見 bolster confidence/economy，強調透過某種手段加強或鞏固既有的事物。
w_bolt
a metal pin used to fasten things together, or a sudden quick movement 常見 nuts and bolts，也可指突然的快速動作，如 make a bolt for the door。
w_bombardment
a sustained attack with bombs, shells, or (figuratively) an overwhelming amount of something 字面指軍事上持續猛烈的攻擊；比喻用法常見 a bombardment of questions，指大量湧來的事物。
w_bombastic
(of speech or writing) using inflated, pompous language to impress 常修飾 speech、rhetoric，語氣帶明顯負面評價，指言詞浮誇卻空洞。
w_bond
a close connection between people, or a certificate of debt issued by a government or company 可指人際間的情感連結（a bond of trust），也可指金融投資工具（government bonds），須視語境判斷。
w_bonus
an extra payment or benefit given in addition to what is expected 常見 a christmas bonus、an added bonus，指超出預期的額外報酬或優點。
w_booklet
a small, thin book, usually with a paper cover 常見於說明手冊、簡介文件，如 an information booklet，指頁數較少的小型書冊。
w_bookshop
a shop that sells books 英式英語用詞，美式英語多用 bookstore，兩者意義相同。
w_boom
a period of rapid economic growth, or a deep, loud sound 可指經濟蓬勃發展的時期（an economic boom），也可指低沉巨響，須依語境判斷。
w_boost

an increase or improvement in something, or an act of encouragement 常見 a boost in sales/confidence，指數量或士氣上的提升。 提升；提高 to increase, improve, or raise the level of something 常見 boost morale/sales，強調使某事物的數值或水準提高。
w_booth
a small enclosed structure or partitioned area used for a specific purpose 常見 a phone booth、a voting booth，指用於特定用途的小型隔間或攤位。
w_boulder
a large rock, typically one that has been worn smooth by erosion 常見於自然地形描述，指體積龐大、經風化侵蝕而顯圓滑的岩石。
w_bounce

the action of springing back after hitting a surface, or a lively quality 字面指物體撞擊後彈起的動作；也可比喻形容人充滿活力的樣子，如 have a bounce in one's step。 反彈；彈跳 to spring back after hitting a surface 常見 bounce off/back，也可比喻指經濟或情緒的回升，如 bounce back from failure。
w_boundary
a line that marks the limits of an area, or a limit on behavior or ideas 可指實際地理界線（a national boundary），也可比喻指行為或關係的限度，如 set boundaries。
w_bourgeois

a member of the middle class, especially regarded as concerned with respectability and material values 帶輕微負面評價色彩，常見於社會學或馬克思主義論述，指過度重視物質與體面的階層。 中產階級的；世俗保守的 relating to or characteristic of the middle class, especially regarding materialism or conventionality 常修飾 values、lifestyle，帶批判意味，暗指過於重視物質享受與傳統體面。
w_bout
a short period of illness or activity, or a boxing/wrestling match 可指疾病發作的一段時間（a bout of flu），也可指拳擊等對抗性比賽，須依語境判斷。
w_bowel
the intestine, especially the lower part 醫學常用詞，常見複數 bowels，如 bowel movement（排便），語氣較 gut 正式。
w_boycott

a refusal to buy, use, or participate in something as a form of protest 常見 call for a boycott，指集體拒絕與某對象往來以表達抗議。 抵制 to refuse to buy, use, or participate in something as a form of protest 常見 boycott a product/company，強調主動拒絕參與或購買以示抗議。
w_brace
a device that supports or strengthens something, such as a body part or structure 常見 a knee brace、dental braces，指用來支撐或固定的裝置。
w_bracket
a category within defined limits, or a support fixed to a wall to hold something 可指分類區間（tax bracket），也可指實體支撐物（a shelf bracket），須依語境判斷。
w_braid

a length of hair or fabric formed by interweaving three or more strands 常見 hair braid，指頭髮或布料經編織而成的長條狀物。 編辮子；編織 to interweave three or more strands of hair, thread, or rope 常見 braid one's hair，指將多股材料交織編成辮狀。
w_brake
a device used to slow down or stop a vehicle, or something that slows a process 字面指交通工具的煞車裝置；比喻用法指抑制或減緩事物發展的因素，如 put the brakes on。
w_brand

a type of product manufactured by a particular company under a particular name 常見 a well-known brand，指企業用以區別產品的名稱或標誌。 打烙印於；貼上(負面)標籤 to mark with a hot iron to show ownership, or to label someone unfairly with a negative description 字面指用烙鐵標記牲畜；比喻用法指給人貼上不公正的標籤，如 be branded a liar。
w_brandish
to wave or hold up something, especially a weapon, in a threatening or excited way 常見 brandish a weapon/knife，強調帶有威脅性或激動情緒的揮動動作。
w_brash
self-confident in a rude, overly assertive way 常修飾 young man、attitude，帶負面評價，形容過於自信而顯得無禮或急躁。
w_brass
a yellow metal alloy of copper and zinc, or musical instruments made from it 可指金屬材質本身，也可指銅管樂器組（the brass section），須依語境判斷。
w_brawl
a rough or noisy fight, typically in a public place 常見 a bar brawl，指發生在公共場合、較為粗暴混亂的打鬥或爭執。 鬥毆；吵架 to fight or quarrel in a noisy, rough way 常見 brawl in the street，強調肢體衝突且伴隨喧鬧的爭吵場面。
w_brazen

bold and shameless, without regard for the reactions of others 常修飾 lie、attempt，強調毫不掩飾、不顧他人觀感的大膽行為，帶強烈負面評價。 厚著臉皮應付 to face or endure a difficult situation with bold confidence, despite feeling embarrassed 常見固定片語 brazen it out，指以無所謂的態度硬撐過尷尬或困難的處境。
w_breach
an act of breaking a law, agreement, or code of conduct, or a gap in a barrier 常見 a breach of contract/security，指未能履行義務或安全防護出現漏洞。
w_breakdown
a failure to function properly, or a detailed analysis of something 可指機械或關係的失靈（a mental breakdown），也可指資料的詳細分類，如 a cost breakdown。
w_breakthrough
a sudden, important discovery or development that overcomes a previous obstacle 常見 a scientific/medical breakthrough，指在困境或研究中取得重大進展。
w_breed

a particular type of animal or plant developed through selective breeding 常見 a breed of dog，也可比喻用於指某類人，如 a new breed of entrepreneur。 繁殖；引起 to keep animals for the purpose of producing offspring, or to cause something to develop 字面指飼養動物繁衍後代（breed horses）；比喻用法指造成某種情況，如 poverty breeds crime。
w_breeze
a gentle wind, or something that is easy to do 字面指涼爽宜人的風；比喻用法 a breeze，指非常容易完成的事情，語氣口語化。 輕鬆地走；快速通過 to move somewhere quickly and confidently, without difficulty 常見 breeze through/into，強調毫不費力地完成或通過某事。
w_bribe

money or a favor given to someone to influence their behavior dishonestly 常見 offer/take a bribe，指以不正當手段換取利益的財物或好處。 賄賂；收買 to persuade someone to act dishonestly by giving them money or a favor 常見 bribe someone to do something，強調透過金錢誘使對方違背原則。
w_brick
a rectangular block of baked clay used for building 常見 a brick wall/house，指建築材料，也可比喻形容人可靠，如 a real brick（少見用法，此處聚焦建材義）。
w_brief

a document that summarizes the facts and legal points of a case, or a set of instructions 常見於法律文件（a legal brief）或工作指示（a project brief），指精簡概述重點的文件。 簡短的；短暫的 lasting only a short time, or concise 常見 a brief meeting、a brief explanation，形容時間短或內容精簡扼要。 作簡報；下達指示 to give someone essential information or instructions before an important task 常見 brief someone on something，強調在任務執行前提供必要資訊。
w_brim

the upper edge of a container, or the projecting edge of a hat 常見 filled to the brim（滿到邊緣）、the brim of a hat，指容器頂端或帽子外緣。 滿溢；充滿 to be completely full to the point of overflowing 常見 brim with confidence/tears，形容情緒或液體滿溢欲出的狀態，語氣較文學化。
w_brisk
to become lively or energetic 此動詞用法較少見，日常英語更常用形容詞 brisk 描述動作或步伐輕快，如 a brisk walk。
w_bristle

a short, stiff hair, especially on an animal or a brush 常見於刷子或動物毛髮描述，如 the bristles of a toothbrush，指堅硬且短的毛狀物。 豎起；勃然大怒 (of hair) to stand up stiffly, especially in anger or fear; to react with anger 字面指毛髮因驚嚇而豎起；比喻用法 bristle at/with，形容對批評或冒犯感到憤怒。
w_brittle
hard but easily broken; fragile 字面形容物理材質易碎，如 brittle glass；也可比喻形容個性或關係脆弱敏感。
w_broach
to raise a sensitive or difficult topic for discussion 常見 broach the subject of，強調小心謹慎地開啟一個可能敏感的話題。
w_brochure
a small booklet or pamphlet containing information or advertising 常見 a travel brochure，指用來介紹產品、服務或旅遊地點的印刷品。
w_broil
to cook food by direct exposure to intense heat, or to become extremely hot 字面指用直火燒烤食物（broil a steak）；也可形容天氣極度炎熱，如 broiling in the sun。
w_bronze
a hard, brownish alloy of copper and tin, or an object made from it 常見 a bronze statue、bronze medal，指此合金材質或以此製成的物品。 青銅色的 made of, or having the color of, bronze 常修飾 skin、medal，形容物體呈現金屬光澤的褐黃色。
w_brood
a family of young animals, especially birds, produced at one time 常見於鳥類或動物描述，指同一批孵化或生產的幼體。 沉思；憂慮 to think deeply and anxiously about something troubling 常見 brood over/about，強調反覆思考令人不安或煩惱的事，語氣帶負面情緒。
w_browse

to look through or read something casually without a specific purpose 常見 browse the internet/a store，強調隨意查看而非有目的地搜尋。 瀏覽 an act of looking through something casually 名詞用法較少見，多見於固定搭配 have a browse，指隨意查看一下的動作。
w_brutal
savagely violent, or unpleasantly direct and harsh 可形容暴力行為（a brutal attack），也可形容言詞直白不留情面，如 brutal honesty。
w_brute
a cruel or violent person, or an animal 常帶負面評價，形容行為粗暴殘忍之人，也可泛指動物（相對於人類）。 純粹體力的；蠻力的 relating to physical strength rather than intelligence or reasoning 常見 brute force/strength，指單純依靠力量而非策略或智慧，語氣中性偏描述性。
w_bubble

a thin, spherical film of liquid enclosing gas, or an unsustainable period of economic growth 字面指氣泡（soap bubble）；比喻用法常見 a housing bubble，指不切實際的經濟繁榮現象。 冒泡；洋溢(情緒) to form or produce bubbles, or to be full of a lively emotion 字面指液體冒泡；比喻用法常見 bubble with excitement，形容情緒高漲難以抑制。
w_buck

a dollar (informal), or an adult male deer 口語用法指美元，如 make a quick buck；也可指雄性鹿類動物，須依語境判斷。 反抗；抵制 to resist or oppose something, especially a trend or authority 常見 buck the trend，指違背普遍趨勢或既定規則行事，語氣帶主動反抗意味。
w_bucket

w_bunch

w_buoy

w_buoyant
able to float, or cheerful and optimistic 字面形容物體能浮於水面；比喻用法形容心情愉快、充滿活力，如 a buoyant mood。

w_bureaucracy

w_cable

w_cadence
the rhythmic flow or beat of sound, especially in speech or music 常見於描述說話或音樂的抑揚頓挫，如 the cadence of her voice，語氣較文學化。

w_calm

truthful and straightforward, especially about something difficult or sensitive 常見 to be candid about，強調誠實表達意見而不隱瞞，語氣正面但也可能顯得直接。

w_canvas

w_canyon

w_carrot

w_cart

a small vehicle with wheels used for carrying goods, often pushed or pulled by hand 常見 a shopping cart，指用於搬運貨物的輕型車輛，通常人力操作。 用車搬運；搬運(沉重物品) to transport something in a cart, or to carry something heavy or awkward 常見 cart something around，也可比喻指費力搬運或攜帶笨重的東西。
w_cartoon

a humorous drawing, or an animated film 常見於報章雜誌的諷刺畫，也可指動畫作品，如 watch cartoons on saturday morning。 把...畫成漫畫 to depict someone or something in a humorous or satirical drawing 常見於媒體語境，指以誇張或諷刺手法將人物或事件繪製成漫畫形式。

w_cassette

w_casual
relaxed and informal, or happening without much thought or planning 常見 casual clothing、a casual remark，形容輕鬆不拘謹的態度、服裝或言行。

stated clearly and directly, without exception or qualification 常見 a categorical denial，強調毫無保留、斬釘截鐵的陳述，語氣正式強烈。
w_cater
to provide food and drinks for an event, or to satisfy the needs of a particular group 常見 cater a wedding，也可比喻指針對特定對象提供服務，如 cater to tourists。
w_cathedral

w_caucus

a large natural underground hollow, often with an opening to the surface 常見 explore a cave，指地下天然形成、通常有出入口的空間。 坍塌；屈服 to collapse inward, or to give in to pressure or persuasion 常見固定片語 cave in，字面指結構崩塌，比喻用法指最終讓步或妥協。

w_celebrity

w_champion

w_chaos

w_characteristic

w_characterization
the way a person or thing is described or portrayed 常用於文學或戲劇評論，指作者如何刻劃人物性格與形象。
w_characterize
to describe the typical qualities of someone or something 常用被動式 be characterized by，表示某事物以某種特質為顯著標誌。
w_charity
an organization that helps people in need, or the giving of such help 可指具體組織（a charity）或抽象行為（give to charity），常見 charity event（慈善活動）。
w_charm

a quality that makes someone or something attractive or delightful 不可數，常見 personal charm，形容討人喜歡的特質，語氣正面。 迷住；使著迷 to please or attract someone greatly 及物動詞，常見 charm someone into doing something，帶有巧妙說服的意味。
w_chart
a diagram or graph that displays information 常見 bar chart、flow chart，指以視覺方式呈現資料的圖形。 規劃；記錄（進展、路線） to plan or track the course of something 常見 chart a course（規劃路線）或 chart progress（追蹤進度），語氣正式。
w_charter

a formal document granting rights or defining an organization's principles 常見 the un charter（聯合國憲章），指具法律或組織效力的正式文件。 包租（船、飛機等） to hire a vehicle or vessel for exclusive use 常見 charter a boat／plane，指整艘或整架包下供私人或團體使用。
w_chase
to run after someone or something in order to catch them 及物動詞，可接人或物；也可比喻性地用於 chase a dream（追求夢想）。 追逐；追捕 an act of pursuing someone or something 常見 a car chase（飛車追逐），也用於 give chase（展開追逐）。
w_chastise
to criticize or reprimand someone severely 語氣正式且帶有權威意味，常見於長輩對晚輩或上司對下屬的責備。
w_chat
an informal conversation 不可數或可數皆可，常見 have a chat with someone，語氣輕鬆隨意。
w_cheerful
feeling or showing happiness and positivity 常修飾人的個性或語氣，如 a cheerful smile，語氣正面且日常。
w_chef
a professional cook, especially the head cook in a restaurant 通常指專業廚師，尤指餐廳的主廚，語氣比 cook 更正式且帶有專業意涵。
w_chemist
a scientist who studies chemistry, or (british) a pharmacist 英式英語中也指藥局或藥師，美式英語則多用 pharmacist 表達後者。
w_chew
to crush food repeatedly with the teeth before swallowing 及物或不及物皆可，常見 chew food thoroughly，強調充分咀嚼以利消化。
w_chic
stylish and fashionable 常修飾服裝、裝潢等，帶有法式優雅的語感，語氣正面且略帶高級感。
w_chicanery
the use of deception or trickery, especially in legal or political matters 語氣正式且帶負面色彩，常用於指責政治或商業上的狡詐行為。
w_chide
to scold someone gently for a minor fault 語氣比 scold 溫和，常用於長輩對晚輩略帶關心的責備。
w_chill
an unpleasant feeling of coldness, or a feeling of fear 可指天氣的涼意，也可比喻性地形容因恐懼而生的寒意，如 a chill ran down her spine。 使冷卻；（口語）放鬆 to make something cold, or to relax 及物動詞指冷藏食物飲料，如 chill the wine；口語用法則指放鬆休息。
w_chin
the part of the face below the mouth 日常詞彙，常用於描述臉部特徵或動作，如 rest one's chin on one's hand。
w_chip
a small piece broken off something, or a small electronic circuit 可指物體碎片（wood chip）或電子元件（computer chip），依語境判斷詞義。
w_chisel
a tool with a sharp edge used for cutting or shaping wood, stone, or metal 工具類名詞，常見於木工或雕刻情境，如 hammer and chisel。
w_choir
an organized group of singers, especially one that performs in church 常見 church choir、school choir，指有組織地一起演唱的團體。
w_choke
to have difficulty breathing because the throat is blocked 可及物（choke someone）或不及物（choke on food），常見 choke on a bone。
w_chop
a cut of meat still attached to a bone, or a sharp cutting blow 常見 pork chop（豬排），也可指用力劈砍的動作。
w_chord
a group of musical notes played together in harmony 音樂術語，常見 play a chord，指同時彈奏的多個音符組合。
w_chore
a routine task, especially a household one 常見 household chore、daily chore，指例行且略顯乏味的任務。
w_choreography
the arrangement of dance movements for a performance 常見 stage choreography，指為表演設計並安排的舞步動作。
w_chorus
a part of a song repeated after each verse, or a group singing together 音樂用語，可指反覆演唱的段落，也可指一群人共同演唱的團體。
w_chromosome
a structure in a cell that carries genetic information 生物學術語，常見 human chromosome，指細胞內攜帶遺傳訊息的結構。
w_chronic
persisting for a long time or constantly recurring 常修飾疾病或問題，如 chronic pain（慢性疼痛），與急性 acute 相對。
w_chronology
the arrangement of events in the order they occurred 常見 in chronological order，指依時間先後排列事件的方式。
w_chuckle
to laugh quietly 語氣比 laugh 輕柔，通常表示對某事感到有趣但不張揚地笑出聲。
w_chunk
a thick, solid piece of something 常見 a chunk of，可指實體的一大塊，也可比喻性地指時間或金錢的一大部分。
w_circuit
a closed path along which an electric current flows, or a circular route 可指電子迴路（electric circuit），也可指運動或表演的巡迴路線（tennis circuit）。
w_circular
shaped like a circle, or (of reasoning) illogically self-referential 可描述形狀（circular table），也可指邏輯上互為前提的謬誤論證（circular reasoning）。
w_circulate
to move continuously through a system, or to distribute information 可指物理性的流通（blood circulates），也可指資訊或文件的散布（circulate a memo）。
w_circulation
the movement of blood through the body, or the distribution of publications 醫學上指血液流動，出版業則指報刊雜誌的發行數量，如 the magazine's circulation。
w_circumference
the distance around a circle or circular object 幾何學術語，常見 the circumference of a circle，計算方式為直徑乘以圓周率。
w_circumspect
cautious and careful to consider possible consequences 語氣正式，常用於描述決策或發言時的謹慎態度，帶有深思熟慮的意味。
w_circumstantial
based on inference rather than direct evidence 常見於法律用語 circumstantial evidence（間接證據），指非直接目擊但可推論出結論的證據。
w_circus
a traveling company that performs acrobatics, animal acts, and other shows 常見 go to the circus，也可比喻性地形容混亂喧鬧的場面（a media circus）。
w_citation
a quoted reference to a source, or an official notice for a violation 學術上指引用出處，也可指警方開立的違規通知，如 a parking citation。
w_cite
to quote a source as evidence, or to officially summon someone 學術寫作中指引用文獻，法律或執法情境則指正式傳喚或開立罰單。
w_citizenship
the legal status of being a citizen of a particular country 不可數名詞，常見 apply for citizenship，指經法律程序取得的國家公民資格。
w_civic
relating to a city or town, or to citizens and their responsibilities 常見 civic duty（公民義務）、civic pride（市民榮譽感），強調公共事務層面。
w_civilian

a person who is not a member of the armed forces or police 常與軍人或警察相對，強調非軍職身分，如 civilian casualties（平民傷亡）。 平民的；非軍職的 relating to people who are not members of the armed forces 常修飾生活或身分，如 civilian life（平民生活），與軍事身分相對。
w_civility
polite, courteous behavior 不可數名詞，常用於描述人際互動中應有的基本禮儀，尤其在公共討論中。
w_civilization
an advanced and organized society, or human society as a whole 可指特定的古文明（ancient civilization），也可泛指人類整體社會發展。
w_clamor

a loud, confused noise, especially of shouting 不可數名詞，常見 a clamor of voices，也可比喻性地指強烈的公眾訴求（a clamor for change）。 大聲要求；強烈呼籲 to shout or demand something loudly and insistently 常接 for，如 clamor for reform，表示大聲、堅持地要求某事發生。
w_clamp
a device used to hold objects firmly together 工具類名詞，常見於木工或機械情境，用來固定物體使其不移動。 夾緊；固定 to fasten or hold something firmly with a clamp 及物動詞，也常見片語 clamp down on（嚴加取締），表示加強管制或鎮壓。
w_clan
a group of families united by kinship or a common ancestor 常見於蘇格蘭傳統或人類學語境，指以血緣或共同祖先連結的社群。
w_clarify
to make something clearer or easier to understand 及物動詞，常見 clarify a point／statement，用於消除誤解或補充說明。
w_clarity
the quality of being clear and easy to understand 不可數名詞，常見 clarity of thought／expression，強調表達或思路的清楚明確。
w_clash

a violent confrontation, or a serious disagreement 可指實際的武力衝突（armed clash），也可指意見或風格上的不合（a clash of opinions）。 發生衝突；牴觸；（顏色）不搭調 to fight or disagree strongly, or (of colors/styles) to look unpleasant together 可用於人際或團體衝突，也可用於描述顏色或風格不協調，如 colors that clash。
w_classification
the act of arranging things into categories 常見 scientific classification，指依特定標準將事物系統性地歸入類別。
w_classify
to arrange things into categories according to shared characteristics 及物動詞，常見 classify something as，表示依標準將事物歸入某一類別。
w_clause
a part of a sentence with its own subject and verb, or a section of a legal document 語法上指含主詞與動詞的句子單位，法律上則指合約或法規中的個別條款。
w_clay
a natural, sticky earth material used for making pottery and bricks 不可數名詞，常見 clay pottery，指用來製作陶器或磚塊的天然材料。
w_clearance
official permission or approval, or the act of removing obstructions 可指正式核准（security clearance），也可指清除障礙物或存貨（a clearance sale）。
w_clement
(of weather) mild and pleasant 語氣正式且較少見，通常僅用於描述天氣，與 harsh 或 severe 相對。
w_clench
to close tightly, especially the fist or teeth 及物動詞，常見 clench one's fist／teeth，表示因憤怒或緊張而用力收緊。
w_clerk
a person who works in an office doing administrative tasks, or a shop assistant 英式英語多指辦公室文書人員，美式英語則常指商店的銷售或收銀人員。
w_click
a short, sharp sound, or the act of pressing a mouse button 可指聲音本身，也可指電腦操作中按下滑鼠按鍵的動作。 發出喀嗒聲；點擊 to make a short, sharp sound, or to press a mouse button 及物或不及物皆可，常見 click on a link，指用滑鼠點選網路連結。
w_cliff
a steep rock face, especially at the edge of the sea 常見 sea cliff，指陡峭的岩壁，尤指海岸邊緣的地形。
w_climate
the general weather conditions of an area over time, or a prevailing atmosphere 可指天氣型態（tropical climate），也可比喻性地形容社會或政治氛圍（political climate）。
w_clinch
to settle a deal or contest decisively 及物動詞，常見 clinch a deal／victory，表示最終確定或贏得某項結果。
w_cling
to hold on tightly, or to remain attached to something 常接 to，如 cling to hope／a belief，可指實體抓握，也可比喻性地形容堅持不放。
w_clinic
a facility that provides medical treatment, often for outpatients 常見 dental clinic、health clinic，指提供醫療服務的場所，通常規模較醫院小。
w_clinical
relating to the direct observation and treatment of patients, or coldly objective 醫學上指與病患診療直接相關（clinical trial），也可比喻性地形容態度冷靜甚至冷漠。
w_clip
a device for fastening things together, or a short extract from a film 可指實體夾具（paper clip），也可指影片或音樂的一小段（a video clip）。
w_clog
something that blocks a passage, or a type of wooden shoe 可指造成阻塞的物體（a clog in the pipe），也可指傳統的木製鞋子。 堵塞；阻塞 to block a passage so that movement is difficult 及物動詞，常見 clog the drain／traffic，表示使通道受阻而難以通行。
w_closet
a small room or cabinet used for storage, especially of clothes 美式英語常用詞，相當於英式英語的 wardrobe，指存放衣物或雜物的空間。
w_closure
the act of closing something permanently, or a sense of resolution 可指實體或機構的關閉（factory closure），也可指情感上獲得的解脫感（emotional closure）。
w_clot
a thickened, semi-solid mass, especially of blood 醫學上常見 blood clot，指血液凝結形成的塊狀物，可能引發健康風險。
w_clout
influence or power, especially in politics or business 不可數名詞，常見 political clout，強調在特定領域中具有的實質影響力。
w_clue
a piece of evidence or information that helps solve a problem 常見 give someone a clue、find a clue，指有助於解決謎題或案件的資訊。
w_clumsy
lacking physical grace or skill, causing awkward movements 常修飾動作或人，也可比喻性地形容處理方式不當或欠缺技巧。
w_cluster
to gather or group together closely 常見 cluster around，表示人或物緊密地聚集在某處或某人周圍。
w_clutch
a tight grip, or a device that connects and disconnects gears in a vehicle 可指抓握的動作（in the clutches of），也可指汽車排檔系統中的機械裝置。
w_coalesce
to come together to form one group or mass 不及物動詞，常用於描述原本分散的元素逐漸合併成一個整體，語氣較正式。
w_coalition
a temporary alliance formed by different groups for a common purpose 常見 coalition government，指不同政黨或團體為共同目標而組成的聯盟。
w_coastal
relating to or located near a coast 常修飾地區或城市，如 coastal city、coastal erosion，強調地理位置靠近海岸。
w_coax
to persuade someone gently and patiently 及物動詞，常接 into doing something，語氣溫和，強調以耐心而非強迫的方式說服。
w_cocaine
an addictive stimulant drug 不可數名詞，屬管制藥物，常見於毒品相關報導或醫學文獻。
w_cocktail
a mixed alcoholic drink, or a mixture of different elements 可指調製的酒精飲品，也可比喻性地指多種元素的混合（a cocktail of drugs）。
w_codify
to arrange laws or rules into a systematic code 及物動詞，語氣正式，常見於法律或制度層面的整理與統一規範。
w_coerce
to force someone to do something through pressure or threats 及物動詞，常見 coerce someone into doing something，帶有負面意涵，強調非自願的強迫。
w_cogent

clearly reasoned and therefore convincing cogent 稱讚的是論證的「邏輯品質」，而不是情感感染力。這使它與 compelling 有微妙分工：compelling 可以形容一個動人的故事，cogent 只能形容站得住腳的推理。它幾乎只修飾 argument、case、reason、analysis 這類名詞。 a cogent argument make a cogent case for + noun a cogent argument 論理嚴密的論證 a cogent explanation 條理清楚的解釋 cogent reasoning 嚴謹的推理 compelling persuasive tenuous incoherent cogency compelling
w_cognitive
relating to mental processes such as thinking, knowing, and remembering 常見 cognitive ability／development，多用於心理學或教育學語境。
w_coherent

logically connected and consistent, so that all the parts fit together sensibly coherent 的重點是「各部分之間彼此吻合，構成一個講得通的整體」。它可以形容論述（a coherent argument）、策略（a coherent strategy）、也可以形容系統設計（a coherent api）。與 consistent 的差別在於：consistent 只要求「不互相矛盾」，coherent 還要求「合起來能說出一個道理」。 a coherent + noun form a coherent whole a coherent argument 有條理的論證 a coherent strategy 連貫的策略 form a coherent whole 構成連貫的整體 internally coherent 內部自洽的 consistent logical incoherent disjointed coherence cohesive consistent
w_cohesion
the state of sticking together or forming a unified whole 不可數名詞，常見 social cohesion（社會凝聚力），強調群體之間的團結一致。
w_cohesive
forming a united whole; sticking together well 常修飾團體或論述，如 cohesive team／argument，強調各部分之間的協調一致。
w_coincide
to happen at the same time as something else, or to be in agreement 常接 with，如 coincide with，可指時間上的巧合，也可指意見或利益的一致。
w_coincidence
a situation in which two events happen at the same time by chance 常見 by coincidence，強調事件同時發生並非刻意安排，而是偶然巧合。
w_collaboration
the act of working together with others to achieve a shared goal 常見 in collaboration with，指多方共同努力完成某項工作或計畫。
w_collapse
a sudden failure or downfall 可指實體結構的倒塌（building collapse），也可指制度或健康狀況的崩潰（economic collapse）。 倒塌；崩潰 to fall down or fail suddenly 不及物動詞，可指實體結構倒塌，也可比喻性地形容制度、健康或計畫的突然失敗。
w_collar
the part of a shirt or coat that fits around the neck 日常詞彙，也可比喻性地用於片語 hot under the collar（生氣、惱怒）。
w_collate
to collect and combine information or documents in order 及物動詞，常見於辦公或研究情境，指將分散的資料依順序合併整理。
w_collective
done or shared by a group as a whole 常見 collective decision／responsibility，強調由整個群體共同承擔或做出。
w_collision
an instance of two or more things crashing into each other 常見 car collision，也可比喻性地指利益或想法上的衝突（collision of interests）。
w_colonel
a senior military officer rank, above lieutenant colonel and below brigadier 軍階名稱，常見於軍事語境，指介於中校與准將之間的軍官職級。
w_colonial
relating to a colony or colonialism 常修飾歷史時期或建築風格，如 colonial architecture，指與殖民統治相關的事物。
w_colonize
to establish control over a foreign territory and settle it with people 及物動詞，常見於歷史語境，指一國對外國領土建立統治並移入人口。
w_colony
a territory controlled by a foreign power, or a group of the same organisms living together 歷史上指被外國統治的領土，生物學上則指同種生物聚集生活的群體（an ant colony）。
w_colossal
extremely large in size or extent 語氣比 huge 更強烈，常修飾規模、數量或成就，帶有誇張的正面或負面語氣。
w_combat
fighting between armed forces, especially in war 不可數名詞，常見 in combat，指軍事上的實際交戰，語氣正式且嚴肅。
w_combination
a joining or mixture of different elements 常見 a combination of，指多種元素或因素共同作用產生的結果。
w_comedy
a genre of entertainment intended to be humorous 常見 romantic comedy、stand-up comedy，指以幽默逗趣為主的娛樂類型。
w_comet
a celestial body made of ice and dust that orbits the sun 天文學詞彙，常見於描述繞行太陽的冰塊與塵埃天體，並拖有明顯的尾巴。
w_comic
causing laughter or amusement 常修飾情境或效果，如 comic relief（喜劇調劑），也可指與漫畫相關的（comic book）。
w_commander
a person who is in charge of a military unit or operation 常見於軍事語境，指負責統率特定部隊或行動的高階軍官。
w_commence
to begin or start 語氣比 start 正式，常見於正式文件或典禮場合，如 proceedings commence。
w_commencement
the beginning of something, or (american) a graduation ceremony 英式英語多指事件的開端，美式英語則常特指大學的畢業典禮。
w_commensurate
corresponding in size or degree to something else 常接 with，如 commensurate with experience，指薪資或待遇與資歷等相符。
w_commentary
a spoken or written explanation or discussion accompanying an event 常見 live commentary（現場實況轉播評論），也可指對書籍或事件的深入解析文字。
w_commentator
a person who provides commentary, especially on broadcasts 常見 sports commentator、political commentator，指針對特定領域提供分析與評論的人。
w_commerce
the activity of buying and selling goods and services 不可數名詞，常見 chamber of commerce（商會），強調大規模的商業交易活動。
w_commissioner
an official appointed to oversee a particular department or organization 常見 police commissioner，指經任命負責監督特定部門或機構的官員。
w_commodity
a raw material or primary product that can be bought and sold 常見 agricultural commodity，多指可交易的原始物資，如穀物、石油等。
w_commonplace
ordinary and not unusual 常用於描述已變得普遍或不再新奇的事物，語氣中性偏平淡。
w_commonwealth
a group of nations or states united by common interests, or a self-governing political unit 常見 the commonwealth（大寫，指大英國協），也可指某些美國州的正式名稱，如 the commonwealth of massachusetts。
w_commotion
a state of confused and noisy disturbance 不可數名詞，常見 cause a commotion，指突發的混亂吵鬧場面。
w_commune

skilled at achieving one's aims through cunning or deception 帶負面含意，強調用計謀或欺瞞手段達成目的，與 clever 的中性意味不同。
w_cramp

a sudden, involuntary contraction of a muscle causing pain 常見 a leg cramp（腿抽筋）、stomach cramps（腹部絞痛），指肌肉突然痛性收縮。 妨礙；限制（空間或發展） to restrict or hinder the space, movement, or development of something 常見 cramp someone's style（比喻用法，妨礙某人發揮），強調造成拘束或不便。
w_cranky
irritable or bad-tempered, often due to tiredness 口語用語，常見於描述因疲累或不適而情緒不佳，如 a cranky toddler（鬧脾氣的小小孩）。
w_crash
a sudden violent collision, loud noise, or a sudden failure (as of a computer or market) 常見 a car crash（車禍）、a stock market crash（股市崩盤）、a computer crash（電腦當機），依語境略有不同。
w_craven
lacking courage; contemptibly cowardly 書面用語，語氣強烈負面，比 cowardly 更帶輕蔑意味。
w_crawl

a very slow pace of movement, or a swimming stroke 一義指移動極慢（traffic crawl，車流緩慢），另一義指游泳姿勢（the front crawl，自由式）。 爬行；緩慢移動 to move slowly on hands and knees, or (of a vehicle/vehicle traffic) to move very slowly 常見嬰兒學爬（the baby crawls）或形容車流極慢（traffic crawled along）。
w_crease

a line or ridge made by folding or crushing a flexible material 常見 iron out the creases（燙平皺褶），指衣物或紙張因摺疊產生的線條。 使起皺；折出摺痕 to make lines or folds in something, especially fabric or paper 常見 crease a shirt/paper，指衣物或紙張因擠壓或折疊而產生皺褶。
w_credence
acceptance that something is true or valid 書面用語，常見 give/lend credence to（使……可信），多用於描述說法或理論被接受的程度。
w_credential
a qualification, achievement, or quality that entitles someone to trust or authority 常見複數形 credentials，指學歷、證照等能證明能力或身分的文件或經歷。
w_credible

able to be believed or trusted, because it is reasonable and well supported credible 評價的是「值得相信的程度」，可以形容說法、來源或威脅。它與 plausible 的差別在於強度：plausible 只是「聽起來合理」，credible 則已經有分量到值得採信。留意 credible（可信的）與 credulous（輕信的）意思幾乎相反。 a credible + noun find something credible a credible source 可信的來源 a credible threat 有實質可能性的威脅 highly credible 高度可信的 a credible alternative 可行且可信的替代方案 believable trustworthy incredible spurious credibility credibly plausible credulous
w_creditor
a person or organization to whom money is owed 金融用語，與 debtor（債務人）相對，指借出款項、有權要求償還的一方。
w_credulous
too ready to believe things without sufficient evidence 書面用語，帶輕微負面意味，強調過於天真、缺乏懷疑精神。
w_creek
a small stream or narrow waterway 日常用語，常見於自然地理描述，如 fish in the creek（在小溪釣魚）。
w_creep

an unpleasant or creepy person, or a slow, gradual movement 一義指令人不悅或怪異的人（口語貶義），另一義指緩慢漸進的變化（scope creep，範圍逐漸擴大）。 躡手躡腳地移動；悄悄爬行 to move slowly, quietly, and carefully, especially to avoid being noticed 常見 creep up on someone（悄悄接近某人），也可比喻用於變化緩慢地發生（doubts crept in）。
w_crew
a group of people who work together, especially on a ship, aircraft, or a specific task 常見 flight crew（機組人員）、a film crew（拍攝團隊），強調共同執行特定任務的一群人。
w_cringe
to feel embarrassment or disgust, often shrinking back physically 口語用法，常見 cringe at/when，強調對令人尷尬或不適的事物產生反射性的不悅反應。
w_cripple

a person who is unable to walk or move properly due to injury or disability (dated, now considered offensive) 此用法現今被視為冒犯性用語，正式或禮貌場合建議改用 a person with a disability，多見於歷史文本。 使殘廢；使嚴重受損；使癱瘓（比喻） to severely damage or weaken something, or to cause someone to lose the ability to move normally 常見比喻用法，如 cripple the economy（重創經濟），強調造成嚴重且難以恢復的損害。
w_crisp
firm, dry, and brittle, or (of weather) cold and invigorating 一義形容食物口感（a crisp apple，脆的蘋果），另一義形容天氣（a crisp autumn morning，清爽的秋日早晨）。
w_criterion

a standard by which something is judged or a decision is made criterion 是「用來判斷的標準」，最大的難點是它的複數：criteria。這是希臘語來源的不規則變化，也是母語人士都常寫錯的地方。單數用 criterion，複數用 criteria，而且 criteria 要搭配複數動詞。軟體開發中的 acceptance criteria（驗收標準）是最常見的固定用法。 meet the criteria the criteria for + noun on the basis of + criterion meet the criteria 符合標準 acceptance criteria 驗收標準 selection criteria 篩選標準 the main criterion 主要判準 standard benchmark criterion-referenced benchmark
w_critique
a detailed analysis and assessment of something, especially a literary or artistic work 書面用語，常見 a critique of，強調有系統、深入的分析與評價，語氣較 criticism 中性。
w_crook
a dishonest or criminal person 口語用語，帶負面意味，泛指從事不誠實或犯罪行為的人。 彎曲（手指、手臂等） to bend something, especially a finger or arm 較正式或文學用語，常見 crook one's finger（勾起手指），描述肢體彎曲的動作。
w_crouch

a position in which the knees are bent and the upper body is brought forward and down 描述身體蹲低、彎曲的姿態，常見於運動或動物行為描寫。 蹲下；蹲伏 to bend one's knees and lower the body close to the ground 常見 crouch down，強調身體彎低靠近地面的動作，多見於躲藏或準備動作。
w_crown
a circular ornamental headdress worn by a monarch, or the top part of something 一義指君主佩戴的頭飾（象徵王權），另一義可指牙齒、樹木等的頂部（a tooth crown，牙冠）。
w_crucial
extremely important or essential, especially for future success 常修飾 role、moment、decision 等，強調對結果有決定性影響，語氣比 important 更強烈。
w_crude
in a natural or raw state (not yet processed), or lacking sophistication and refinement 一義指原始未加工的物質（crude oil，原油），另一義指言行粗俗無禮（a crude joke，粗俗的笑話）。
w_cruise

a voyage on a ship taken for pleasure, typically calling at several ports 日常用語，常見 go on a cruise（搭郵輪旅行），強調以觀光休閒為目的的航行。 巡航；以穩定速度行駛 to sail or travel at a steady, moderate speed, especially for pleasure 常見 cruise along/at，也可指飛機或車輛以固定速度平穩行進（cruising altitude，巡航高度）。
w_crush

a strong but often short-lived infatuation with someone, or a densely packed crowd 口語用法，have a crush on someone（暗戀某人）十分常見，另一義指擁擠的人群（in the crush of the crowd）。 壓碎；壓垮 to press or squeeze something forcefully so as to break or destroy its structure 常見 crush a can/grape，也可比喻指徹底擊敗或摧毀（crush the rebellion）。
w_crust

the hard outer layer of bread, pastry, or the earth 常見 pizza crust（披薩餅皮）、the earth's crust（地殼），指外層堅硬的部分。 結成硬殼；覆上一層外皮 to form a hard outer layer 較不常見的動詞用法，常見於描述表面逐漸變硬，如 mud crusted on his boots（泥巴在他的靴子上結成硬殼）。
w_cryptic
having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure 常修飾 message、remark，強調言辭故意模糊、不易理解，帶神秘感。
w_crystal
a clear, transparent mineral or a piece of high-quality glass, or a solid with a regular geometric structure 一義指晶瑩剔透的礦物或玻璃製品（crystal glassware），另一義指分子規則排列的固體（sugar crystals，糖的結晶）。
w_cube
a three-dimensional shape with six equal square sides, or a cube-shaped piece of something 常見 an ice cube（冰塊）、a sugar cube（方糖），也指數學上的立方體。
w_cuddle

an act of holding someone closely and affectionately 口語用語，常見 give someone a cuddle，強調親密溫柔的身體接觸。 依偎；擁抱 to hold someone or something closely and affectionately 常見 cuddle up (to/with someone)，強調親密溫暖的肢體接觸，多用於親子、情侶。
w_culminate
to reach a climax or final result after a series of events 常見 culminate in，強調一連串事件發展到最終結果，語氣正式書面。
w_cult
a system of religious devotion directed toward a particular figure or object, often regarded as extreme or false 常帶負面意味，指教義偏激或以個人崇拜為核心的團體，也可形容次文化現象（a cult classic，邪典經典）。
w_cultivate
to prepare and use land for growing crops, or to develop a skill, relationship, or quality 一義指農業耕作（cultivate the soil），另一義為比喻用法，指培養能力或人際關係（cultivate a friendship）。
w_cultivation
the act of preparing land and growing crops, or the development of a skill or quality over time 涵蓋農業種植（rice cultivation，稻米栽培）與抽象能力的養成（the cultivation of good habits，好習慣的養成）。
w_cunning
skilled at achieving one's aims through deceit or trickery 帶負面意味，強調用心機或欺瞞手段達成目的，語氣接近 crafty。
w_cupboard
a piece of furniture or a small closet with doors and shelves for storage 日常用語，常見 kitchen cupboard（廚房櫥櫃），指用來收納物品的有門櫃子。
w_curator
a keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection 常見於藝文語境，如 a museum curator（博物館館長），負責管理與規劃展覽內容。
w_curb

a check or restraint on something, or the edge of a raised path along a street 一義指對某事物的節制（a curb on spending，對支出的限制），另一義指街道路面邊緣（美式用法，同英式 kerb）。 抑制；控制；遏止 to restrain or keep something in check 常見 curb one's appetite/spending，強調主動限制或壓抑某種行為或衝動。
w_cure
to relieve a person of the symptoms of a disease, or to solve a problem 常見 cure a disease/illness，也可比喻指解決棘手的問題（cure the economy's woes）。
w_curiosity
a strong desire to know or learn something 常見 out of curiosity（出於好奇）、arouse curiosity（激起好奇心），描述對未知事物的求知慾望。
w_curious
eager to know or learn something, or strange and unusual 一義形容渴望了解的心態（curious about），另一義形容事物本身怪異（a curious coincidence，奇特的巧合）。
w_curl
to form or cause to form a curved or spiral shape 常見 curl one's hair（把頭髮弄捲）、curl up（蜷縮身體），描述彎曲成螺旋或圓弧狀。
w_currency
a system of money used in a particular country, or general acceptance or use 一義指某國使用的貨幣系統（foreign currency，外幣），另一義為比喻用法，指想法或說法被廣泛接受（gain currency，逐漸流行）。
w_curriculum
the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college 教育用語，常見 the school curriculum、a curriculum designer，指整體規劃的教學內容。
w_curse

a solemn utterance calling for harm to befall someone, or a source of trouble 一義指惡意咒語（put a curse on someone），另一義指帶來不斷麻煩的事物（a curse rather than a blessing）。 詛咒；咒罵 to utter a curse against, or to swear angrily 常見 curse someone/something，強調用惡意語言表達憤怒或詛咒對方。
w_cursory

done quickly and without attention to detail cursory 幾乎總是帶有批評意味，指「看過但沒認真看」。它是 scrutiny 的反面，兩者常在同一篇文章中對照出現。最常見的固定搭配是 a cursory glance 與 a cursory review，後者在程式碼審查文化中是相當嚴厲的評語。 a cursory + noun even a cursory + noun + reveals/shows... a cursory glance 匆匆一瞥 a cursory review 草率的審查 a cursory examination 粗略的檢視 perfunctory superficial thorough meticulous cursorily perfunctory
w_curtail
to reduce in extent or quantity; impose a restriction on 正式書面用語，常見 curtail spending/rights，強調縮小範圍或程度。
w_curtain

a piece of fabric hung to cover a window or door, or something marking the start/end of a performance 常見 draw the curtains（拉上窗簾），劇場語境中也指開演或落幕的布幕（the curtain rises/falls）。 用簾子遮蔽；以布幕隔開 to provide or screen with a curtain 較不常見的動詞用法，常見 curtain off an area（用簾子隔出一塊區域）。
w_curve
a line or surface that bends gradually without sharp angles 常見 a sharp curve（急轉彎）、a learning curve（學習曲線，比喻用法）。
w_cushion

a soft bag of fabric filled with padding, used for comfort 日常用語，常見 a sofa cushion（沙發靠墊），也可比喻指緩衝作用（a financial cushion）。 緩和（衝擊）；為……提供緩衝 to soften the effect of an impact or hardship 常比喻用法，如 cushion the blow（減輕打擊），強調降低負面影響的程度。
w_custody
the state of being detained by the police, or the legal right to care for a child 一義指遭警方羈押（in police custody），另一義指離婚後對子女的法定監護權（child custody）。
w_custom
a traditional way of behaving or doing something particular to a society or people 常見 a local custom（當地習俗）、customs and traditions，強調長期形成的社會行為模式。
w_customary
according to custom; usual or habitual 常見 it is customary to（依慣例應該……），強調符合社會或個人的固定作法。
w_cute
attractive in a pretty or endearing way 日常口語用語，常修飾外貌或行為，語氣輕鬆親切，如 a cute puppy（可愛的小狗）。
w_cyclical
occurring in cycles; recurring at regular intervals 常見於經濟或自然現象描述，如 cyclical trends（週期性趨勢），強調反覆出現的模式。
w_cylinder
a solid or hollow object with straight parallel sides and a circular cross section 幾何學或機械用語，常見於工程語境，如 a car engine's cylinders（汽車引擎的汽缸）。
w_cynical
believing that people are motivated by self-interest; distrustful of sincerity or goodness 常見 a cynical attitude，強調對他人動機抱持懷疑或不信任的態度，語氣偏負面。
w_dabble
to engage in an activity casually or superficially, without serious commitment 常見 dabble in painting/writing，強調非專業、隨興嘗試某件事，沒有深入投入。
w_dainty
delicately small and pretty 常修飾外觀或動作，如 dainty fingers（纖細的手指），語氣帶有優雅細膩的意味。
w_dairy
milk and products made from milk, or a place where these are produced/sold 常見 dairy products（乳製品）、a dairy farm（酪農場），指與牛奶相關的食品或產業。
w_damn
the least amount or degree, used in negative expressions of indifference (informal) 口語且略帶粗俗，常見 not give a damn（毫不在乎），語氣隨意，正式場合應避免使用。
w_damp

slightly wet 日常用語，程度介於 wet（濕）與 dry（乾）之間，常見 damp weather（潮濕的天氣）。 潮氣；濕氣 moisture in the air or on a surface, especially causing an unpleasant effect 常見於描述建築物或環境的濕氣問題，如 rising damp（地面滲上來的濕氣）。 使潮濕；抑制（情緒或反應） to make something slightly wet, or to reduce the intensity of a feeling or reaction 常見 damp someone's spirits/enthusiasm，比喻削弱熱情或士氣。
w_dancer
a person who dances, especially professionally 日常用語，指從事舞蹈表演的人，可為職業或業餘，如 a ballet dancer（芭蕾舞者）。
w_dangle
to hang or swing loosely, or to offer something as an enticement 一義指物體鬆散地垂掛擺動（legs dangling），另一義為比喻用法，指用利益吸引他人（dangle a promotion）。
w_dash
a sudden quick movement or short distance run, or a small amount of something added 一義指突然快速的動作（make a dash for the door），另一義指少量添加的東西（a dash of salt，一小撮鹽）。
w_dawn

the first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise, or the beginning of something 一義指清晨天亮之時（at dawn），另一義為比喻用法，指新時代或新階段的開始（the dawn of a new era）。 破曉；（真相或想法）逐漸明朗 to begin to grow light in the morning, or to begin to be understood or realized 常見 it dawned on me that...（我突然明白了……），強調某個想法或事實逐漸浮現在意識中。
w_deadline
the latest time or date by which something must be completed 日常與職場用語，常見 meet a deadline（趕上截止日期）、miss a deadline（錯過期限）。
w_deadly
likely to cause death, or extremely serious or intense 常修飾 disease、weapon 等，也可比喻用於強調程度極端，如 deadly serious（非常認真）。
w_dealer
a person or company whose business is trading in a particular commodity, or someone who illegally sells drugs 一義為合法商業用語（a car dealer，汽車經銷商），另一義帶負面意味，指非法販售毒品的人（a drug dealer）。
w_dean
the head of a university faculty or department, or a senior clergy official 學術用語，常見 the dean of the medical school（醫學院院長），也可指教會中的資深神職人員。
w_debris
scattered pieces of rubbish, wreckage, or discarded material 常見於災難或事故報導中，如 flood/storm debris（洪水／暴風雨造成的殘骸），為不可數名詞。
w_debtor
a person or entity who owes money 金融與法律用語，與 creditor（債權人）相對，指有償還義務的一方。
w_debut

a person's first public appearance or performance 常見 make one's debut（首次登場），也可指產品或作品的首次發表（a debut album，首張專輯）。 首次登場；初次亮相 to make a first public appearance or performance 常見 debut at/in，強調人或作品在特定場合首次公開呈現。
w_decay
the process of rotting or gradual decline in quality or condition 常見 tooth decay（蛀牙）、urban decay（城市衰敗），指物質腐壞或整體狀態的衰退。
w_decent
conforming to accepted standards of respectable behavior, or satisfactory in quality 常見 a decent person（正派的人）、a decent salary（不錯的薪水），語氣中性偏正面，口語常用。
w_decimate
to destroy or kill a large proportion of something 書面用語，語氣強烈，常見 decimate the population，強調大規模的破壞或損失。
w_decipher
to succeed in understanding, interpreting, or identifying something obscure or unclear 常見 decipher a code/handwriting，強調解開原本難以理解或辨識的內容。
w_deck

a floor of a ship or bus, or a flat wooden platform attached to a house 常見 on deck（在甲板上）、a wooden deck（木製露台），指船隻或建築的平面結構。 裝飾；佈置 to decorate something, typically for a festive occasion 常見 deck out（把……裝飾一新），語氣輕鬆，多用於節慶場合。
w_declaration
a formal or official statement or announcement 常見 a declaration of independence（獨立宣言），指正式、公開的官方聲明。
w_declare
to state something formally or officially, or to announce clearly 常見 declare war（宣戰）、declare goods at customs（在海關申報物品），依語境略有不同。
w_decline

a gradual and continuous loss of strength, quality, or importance 常見 a decline in sales/health，指數量或狀態逐漸下降的過程。 衰退；下降；婉拒 to become smaller, weaker, or worse, or to politely refuse something 一義指狀態逐漸變差（sales declined），另一義指有禮貌地拒絕（decline an invitation，婉拒邀請）。
w_decode
to convert a coded message into ordinary language, or to interpret complex information 常見 decode a message/signal，可指字面上的解碼，也可比喻指理解複雜訊息。
w_decompose
