to break down or rot through natural chemical processes 常見於生物或環境語境，如 organic matter decomposes（有機物質分解）。
w_decomposition
the process by which organic substances break down into simpler forms 科學用語，常見 the decomposition of organic matter，指生物物質經自然過程分解。
w_decorate
to make something look more attractive by adding ornamental features 日常用語，常見 decorate a room/cake，指添加裝飾使外觀更美觀。
w_decoration
an object or item used to make something more attractive 常見 christmas decorations（聖誕裝飾），指用來美化空間或物品的物件。
w_decorative
serving to make something look more attractive; ornamental 常修飾 item、pattern，強調物品的美觀功能而非實用功能。
w_decorum
behavior in keeping with good taste and propriety 正式書面用語，常見 maintain decorum（保持得體），強調符合社會禮節與場合的行為舉止。
w_decoy
a person or thing used to lure someone into a trap 常見於軍事、狩獵或詐騙語境，指用來引誘目標上鉤的人或物。 引誘；誘騙（進入陷阱） to lure someone or something into a trap by deception 較不常見的動詞用法，強調用計謀將目標引誘至特定位置。
w_decrease
a reduction in the size, amount, or intensity of something 常見 a decrease in，強調數量或程度上的下降，語氣中性正式。
w_decree
an official order issued by a legal authority 正式用語，常見 a presidential decree（總統令），指具法律效力的正式命令。 頒布法令；下令 to order something by decree; to command officially 正式用語，強調透過具法律效力的方式做出命令。
w_dedicate
to devote time and effort to a particular task or purpose, or to inscribe a work in someone's honor 常見 dedicate oneself to（致力於），也可指把作品獻給某人（dedicate a book to）。
w_deed
an action that is performed intentionally, or a legal document showing ownership 一義指所做的事（a good deed，善行），另一義為法律用語，指房地產所有權文件。
w_deem
to regard or consider something in a specified way 正式書面用語，常見 deem it necessary/appropriate，語氣比 think 更正式。
w_default

a failure to fulfill an obligation, especially a financial one, or a preset option 一義指未履行義務（default on a loan，貸款違約），另一義指電腦系統的預設設定（default settings）。 違約；拖欠（債務） to fail to fulfill an obligation, especially to repay a debt 常見 default on a payment/loan，強調未能履行還款等義務。
w_defeat
failure to win or succeed, or the act of overcoming someone in a contest 常見 admit defeat（承認失敗）、suffer a defeat，指競賽或戰爭中的落敗。
w_defect
a shortcoming, imperfection, or lack that impairs worth or utility 常見 a birth defect（先天缺陷）、a manufacturing defect（製造瑕疵），指產品或身體上的不完美之處。
w_defend
to resist an attack made on someone or something, or to speak in support of someone or something 常見 defend a country/decision，涵蓋實體防禦與言語上的辯護。
w_defendant
a person or entity accused of a crime or sued in a court of law 法律用語，與 plaintiff（原告）相對，指在訴訟中被指控或被起訴的一方。
w_defensive

used or intended to defend, or behaving in a way that suggests one feels attacked or criticized 一義指軍事或體育上的防守（a defensive strategy），另一義指人因感覺受批評而產生的抗拒態度（get defensive）。 防守狀態；防禦姿態 a position or attitude of defense 常見 on the defensive（處於防禦狀態），指因感受到威脅或批評而採取自我保護的態度。
w_defer
to postpone something to a later time, or to yield to another's opinion or authority 一義指延後執行（defer a decision），另一義指尊重並順從他人判斷（defer to someone's judgment）。
w_deference
humble submission and respect shown toward someone 正式書面用語，常見 out of deference to（出於對……的敬重），強調對他人意見或地位的尊重。
w_defiance
open resistance or bold disobedience 常見 in defiance of（不顧……；公然違抗），強調公開且大膽地不服從權威或規則。
w_deficiency
a lack or shortage of something needed 常見 a vitamin deficiency（維生素缺乏），指所需事物的量不足以達到正常標準。
w_deficit
the amount by which something, especially money, falls short of what is needed 財經用語，常見 a budget/trade deficit（預算／貿易赤字），指支出超過收入的差額。
w_definite
clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful 常見 a definite answer/plan，強調確定無疑、不含糊，語氣正式或日常皆可。
w_definitely
without doubt; certainly 日常口語常用，語氣強烈肯定，用於加強語句的確定性。
w_definition
a statement of the exact meaning of a word, or the degree of clarity in an image or sound 一義指詞語的精確意義（by definition），另一義指影像或聲音的解析度（high definition，高畫質）。
w_definitive
conclusive or authoritative and not able to be improved upon or questioned 常見 a definitive answer/version，強調具有最終性、不容質疑的權威地位。
w_deflect
to cause something to change direction, or to divert attention or criticism away from oneself 一義指使物體改變方向（deflect a blow），另一義為比喻用法，指迴避批評或責難（deflect criticism）。
w_deforestation
the action of clearing a wide area of trees 環境用語，常見 deforestation rates（森林濫伐率），指大規模移除林木的行為。
w_defraud
to illegally obtain money from someone by deception 正式法律用語，常見 defraud investors/the government，強調以欺騙手段非法取得財物。
w_deft
neatly skillful and quick in one's movements 常修飾 hands、touch，強調動作俐落精準，語氣正面。
w_defunct
no longer existing, functioning, or in use 書面用語，常見 a defunct company/law，指組織、制度或事物已經停止運作或失效。
w_defuse
to remove the fuse from an explosive device, or to reduce the tension in a difficult situation 一義為字面意義（defuse a bomb），另一義為比喻用法，指化解衝突或緊張氣氛（defuse a tense situation）。
w_defy
to openly resist or refuse to obey, or to challenge someone to do something believed impossible 常見 defy authority/expectations，強調公開不服從或超乎預期，語氣堅定。
w_delay

a period of time by which something is late or postponed 日常用語，常見 a flight delay（航班延誤），指事情發生的時間比預期晚。 延遲；耽擱 to make something happen later than planned, or to make someone/something slow 常見 delay a decision/departure，強調把事情往後推延或使進度變慢。
w_delegate

to give a task or responsibility to someone else, usually someone more junior delegate 是管理的核心動詞：把任務連同必要的決定權一起交給別人。句型是 delegate something to someone。在程式設計中它也是常用術語，指「把工作轉交給另一個物件或函式處理」，例如 delegate rendering to a child component。 delegate a to b delegate responsibility for + noun delegate responsibility 下放職責 delegate a task to someone 把任務委派給某人 delegate authority 授權 learn to delegate 學會授權 代表；與會代表 a person chosen to represent a group at a meeting or conference 作名詞時指「被推派代表某個團體出席的人」，注意字尾發音弱化為 /-gɪt/。常見於會議、工會與國際組織語境。 a union delegate 工會代表 conference delegates 與會代表 assign entrust delegation relegate
w_delete
to remove or erase something, especially text or data 日常科技用語，常見 delete a file/message，指移除文字、檔案或資料。
w_deleterious
causing harm or damage, especially in a subtle or gradual way 書面正式用語，常見 deleterious effects/consequences，強調負面影響可能不易立即察覺。
w_deliberately
on purpose; in a way that is planned or intended 常修飾動詞，強調行為並非意外，而是經過思考或計畫，語氣中性至負面。
w_delicate
easily damaged or broken; fragile, or requiring careful handling 一義指物理上的脆弱（a delicate vase），另一義指需要謹慎處理的敏感狀況（a delicate situation）。
w_delinquent

a person, typically a young person, who commits illegal or antisocial acts 常見 a juvenile delinquent（青少年不良少年），指有違法或反社會行為傾向的人。 行為不良的；（債務）逾期未償的 tending to commit crime, especially as a young person, or (of a debt) overdue 一義形容有違法傾向的行為，另一義為財務用語，指債務逾期未繳（a delinquent account）。
w_delusion
an idiosyncratic belief maintained despite being contradicted by reality 常見 under the delusion that（在……的錯覺之下），也可為精神醫學用語，指與現實脫節的堅信。
w_delve
to research or examine something in detail 書面用語，常見 delve into，強調深入挖掘某主題的細節或內涵。
w_demented
suffering from severe mental impairment, or behaving in a wild or irrational manner 醫學用語指患有失智症狀，也可口語用來形容行為瘋狂荒唐（常帶誇張語氣）。
w_democracy
a system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives 政治用語，常見 a parliamentary democracy（議會民主制），指人民透過選舉參與治理的政治體制。
w_demolish
to pull down or destroy a building, or to disprove an argument thoroughly 一義指實體拆除（demolish a building），另一義為比喻用法，指徹底推翻論點（demolish an argument）。
w_demonstrate

to show clearly that something is true, by giving proof or evidence demonstrate 比 show 正式，且暗示「拿得出證據」。學術寫作中 the data demonstrate that... 是很有分量的說法，因為它宣稱證據足以支持結論；若證據較弱，用 suggest 或 indicate 比較誠實。這種強弱分寸是學術英文的重要能力。 demonstrate that + clause demonstrate + noun demonstrate how + clause demonstrate that 證明…… clearly demonstrate 清楚顯示 demonstrate competence 展現能力 show prove demonstration demonstrable indicate
w_demonstration
a public gathering to express views on a political or social issue, or a display showing how something works 一義指公開表達訴求的集會（a peaceful demonstration），另一義指展示操作方式（a cooking demonstration）。
w_demur
to raise doubts or objections; to express reluctance 書面正式用語，常見 demur at/to something，語氣較委婉，不同於直接反對。 異議；遲疑 the act of raising objections or showing reluctance 正式書面用語，常見 without demur（毫無異議地），強調沒有表達反對。
w_denial
the act of declaring something to be untrue, or a refusal to grant something requested 常見 a flat denial（斷然否認）、denial of access（拒絕給予存取權限），依語境略有不同。
w_denigrate
to unfairly criticize or belittle someone or something 書面正式用語，語氣負面，常見 denigrate someone's work/achievements，強調不公正地貶損他人。
w_denomination
a recognized branch or subdivision of a religion, or the face value of a unit of currency 一義指宗教內部分支（a christian denomination），另一義指紙鈔或硬幣的面值（bills of various denominations）。
w_denote
to be a sign or indication of something; to signify 書面正式用語，常見於學術或邏輯語境，強調符號或詞語所代表的意義。
w_denounce
to publicly declare something to be wrong or evil 正式用語，常見 denounce someone/something as，強調公開且強烈地批評不當行為。
w_dense
closely compacted in substance, or (informal) slow to understand 一義指物質緊密（a dense forest，茂密的森林），另一義為口語貶義，指反應遲鈍。
w_density
the degree of compactness of a substance, or the amount of something per unit area 科學用語，常見 population density（人口密度）、the density of a material（物質密度）。
w_denunciation
public condemnation of someone or something 正式書面用語，較 denial 語氣更強烈，強調公開且嚴厲地批評。
w_depart
to leave, especially to start a journey 常見 depart from a place（從某地出發），多用於正式或交通運輸語境，如班機、列車時刻表。
w_departmental
relating to a department, especially within an organization or institution 常見 departmental meeting/budget，指與特定部門有關的事務。
w_departure
the act of leaving, especially to start a journey, or a change from a usual pattern 一義指出發（flight departure，航班出發），另一義為比喻用法，指與常規不同（a departure from tradition）。
w_dependence
the state of relying on someone or something for support 常見 dependence on，也可指藥物依賴（drug dependence），強調需要依靠外力才能維持。
w_dependent
relying on someone or something for financial or other support 常見 dependent on/upon，強調需要他人或某事物提供支持才能運作或存活。
w_depict
to represent or show something in a picture or story 常見於藝術或文學語境，如 depict a scene（描繪一個場景），強調用視覺或文字呈現。
w_deplore
to feel or express strong disapproval of something 正式書面用語，語氣強烈，常見 deplore violence/injustice，強調對不當行為的強烈不滿。
w_deportation
the action of expelling a foreigner from a country 法律用語，常見 face deportation（面臨被驅逐出境），指強制將外國人遣返出境的行為。
w_depose
to remove someone from power, especially a ruler 正式書面用語，常見 depose a king/president，指以武力或政治手段推翻掌權者。
w_deposit
a sum of money paid as a first installment or as a pledge, or a layer of accumulated matter 一義指財務用語（a security deposit，押金），另一義指自然沉積形成的物質（mineral deposits，礦床）。
w_depression
a state of persistent low mood, or a period of severe economic decline 一義指心理疾病（clinical depression），另一義指嚴重的經濟衰退期（the great depression，經濟大蕭條）。
w_deprivation
the state of being deprived of something considered necessary 常見 sleep deprivation（睡眠不足）、economic deprivation，指缺乏基本必需之物的狀態。
w_deprive
to prevent someone from having or enjoying something 常見 deprive someone of something，強調不當地拿走他人本應擁有的事物。
w_deputy
a person appointed to act as a substitute or assistant to another, especially in an official role 常見 a deputy mayor（副市長），指在官方職位中輔佐或代理主管的人。
w_derelict

abandoned and left to fall into disrepair 常修飾 building、ship，指因無人使用或維護而破敗荒廢的狀態。 無家可歸者；被棄置的建物（或船隻） a person without a home, job, or property, or an abandoned building/ship 一義指流離失所、貧困的人，另一義指荒廢的建築或船隻，語境需視上下文判斷。
w_deride
to express contempt for someone or something; to mock 書面用語，語氣帶輕蔑，常見 deride someone's ideas/efforts，強調公開表達不屑。
w_derivation
the process of obtaining something from a source, or the origin of a word 語言學或學術用語，常見 the derivation of a word（一個詞語的詞源），指其來源與形成過程。
w_derivative

imitative of the work of another; not original 帶負面意味，常見 a derivative work/style，強調過度仿效他人而缺乏新意。 衍生物；（金融）衍生性商品 something derived from another source, or a financial instrument whose value depends on an underlying asset 一義指由某物衍生而來的事物，另一義為財經用語，指以基礎資產計價的金融商品。
w_derive

to obtain something from a particular source derive 表示「從某個來源取得」，句型是 derive a from b。在技術語境中，derived data 指「由其他資料計算出來、而非獨立儲存的資料」，這是資料建模的重要概念。學術寫作則常用 derive a formula from first principles。 derive a from b be derived from + noun derive from 源自於 derive value from 從……中取得價值 a derived value 衍生值 derive a conclusion 得出結論 obtain deduce derivation derivative deduce
w_descend
to move downward, or to be descended from a particular ancestor 一義指實體下降的動作（descend the stairs），另一義指血統來源（descended from royalty，出身皇室血統）。
w_descendant
a person or animal descended from a particular ancestor 常見 a direct descendant of，指血緣上承襲自某位祖先的人。
w_descent
the action of moving downward, or a person's family origin 一義指下降的動作或過程（a steep descent），另一義指血統來源（of irish descent，愛爾蘭血統）。
w_desertion
the act of abandoning a person, cause, or duty, especially military service 常見 desertion from the army（從軍中逃兵），強調未經許可拋棄責任或崗位。
w_deserve
to be entitled to something because of one's actions or qualities 常見 deserve credit/punishment，強調基於行為或表現而理應獲得某種結果。
w_desiccate
to remove the moisture from something; to dry out thoroughly 科學或食品加工用語，常見 desiccated coconut（乾燥椰絲），強調徹底去除水分。
w_designate

to officially assign a name, role, or status to someone or something 常見 designate someone as，強調正式賦予某人特定角色或名稱。 （已任命但）尚未就任的 appointed to a position but not yet installed 較正式的用法，置於職稱之後，如 the president designate（候任總統），指已獲任命但尚未正式上任。
w_designation
an official title, name, or classification given to someone or something 常見 an official designation，指正式賦予的分類或頭銜。
w_designer
a person who plans the look or workings of something before it is made 常見 a fashion/graphic designer，指負責構思產品外觀或功能的人。
w_desirable
wanted or wished for; attractive or worth having 常見 a highly desirable property/quality，強調具吸引力或值得擁有的特質。
w_desire

a strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen 常見 a desire for/to，強調對某事物的強烈渴求，語氣可中性或帶情感色彩。 渴望；想要 to strongly wish for or want something 正式用語，語氣比 want 更強烈，常見 desire something/to do something。
w_despair
the complete loss or absence of hope 常見 in despair（在絕望之中），強調完全失去希望的心理狀態。 絕望；感到心灰意冷 to lose all hope; to be in a state of despondency 常見 despair of（對……感到絕望），強調對某事完全失去信心或希望。
w_desperate
feeling or showing a hopeless sense that a situation is so bad it requires extreme action 常見 desperate measures/attempt，強調因情況危急而採取極端手段，或迫切需要某物。
w_desperately
in a way that shows a hopeless sense of urgency or extreme need 常修飾動詞，強調程度極為強烈或急迫，語氣強烈。
w_dessert
a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal 日常用語，常見於餐廳菜單，如 a dessert menu（甜點菜單）。
w_destination
the place to which someone or something is going or being sent 日常旅遊用語，常見 a popular tourist destination（熱門旅遊目的地）。
w_destiny
the events that will necessarily happen to a person or thing in the future; fate 書面用語，常帶宿命論色彩，如 fulfill one's destiny（完成自己的命運）。
w_destruction
the action or process of causing so much damage that something no longer exists 常見 mass destruction（大規模毀滅）、environmental destruction，強調徹底破壞使事物不復存在。
w_destructive
causing great and harmful damage 常見 a destructive habit/force，強調造成嚴重損害的性質，可指實體或抽象層面。
w_desultory
lacking a plan or purpose; disconnected or unfocused 書面用語，常見 desultory conversation/effort，強調缺乏系統性或持續的努力。
w_detain
to keep someone in official custody, or to delay someone from proceeding 一義為法律用語（detained by police，遭警方拘留），另一義指使某人延遲離開（i won't detain you long）。
w_detect
to discover or identify the presence of something not immediately obvious 常見 detect a change/problem，強調透過觀察或儀器發現不易察覺的事物。
w_detection
the act or process of discovering or identifying something 常見 crime detection、smoke detection、early detection（早期發現）；強調找出隱藏或不易察覺的事物。
w_detective
a person, often a police officer, who investigates crimes 常見 private detective（私家偵探）、detective novel（偵探小說）；指負責調查案件、蒐集證據的人。
w_deter
to discourage someone from doing something, especially through fear or difficulty 常接 from，如 deter someone from doing something；常用於犯罪、戰爭等語境，強調使人因恐懼或困難而打消念頭。
w_deteriorate

to become gradually worse in quality or condition deteriorate 是不及物動詞：東西自己變差，不能說 deteriorate something。它強調「逐漸」，因此適合描述長期趨勢——程式碼品質、服務效能、關係。若要表達「使某物變差」，請用及物的 degrade 或 worsen。 a deteriorates deteriorate into + noun steadily deteriorate 持續惡化 performance deteriorates 效能變差 deteriorate into 惡化成…… worsen degrade improve deterioration degrade
w_determination
firmness of purpose; resolve 常搭配 with determination、show great determination；強調堅持到底、不輕言放棄的態度。
w_detest
to dislike someone or something intensely 語氣比 dislike 強烈許多，接名詞或動名詞，如 detest liars；帶強烈負面情緒，較少用於輕微不喜歡。
w_detonate
to explode or cause something to explode 常見於炸彈、爆裂物相關語境，如 detonate a bomb；及物與不及物用法皆有。
w_detour

a longer route taken to avoid something or to visit an extra place 常見 take a detour、make a detour；可指實際繞路，也可比喻偏離原定計畫。 繞道而行；改道 to take a different, usually longer route 常接 around/via，如 detour around the construction site；強調刻意改變路線。
w_detrimental
tending to cause harm or damage 常搭配 to，如 detrimental to one's health；語氣正式，較 harmful 更常用於書面或學術語境。
w_devastate
to destroy or severely damage something, or to overwhelm someone emotionally 可指實際破壞（如地震摧毀城鎮），也可指精神上的重創，如 devastated by the loss，兩種用法都常見。
w_deviant

departing from usual or accepted standards, especially in social or sexual behavior 常修飾 behavior，如 deviant behavior，帶有負面評價，指明顯偏離社會常規。 行為偏差者 a person whose behavior departs markedly from accepted social standards 通常帶負面意味，指明顯違反社會規範的人，較正式或臨床的用語。
w_device
a piece of equipment made for a particular purpose, especially a mechanical or electronic one 常見 electronic device、safety device；泛指各種功能性器具，範圍廣泛。
w_devise
to plan or invent something through careful thought 常接 a plan/method/way，如 devise a strategy；強調經思考後創造出新方法或計畫。
w_devoid
completely lacking or free from something 固定搭配 devoid of，如 devoid of emotion／meaning；語氣正式，強調徹底沒有某特質。
w_devolve
to transfer power or authority to a lower level, or to gradually decline into a worse state 可指政治上的權力下放，如 devolve power to local governments；也可指狀況逐漸惡化，如 devolve into chaos。
w_devote
to give a large amount of time, effort, or resources to a person, activity, or cause 固定用法 devote oneself/time/energy to，強調長期、專心地投入某事。
w_devour
to eat something hungrily or quickly, or to consume something eagerly 字面指快速吃光食物，也常比喻用於書籍、資訊，如 devour a book（廢寢忘食地讀完一本書）。
w_diabetes
a chronic medical condition in which the body cannot properly regulate blood sugar levels 醫學用語，常搭配 type 1/type 2 diabetes；為不可數名詞，動詞用單數。
w_diagnose
to identify the nature of an illness or problem through examination 常見 be diagnosed with，如 diagnosed with cancer；也可用於機械故障等非醫療語境。
w_diagnosis
the identification of the nature of an illness or problem 常見 make a diagnosis、receive a diagnosis；為 diagnose 的名詞形式，指診斷的結果或過程。
w_diagram
a simplified drawing showing the appearance, structure, or workings of something 常見 a diagram of，用於說明結構、流程或系統，比 chart 更強調線條與結構圖示。
w_dial
a circular control or display on a device, such as a clock or instrument 常見 telephone dial（電話撥號盤，多為歷史用語）、pressure dial（壓力表）；泛指圓形的控制或顯示面板。
w_dialect
a regional or social variety of a language, differing in pronunciation, vocabulary, or grammar 常見 a regional dialect、speak in dialect；強調同一語言下因地域或社會群體產生的變體。
w_diameter
a straight line passing through the center of a circle, connecting two points on its boundary 數學與工程用語，常見 the diameter of，也用於描述管線、圓形物體的寬度。
w_dictate

to say words aloud for someone else to write down, or to state with authority what must be done 常見 dictate a letter（口述信件內容）、dictate terms/policy（強行規定條件或政策），後者帶有權威、強制意味。 命令；規範；準則 an order or principle that must be obeyed 常見 the dictates of conscience/fashion，指必須遵從的原則或規範，語氣較正式書面。
w_didactic
intended to teach or instruct, often excessively moralistic 常帶負面意味，指作品或言論過度說教、缺乏趣味，如 a didactic tone。
w_diet
the food a person or animal usually eats, or a controlled eating plan for health reasons 常見 a balanced diet（均衡飲食）、go on a diet（開始節食）；前者指日常飲食習慣，後者強調刻意控制飲食以減重或治療。
w_differentiate
to recognize or express what makes something different from another thing, or to develop differences 常接 between a and b 或 a from b，如 differentiate between right and wrong；也用於生物學指細胞分化。
w_digestion
the process of breaking down food in the body so nutrients can be absorbed 醫學與生理學用語，常見 aid digestion（幫助消化）、poor digestion（消化不良）。
w_dignity
the state of being worthy of honor or respect; a calm, serious manner 常見 with dignity、human dignity；強調自尊自重的態度，或應受到的基本尊重。
w_dilatory
slow to act or intended to cause delay 正式用語，常見 dilatory tactics（拖延戰術），多用於描述刻意拖延以達目的的行為。
w_dilemma
a situation requiring a difficult choice between two or more unfavorable options 常見 face a dilemma、a moral dilemma；強調各選項都有缺點，難以抉擇。
w_diligence
careful and persistent effort in one's work or duties 常見 due diligence（法律／商業上的盡職查核）；也泛指工作或學習上的努力不懈。
w_dimension

a measurable extent of some kind, such as length, width, or depth, or an aspect of a situation 常見 the dimensions of a room（房間的尺寸）、a new dimension to the problem（問題的新面向），後者為比喻用法。 標註尺寸 to give something specific measurements, especially in engineering or design drawings 工程與製圖用語，指在圖面上標示長度、寬度等具體數值，較少用於日常口語。
w_diminish
to make or become less in size, importance, or intensity 及物與不及物皆常見，如 diminish in value、diminish someone's authority；強調程度或數量的降低。
w_diminution
a reduction in the size, extent, or importance of something 較 diminish 更正式書面，常見 a diminution of/in，用於學術或法律語境。
w_dingy
dirty and drab in appearance, especially due to lack of light or care 常修飾 room、street 等場所，強調光線不足、缺乏整潔而顯得陰沉破舊。
w_dinosaur
a large extinct reptile that lived millions of years ago, or (informally) someone outdated 字面指史前生物，比喻用法則指觀念或做法陳舊過時的人，如 a corporate dinosaur。
w_diocesan
relating to a diocese, an area under a bishop's authority 天主教／聖公會用語，常見 diocesan school（教區學校），較少用於日常語境。 教區主教（人員） a bishop or other official responsible for a diocese 正式宗教用語，指負責管理教區事務的神職人員，日常較少使用。
w_dioxide
a compound containing two oxygen atoms combined with another element 化學用語，最常見於 carbon dioxide（二氧化碳），較少單獨使用。
w_diploma
a certificate awarded for completing a course of study 常見 a diploma in，如 a diploma in nursing；通常指專科或職業訓練課程的證書，不一定等同學位。
w_diplomacy
the management of relations between countries, or tact and skill in dealing with people 常見 international diplomacy（國際外交）；也可比喻用於人際互動，指說話圓融、講究技巧的能力。
w_diplomat
an official representing a country in dealings with other countries 常見 a career diplomat（職業外交官），指政府派駐國外處理外交事務的官員。
w_diplomatic
relating to diplomacy, or tactful in dealing with sensitive matters 常見 diplomatic relations（外交關係）、a diplomatic response（得體圓融的回應），後者強調措辭謹慎、不得罪人。
w_directory
a listing of names, addresses, or files, or a folder used to organize computer files 常見 a telephone directory（電話簿）、a computer directory（電腦資料夾）；兩義項皆指有系統整理的清單或存放結構。
w_disadvantage
an unfavorable circumstance or condition that reduces the chances of success 常見 at a disadvantage（處於不利地位）、the advantages and disadvantages of（優缺點）；強調相對於他人或其他選項處於較差的位置。
w_disagreeable
unpleasant or unfriendly in manner or nature 可形容人的個性（如態度粗魯）或事物（如氣味、天氣），語氣比 unpleasant 稍書面。
w_disagreement
a difference of opinion or a dispute between people 常見 a disagreement over/about，指雙方對某事看法不同，可能導致爭吵或僅是意見不合。
w_disappointment
a feeling of sadness caused by the failure of something to meet one's expectations 常見 to someone's disappointment（令某人失望的是）、a big disappointment；可指情緒本身，也可指造成失望的人或事物。
w_disarm
to take weapons away from someone, or to reduce someone's hostility or suspicion 字面指軍事上繳械，比喻用法如 disarm someone with a smile（用微笑化解對方的戒心），強調使對方放下防備。
w_disaster
a sudden event causing great damage or suffering, or a complete failure 常見 a natural disaster（天然災害）；也可誇張用於形容徹底搞砸的情況，如 the party was a disaster。
w_disastrous
causing great damage or having very unfortunate consequences 常修飾 decision、result、effect 等，強調結果極為糟糕，語氣強烈。
w_discard

to get rid of something no longer wanted or needed 常接具體物品，如 discard old clothes，也可比喻捨棄想法、計畫等；語氣中性，較 throw away 正式。 被丟棄的東西 something that has been thrown away or rejected 名詞用法較少見，常見於紙牌遊戲（丟出的牌）或指被淘汰的物品。
w_discern

to recognise or make out something that is not obvious discern 的前提是「不容易看出來」，因此它常出現在否定或條件句中：no clear pattern can be discerned。這種用法在資料分析與學術寫作中很有用，可以誠實地表達「我們看不出明確的規律」。形容詞 discerning 則是稱讚：眼光獨到的。 discern + noun discern whether + clause be discernible discern a pattern 看出規律 hard to discern 難以辨識 a discerning reader 有眼光的讀者 perceive make out discernible discerning distinguish
w_disclose
to make secret or private information known 正式用語，常見 disclose information/details，強調公開原本隱藏或保密的事項。
w_disco
a club, party, or style of music featuring dancing to popular music, typically from the 1970s 口語用詞，常見 go to a disco、disco music，帶有 1970 年代流行文化的懷舊色彩。
w_discourage
to make someone less confident or enthusiastic, or to try to prevent an action 常見 discourage someone from doing something（勸阻某人做某事），也可指使人失去信心或動力。
w_discourse

written or spoken communication or debate, especially on a serious topic 常見 public discourse（公共論述）、academic discourse（學術論述），指較正式、深入的討論或表達方式。 論述；講述 to speak or write authoritatively about a topic 正式書面用語，常接 on/upon，如 discourse on a subject，較少用於日常口語。
w_discredit
to harm someone's reputation, or to cause doubt about the truth of something 常接人或言論作受詞，如 discredit a witness/theory，強調使他人失去可信度。
w_discrepancy

a difference between two things that should be the same discrepancy 的關鍵前提是「這兩者本來應該一樣」，因此差異本身就是問題的訊號。這與中性的 difference 不同：兩個功能不同叫 difference，兩份應該一致的報表對不起來才叫 discrepancy。資料工程與會計中極常用。 a discrepancy between a and b account for a discrepancy a discrepancy between ……之間的不一致 account for the discrepancy 解釋這個差異 a significant discrepancy 顯著的落差 resolve discrepancies 解決不一致 inconsistency mismatch discrepant difference
w_discrete
individually separate and distinct 常修飾 units、categories、steps 等，強調彼此界線分明、不相連，易與 discreet（謹慎的）混淆，拼字不同。
w_discretion
the freedom to make judgments and decisions on one's own, or the quality of being careful about what one says or does 常見 at one's discretion（由某人自行決定）、use discretion（謹慎行事），前者指決定權，後者指言行的分寸拿捏。
w_discriminate

to treat a person or group unfairly based on prejudice, or to recognize a distinction between things 常接 against（歧視）或 between（區分），如 discriminate against applicants、discriminate between right and wrong，兩義項需視上下文判斷。
w_discrimination
unjust treatment based on prejudice against a category of people 常見 racial/gender discrimination；指基於偏見對特定群體的不公平對待，語氣帶負面評價。
w_discriminatory
showing unfair treatment based on prejudice against a particular group 常修飾 policy、practice、law 等，指帶有偏見、對特定群體不公平的制度或行為。
w_discursive
tending to wander from topic to topic rather than staying focused 常形容說話、寫作方式散漫、缺乏條理，如 a discursive style，語氣可中性也可帶輕微批評。
w_disdain

a feeling of contempt for someone or something considered unworthy 常見 with disdain、treat someone with disdain，強調高高在上、瞧不起對方的態度。 鄙視；不屑一顧 to regard someone or something with contempt 常接 to do something 或直接受詞，如 disdain to answer，強調態度上的輕視或不屑。
w_disengage
to release or detach something, or to stop being involved in an activity 可指機械上分離（如齒輪），也可指人退出某活動或關係，如 disengage from a conversation。
w_disentangle
to free something from a tangled or complicated state 字面指解開纏繞的線或繩，比喻用法指理清複雜的問題或關係，如 disentangle facts from rumors。
w_disguise

a costume or appearance used to conceal one's identity 常見 in disguise（喬裝打扮）、a blessing in disguise（塞翁失馬）；強調隱藏真實身分或本質。 偽裝；掩飾 to change the appearance of someone or something to conceal identity or nature 常接 as，如 disguise oneself as，也可指掩飾情緒或事實，如 disguise one's fear。
w_disillusion

a feeling of disappointment resulting from discovering that something is not as good as believed 常見 a sense of disillusion，指原本抱持的美好想像破滅後的失落感。 使幻滅；使覺醒 to make someone realize that their belief in something was mistaken or too idealistic 常見被動語態 be disillusioned with/by，強調原本的美好想像被現實打破。
w_disinterested
not influenced by personal interest or bias; impartial 常用於法律或仲裁語境，強調沒有私利考量；易與 uninterested（不感興趣的）混淆，兩者意義不同。
w_dislodge
to force something out of a fixed or established position 常接具體物體，如 dislodge a stone，也可比喻用於使人離開職位或地位，如 dislodge a leader。
w_dismal
depressingly bad, dull, or gloomy 常修飾天氣、表現或前景，如 dismal weather、a dismal failure，強調令人失望或情緒低落的程度。
w_disparage
to speak of someone or something in a critical or belittling way 正式用語，常見 disparage someone's work/efforts，強調言語上貶損他人價值或能力。
w_disparate
essentially different in kind; not able to be compared 常修飾 groups、views、elements 等，強調彼此差異極大，難以歸為同類，語氣正式。
w_disparity

a large difference between two things, especially one that seems unfair disparity 指「大到值得注意、而且往往不公平」的差距。它比 difference 帶有更強的評價色彩，因此常用於社會科學與績效分析：income disparity、a disparity in access。介系詞用 between 或 in。 a disparity between a and b a disparity in + noun a disparity between ……之間的落差 a wide disparity 巨大的差距 income disparity 所得差距 address the disparity 處理這個落差 inequality gap parity equivalence disparate discrepancy
w_dispassionate
not influenced by strong emotion, and therefore able to be rational and impartial 常修飾 analysis、view，強調理性、不受情緒左右地看待事物，語氣正面，與 passionate 相對。
w_dispel
to make a feeling, belief, or rumor disappear 常接 doubts、fears、rumors 等抽象名詞，強調徹底消除負面或錯誤的想法。
w_disperse
to spread out or distribute over a wide area, or to cause a crowd to break up 常見 the crowd dispersed（人群散去）、disperse seeds（散播種子）；可指人群、氣體或物質的擴散。
w_display
an exhibition or arrangement of something for people to see, or a screen showing information 常見 on display（展示中）、a fireworks display（煙火表演）、a computer display（電腦顯示器），涵蓋實體展示與電子螢幕兩種意義。
w_disposable
designed to be thrown away after use, or (of income) available for spending after essentials 常見 disposable cup/diaper（免洗杯／紙尿褲）、disposable income（可支配所得），前者指一次性使用，後者為經濟學用語。
w_disposal
the act of getting rid of something, or the arrangement of something 常見 waste disposal（廢棄物處理）、at someone's disposal（供某人使用），後者為固定片語，指東西可任其使用。
w_dispose
to get rid of something, or to arrange or incline someone toward a particular attitude 常見 dispose of（丟棄、處理），為固定片語；也可用於 be disposed to do something（傾向於做某事），語氣較正式。
w_disposition
a person's inherent qualities of mind and character, or a tendency toward a particular behavior 常見 a cheerful disposition（開朗的性情）、a disposition to/toward，強調天生的性格特質或行為傾向。
w_disprove
to prove that something is false or wrong 常接 a theory、claim、allegation 等，強調用證據推翻先前的主張或說法。
w_dispute
a disagreement or argument, especially a formal or prolonged one 常見 a labor dispute（勞資糾紛）、in dispute（有爭議的），常用於正式、法律或政治語境。
w_disrupt
to interrupt the normal course or continuity of something 常接 activity、schedule、meeting 等，如 disrupt traffic（造成交通中斷），強調破壞原有的順暢或秩序。
w_disruptive
causing disturbance or interruption to a normal process 常修飾 behavior、technology 等，如 disruptive technology（顛覆性科技，帶正面創新意味）、disruptive student（搗亂的學生，帶負面意味）。
w_dissection
the act of cutting something apart to examine it, or a detailed analysis 字面指生物解剖（如 frog dissection），比喻用法指深入分析事物，如 a dissection of the argument。
w_dissent

disagreement with a widely held or official opinion 常見 political dissent（政治異議）、express dissent，指公開反對主流或官方立場，帶有勇於發聲的意味。 持異議；表示反對 to hold or express opinions that differ from those officially or generally held 常接 from，如 dissent from the majority view，強調公開表達與主流不同的立場。
w_dissertation
a long piece of academic writing based on original research, typically for an advanced degree 常見 write a dissertation、a doctoral dissertation，通常指博士或碩士層級的長篇研究論文。
w_dissident
openly opposing official policy, especially in a political context 常修飾 group、writer 等，指公開反對政府或體制的立場，帶政治色彩。
w_dissipate
to gradually disappear or scatter, or to waste something such as energy or resources 可指霧氣、憤怒等逐漸消散（不及物），也可指浪費資源或精力（及物），如 dissipate one's energy。
w_dissociate
to separate oneself from an association with someone or something, or to disconnect two things mentally 常見 dissociate oneself from（撇清與…的關係），強調刻意切割與某事物或某人的聯繫。
w_dissolve

to become or cause a solid to become incorporated into a liquid, or to bring an official group or agreement to an end 常見 dissolve in water（溶於水），也可指正式終止關係或組織，如 dissolve parliament（解散國會）、dissolve a marriage。
w_dissuade
to persuade someone not to do something 常接 from，如 dissuade someone from doing something，與 persuade 意義相反，強調成功使人打消念頭。
w_distal
situated away from the center of the body or from the point of attachment 解剖學專業用語，與 proximal（近端的）相對，較少用於日常語境。
w_distant
far away in space or time, or emotionally reserved and detached 可指實際距離或時間上的遙遠，如 the distant past，也可形容人的態度冷淡、不親近，如 a distant relationship。
w_distinct
recognizably different or separate; clearly perceptible 常接 from，如 distinct from，也可單獨修飾感官感受，如 a distinct smell，強調界線分明、容易辨識。
w_distinction

a clear difference between two similar things distinction 指「兩個相似事物之間的清楚分別」，重點在於「分辨」這個動作的結果。它常出現在分析性寫作中，用來提醒讀者不要混淆兩個概念。最重要的句型是 the distinction between a and b，以及動詞搭配 draw / make a distinction。 the distinction between a and b draw a distinction between a and b make a distinction between a and b draw a distinction between 區分……與…… a clear distinction 明確的區別 a subtle distinction 細微的差別 blur the distinction 模糊界線 difference differentiation distinguish distinct distinctive difference
w_distinctive
having a quality or characteristic that makes something easily recognizable and different from others 常修飾 style、feature、flavor，強調某事物具有辨識度高的獨特之處，語氣正面。
w_distinctly
clearly and unmistakably, or in a way that shows a distinct quality 常修飾動詞或形容詞，如 distinctly remember、distinctly different，強調程度或感受非常明確。
w_distinguish
to recognize a difference between things, or to make oneself notably successful or different 常接 between a and b 或 a from b，如 distinguish right from wrong；也可用反身用法 distinguish oneself（表現出眾）。
w_distort
to give a misleading or false account of something, or to twist something out of its normal shape 可指事實、訊息被扭曲，如 distort the truth，也可指物理上的變形，如聲音或影像失真。
w_distortion
the action of distorting or the state of being distorted 常見 a distortion of the facts（事實的扭曲）、sound distortion（音訊失真），涵蓋抽象與物理層面。
w_distract
to draw someone's attention away from what they are doing or thinking about 常接 from，如 distract someone from their work，強調打斷專注力，可能是有意或無意造成。
w_distraction
something that prevents someone from concentrating, or the state of being unable to concentrate 常見 a distraction from，指造成分心的具體事物；也可指心不在焉的狀態。
w_distraught
deeply upset and agitated, often to the point of being unable to think clearly 常見 distraught parents/family，強調因悲傷或驚恐而情緒失控，語氣強烈。
w_distress
extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain, or a state of danger requiring immediate help 常見 emotional distress（情緒上的痛苦）、a ship in distress（遇險的船隻），後者為固定用法，指急需救助的狀態。
w_distribute
to give shares of something to a number of people, or to spread something over an area 常接 among/to，如 distribute food among refugees，也可指均勻分布，如 distribute weight evenly。
w_disturbance
an interruption of a settled or peaceful condition, or a public disorder 常見 a disturbance in the neighborhood（社區騷動）、sleep disturbance（睡眠干擾），涵蓋日常干擾與公共秩序混亂兩種情境。
w_ditch

a long narrow channel dug in the ground, typically for drainage 常見 a drainage ditch（排水溝），指沿路或田邊挖掘的長條形凹槽，用於排水或界定範圍。 拋棄；甩掉；放棄 to abandon or get rid of something or someone, often abruptly 口語用法，常接人或計畫，如 ditch a plan、ditch a friend，語氣較隨性直接，帶輕微負面意味。
w_dive

an act of plunging into water headfirst, or a sudden drop 常見 a swan dive（燕式跳水）、take a dive（假摔或價格暴跌），後者為比喻用法。 跳水；俯衝；急速下降 to plunge headfirst into water, or to move quickly downward 常接 into，如 dive into the pool；也可比喻用於物價、股市等急遽下滑，如 stock prices dove。
w_diverge
to separate and go in different directions, or to differ from a standard or expected pattern 常接 from，如 diverge from the norm，也可指道路、意見等分開，如 the paths diverge。
w_diverse
showing great variety; including many different types 常修飾 group、population、range，如 a diverse workforce（多元的員工組成），強調種類或成員的多元性。
w_diversity
the state of including a range of different types of people or things 常見 cultural diversity（文化多樣性）、diversity and inclusion（多元與包容），常用於社會、職場議題。
w_divert
to cause something to change direction or purpose, or to distract someone's attention 常接 from...to，如 divert funds from one project to another，也可指使人分心，如 divert attention。
w_divine
relating to or coming from god or a god; excellent or wonderful 常見 divine intervention（神的干預）；口語中也可誇張形容極好的事物，如 the dessert was divine。
w_divorce

the legal ending of a marriage 常見 get a divorce、file for divorce，指婚姻透過法律程序正式終止。 離婚；使分離 to legally end a marriage, or to separate one thing from another 及物動詞，如 divorce someone；也可比喻用於將兩者切割開來，如 divorce theory from practice。
w_divulge
to make known private or previously secret information 正式用語，常接 information、secret，如 divulge confidential details，強調揭露原本不該公開的內容。
w_dock
an area of water beside a wharf where ships load, unload, or are repaired 常見 the ship is in dock（船在碼頭停靠或維修），指供船隻停泊或整修的水域區。
w_doctrine
a belief or set of beliefs held and taught by a religious, political, or philosophical group 常見 religious doctrine（宗教教義）、political doctrine（政治主張），指有系統、被官方認可的一套信念或原則。
w_documentary

a film or program presenting factual information about a real event or subject 常見 a documentary about/on，指以真實事件或議題為主題拍攝的非虛構影片。 文件的；紀錄片式的 relating to or consisting of documents, or in the style of a documentary 常見 documentary evidence（書面證據）、documentary style（紀錄片風格），前者強調正式書面文件的性質。
w_documentation
written or printed materials used as evidence or as instructions 常見 supporting documentation（佐證文件）、technical documentation（技術文件），泛指提供證明或說明用途的書面資料。
w_dogmatic
inclined to lay down principles as unquestionably true, without allowing for debate 常帶負面評價，形容人固執己見、不容質疑的態度，如 a dogmatic approach。
w_dolphin
a highly intelligent marine mammal known for its playful behavior 常見於海洋生態、水族館語境，如 a pod of dolphins（一群海豚），指高智商的海洋哺乳動物。
w_domain
an area of activity, knowledge, or interest under someone's control, or a website's internet address 常見 public domain（公共領域，指不受版權限制的作品）、a domain name（網域名稱）；涵蓋抽象領域與網路技術兩種意義。
w_dome
a rounded roof or ceiling, typically hemispherical in shape 常見於建築描述，如 the dome of the cathedral（大教堂的圓頂），指半球形的屋頂結構。
w_dominant
most powerful, important, or influential in a particular context 常見 the dominant species/party，也可指遺傳學上的顯性基因，如 a dominant gene，需視上下文判斷詞義。
w_dominate
to have a controlling influence over someone or something 常接 the market、conversation 等，如 dominate the industry，強調在某領域擁有壓倒性的影響力或控制力。
w_domination
the exercise of control or power over someone or something 常見 world domination（世界霸權，常用於誇張或戲劇語境）、economic domination，強調全面掌控的狀態。
w_donate
to give money, goods, or time freely to help a person or cause 常見 donate money/blood/time，強調無償給予以幫助他人或支持某項目的。
w_donation
something given, especially money, to help a person, group, or cause 常見 make a donation、a charitable donation，指實際捐出的財物本身。
w_donor
a person or organization that gives something, especially money or an organ 常見 a blood donor（捐血者）、an organ donor（器官捐贈者）、a major donor（重要捐款人），依語境涵蓋不同捐贈類型。
w_dose

a specific quantity of a medicine or drug taken at one time 常見 a daily dose、an overdose（過量），指藥物一次服用的份量，醫學語境常用。 給予（藥物）劑量 to give someone a specific amount of medicine 及物動詞，常見 dose someone with，強調對病人或動物投予特定劑量的藥物。
w_doubtful
uncertain or unlikely; feeling or expressing doubt 常見 it is doubtful whether/that，也可形容人心存懷疑，如 look doubtful，強調對某事的真實性或可能性存疑。
w_doubtless
almost certainly; without much doubt 書面正式用語，常置句首，如 doubtless, he will succeed，語氣比 undoubtedly 稍弱但仍表達高度確信。
w_dour
stern, unfriendly, and lacking in warmth or humor 常形容人的表情或性格，如 a dour expression，強調給人冷淡、不易親近的印象。
w_douse
to drench something with liquid, or to extinguish a fire or light 常接 with water，如 douse the flames，也可用於熄燈或關閉裝置，強調用液體撲滅或使某物濕透。
w_downplay
to make something seem less important than it really is 常接 the importance/significance of，強調刻意降低某事的嚴重性或重要性。
w_downtown

located in or relating to the central business area of a city 常見 downtown area、a downtown office，指城市中心商業區相關的地點或事物，美式用法常見。 往市中心；在市中心 toward or in the central business area of a city 常接動詞，如 go downtown、work downtown，美式英語常用，口語中十分自然。
w_drab
lacking brightness or color; dull and dreary 常形容顏色、環境或生活枯燥無趣，如 drab clothing、a drab office，語氣帶輕微負面。
w_draft
a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of cool air 常見 a first draft（初稿）、feel a draft（感覺到穿堂風），兩義項意義差異大，需依上下文判斷。
w_drag
the action of pulling something with effort, or something tediously slow or boring 常見 what a drag（真無聊）為口語表達，也可指物理上的阻力（如空氣阻力），依語境判斷。
w_drain
a pipe or channel carrying away liquid waste or excess water, or something that depletes resources 常見 down the drain（付諸東流，比喻用法）、a drain on resources（資源的消耗），後者強調持續耗損。
w_drainage
the process or system for removing excess water or liquid from an area 常見 a drainage system、poor drainage，指用於排除積水的系統或過程，常用於農業、都市規劃語境。
w_drama
a play for theater, radio, or television, or an exciting and emotional situation 常見 a tv drama（電視劇）；also 口語用於形容誇張的情緒風波，如 don't create drama。
w_dramatic
sudden and striking, or relating to drama 常修飾 change、increase 等，強調變化幅度大且顯著，如 a dramatic improvement；也可單純指與戲劇相關。
w_dramatically
in a sudden, striking, or extreme way 常修飾 change、increase、decrease 等動詞，強調變化的幅度顯著、出人意料。
w_drawl
to speak slowly with prolonged vowel sounds 常見於描述南方口音或懶散的說話方式，如 he drawled his words，帶有地域或個人風格色彩。 拖長的說話腔調 a way of speaking with prolonged vowel sounds 常見 a southern drawl（美國南方拖長腔），指說話時母音拉長的特殊腔調。
w_dreadful
extremely bad, unpleasant, or serious 口語常用於誇張表達不滿或負面評價，如 dreadful weather、a dreadful mistake，語氣強烈但較 disaster 稍輕。
w_drench
to make someone or something completely wet 常見被動語態 be drenched in/with，如 drenched in sweat（汗流浹背），強調徹底浸濕的程度。
w_dribble

to let liquid or saliva fall in drops, or to move a ball forward with light touches (in sports) 字面指液體滴落，也常見於籃球、足球等運動中控球前進的動作，兩義項語境差異大。 滴落的少量液體；運球（動作） a small trickle of liquid, or the act of moving a ball with light touches 常見於描述少量液體滴落，或運動中控球動作的名詞形式。
w_drift
a slow, gradual movement, or the general meaning of what someone is saying 常見 catch someone's drift（明白某人的意思，口語用法）、a snow drift（雪堆），依語境判斷詞義。
w_drill

a tool for boring holes, or a repeated exercise for training 常見 a fire drill（消防演習）、a power drill（電鑽），涵蓋工具與訓練演練兩種常見用法。 鑽孔；反覆訓練 to make a hole using a drill, or to train someone through repeated exercises 常接具體物體，如 drill a hole，也可用於教育語境，如 drill students on vocabulary（反覆訓練學生單字）。
w_drip

a small falling drop of liquid, or the sound or process of dripping 常見 drip by drip（一滴一滴地）、an iv drip（點滴，醫療用語），指液體逐滴落下的現象或聲音。 滴落 to fall or let fall in small drops 常接 from/with，如 drip from the ceiling、dripping with sweat，強調液體以小滴形式落下。
w_drizzle

light rain falling in fine drops 常見 a light drizzle，指比 rain 更輕、顆粒更細的降雨，天氣預報常用詞。 下毛毛雨；（把液體）細細淋在食物上 to rain lightly in fine drops, or to pour a liquid lightly over food 天氣用法為不及物動詞；烹飪用法則常見 drizzle olive oil over the salad（在沙拉上淋橄欖油）。
w_drone

an unmanned aircraft controlled remotely, or a continuous low humming sound 常見 a surveillance drone（監視用無人機），也可指單調持續的聲音，如 the drone of traffic，兩義項常見於不同語境。 發出嗡嗡聲；用單調的語氣說話 to make a continuous low humming sound, or to talk in a monotonous tone 常接 on，如 drone on about something（喋喋不休地講某事），帶輕微負面意味，指說話乏味冗長。
w_droop
to bend or hang down weakly, especially from tiredness or lack of support 常形容眼皮、花朵或肩膀因疲勞或缺乏支撐而下垂，如 eyelids drooping，語氣中性偏消極。
w_drought
a prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall 常見 a severe drought、drought conditions，指長期降雨不足導致的缺水狀況，農業與氣候語境常用。
w_drown
to die or cause death from being unable to breathe underwater, or to overwhelm a sound 字面指溺水，比喻用法如 drown out a sound（蓋過某聲音），強調某聲音被完全掩蓋。
w_dual
consisting of two parts, elements, or aspects 常見 dual citizenship（雙重國籍）、dual purpose（雙重目的），強調同時具備兩種性質或功能。
w_duel

a formal fight between two people with weapons, or an intense contest between two parties 字面指歷史上兩人以武器對決，比喻用法指激烈的競爭，如 a political duel。 決鬥；激烈競爭 to fight in a formal duel, or to compete intensely with someone 字面用法較少見於現代，比喻用法常見於體育或政治語境，如 the two candidates dueled over the issue。
w_dull
to make something less sharp, intense, or interesting 常接 pain、senses 等，如 the medicine dulled the pain（藥物減輕了疼痛），也可指使人失去興趣或活力。
w_duly
in a proper or expected manner; at the appropriate time 正式用語，常見 duly noted（已如實記錄）、duly elected（依法當選），強調依照正確程序或預期完成。
w_dumb
stupid or foolish, or (dated/offensive) unable to speak 口語中常指愚蠢，如 a dumb question；指「不能說話」的用法現已過時且可能冒犯，較少使用。
w_dummy

an object made to resemble a real thing, especially for training or display, or (informally) a stupid person 常見 a crash test dummy（碰撞測試假人）、a dummy pacifier（安撫奶嘴，英式用法），口語中也可用來罵人愚蠢。 假的；模擬用的 made to imitate or replace something real, used for testing or as a placeholder 常見 a dummy account（測試用假帳號）、dummy data（測試用假資料），指非真實但用於模擬或測試的事物。
w_dump

a site where waste is left, or (informally) an unpleasant, messy place 常見 a garbage dump（垃圾場），口語也可用來形容雜亂骯髒的住處，如 this apartment is a dump。 傾倒（垃圾）；隨意丟棄；（口語）甩掉（情人） to get rid of something in a careless or hasty way, or to end a romantic relationship abruptly 常見 dump waste（傾倒廢棄物）；口語中也常用於分手情境，如 he dumped his girlfriend。
w_duration
the length of time something continues or lasts 常見 for the duration of，如 for the duration of the meeting（整場會議期間），強調事件延續的時長。
w_dwarf

a person, animal, or plant much smaller than usual, especially one with a genetic condition affecting growth 字面用法涉及生理特徵，需謹慎使用避免冒犯；也可指童話中的小矮人角色，如 snow white and the seven dwarfs。 使相形見絀；遠遠超過 to make something seem small by comparison; to greatly exceed in size 常見 be dwarfed by，如 the old building was dwarfed by the new skyscraper，強調在體積或規模上遠遠超越。
w_dynamic
characterized by constant change, activity, or energy 常修飾 person、market、process，強調積極變化、不斷發展的特質，語氣正面，與 static 相對。
w_dynamics
the forces or properties that stimulate change, growth, or activity within a system 常見 group dynamics（團體互動關係）、market dynamics（市場動態），指影響系統運作或變化的內在因素。
w_dysfunctional
not operating normally or properly, especially in relation to social or family relationships 常見 a dysfunctional family（失能家庭）、a dysfunctional system，強調原本應正常運作的關係或系統出現嚴重問題。
w_eager
strongly wanting to do or have something 常接 to do something 或 for，如 eager to learn、eager for success，語氣積極正面，強調熱切的期待或意願。
w_eagle
a large bird of prey known for its keen eyesight and powerful flight 常見 a bald eagle（美國國鳥白頭海鵰）、eagle-eyed（比喻視力敏銳、觀察力強），也常作為國家或組織的象徵。
w_earthly
relating to life on earth or to worldly, rather than spiritual, matters 常見 earthly possessions（塵世財產）、no earthly reason（毫無道理，口語誇張用法），強調與精神、天堂相對的現世層面。
w_earthquake
a sudden violent shaking of the ground caused by movement in the earth's crust 常見 a major earthquake、an earthquake struck，指地殼運動引發的地表震動，常伴隨災害描述。
w_earthy
resembling or suggestive of earth or soil, or direct and unrefined in a natural way 常見 an earthy smell（泥土味）、an earthy sense of humor（粗獷直率的幽默），後者形容不做作、貼近自然的個性。
w_eavesdrop
to secretly listen to a private conversation 常接 on，如 eavesdrop on a conversation，強調未經允許暗中竊聽他人談話，帶負面意味。
w_echo
a repetition of sound caused by reflection, or something that closely resembles or reminds one of another thing 字面指聲音反射，比喻用法如 an echo of the past（過去的回響），強調某事讓人聯想起先前類似的事物。
w_eclectic

a person who draws ideas, style, or content from a diverse range of sources 名詞用法較少見，通常出現在描述某人綜合多元風格或思想的語境中。 兼容並蓄的；多元折衷的 deriving ideas, style, or taste from a broad and diverse range of sources 常修飾 taste、style、collection，如 an eclectic mix of music，強調來源多樣、不侷限於單一風格。
w_ecological
relating to the environment and the relationships between living organisms and their surroundings 常見 ecological balance（生態平衡）、ecological damage（生態破壞），用於環境、保育相關語境。
w_ecology
the branch of biology dealing with the relationships between organisms and their environment 學術用語，常見 the ecology of，指研究生物與環境相互關係的科學領域。
w_economical
giving good value or using limited resources efficiently; frugal 常修飾 car、method 等，如 an economical choice（划算的選擇），強調省錢或有效利用資源，注意與 economic（經濟的）不同。
w_economics
the branch of social science concerned with the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services 學術學科名稱，常見 study economics、a degree in economics，作不可數名詞，動詞用單數。
w_ecosystem
a community of living organisms interacting with their physical environment 常見 a fragile ecosystem（脆弱的生態系統）、a marine ecosystem（海洋生態系統），生態學核心概念。
w_ecstatic
feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement 常見 be ecstatic about，語氣比 happy 強烈許多，強調極度興奮愉悅的情緒。
w_ecumenical
promoting unity among different christian denominations, or broadly inclusive of different groups 主要用於宗教語境，指促進不同教派合作與共融，也可比喻用於跨群體合作的場合。
w_edit
to prepare written, film, or audio material for publication by correcting, condensing, or arranging it 常接 a manuscript、a video 等，如 edit a document，強調對內容進行修改、刪減或整理以達到最終呈現效果。
w_editorial
relating to the process of editing or to an editor's opinion 常見 editorial content（編輯內容）、editorial board（編輯委員會），也指報刊表達立場的社論性質。
w_eerie
strange and frightening in a mysterious way 常修飾 silence、feeling、place，如 an eerie silence（詭異的寂靜），強調帶有神祕、不安的氛圍。
w_effectiveness
the degree to which something produces the intended result 常見 measure the effectiveness of，指某方法、政策或藥物達成預期成效的程度。
w_efficacy
the ability of something, especially a treatment or method, to produce the intended result 正式用語，常見於醫學或科學語境，如 clinical efficacy，較 effectiveness 更專業書面。
w_efficiency
the ability to accomplish something with minimum wasted time, effort, or resources 常見 improve efficiency、energy efficiency，強調以最少資源達成最大成果的能力。
w_efficient
achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense 常修飾 system、worker、method，如 an efficient process，強調能快速有效地完成任務，資源浪費少。
w_effrontery
shameless boldness or disrespectful behavior 正式書面用語，常見 have the effrontery to do something，強調做出令人吃驚的無禮或大膽舉動。
w_egregious
outstandingly bad or shocking, especially in a way that is very obvious 正式用語，常修飾 error、violation，如 an egregious mistake，強調程度嚴重到令人無法忽視。
w_elaboration
the addition of further detail or explanation to something 常見 without further elaboration（不再詳加說明）、an elaboration of，指為使內容更清楚而補充的細節。
w_elbow
the joint between the upper arm and the forearm 常見 elbow room（比喻迴旋餘地）、elbow someone（用手肘推擠某人），為身體部位常用詞。
w_electorate
all the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote 集合名詞，常見 appeal to the electorate、the wider electorate，指整個具投票資格的群體，而非單一選民。
w_electron
a subatomic particle with a negative electric charge 物理與化學專業用語，常見 electron microscope（電子顯微鏡），指原子中帶負電的基本粒子。
w_electronics
the branch of technology dealing with electronic devices and systems, or such devices collectively 常見 study electronics（研讀電子學）、consumer electronics（消費性電子產品），依語境指學科或產品類別。
w_elegant
graceful and stylish in appearance or manner 常修飾 dress、design、solution，如 an elegant solution（比喻簡潔漂亮的解法），涵蓋外觀與抽象層面的美感。
w_elegy
a poem or song of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead 文學用語，常見 an elegy for，指悼念逝者、表達哀思的詩歌或樂曲。
w_elementary
relating to the basic elements of a subject; simple or introductory 常見 elementary school（小學，美式用法）、elementary mistakes（低級錯誤），強調簡單、入門程度。
w_elevate
to raise something to a higher position, level, or status 常接 to，如 elevate someone to a position，也可指實際抬高物體，語氣正式，較 raise 書面。
w_elevator
a platform or enclosure that moves people or goods between floors of a building 美式用語（英式為 lift），常見 take the elevator，日常生活常用詞。
w_elicit

to draw out a response, reaction, or piece of information from someone elicit 的核心是「主動設法讓對方給出反應」，因此它的受詞是 response、reaction、information、feedback 這類抽象名詞。需求訪談中的 elicit requirements（引導出需求）是專業術語，強調需求要靠提問挖掘，而不是等人交出來。 elicit a from b elicit a response elicit a response 引出回應 elicit requirements 引導出需求 elicit feedback 取得回饋 draw out evoke elicitation illicit
w_eligible
satisfying the appropriate conditions to do or receive something 常接 for，如 eligible for a discount/loan，強調符合特定條件或標準而具備資格。
w_eliminate

to completely remove or get rid of something that is unwanted eliminate 強調「徹底、完全地去掉」，讓某個問題、風險或多餘的東西不再存在。它比 remove 語氣更強：remove 只是把東西「拿走、搬走」，eliminate 則暗示「讓它從此不存在」。因此常用於 bug、風險、浪費、重複、瓶頸等抽象事物。 eliminate + noun eliminate the need for + noun eliminate the need for 使……變得不必要 eliminate duplication 消除重複 eliminate a risk 消除風險 eliminate waste 消除浪費 completely eliminate 完全消除 preclude eradicate introduce retain elimination eliminated remove
w_elite
a select group considered to be the best or most privileged in a society 常見 the political elite（政治菁英）、a small elite，指在能力、地位或財富上居於頂尖的群體。
w_elliptical
having the shape of an ellipse, or (of speech/writing) using very few words and omitting details 字面指幾何形狀，比喻用法形容說話簡略、意在言外，如 an elliptical remark，需依上下文判斷。
w_elucidate

to make something clearer by explaining it in more detail elucidate 的字根與「光」有關，意象是「照亮原本晦暗之處」。它比 explain 正式得多，多見於學術寫作與正式簡報。受詞通常是複雜的機制、關係或概念。日常對話中使用會顯得過於文縐縐。 elucidate + noun elucidate how/why + clause elucidate the mechanism 闡明機制 further elucidate 進一步闡明 elucidate the relationship 釐清兩者的關係 clarify explain obfuscate elucidation illustrate
w_elude
to escape from or avoid someone or something skillfully, or to fail to be understood or remembered 常見 elude capture（逃脫追捕）、the answer eludes me（我怎麼也想不起答案），後者強調某事難以掌握或回憶。
w_emanate
to come out from a source, especially in the form of a feeling, quality, or idea 常接 from，如 confidence emanates from her，強調某種特質、氣息或聲音自然地從來源散發出來。
w_embankment
a wall or bank built to hold back water or to carry a road or railway 常見 a river embankment（河堤）、a railway embankment（鐵路路堤），指用於防洪或支撐道路鐵軌的土石結構。
w_embargo

an official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country 常見 impose/lift an embargo，指政府對特定國家實施的貿易限制，常用於國際政治語境。 對…實施禁運 to officially forbid trade or commercial activity with a country 及物動詞，接國家或商品作受詞，強調正式下令禁止貿易往來。
w_embark
to begin a journey, especially by ship, or to start a new project or undertaking 常接 on/upon，如 embark on a journey/project，強調正式展開某項活動或旅程。
w_embassy
the official residence or offices of an ambassador and staff representing their country abroad 常見 the american embassy，指一國派駐他國的官方外交機構。
w_embed
to fix something firmly into a surrounding mass, or to incorporate as an integral part 常見 embed a video（嵌入影片）、embed values in a culture（將價值觀深植於文化中），常見被動語態 be embedded in。
w_embellish
to make something more attractive by adding decorative details, or to add fictional details to a story 字面指增添裝飾，比喻用法常見 embellish a story，帶輕微負面意味，指誇大或虛構部分細節。
w_emblazon
to display a design or words prominently on something 常見被動語態，如 a logo emblazoned on a shirt，強調圖案或文字醒目地印製或裝飾在物體表面。
w_emblematic
serving as a symbol or representative example of something 常接 of，如 emblematic of a broader trend，強調某事物是更大現象或特質的典型代表。
w_embodiment
a person or thing that represents an idea or quality in a physical or concrete form 常見 the embodiment of，如 the embodiment of courage（勇氣的化身），強調抽象特質透過具體的人或事物呈現。
w_embody
to represent or express an idea, quality, or feeling in a tangible form 常見 embody a value/spirit，強調某人或事物具體展現出某種精神、特質或原則。
w_embrace

an act of holding someone closely in one's arms 常見 a warm embrace，強調身體上親密的擁抱動作，語氣溫暖。 擁抱；欣然接受（想法、變革） to hold someone closely in one's arms, or to accept an idea, opportunity, or change willingly 字面指身體上的擁抱，比喻用法更常見，如 embrace change（擁抱改變），強調積極接納。
w_embroider
to decorate fabric with needlework designs, or to add exaggerated details to a story 字面指縫紉裝飾布料，比喻用法類似 embellish，指誇大敘述以使故事更精彩。
w_embroil
to involve someone deeply in a conflict, argument, or difficult situation 常見被動語態 be embroiled in，如 embroiled in a scandal/lawsuit，強調深陷難以脫身的複雜狀況。
w_embryo
an unborn or unhatched offspring in the early stages of development 醫學與生物學用語，常見 embryo development，也可比喻用於構想的初期階段，如 in embryo（尚在萌芽階段）。
w_emergence
the process of coming into existence or prominence 常見 the emergence of，如 the emergence of new technology（新科技的興起），強調某事物從無到有或逐漸受到關注。
w_emergency
a serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action 常見 in case of emergency、an emergency room（急診室），強調需要立即處理的危急狀況。
w_emigrate
to leave one's own country to settle permanently in another 常接 from，強調「離開」原本的國家，與 immigrate（移入某國）視角相反，常搭配使用。
w_eminent
famous and respected within a particular sphere, especially a profession 常修飾 scientist、professor 等，如 an eminent scholar，強調在特定領域享有崇高聲望與地位。
w_emission
the production and release of something, especially gas or radiation 常見 carbon emissions（碳排放）、greenhouse gas emissions，環境議題常用詞。
w_emit
to give off or release something, such as light, sound, gas, or heat 常接具體物理現象作受詞，如 emit light/heat/a sound，強調物體主動散發出某種能量或物質。
w_emotion
a strong feeling such as joy, anger, or fear 常見 show emotion、a wave of emotion，泛指各種強烈的內在感受，涵蓋正面與負面情緒。
w_emotional
relating to emotions, or showing strong feelings 常見 an emotional response（情緒反應）、get emotional（變得激動），可中性描述情感相關事物，也可指人容易動情。
w_emphasis

special importance or attention given to something emphasis 指「把注意力特別放在某件事上」。最常見的句型是 place / put emphasis on something，介系詞固定為 on。注意複數是 emphases（如同 analysis→analyses），這是希臘語來源的變化，也是常見的拼寫錯誤來源。 place/put emphasis on + noun with an emphasis on + noun place emphasis on 著重於 a shift in emphasis 重心的轉移 with an emphasis on 以……為重點 particular emphasis 特別的強調 focus stress emphasize emphatic importance
w_emphasize
to give special importance or prominence to something 常接名詞或子句，如 emphasize the importance of，強調刻意突顯某重點以引起注意。
w_empirical

based on observation or measurement rather than on theory or pure reasoning empirical 的核心對比是「觀測 vs. 理論」：empirical evidence 是實際量測或觀察來的證據，與從原理推導出的結論相對。工程討論中它常用來把爭論拉回數據：do we have any empirical evidence for that? 是一句很有力的提問。 empirical evidence for + noun an empirical study of + noun empirical evidence 實證證據 an empirical study 實證研究 empirical data 實測資料 purely empirical 純粹經驗性的 observational experimental theoretical speculative empirically empiricism anecdotal
w_empower
to give someone the authority, confidence, or means to do something 常接 to do something，如 empower employees to make decisions，強調給予他人自主行動或決策的能力與信心。
w_emulate
to try to match or surpass someone by imitating their achievements or qualities 常接人或成就作受詞，如 emulate a role model，強調以他人為榜樣努力追趕或超越，語氣正面。
w_enact
to make a bill or plan into law, or to perform or act out a role 常見 enact a law/legislation（制定法律），也可用於戲劇語境，指扮演角色或重演事件。
w_encapsulate
to express or represent the essential features of something concisely 常見 encapsulate an idea/feeling，強調用簡潔的方式完整呈現某事物的核心要點。
w_enclose
to surround something on all sides, or to put something inside an envelope or package along with a main item 常見 enclose a document（隨信附上文件）、an enclosed garden（被圍住的花園），依語境判斷詞義。
w_enclosure
an area surrounded by a fence or wall, or an item included along with a letter 常見 an animal enclosure（動物圍欄）、please see enclosure（請見附件），依語境涵蓋實體空間與文件附件兩種意義。
w_encompass
to include a wide range of things or areas as part of something 常見 encompass a wide range of topics，強調範圍廣泛地包括多項內容或層面，語氣正式。
w_encounter
an unexpected or casual meeting with someone or something 常見 a chance encounter（不期而遇）、a close encounter（近距離接觸），強調意外或短暫的接觸經驗。
w_encroach
to gradually intrude on someone's territory, rights, or time 常接 on/upon，如 encroach on someone's privacy，強調逐步、悄悄地侵犯他人的權利或領域。
w_endeavor
to try hard to achieve or complete something 常接 to do something，如 endeavor to improve，語氣正式，強調認真努力達成目標，較 try 更書面。
w_endemic

a disease or condition regularly found within a particular area or population 醫學用語，指在特定地區或群體中持續存在的疾病，與偶發性的 epidemic 不同。 （某地區）特有的；地方性的 regularly found in a particular area, population, or field 常見 endemic species（特有種）、an endemic problem（根深蒂固的問題），強調長期存在且與特定範圍緊密相關。
w_endless
having or seeming to have no end; very long or continuous 常修飾 possibilities、supply、wait 等，如 endless possibilities（無限的可能性），強調數量、時間或範圍極大。
w_endorse
to declare one's public approval or support of someone or something 常見 endorse a candidate/product，指公開表態支持某人、產品或政策，帶正式或商業色彩。
w_endow
to provide someone or something with a quality or ability, or to give a large sum of money to fund an institution 常見 be endowed with talent（天生具有才能）、endow a scholarship（捐款設立獎學金），依語境涵蓋抽象特質與實質捐款。
w_endure
to suffer something difficult or painful patiently, or to continue to exist over a long period 可指忍耐艱難處境，如 endure hardship，也可指事物長久留存，如 traditions that endure。
w_enforce
to compel observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or requirement 常接 a law/rule/policy，如 enforce regulations，強調確保規則被確實遵守，必要時採取強制手段。
w_engagement
a formal agreement to get married, or the state of being involved in an activity 常見 announce an engagement（宣布訂婚）、customer engagement（顧客參與度），依語境判斷為婚姻承諾或參與程度。
w_engrave
to cut or carve words or a design onto a hard surface 常接 on/with，如 engrave a name on a ring，強調在堅硬表面（金屬、石材）刻上文字或圖案，常見於紀念物品。
w_engross
to absorb all of someone's attention or interest completely 常見被動語態 be engrossed in，如 engrossed in a book，強調某人專注到幾乎忽略周遭一切的程度。
w_engulf
to surround and cover something completely, often suddenly and destructively 常見主詞為火、水、恐慌等，表示迅速且徹底地包圍或吞噬；也可用於情緒，如 engulfed in guilt。
w_enhance
to improve the quality, value, or attractiveness of something 常接 reputation、flavor、experience 等抽象或感官名詞，語氣正面；不用於改善人的品德。
w_enigmatic
difficult to understand or interpret; mysterious 常修飾 smile、figure、statement，帶有引人好奇、無法完全看透的意味，語氣偏文學。
w_enlist
to join the armed forces 不及物動詞，常接 in，如 enlist in the army；指主動報名加入軍隊。 徵求（協助或支持） to obtain someone's help or support for a task 及物動詞，常見 enlist someone's help/support，指設法讓他人加入協助行列。
w_enormity
the great or overwhelming size, seriousness, or extent of something, especially something difficult or bad 常搭配 the enormity of the situation/task/tragedy，強調規模或後果之巨大，帶有壓迫感；不宜當作 enormousness 的一般同義詞使用。
w_enormous
extremely large in size, extent, or degree 可修飾具體事物（an enormous building）或抽象概念（enormous pressure），語氣中性，比 huge 稍正式。
w_enquire
to ask for information 英式英語常用拼法（美式多用 inquire）；常接 about 或直接引述問句，語氣正式。
w_enrage
to make someone extremely angry 及物動詞，常用被動 be enraged by/at，語氣比 anger 更強烈。
w_enroll
to register officially as a member, participant, or student 常接 in/on，如 enroll in a course；也可用於 enroll someone（讓某人）加入。
w_enrollment
the act of enrolling, or the number of people enrolled 可指註冊這個動作，也可指在學/入會的總人數，如 enrollment figures。
w_ensemble
a group of musicians, actors, or dancers who perform together 常見於 a jazz/dance ensemble；也可指服裝的整體搭配（an ensemble of clothes）。
w_enshrine
to preserve a right, tradition, or idea in a form that ensures it is protected 常見 enshrine a right in law/the constitution，語氣正式，強調賦予制度性保障。
w_enslave
to make someone a slave, or to deprive someone of freedom and control over their own life 可用於歷史上的實際奴役，也可比喻性地指被某事物（如毒品、科技）控制而失去自主。
w_ensue
to happen after or as a result of something else 不及物動詞，常見於描述事件先後順序，如 chaos/silence ensued；語氣正式，多用於書面。
w_ensure

to make certain that something will happen or be the case ensure 表示「採取行動讓某件事一定成立」。技術文件中極為高頻：ensure that the connection is closed。要注意它和 insure（投保）、assure（向人保證，讓人安心）三者的分工，這是英語母語者也常搞混的一組字。 ensure that + clause ensure + noun ensure that 確保…… ensure consistency 確保一致性 ensure compliance 確保合規 guarantee make sure assurance assure
w_entail

to involve something as a necessary part or consequence 及物動詞，後接名詞或動名詞，如 entail risk、entail spending money；語氣正式，常見於描述工作或計畫的必要條件。 限定繼承（法律用語，限定財產只能傳給特定繼承人） a legal restriction limiting the inheritance of property to a specified line of heirs 法律專有名詞，日常對話極少使用，多見於歷史小說或法律文本，如 an entail on the estate。
w_entangle
to cause something to become twisted together with something else, or to involve someone in a complicated situation 常見被動 be entangled in/with，可指實體纏繞（如魚網），也可比喻捲入糾紛或關係。
w_enterprise
a company or business, especially a new or risky one 常見 a private/commercial enterprise；也可指「進取精神」（free enterprise 自由企業制度）。
w_entertain

to provide people with enjoyment or amusement 及物動詞，常接人作受詞，如 entertain the guests；語氣中性，用於表演、活動等場合。 考慮；抱持（想法） to consider or give attention to an idea, possibility, or feeling 常接抽象名詞，如 entertain the idea/possibility/doubt，語氣正式，常見於否定句 won't entertain。
w_entertainment
movies, music, or other performances or activities that provide enjoyment 不可數名詞，泛指娛樂內容或產業，如 the entertainment industry。
w_enthusiasm
intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval 常搭配 with enthusiasm 或 enthusiasm for，強調對某事物的積極投入與興趣。
w_enthusiastic
feeling or showing intense enjoyment, interest, or approval 常接 about，如 enthusiastic about learning；修飾人或態度，語氣正面積極。
w_entice
to persuade someone to do something by offering them something pleasant 及物動詞，常見 entice someone into/to do something，帶有以利益吸引的意味，可正面（吸引顧客）也可略帶負面。
w_entitle
to give someone the right to have or do something 常見被動 be entitled to，後接名詞或不定詞，如 entitled to a refund/vacation。
w_entity
something that exists separately from other things and has its own distinct identity 常見於法律、商業或哲學語境，如 a legal/corporate entity，指具有獨立身分的組織或個體。
w_entrench
to establish something so firmly that it is very difficult to change 常見被動 be entrenched，修飾 belief、power、position 等，強調難以撼動的穩固狀態，語氣偏負面（如既得利益）。
w_entrepreneur
a person who starts and runs a business, especially one involving financial risk 常見 a young/successful entrepreneur，強調自行創業、承擔風險的人，與一般 businessman 略有不同，更強調創新與冒險精神。
w_entrust
to give someone the responsibility to do something or deal with something 常見 entrust someone with something 或 entrust something to someone，強調基於信任而交付責任或物品。
w_enumerate
to name a list of things one by one 及物動詞，語氣正式，常見於書面或正式演講中列出具體項目，如 enumerate the reasons/steps。
w_enunciate
to pronounce words clearly and distinctly 常用於描述說話或演講的發音方式，如 enunciate clearly；也可指清楚陳述一項原則或想法。
w_envisage
to imagine or expect something as a future possibility 英式英語較常用（美式多用 envision），後接名詞或 that 子句，語氣正式，常見於計畫、政策討論。
w_envision
to imagine something as a future possibility 與 envisage 意義相近，美式英語更常用，常見 envision a future/scenario，強調對未來的具體構想。
w_enzyme
a substance produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction 生物化學專有名詞，常見於消化、代謝相關描述，如 digestive enzymes。
w_ephemeral
lasting for only a short time 語氣文學化，常修飾 beauty、moment、trend 等，強調事物美好但轉瞬即逝。
w_epic
very large or impressive in size or extent, especially referring to a heroic story or achievement 常修飾 journey、battle、failure 等，強調規模宏大或意義重大，口語中也可誇張形容「超讚」。
w_epidemic

a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time 常見 a flu/cholera epidemic，指疾病在特定地區、時間內大規模傳播，範圍通常小於 pandemic（大流行）。 氾濫的；普遍流行的（形容問題大量出現） widespread; affecting a disproportionately large number of people within a population 常修飾抽象問題，如 epidemic levels of obesity/violence，比喻性地形容某問題像疾病一樣廣泛蔓延。
w_episode
one part of a television or radio series, or a single event forming part of a longer sequence 常見 the latest episode（最新一集），也可指人生或歷史中的單一事件，如 a brief episode of illness。
w_epitomize
to be a perfect example of something 及物動詞，常接抽象特質或類別，如 epitomize elegance/the era，強調某人事物完美體現某種特質。
w_equal

the same in size, amount, value, or status 常接 to，如 equal to the task；也可用 be equal in size/importance 比較兩者。 等於 to be the same in number or amount as something else, especially in mathematics 數學或計算語境常用，如 two plus two equals four；也可比喻性表示「等同於、比得上」。
w_equality
the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities 不可數名詞，常見 gender/racial equality，強調權利與機會上的平等地位。
w_equanimity
calmness and composure, especially in a difficult situation 正式書面用語，常見 with equanimity，強調面對壓力或逆境仍保持心理平靜。
w_equation
a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal 數學專有名詞，如 solve an equation；也可比喻性地指影響某結果的各項因素，如 add money into the equation。
w_equilibrium
a state of balance between opposing forces or influences 常見於物理、經濟或心理層面，如 economic equilibrium，強調各方力量或因素達到穩定的平衡。
w_equip
to provide someone or something with the necessary items or skills for a particular purpose 常見 equip someone with skills/knowledge，也可指實體裝備，如 equip a kitchen with new appliances。
w_equity

the value of shares or ownership in a company or property, after subtracting any debts 財經專有名詞，常見 home equity（房屋淨值）、equity in a company（公司股權）。 公平；公正 the quality of being fair and impartial 常見於社會議題討論，如 social equity，強調資源分配或待遇上的公平性，與 equality（結果相同）略有不同，equity 更強調依需求給予公平對待。
w_equivalent

something that has the same value, amount, or meaning as something else 常接 of，如 the equivalent of a month's salary，指與某物在數量或意義上相等的東西。 相等的；相當的 equal in value, amount, function, or meaning 常接 to，如 equivalent to a bachelor's degree，用於比較兩者在某方面具有相同的價值或作用。
w_equivocal

open to more than one interpretation, often deliberately, so that no clear conclusion can be drawn equivocal 有兩種常見用法。形容研究結果時，它中性地表示「數據不足以下定論」：the results were equivocal。形容人的回答時，它往往帶有批評：對方刻意含糊以迴避表態。與 ambiguous 相比，equivocal 更常暗示「刻意」。 equivocal results be equivocal about + noun equivocal results 無法下定論的結果 an equivocal answer 模稜兩可的回答 remain equivocal 仍未明確表態 ambiguous inconclusive explicit unequivocal unequivocal equivocate ambiguous
w_eradicate
to completely destroy or get rid of something, especially something bad 常見受詞為疾病或社會問題，如 eradicate poverty/disease，強調徹底消除，不留殘餘。
w_erase

precise and accurate in every detail 常修飾 amount、time、location，強調毫無誤差，也可用 to be exact 作插入語補充精確資訊。

a statement that represents something as larger, better, or worse than it really is 常見 without exaggeration、it's no exaggeration to say...，用於強調敘述並非言過其實。

w_excess

an amount of something that is more than necessary, permitted, or reasonable 常見 in excess of（超過）、to excess（過度地），強調數量或程度超出合理範圍。 多餘的；額外的 more than is necessary, usual, or specified 直接修飾名詞，如 excess baggage/weight，指超出正常或允許範圍的部分。

more than what is necessary, normal, or reasonable 常修飾 amount、cost、force，帶有負面意味，強調程度超出合理範圍。

a feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness 不可數名詞，常見 with excitement、in excitement，描述因期待或高興而產生的情緒。

only, and not involving anything or anyone else 常修飾動詞，如 available exclusively、used exclusively for，強調限定於單一對象或用途。

a short trip, especially one taken for pleasure 常見 go on an excursion，指以娛樂為目的的短程外出，常見於旅遊團行程。

free from an obligation, duty, or liability that applies to others 常接 from，如 exempt from tax/military service，指依法不必承擔某項一般性義務。 使豁免；免除（義務） to officially free someone from an obligation or duty 及物動詞，常見 exempt someone from something，指官方正式給予某人免除義務的資格。

official permission to be freed from an obligation, duty, or liability 常見 a tax exemption，指依法獲准不須履行某項一般性義務。

originating from or characteristic of a distant foreign country, especially in an unusual or attractive way 常修飾 fruit、animal、location，強調帶有外國、罕見或新奇的吸引力。

the process of increasing in size, number, or extent 常見 business/economic expansion，指規模、範圍或數量增加的過程。

covering a large area, or (of a person) open and willing to talk freely 可形容空間廣大（an expansive view），也可形容人開朗健談、暢所欲言（in an expansive mood）。

w_exquisite
extremely beautiful, delicate, or finely made 常修飾 craftsmanship、detail、beauty，強調工藝或美感極為細膩、令人讚嘆。

full of energy, enthusiasm, and excitement 常修飾 crowd、mood、welcome，強調外顯的活力與興奮之情。

a workshop where metal is heated and shaped, especially by a blacksmith 常見 a blacksmith's forge，指用於加熱、鍛造金屬的工作場所。 鍛造；建立（透過努力）；偽造（文件或簽名） to make or shape metal by heating and hammering it, to create something through great effort, or to illegally copy a document or signature 及物動詞，涵蓋三種常見用法：鍛造金屬（forge a sword）、建立關係（forge an alliance）、偽造文件（forge a signature），須依語境判斷語意。

w_forlorn
sad and lonely because of neglect or loss 常修飾人的表情、處境或荒廢的地方，forlorn hope 則是固定用法，指渺茫的希望。

w_fruition

w_furious

w_gallery

w_gallon

w_gallop

the fastest pace of a horse, with all four feet off the ground at once 常見 at a gallop（以疾馳的速度）；比喻快速前進的過程亦可使用。 （馬）疾馳；快速前進 (of a horse) to run at a gallop, or to move or progress very quickly 常見 gallop across the field；比喻用法如 the story gallops along（故事節奏明快）。
w_galvanize
to shock or excite someone into taking action 常接 into action，如 galvanize people into action，強調突然的激勵效果，語氣正式。
w_gamble

an act involving risk that may result in loss, undertaken with hope of gain 常見 take a gamble（冒險一試），可指實際賭博或比喻性的冒險決定。 賭博；下賭注 to risk money or something valuable on an uncertain outcome, especially in games of chance 常接 on，如 gamble on the stock market；也可比喻性使用，指冒險做決定。
w_gape

w_garbage

w_garrulous

w_gasp

w_gastric

w_gauge

w_gaunt
extremely thin and bony, especially from illness, hunger, or suffering 常修飾人的外貌，強調因病痛或飢餓而顯得虛弱，語氣中性偏負面。
w_gaze
a long, steady look at someone or something 常見 fix one's gaze on（將視線固定在……上），語氣比 look 更持久專注。 凝視；注視 to look steadily and intently at someone or something 常接 at，如 gaze at the stars；比 look 更強調持續且專注的凝視。
w_gear

equipment or clothing needed for a particular activity 常見 camping gear（露營裝備）、safety gear（安全裝備）；也可指機械齒輪或汽車排檔。 使適合；針對（某目的或對象調整） to adjust or design something to suit a particular purpose or group 常見 be geared toward/to，如 courses geared toward beginners（針對初學者設計的課程）。
w_gene

w_generality
