w_generous
willing to give more of something, such as money or time, than is expected 常接 with，如 generous with one's time；也可修飾份量，如 a generous portion（豐盛的份量）。
w_genetic
relating to genes or heredity 常見 genetic disorder（遺傳疾病）、genetic engineering（基因工程）。
w_genial
friendly, warm, and cheerful in manner 常修飾人的態度或性格，語氣正面，強調讓人感到舒服自在。
w_genius
exceptional intellectual or creative ability, or a person who has it 常見 a stroke of genius（神來一筆）；可指人（he is a genius）或才能本身。
w_genre
a category of artistic work characterized by a particular style or content 常見於文學、電影、音樂分類，如 the horror genre（恐怖片類型）。
w_genteel
polite, refined, or affectedly elegant in manner 常帶輕微負面意味，暗示刻意表現出的高雅，與自然的 elegant 略有不同。
w_gentle
mild, kind, or not forceful or harsh 常修飾人的態度或動作力道，如 a gentle touch（輕柔的觸碰），也可形容坡度平緩，如 a gentle slope。
w_genuine
truly what it is said to be; authentic; sincere 常見 genuine leather（真皮）、genuine concern（真誠的關心）；與 fake 相對。
w_geographic
relating to geography or the physical features of an area 常見 geographic location（地理位置）、geographic boundary（地理界線）。
w_ghastly
extremely unpleasant, frightening, or shocking 語氣強烈，常修飾事故、景象或情況，如 a ghastly accident；口語也可誇張形容令人不快之事。
w_giant
a legendary being of human form but superhuman size, or something huge or very important 常見比喻用法 an industry giant（產業巨頭），指規模或影響力極大的組織或人物。
w_giddy
having a sensation of whirling and a loss of balance, or feeling extremely excited 可形容生理暈眩，如 feel giddy；也常形容因興奮而忘乎所以，如 giddy with excitement。
w_giggle
to laugh in a silly or nervous, high-pitched way 常見於形容孩童或害羞的笑聲，語氣輕鬆帶點孩子氣。 咯咯的笑聲 a silly, high-pitched laugh 常見 have a fit of giggles（一陣咯咯笑），常形容難以克制的笑意。
w_gingerly
in a careful, cautious manner, especially to avoid harm or noise 常修飾動作動詞，如 step gingerly（小心翼翼地踏步），強調動作輕柔謹慎。
w_glacial
relating to glaciers or ice ages, or extremely cold and slow 可指地質上的冰河現象，如 glacial period；比喻用法如 glacial pace（極其緩慢的速度）。
w_glacier
a large, slow-moving mass of ice formed over many years 地理學用語，常見 melting glaciers（融化的冰河），與氣候變遷議題常一起出現。
w_glance
a brief or quick look 常見 at a glance（一看就知道）、a quick glance；比 look 更短暫。 瞥一眼；匆匆看一下 to take a brief or quick look at something 常接 at，如 glance at the clock；動作短暫，與 stare（長時間凝視）相對。
w_glare

a fierce or angry look, or a strong, unpleasant light 常見 give someone a glare（狠狠瞪某人），或形容陽光刺眼，如 the glare of the sun。 怒目而視；刺眼地照射 to look at someone angrily, or (of light) to shine with a harsh, dazzling brightness 常接 at，如 glare at someone；亦可形容陽光或燈光過於刺眼。
w_glaze

a smooth, shiny coating applied to pottery, food, or a surface 常見於陶藝 pottery glaze，或甜點裝飾 a sugar glaze（糖霜）。 為……上釉；為……塗上光亮塗層 to cover something with a smooth, shiny coating 常見 glaze a pot（為陶器上釉）；也可形容眼神呆滯，如 her eyes glazed over（她的眼神變得呆滯）。
w_gleam
a brief flash or beam of light, often soft or reflected 常見 a gleam in someone's eye（眼中閃現的光芒），比喻興奮或期待的神情。 發出微光；閃爍 to shine with a soft, reflected light 常修飾乾淨光亮的物體表面，如 the floor gleamed（地板閃閃發亮）。
w_glimmer
a faint, unsteady light, or a small sign of something 常見 a glimmer of hope（一線希望），比喻性用法非常普遍。 發出微弱閃爍的光 to shine faintly and unsteadily 常修飾星光、燭光等微弱光源，語氣柔和。
w_glimpse
a brief, incomplete view or look at something 常見 catch a glimpse of（瞥見），描述短暫看到的畫面。 瞥見 to see something briefly or partially 及物動詞，常用於文學語氣，強調短暫且不完整的視覺經驗。
w_glisten
to shine with a wet or oily surface 常修飾露珠、汗水、雨後路面等，如 dew glistening on grass。 （潮濕表面的）光澤；閃光 a sparkling or shining appearance, especially from wetness 較少單獨作名詞使用，多見於文學描寫。
w_glitter

small, sparkling pieces used for decoration, or a sparkling light 常見手作或化妝用亮片 glitter makeup；比喻用法如 the glitter of fame（名聲的光環，常帶諷刺意味）。 閃閃發光；閃爍 to shine with a sparkling light 常修飾珠寶、星星等，如 stars glittering in the sky；也可比喻虛有其表，如成語 all that glitters is not gold。
w_gloom
partial or total darkness, or a feeling of sadness and hopelessness 可指實際的昏暗光線，也可比喻低落的心情或氣氛，如 an air of gloom。
w_glorify
to praise or represent something as more wonderful than it really is 常帶批評意味，指過度美化某事物，如 glorify violence（美化暴力），需視語境判斷褒貶。
w_glorious
having, worthy of, or bringing great honor or praise; magnificent 常修飾勝利、天氣或景色，如 a glorious victory、a glorious sunset。
w_gloss

a shiny appearance on a surface, or a brief explanatory note on a text 可指物體表面的光澤，如 lip gloss（唇蜜）；也指對文字的簡短注解說明。 使有光澤；淡化（過失或錯誤，常與 over 連用） to give a shiny surface to something, or to try to make a fault or mistake seem less serious 常見固定片語 gloss over（輕描淡寫、掩飾過失），語氣帶批評意味。
w_glow

a steady, soft light or warmth, or a feeling of pleasure and well-being 常見 the glow of the fire（爐火的微光）；比喻用法如 a healthy glow（健康紅潤的氣色）。 發出微光；（因喜悅或健康）容光煥發 to produce a steady light without flame, or to show pleasure and well-being 常接 with，如 glow with pride（因驕傲而容光煥發），也可形容燒紅的煤炭等。
w_gnaw
to bite or chew on something persistently, or to cause persistent distress 常見 gnaw a bone（啃骨頭）；比喻用法如 doubt gnawed at her（疑慮一直困擾著她）。
w_gobble
to eat food quickly and greedily 常接 up，如 gobble up food，語氣口語生動，強調吃得又快又急。 火雞的咯咯叫聲；狼吞虎嚥（口語） the sound made by a male turkey, or an act of eating greedily 較少見用法，多見於描述火雞叫聲的擬聲詞。
w_goggle
to stare with wide-open eyes in surprise 較少見用法，語氣生動誇張，強調因驚訝而睜大雙眼。
w_gorgeous
extremely beautiful or attractive; delightful 常修飾外貌、景色或天氣，口語常用，如 a gorgeous sunset（美麗的日落）。
w_gospel
the teachings of jesus christ as recorded in the bible, or something regarded as absolute truth 常見 the gospel of matthew（馬太福音）；口語用法如 take something as gospel（把某事當成絕對真理）。
w_gossip
casual talk about other people's private lives, often unconfirmed 常見 celebrity gossip（名人八卦）、office gossip（辦公室八卦），常帶輕微負面意味。
w_gouge

a deep hole, cut, or gash made in a surface 常見於描述表面損傷，如 a gouge in the wood（木頭上的凹痕）。 （用工具）挖出洞；（口語）敲詐、漫天要價 to make a hole or groove in something with a sharp tool, or (informally) to overcharge someone 常見 gouge a hole；口語用法如 price gouging（哄抬價格，敲詐消費者）。
w_govern
to control the affairs of a country or organization, or to determine the behavior of something 常見 govern a country；也可指抽象規則的支配作用，如 laws that govern behavior。
w_governor
the official leader of a state, province, or institution 常見 the governor of california（加州州長）；也指銀行、學校等機構的董事或首長。
w_gown
a long, formal dress, or a loose robe worn for a particular occasion 常見 evening gown（晚禮服）、hospital gown（病人服），依語境不同意思各異。
w_grace
elegance and beauty of movement, or a period of extra time allowed before a deadline 常見 with grace（優雅地）；也可指宗教中的恩典，或 a grace period（寬限期）。
w_gracious
courteous, kind, and pleasant, especially to those of lower status 常修飾態度或風度，如 a gracious host（待客有禮的主人），語氣正面且帶點高雅意味。
w_gradual
happening or changing slowly over a period of time 常修飾 change、increase 等，如 a gradual decline，與 sudden（突然的）相對。
w_graft

a piece of tissue or plant transplanted onto another, or (informally) illegal use of one's position for personal profit 醫學或園藝脈絡指移植手術，如 a skin graft；美式口語中則指政治上的貪污舞弊。 移植（組織）；嫁接（植物） to transplant living tissue or a plant part onto another surface 常見 graft skin onto a wound（將皮膚移植到傷口上）；園藝上指嫁接不同品種的枝條。
w_grain
a small hard seed of a food plant, or a very small amount of something 常見 grains of rice（米粒）；比喻用法如 a grain of truth（一絲真實）。
w_grand
impressive in size, appearance, or scope; magnificent 常修飾建築、計畫或典禮，如 a grand entrance（氣派的入口）。
w_grandiose
more impressive or ambitious than is necessary or practical; overblown 常帶負面意味，形容計畫或言辭過度誇張不切實際，如 grandiose plans。
w_graph
a diagram showing the relationship between quantities using lines, bars, or points 常見 a bar graph（長條圖）、a line graph（折線圖），多用於數學或統計。
w_graphic
relating to visual art or design, or (of a description) vivid and detailed, especially unpleasantly so 常見 graphic design（平面設計）；也可形容描述過於露骨寫實，如 graphic violence（血腥暴力畫面）。
w_graphics
visual images or designs, especially on a printed page or computer screen 常見 computer graphics（電腦繪圖）、graphics card（顯示卡）。
w_grate

a metal frame used to hold fuel in a fireplace 常見於描述壁爐結構，the fire crackled in the grate。 磨碎（食物）；發出刺耳聲；使人心煩 to shred food using a grater, or to make an irritating sound or have an irritating effect 常見 grate cheese（磨起司）；比喻用法 grate on someone's nerves（讓人心煩）。
w_grateful
feeling or showing appreciation for something done or received 常接 for，如 grateful for your help；比 thankful 稍正式，常見於書面感謝語。
w_gratification
pleasure or satisfaction, especially when immediate 常見 instant gratification（即時滿足），常用於心理學或消費文化的討論脈絡。
w_gratitude
a feeling of thankfulness or appreciation 常見 express gratitude（表達感謝）、a sense of gratitude；比 thanks 更書面正式。
w_grave

a place in the ground where a dead body is buried 常見 dig a grave（挖墳墓）；比喻用法 have one foot in the grave（來日無多）。 嚴重的；重大的；令人憂心的 very serious or important, especially giving cause for anxiety 常修飾 danger、mistake、concern 等，如 a grave mistake（重大的錯誤），語氣正式莊重。
w_gravel
small stones and pebbles, often used to surface roads or paths 常見 a gravel road（碎石路）、a gravel driveway（碎石車道）。
w_gravitational
relating to gravity, the force that attracts objects toward each other 物理學用語，常見 gravitational force（重力）、gravitational pull（引力）。
w_gravity
the force that attracts objects toward the center of the earth or another mass 物理學用語，常見 the force of gravity；也可比喻嚴重性，如 the gravity of the situation。
w_greenhouse
a glass building used for growing plants that need protection from cold weather 常見 greenhouse effect（溫室效應）、greenhouse gas（溫室氣體），環境議題常提及。
w_grid
a network of horizontal and vertical lines forming squares, or a network for distributing electricity 常見 a power grid（電力網）；也指地圖或圖表上的座標方格。
w_grief
deep sorrow, especially caused by someone's death 常見 grief counseling（悲傷輔導）；比 sadness 更強烈，多用於喪親等重大失落。
w_grieve
to feel or express deep sorrow, especially over a death 常接 for/over，如 grieve for a loved one；也可不接受詞，表示處於哀悼狀態。
w_grievous
very severe or serious, causing great suffering 多見於正式或法律語境，如 grievous bodily harm（嚴重人身傷害），日常口語較少用。
w_grill

a frame of metal bars for cooking food over a fire, or the food cooked on it 常見 barbecue grill（烤肉架）；也指烤肉料理，如 mixed grill（綜合烤肉拼盤）。 用烤架烤（食物）；嚴厲盤問 to cook food on a grill, or to question someone intensively 常見 grill a suspect（嚴厲盤問嫌犯），比喻用法在口語中很常見。
w_grim
forbidding or unattractive; causing feelings of gloom or anxiety 常修飾 news、situation、expression 等，如 grim news（令人沮喪的消息）。
w_grimace

a twisted facial expression showing disgust, pain, or disapproval 常見 with a grimace（帶著痛苦的表情），描述臉部因不適而扭曲。 露出痛苦（或厭惡）的表情 to make a twisted facial expression showing disgust, pain, or disapproval 常接 at，如 grimace at the taste；描述因疼痛或不悅而臉部扭曲。
w_grin
to smile broadly 常見 grin from ear to ear（笑得合不攏嘴）；比 smile 更燦爛、露齒。
w_grind
hard, tedious, or monotonous work 常見 the daily grind（每天單調的例行工作），語氣帶疲憊感。 磨碎；碾碎 to crush or reduce something to small particles by friction 常見 grind coffee beans（磨咖啡豆）；比喻用法如 grind to a halt（緩緩停止）。
w_grip

a firm hold on something, or control over a situation 常見 lose one's grip（失去掌控）、have a grip on the situation（掌控局面）。 緊握；（強烈地）吸引、抓住（注意力） to hold something firmly, or to hold someone's attention or interest strongly 常見 grip the handle；比喻用法如 the movie gripped the audience（這部電影深深吸引了觀眾）。
w_grisly
causing horror or disgust; gruesome 常修飾 murder、scene，如 a grisly crime scene，語氣強烈，多用於描述暴力或死亡場景。
w_grit

small, coarse particles of stone or sand, or courage and determination 常見 gravel and grit（碎石與沙礫）；比喻用法 have grit（有毅力）。 在結冰路面撒沙礫；咬緊牙關（表示決心） to spread grit on an icy road, or to clench one's teeth in determination 常見固定片語 grit one's teeth（咬緊牙關），表示忍耐或下定決心面對困難。
w_groan

a deep, low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or disapproval 常見 with a groan（發出呻吟地），表達疼痛或不情願的情緒。 呻吟；抱怨 to make a deep, low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or disapproval 常接 with，如 groan with pain；也可指口語上的抱怨，如 groan about the traffic。
w_groom

a man who is about to be or has just been married, or a person who cares for horses 常見 the bride and groom（新娘與新郎）；也指專門照料馬匹的人。 替（動物）梳理毛髮；栽培、培養（某人擔任特定職位） to clean and brush an animal's fur, or to prepare someone for a particular role or position 常見 groom a horse；比喻用法如 groom someone for leadership（培養某人成為領導者）。
w_gross
total, before deductions; or (informally) very unpleasant or disgusting 常見 gross income（總收入，與 net income 相對）；口語 that's gross! 表示噁心。
w_grotesque
comically or repulsively distorted or exaggerated in appearance 常修飾 figure、image 等，強調外形扭曲怪異，語氣書面。
w_grudge

a persistent feeling of ill will or resentment resulting from a past insult or injury 常見 hold a grudge（懷恨在心）、bear a grudge against someone。 不甘願地給予；勉強容許 to give or allow something reluctantly or resentfully 常接 someone something，如 grudge him his success（不甘願承認他的成功）。
w_grueling
extremely tiring and demanding 常修飾 schedule、training、race 等，如 a grueling marathon，強調過程極度辛苦。
w_gruesome
causing repulsion or horror; horrific 常修飾 crime scene、discovery 等，強調視覺上令人反感的恐怖，如 grisly 為近義詞。
w_grumble
a complaint expressed in a low, muttering voice 常見 with a grumble（帶著抱怨），指低聲的不滿。 抱怨；發牢騷 to complain in a low, muttering voice about something 常接 about，如 grumble about the weather；語氣較輕微，通常不是激烈爭吵。
w_guarantee

a formal promise or assurance that something will be done or that a product will meet certain standards 常見 a money-back guarantee（退款保證）；也指口頭或書面的承諾。 保證；擔保 to give a formal assurance that something will happen or be provided 常接 that 子句或名詞，如 guarantee success；也可指法律上的擔保責任。
w_guild
an association of people with similar interests or professions, especially in medieval times or in a modern craft context 常見 the writers guild（作家工會）；歷史脈絡中指中世紀的手工業者組織。
w_guile
cunning or clever deception used to achieve one's aims 常見 with guile（狡猾地）；也可用於正面語境，指機智靈巧地達成目的。
w_guilt
the fact of having committed an offense, or a feeling of having done wrong 常見 feel guilt（感到內疚）、admit guilt（承認有罪），視語境指法律上的罪責或心理上的內疚。
w_guilty
responsible for a crime or wrongdoing, or feeling guilt 常見 plead guilty（認罪）、feel guilty（感到內疚），兩種意思都很常見，需依上下文判斷。
w_gulf
a large area of sea partly surrounded by land, or a wide difference between two things 常見 the gulf of mexico（墨西哥灣）；比喻用法如 a gulf between generations（世代之間的鴻溝）。
w_gull
a common seabird with white or gray feathers 常見於海邊描寫，如 seagulls circling the beach。 欺騙；愚弄 to deceive or trick someone 較少見用法，語氣文學或古舊，日常口語更常用 fool 或 deceive。
w_habitat
the natural environment in which a plant or animal normally lives 常見 natural habitat（自然棲息地），環境或生態議題常見詞彙。
w_hackneyed
(of a phrase or idea) overused and lacking original thought 常修飾 phrase、plot 等，指因過度使用而失去新意，語氣帶批評意味。
w_hail

small balls or pellets of ice that fall as precipitation 氣象用語，常見 a hailstorm（冰雹暴）；比喻用法如 a hail of bullets（如冰雹般的子彈）。 讚揚；歡呼致意；（冰雹）落下 to greet or acclaim someone enthusiastically, or (of hail) to fall as precipitation 常見 be hailed as（被譽為），表示公開讚揚某人的成就。
w_hale
(especially of an elderly person) strong and healthy 多見於固定片語 hale and hearty（身體硬朗），日常口語較少單獨使用。
w_hallucination
a perception of something that is not actually present, often caused by illness or drugs 醫學或心理學用語，常見 auditory hallucination（幻聽）、visual hallucination（幻視）。
w_hallway
a corridor or passage inside a building 常見於建築描述，如 down the hallway；比 corridor 更口語常用（尤其美式英語）。
w_halt
to stop moving or operating, or to cause something to stop 常接 to a halt（停下來），也可指抽象事物的停止，如 halt production。
w_hammer
a hand tool with a heavy metal head used for driving nails or breaking things 常見 a hammer and nails；比喻用法如 come down like a hammer（嚴厲對待）。
w_hamper

a large basket with a lid, used for carrying food or storing laundry 常見 a picnic hamper（野餐籃）、a laundry hamper（洗衣籃）。 阻礙；妨礙 to hinder or delay the progress or movement of something 常接名詞受詞，如 hamper efforts、hamper progress，語氣正式。
w_hamstring
any of the tendons at the back of the knee 運動醫學用語，常見 pull a hamstring（拉傷腿後肌腱）。 嚴重限制；使無法有效運作 to severely restrict or handicap someone or something 比喻用法，常見 be hamstrung by（因……而受到嚴重限制）。
w_handful
a small quantity of something, or a person or group that is difficult to control 常見 a handful of people（少數人）；口語 he's a handful 指某人很難帶或很難搞。
w_handicap

a condition that limits a person's physical or mental abilities, or a disadvantage that makes success more difficult 現代用語常改用 disability 描述身心障礙以避免歧視意味；handicap 較常見於高爾夫球的讓桿制度。 使處於不利地位；阻礙 to put someone at a disadvantage 常用被動語態 be handicapped by，語氣正式。
w_handy
convenient to use or reach; skillful with one's hands 常見 come in handy（派上用場）；也可形容人手很巧，如 he's handy with tools。
w_harassment
aggressive pressure or intimidation, often repeated or unwanted 常見 sexual harassment（性騷擾）、workplace harassment（職場騷擾），語氣正式且嚴肅。

lack of knowledge or information 常見 out of ignorance（出於無知）、ignorance of the law（不懂法律）；不帶惡意時是中性描述。
w_illegal
not authorized by law; contrary to or forbidden by law 常見 illegal activity（非法活動）；與 illicit 相似但 illegal 更強調觸犯明文法律。
w_illegitimate
not authorized by law or established rules; (of a child) born to parents not married to each other 常見 illegitimate power（不正當的權力）；歷史語境中指非婚生子女，現代較少使用此義以避免污名化。
w_illicit
forbidden by law, rules, or custom 常見 illicit drugs（違禁藥物）、an illicit affair（不正當的關係），語氣正式。
w_illiterate
unable to read or write 常見 functionally illiterate（功能性文盲）；比喻用法如 computer illiterate（電腦文盲）。 文盲（者） a person who is unable to read or write 名詞用法較少見，多見於統計或社會學語境，如 the number of illiterates。
w_illuminate
to light up something, or to make something clear or easier to understand 常見 illuminate a room（照亮房間）；比喻用法如 illuminate the truth（闡明真相）。
w_illusion
a false belief or impression, or something that appears to be real but is not 常見 under the illusion that...（誤以為……），也指視覺上的錯覺，如 an optical illusion。
w_illusory
based on illusion; not real 常見 illusory hope（虛幻的希望），語氣書面正式，強調表面看似真實實則不然。
w_illustrate
to explain or make something clear by using examples, pictures, or diagrams 常接 with examples，如 illustrate a point；也可指為書籍繪製插圖。
w_illustration
a picture used to explain or decorate a text, or an example used to clarify a point 常見於書籍脈絡，如 a book full of illustrations；也可指用來說明論點的實例。
w_illustrious
well known, respected, and admired for past achievements 常修飾人物或生涯，如 an illustrious career（輝煌的職涯），語氣正式且帶敬意。
w_imagery
visually descriptive or figurative language, especially in literature 常見於詩詞或文學分析，如 vivid imagery（生動的意象）。
w_imaginative
having or showing creativity or a strong imagination 常見 an imaginative solution（有創意的解決方案），語氣正面，強調非傳統或富創造力的思維。
w_imbue
to inspire or permeate someone or something with a feeling or quality 常用被動語態 be imbued with，如 imbued with hope，語氣書面正式。
w_imitate
to copy the behavior, appearance, or actions of someone or something 常接人或風格作受詞，如 imitate a famous singer；也可指仿造物品。
w_immaculate
perfectly clean, neat, or without any flaws 常修飾 condition、appearance，如 immaculate condition（狀況完美），語氣正面且強調極致的整潔。
w_immediate
happening or done at once; occurring next in time or space 常見 immediate action（立即行動）、immediate family（直系親屬），依語境有不同引申義。
w_immense
extremely large or great in size, degree, or amount 常修飾 size、pressure、pride 等抽象或具體事物，如 immense pressure（巨大的壓力）。
w_immerse
to involve oneself deeply in an activity, or to submerge something in liquid 常見 immerse oneself in（沉浸於……之中），比喻用法比字面「浸泡」更常見。
w_immigrant
a person who comes to live permanently in a country that is not their own 常見 an illegal immigrant（非法移民）、immigrant community（移民社群），與 emigrant（移出者）視角相反。
w_immigration
the process of coming to live permanently in a foreign country, or the government department handling this 常見 immigration policy（移民政策）、pass through immigration（通過入境檢查）。
w_imminent
about to happen very soon 常見 imminent danger（迫在眉睫的危險），語氣正式，強調事情近在眼前、無法避免。
w_immune

protected against a particular disease or influence, or not affected by something 常見 immune to criticism（不受批評影響），醫學脈絡指 immune to a disease（對疾病免疫）。 免疫物質（較少見用法） a substance or organism that provides immunity（較少見的名詞用法，多指免疫相關物質） 此詞多作形容詞使用，作名詞極為罕見，一般以 immune system（免疫系統）等複合詞表達相關概念。
w_impart
to communicate information or knowledge, or to give a particular quality to something 常見 impart knowledge（傳授知識）、impart a flavor（賦予風味），語氣正式書面。
w_impassioned
filled with or showing great emotion or enthusiasm 常修飾 speech、plea 等，如 an impassioned speech（慷慨激昂的演講），語氣強烈正面。
w_impassive
not feeling or showing emotion; expressionless 常修飾 face、expression，如 an impassive expression，強調刻意壓抑情緒不表露。
w_impeach
to formally charge a public official with misconduct, potentially leading to removal from office 政治或法律用語，常見 impeach the president（彈劾總統），程序正式且具法律效力。
w_impede
to delay or prevent someone or something by obstructing them 常接抽象名詞，如 impede progress（阻礙進展），語氣正式書面，與 hamper 相似。
w_impenetrable
impossible to enter or pass through, or impossible to understand 常見 an impenetrable forest（無法穿越的森林）；比喻用法如 impenetrable jargon（難懂的術語）。
w_imperative

extremely important or urgent; essential 常見 it is imperative that...（……是必要的），語氣正式強烈，強調不可忽視的急迫性。 當務之急；必要之事 an essential or urgent need or duty 常見 a moral imperative（道德義務）、a business imperative（企業當務之急）。
w_imperial

relating to an empire or emperor, or (informally) majestic or grand 常見 imperial power（帝國勢力）、the imperial palace（皇宮），歷史或政治語境常用。 （英制度量衡的）帝國單位（較少見用法） a unit of measurement in the british imperial system（較少見，多指度量單位或帝國相關概念） 此詞多作形容詞使用，名詞用法較罕見，常見於描述英制度量系統 imperial system 相關語境。
w_impervious
not allowing something to pass through, or not affected by something 常接 to，如 impervious to criticism（不受批評影響），比喻用法非常常見。
w_impinge
to have a negative effect on something, or to encroach on someone's rights or territory 常接 on/upon，如 impinge on someone's rights，語氣正式書面。
w_implausible
not seeming reasonable or probable; hard to believe 常修飾 story、excuse 等，如 an implausible excuse，與 plausible（合理可信的）相對。
w_implement

to put a plan, decision, or design into effect implement 是「把已經決定好的東西真正做出來」，因此它的受詞總是先前存在的計畫、政策或設計。這個「先有藍圖、後有執行」的前提很重要：說 implement an idea 有點怪，因為 idea 還不是可執行的方案；要說 implement a plan 或 implement a design。 implement + noun implement + noun + in + technology implement a policy 實施政策 implement a feature 實作功能 fully implemented 完整實作的 an implementation detail 實作細節 execute carry out implementation implementer deploy
w_implication
a conclusion that can be drawn from something, though not explicitly stated, or a possible effect 常見 the implications of a decision（決定所帶來的影響），常用複數形。
w_implicit

suggested or understood without being directly stated implicit 指「雖然沒有明說，但確實存在」。它常搭配 in：an assumption implicit in the design（設計中隱含的假設）。在技術討論中，implicit 常帶有輕微的警告意味，因為隱含的假設一旦不成立就會造成 bug。 implicit in + noun an implicit + noun implicit assumption 隱含假設 implicit in 隱含於……之中 implicit conversion 隱式轉換 an implicit contract 隱含的約定 explicit implicitly implied
w_implore
to beg someone earnestly or desperately to do something 常接 to do something，如 implore someone to stay，語氣比 ask 強烈許多，帶有絕望懇切的情感。
w_imply

to suggest something indirectly without stating it openly imply 的主詞是「發出訊息的一方」——可以是人，也可以是文件、數據或事實。當主詞是人時，往往帶有「話中有話」的意味，語氣可能不太友善；當主詞是事物時，則只是中性地表示「邏輯上意味著」。數學與邏輯中的 a implies b 就是後者。 imply that + clause a implies b imply that 暗示…… strongly imply 強烈暗示 an implied warranty 默示擔保（法律術語） implication implicit infer
w_impose
to force something to be accepted or put in place, especially a rule, tax, or opinion 常接 on，如 impose a tax on，也可用 impose oneself on someone（強行打擾某人）。
w_impression
an idea or feeling about someone or something, based on how they appear 常見 make a good impression（留下好印象）、under the impression that...（誤以為）。
w_impressive
evoking admiration through size, quality, or skill 常修飾成就、表演或能力，如 an impressive performance，語氣正面。
w_imprisonment
the state of being kept in prison as a punishment 法律用語，常見 life imprisonment（終身監禁）、a sentence of imprisonment。
w_improvise
to create or perform something spontaneously, without preparation 常見 improvise a solution（臨場想出解決辦法）；音樂或戲劇領域常指即興演出。
w_impulse
a sudden strong desire or urge to act, often without thinking 常見 act on impulse（憑一時衝動行事）、buy something on impulse（衝動購物）。
w_impulsive
acting or done suddenly without careful thought 常修飾人的性格或行為，如 an impulsive decision（衝動的決定），語氣中性偏負面。
w_impunity
freedom from punishment or unpleasant consequences of an action 常見 with impunity（不受懲罰地），常用於描述有權勢者做壞事卻不受追究的情況。
w_inability
the lack of ability or capacity to do something 常見 inability to do something，如 his inability to communicate clearly（他無法清楚溝通的問題）。
w_inadequate
not sufficient or good enough for a particular purpose 常見 inadequate funding（資金不足）；也可形容人感到自己能力不足，如 feel inadequate。
w_inanimate
not alive, especially not in the way people, animals, and plants are 常見 an inanimate object（無生命的物體），與 animate（有生命的）相對，多用於哲學或語言學語境。
w_inappropriate
not suitable or proper in the circumstances 常見 inappropriate behavior（不當行為），語氣正式，常見於職場或禮儀相關語境。
w_inaugural
marking the beginning of an organization, activity, or period of office 常見 inaugural speech（就職演說）、inaugural meeting（首次會議），語氣正式莊重。
w_incarcerate
to imprison or confine someone 比 imprison 更正式，常見於法律或新聞報導，如 be incarcerated for a crime。
w_incentive
something that motivates or encourages someone to do something 常見 tax incentive（稅務優惠）、financial incentive（經濟誘因），商業與政策語境常用。
w_inception
the beginning or establishment of an organization or activity 常見 since its inception（自成立以來），語氣正式，常見於機構或計畫的歷史敘述。
w_incessant
continuing without pause or interruption 常修飾令人厭煩的持續事物，如 incessant noise（不停的噪音），語氣帶輕微負面。
w_inchoate
just begun and not yet fully formed or developed 語氣書面正式，常修飾 idea、plan 等尚在雛形階段的事物，日常口語極少使用。
w_incidence
the frequency or rate of occurrence of something, especially something undesirable 常見 the incidence of a disease（疾病的發生率），常用於統計或醫學語境。
w_incident

an event, especially one that is unusual, unpleasant, or noteworthy 常見 a minor incident（一起小事故）；也用於外交或安全語境，如 a diplomatic incident。 附帶發生的；伴隨而來的 naturally accompanying or related to something else, especially as a secondary effect 較少見用法，常見固定片語 incident to，強調某事作為另一事件自然伴隨的結果，多見於正式或法律文本。
w_incidentally
used to introduce a related but less important point, or by chance 常置句首作插入語，如 incidentally, i forgot to mention...，用於引出補充資訊。
w_incipient
in an initial stage; beginning to happen or develop 常修飾抽象事物，如 an incipient crisis（初現端倪的危機），語氣正式書面。
w_incision
a cut made into tissue or an organ, especially during surgery 醫學用語，常見 make an incision（開刀切口），語氣正式且技術性。
w_inclusive
including everyone or everything, especially without discrimination 常見 an inclusive environment（包容的環境）；也可指價格已含所有費用，如 all-inclusive。
w_incoming
arriving or about to arrive, or about to begin a term of office 常見 incoming call（來電）、incoming president（即將上任的總統）。
w_incompetent
lacking the necessary skills or ability to do something properly 常修飾人或表現，如 an incompetent employee，語氣帶負面評價。 無能的人 a person who lacks the necessary skills or ability 名詞用法帶強烈負面意味，語氣直接，使用時需留意場合。
w_incongruous
not in harmony or agreement with the surroundings or situation; out of place 常修飾與周遭格格不入的事物，如 an incongruous sight，語氣書面正式。
w_incorporate
to include something as part of a whole 常接 into，如 incorporate feedback into the plan（將意見納入計畫），語氣中性正式。 已依法組成法人的 formally established as a legal corporation 法律用語，較不常見，多見於公司法相關正式文件。
w_incredible
impossible or very difficult to believe, or extraordinarily good 口語常誇張使用，表示非常出色，如 an incredible performance，語氣正面。
w_incredulity
the state of being unwilling or unable to believe something 常見 with incredulity（帶著難以置信的態度），語氣正式書面。
w_increment
a regular increase in a quantity or amount 常見 salary increment（薪資調升）、in small increments（以小幅度遞增），多用於商業或數學語境。
w_incubation
the process of maintaining eggs at a suitable temperature for development, or the period before symptoms of a disease appear 常見 an incubation period（潛伏期），醫學語境常用；也指鳥類或昆蟲孵蛋的過程。
w_incur
to become subject to something unpleasant as a result of one's own actions 常接 costs、debt、penalty 等，如 incur a fine（招致罰款），語氣正式書面。
w_indebted
owing money, or feeling grateful for a favor received 常見 be indebted to someone for their help（感激某人的幫助），比喻用法多於字面欠債之意。
w_indefatigable
persisting tirelessly, without ever giving up 語氣正式書面，常修飾人的毅力，如 an indefatigable worker，帶明顯正面評價。
w_indelible
making marks that cannot be removed, or (of an impression or memory) permanent 常見 an indelible mark（擦不掉的痕跡）；比喻用法如 leave an indelible impression（留下不可磨滅的印象）。
w_indeterminate
not exactly known, established, or defined 常見 an indeterminate amount（不確定的數量），語氣正式，強調範圍或性質尚未明確。
w_indicate

to show that something is probably true, without proving it indicate 是學術寫作中控制語氣強度的關鍵字：它表示「證據指向這個方向」，但保留了修正空間。當數據還不夠強時，寫 the results indicate 遠比 the results prove 誠實。主詞通常是證據本身（data、logs、results），而不是人。 indicate that + clause indicate + noun the data indicate 數據顯示 strongly indicate 強烈顯示 as indicated above 如上所述 suggest signal indication indicator indicative demonstrate
w_indicative
serving as a sign or indication of something 常接 of，如 indicative of a larger problem（顯示出更大的問題），語氣正式書面。
w_indicator
a sign, measure, or gauge that shows the state or level of something 常見 an economic indicator（經濟指標）；也指車輛的方向燈（英式英語）。
w_indictment
a formal charge or accusation of a serious crime, or something that reveals a serious problem 法律用語，常見 issue an indictment；比喻用法如 a damning indictment of the system（對這個體制的嚴厲控訴）。
w_indigenous
originating naturally in a particular place; native 常見 indigenous peoples（原住民族）、indigenous species（原生物種），語氣中性且尊重原生性。
w_indignation
anger or annoyance provoked by something perceived as unjust or unfair 常見 righteous indignation（義憤），強調因不公不義而產生的憤怒，語氣正式。
w_indignity
treatment or a situation that causes shame, embarrassment, or a loss of self-respect 常見 suffer the indignity of，指經歷讓人失去尊嚴的情況，語氣正式書面。
w_indispensable

so important or useful that it is impossible to manage without it indispensable 是很強的形容詞：沒有它就辦不成事。介系詞用 to 或 for。它常出現在關於「單點失效」的討論中：如果某位同事變得 indispensable，那其實是組織的風險，而不是對他的稱讚。 indispensable to + noun indispensable for + doing indispensable to 對……不可或缺 an indispensable tool 不可或缺的工具 become indispensable 變得無可取代 essential vital redundant dispensable dispensable essential
w_induce
to succeed in persuading someone to do something, or to bring about a state or condition 常接 to do something，如 induce someone to sign；醫學語境也指誘發，如 induce labor（催生）。
w_induct
to formally admit someone to a role, position, or organization 常接 into，如 induct someone into a hall of fame（將某人納入名人堂），語氣正式莊重。
w_indulge
to allow oneself to enjoy something, especially something pleasurable, or to satisfy someone's wishes 常見 indulge in something（沉溺於某事）、indulge a child（寵溺孩子）。
w_ineffectual
not producing the desired effect; incapable of performing efficiently 常修飾人或措施，如 an ineffectual leader（無能的領導者），語氣帶負面評價。
w_ineligible
not qualified or entitled to do or receive something 常見 ineligible for a benefit（不符合福利資格），常接 for，語氣正式。
w_inept
having or showing no skill; clumsy or incompetent 常修飾人的能力或表現，如 socially inept（不擅社交），語氣帶負面評價。
w_inequity
unfairness or lack of justice, especially in the distribution of resources or opportunities 常見 income inequity（收入不平等），與 inequality 相近但更強調道德上的不公。
w_inevitable
certain to happen; impossible to avoid 常見 an inevitable outcome（必然的結果），語氣正式，強調事情必定發生。
w_inevitably
in a way that is certain to happen; unavoidably 常置句首或修飾整個句子，如 inevitably, prices rose.，語氣正式書面。
w_inexorable
impossible to stop or prevent; relentless 常修飾 progress、decline 等，如 the inexorable march of time，語氣書面正式且帶宿命感。
w_inexplicable
unable to be explained or accounted for 常修飾 phenomenon、behavior，如 an inexplicable feeling，語氣正式，強調理性上無法解釋。
w_infant
a very young child or baby 常見 infant care（嬰兒照護）；也可作形容詞用，如 infant mortality（嬰兒死亡率）。
w_infect
to contaminate with a disease-causing organism, or to spread a feeling or attitude to others 常見 infect a wound（傷口感染）；比喻用法如 her enthusiasm infected the whole team（她的熱情感染了整個團隊）。
w_infection
the invasion and multiplication of disease-causing organisms in the body 醫學用語，常見 a bacterial infection（細菌感染）、an ear infection（耳部感染）。
w_infer

to reach an opinion or conclusion from evidence rather than from being told directly infer 的主詞是「接收訊息的人」：你根據證據，自己得出結論。這與 imply（說話者暗示）方向完全相反，是英文中最經典的一對混淆詞。在程式語言中 type inference（型別推論）就是這個意思：編譯器從程式碼推斷型別，而不是你明白寫出來。 infer a from b infer that + clause infer from 從……推斷 reasonably infer 合理推斷 type inference 型別推論 deduce conclude inference inferred imply
w_inference
a conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning 常見 draw an inference（做出推論），語氣正式，常見於學術或邏輯討論。
w_inferior

lower in quality, status, or rank compared to another 常接 to，如 inferior to the original，語氣帶負面比較意味。 下屬；地位較低的人 a person of lower rank or status than another 常見於階級或組織脈絡，如 treat someone as an inferior（把某人當下屬對待），語氣帶負面意味。
w_infinite
limitless or endless in space, extent, or size; impossible to measure or calculate 常見 infinite possibilities（無限的可能性），語氣正式，數學或哲學語境也常用。
w_infinity
the state or quality of being infinite; an infinitely great number or distance 常見 to infinity（直到無窮），數學用語也常見於哲學討論。
w_inflame
to provoke or intensify strong feelings, especially anger, or to cause a part of the body to become red and swollen 比喻用法常見 inflame tensions（激化緊張情勢）；醫學語境指身體部位發炎紅腫。
w_inflammation
a localized physical condition in which part of the body becomes red, swollen, and painful, or a state of intense emotion 醫學用語常見 chronic inflammation（慢性發炎）；比喻用法較少見。
w_inflate
to fill something with air or gas, causing it to expand, or to increase something artificially 常見 inflate a balloon（給氣球充氣）；比喻用法如 inflate prices（哄抬價格）、inflate one's ego（膨脹自我）。
w_inflation
a general increase in prices and a fall in the purchasing value of money 經濟學用語，常見 rising inflation（通膨上升）、control inflation（控制通膨）。
w_inflict
to cause someone or something to suffer something unpleasant 常接 on，如 inflict pain on someone（讓某人遭受痛苦），語氣正式且帶負面意味。
w_influential
having great influence on someone or something 常見 an influential figure（有影響力的人物），語氣正面，強調其對他人或局勢的重大作用。
w_informal
relaxed and friendly, or not following official or conventional rules 常見 an informal setting（輕鬆隨意的場合）、informal language（口語化的用語），與 formal 相對。
w_infraction
a violation or breach of a law, rule, or agreement 法律或體育用語，常見 a minor infraction（輕微違規），語氣正式，程度通常輕於 crime。
w_infuriate
to make someone extremely angry 比 anger 語氣更強烈，常用被動語態 be infuriated by，如 be infuriated by the delay。
w_infuse
to fill or permeate something with a quality or feeling, or to soak an ingredient in liquid to extract its flavor 常見 infuse with energy（注入活力）；料理語境也指浸泡茶葉、香料等以萃取味道。
w_ingenious
clever, original, and inventive 常修飾 solution、design 等，如 an ingenious idea，語氣正面，強調聰明才智。
w_ingenuity
the quality of being clever, original, and inventive 常見 human ingenuity（人類的巧思），語氣正面，多用於稱讚創新的思考能力。
w_ingenuous
innocent and unsuspecting; showing a lack of experience or sophistication 常見於形容年輕人或未受世故薰染的人，語氣中性偏正面，注意勿與 ingenious（巧妙的）混淆。
w_ingredient
a component part of a mixture, especially in cooking, or an essential element 常見 the ingredients for a recipe（食譜的材料）；比喻用法如 the key ingredient of success（成功的關鍵要素）。
w_inhabit
to live in or occupy a place 常接地點作受詞，如 inhabit an area，語氣正式，常見於生態或歷史語境。
w_inhabitant
a person or animal that lives in a particular place 常見 the inhabitants of a city（一座城市的居民），語氣正式，多用於統計或描述性文本。
w_inherent

existing as a natural, permanent, and inseparable part of something inherent 表示「這個性質是本質的一部分，拿不掉」。這在技術討論中是很有力的說法：如果說某個風險是 inherent to distributed systems，意思是你無法藉由更好的實作把它消除，只能設法管理。句型固定為 inherent in 或 inherent to。 inherent in + noun inherent to + noun an inherent + noun inherent risk 固有風險 inherent in ……所固有的 an inherent limitation 本質上的限制 inherent complexity 本質複雜度 intrinsic innate acquired incidental inherently intrinsic
w_inherit
to receive money, property, or a title from someone after they die, or to receive a characteristic from a parent 常接名詞受詞，如 inherit a house；也可指遺傳特徵，如 inherit her mother's eyes。
w_inheritance
money, property, or a title received from someone after they die, or a genetically transmitted characteristic 常見 receive an inheritance（獲得遺產），法律及生物學脈絡皆可使用。
w_inhibit
to prevent or slow down a process, or to make someone unable to act naturally due to shyness or embarrassment 常見 inhibit growth（抑制生長）；心理學脈絡也指使人感到侷促不安，難以自然表現。
w_initial

existing or occurring at the beginning 常見 initial reaction（最初的反應）、initial stage（初期階段）。 （姓名的）首字母 the first letter of a name 常用複數 initials，如 sign with your initials（用姓名縮寫簽名）。 以姓名縮寫簽署 to mark or sign something with one's initials 常見於正式文件，如 initial each page（在每一頁上用縮寫簽名），語氣正式。
w_initially
at the beginning; at first 常置句首，如 initially, the plan seemed simple.，強調後續有所轉變或發展。
w_initiate

to cause a process or action to begin, or to formally admit someone into a group 常接抽象名詞，如 initiate a discussion（發起討論）；也可指入會儀式。 新入會者；剛入門者 a person who has recently been admitted into a group, especially one requiring specific knowledge 較少見用法，常見於正式團體或秘密組織脈絡。
w_initiative

a new plan or process to achieve something, or the ability to act independently 常見 take the initiative（採取主動）、a government initiative（政府的一項倡議）。 主動性的；創始的（較少見用法） relating to the ability to act independently and make decisions（較少見用法，多為名詞） 此詞通常作名詞使用，形容詞用法極為罕見，常見場合仍以名詞片語 show initiative 表達。
w_inject
to introduce a substance into the body with a needle, or to introduce a new quality or element into something 常見 inject a vaccine（注射疫苗）；比喻用法如 inject humor into a speech（在演講中加入幽默）。
w_injection
the act of introducing a substance into the body with a needle, or the act of introducing something new 常見 a flu injection（流感疫苗注射）；也指資金挹注，如 a cash injection。
w_injunction
an official order issued by a court, usually requiring someone to do or stop doing something 法律用語，常見 obtain an injunction against someone（取得針對某人的禁制令）。
w_injure
to cause physical harm to someone 常用被動語態 be injured，如 be injured in an accident，語氣中性，多指身體傷害。
w_injustice
a lack of fairness or justice, or an unfair act 常見 social injustice（社會不公）、do someone an injustice（對某人不公平），語氣正式。
w_inland
located or happening in the interior part of a country, away from the coast or border 常見 inland areas（內陸地區）、inland waterways（內陸水路），與 coastal（沿海的）相對。
w_inner
situated inside or closer to the center; relating to a person's private thoughts or feelings 常見 inner city（市中心區）、inner peace（內心的平靜）；比喻用法非常普遍。
w_innocence
the state of not being guilty of a crime, or a lack of experience or worldliness 常見 prove one's innocence（證明清白）；也可指童年般的純真，如 childhood innocence。
w_innocent

not guilty of a crime, or free from moral wrong; naive 常見 an innocent bystander（無辜的旁觀者）；也可形容缺乏世故的天真，如 an innocent question。 無辜的人；天真的人 a person who is not guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, especially one who is naive 較少見用法，常見於正式或文學語境，如 punish the innocent along with the guilty。
w_innocuous

not harmful or offensive, especially when it appears that way but may not be innocuous 最有力的用法帶有伏筆：說某件事 seemingly innocuous，等於預告它其實造成了大麻煩。事故報告與資安分析中極常見：an innocuous-looking config change。這種「表面無害」的語感讓它比 harmless 更適合敘事。 seemingly innocuous an innocuous-looking + noun seemingly innocuous 看似無害的 an innocuous question 無傷大雅的問題 look innocuous 看起來沒有威脅性 harmless benign harmful malicious innocuously innocent
w_innovation
the introduction of new ideas, methods, or products 常見 technological innovation（科技創新），語氣正面，強調突破性的改變。
w_innovative
introducing new ideas or methods; original and creative 常修飾 idea、product、approach，如 an innovative solution，語氣正面。
w_inquire
to ask for information about something 常接 about，如 inquire about a job（詢問一份工作的相關資訊），比 ask 稍正式。
w_inquiry
an act of asking for information, or an official investigation 常見 make an inquiry（提出詢問）；也指正式調查，如 launch an inquiry into。
w_inquisitive
having or showing a strong curiosity about things 常修飾 child、mind 等，如 an inquisitive child（好奇心旺盛的孩子），語氣中性偏正面。
w_insane
seriously mentally ill, or (informally) extremely foolish or unreasonable 口語中常誇張使用，表示極其荒謬或不合理，如 that's insane（那太瘋狂了）。
w_insanity
the state of being seriously mentally ill, or extreme foolishness 常見 plead insanity（以精神失常為由抗辯），口語也可誇張形容荒謬的行為，如 sheer insanity。
w_insatiable
impossible to satisfy 常見 an insatiable appetite（無法滿足的胃口/慾望），比喻用法非常普遍，強調慾望永無止盡。
w_inscribe
to write or carve words on a surface, especially as a permanent record 常見 inscribe a name on a plaque（在牌匾上刻上名字），語氣正式，強調永久性的紀錄。
w_insider
a person who is a member of a group or organization, and has access to private information 常見 insider trading（內線交易，商業犯罪術語），也可泛指了解內情的人。
w_insidious
proceeding in a gradual, subtle way but with harmful effects 常修飾抽象威脅，如 an insidious disease（悄悄惡化的疾病），語氣書面正式，強調難以察覺的危害。
w_insight
a clear, deep understanding of a complicated problem or situation 常見 gain insight into（獲得對……的深入理解），語氣正面，強調對本質的理解。
w_insinuate
to suggest or imply something negative in an indirect and unpleasant way 常接 that 子句，如 insinuate that someone is lying，語氣帶負面意味，強調間接且令人不快的暗示。
w_insoluble
impossible to solve, or (of a substance) unable to be dissolved 常見 an insoluble problem（無解的問題）；化學語境指物質不溶於液體。
w_inspect
to examine something closely, especially for faults or to check quality 常見 inspect a building（檢查建築物），語氣正式，常見於安全或品質檢驗語境。
w_inspection
a careful examination or official check 常見 a safety inspection（安全檢查）、pass an inspection（通過檢查）。
w_inspector
an official who checks that regulations are being followed, or a police officer of a certain rank 常見 a health inspector（衛生檢查員）；英式英語中也指警察職級，如 detective inspector。
w_inspiration
the process of being mentally stimulated to do or feel something creative, or a person or thing that provides this 常見 draw inspiration from（從……汲取靈感），語氣正面。
w_inspire
to fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially something creative 常接 someone to do something，如 inspire people to act，語氣正面積極。
w_install
to place or fix equipment or software in position for use 常見 install software（安裝軟體）、install a new heater（安裝新暖爐）。
w_instant
happening immediately 常見 instant noodles（速食麵）、instant success（一炮而紅），依語境略有不同引申義。
w_instantaneous
occurring or done immediately, with no delay 比 instant 更強調技術上完全沒有延遲，常見於科學或科技語境。
w_instill
to gradually but firmly establish an idea, attitude, or habit in someone's mind 常接 in/into，如 instill confidence in someone（培養某人的自信），語氣正面，強調長期潛移默化。
w_instinct
an innate, typically fixed pattern of behavior in response to certain stimuli 常見 trust your instincts（相信你的直覺）、maternal instinct（母性本能）。
w_instinctive
relating to or prompted by instinct; natural and unlearned 常修飾 reaction、response，如 an instinctive reaction，強調未經思考的自然反應。
w_institute

an organization founded for a particular purpose, especially research or education 常見 a research institute（研究機構），常出現於機構名稱中，如 institute of technology。 建立；設立；實施（制度或政策） to establish or introduce a system, policy, or practice 常接抽象名詞，如 institute a new policy（實施新政策），語氣正式書面。
w_institution

an organization founded for a particular purpose, especially educational, religious, or social; an established custom or practice 常見 a financial institution（金融機構）；也可指根深柢固的社會習俗，如 marriage as an institution。
w_instruct
to teach someone a skill, or to give someone an authoritative order or direction 常接 someone to do something，如 instruct the staff to follow the procedure，語氣正式。
w_instrument
a tool used for precise or delicate work, or a device used to produce musical sounds 常見 a musical instrument（樂器）、a surgical instrument（手術器械）。
w_instrumental
serving as a crucial means or way to bring about a result, or (of music) performed without vocals 常見 be instrumental in（在……中扮演關鍵角色）；音樂語境指沒有人聲的純樂器演奏曲。
w_insufficient
not enough; inadequate 常見 insufficient evidence（證據不足）、insufficient funds（資金不足），語氣正式。
w_insure
to arrange for compensation in the event of loss or damage, in exchange for regular payments 常見 insure a car（為汽車投保）、insure against loss；美式英語中常與 ensure 混淆，需留意拼寫。
w_insurrection
a violent uprising against an authority or government 政治語境用語，語氣正式且較 rebellion 更強調有組織的武力反抗政府。
w_intact
not damaged or broken; complete 常見 remain intact（保持完好），強調沒有經歷破壞或遺失部分，語氣中性。
w_intangible
unable to be touched or physically grasped, or difficult to define precisely 常見 intangible assets（無形資產，商業用語）；也可形容難以言喻的特質，如 an intangible quality。
w_integral

necessary and important as a part of a whole 常接 to，如 integral to the success of the project（對這項專案的成功不可或缺）。 積分（數學用語） a mathematical function related to the summing of infinitesimal parts 數學用語，指微積分中的積分運算，較少見於一般日常語境。
w_integrate
to combine two or more things so that they work together as a whole, or to become part of a larger group 常見 integrate into society（融入社會）、integrate data from multiple sources。
w_integrity
the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles, or the state of being whole and undivided 常見 act with integrity（正直行事）；也可指結構上的完整，如 structural integrity。
w_intellectual

relating to the ability to think and reason, rather than physical or emotional 常見 intellectual property（智慧財產權）、intellectual curiosity（求知欲）。 知識分子 a person who values and engages in the pursuit of knowledge and ideas 常見於描述學者或思想家，語氣中性偏正面，強調對知識和思想的重視。
w_intelligent
having or showing a high level of understanding, reasoning, or mental capacity 常修飾人或動物，如 an intelligent student；也可用於機器，如 artificial intelligent systems（此處常見 intelligent 修飾系統）。
w_intelligible
able to be understood; clear 常接 to，如 intelligible to a general audience（一般大眾都能理解），與 unintelligible（無法理解的）相對。
w_intense
very strong or extreme in degree or quality 常修飾 emotion、pressure、heat 等，如 intense heat（酷熱），語氣強烈。
w_intensify
to become or make something more intense or extreme 常接抽象名詞，如 intensify efforts（加強努力），語氣正式。
w_intensive
involving a great deal of concentrated effort or resources in a short time 常見 an intensive course（密集課程）、intensive care（加護病房）。
w_intent
an aim or purpose, or the state of mind that must accompany certain criminal acts 常見 with intent to（帶有……的意圖），法律語境常用於描述蓄意犯罪的心理狀態。
w_intentional
done on purpose; deliberate 常見 intentional damage（故意的損害），與 accidental（意外的）相對。
w_inter
to bury a dead body in the ground or a tomb 語氣正式書面，多用於正式葬禮或歷史文本，日常口語通常用 bury。
w_interact
to communicate with or react to each other 常見 interact with others（與他人互動）；科學語境也指物質間的相互作用。
w_interaction
communication or reaction between two or more people or things 常見 social interaction（社交互動）；也可指藥物或化學物質之間的交互作用。
w_interactive
allowing two-way communication or engagement, especially between a computer and a user 常見 an interactive whiteboard（互動式白板）、interactive learning。
w_interchangeable
able to be exchanged or used in place of each other 常見 use a and b interchangeably（將 a 和 b 交替使用），強調兩者功能或意義上相同。
w_interfere
to become involved in and prevent or hinder a process or situation, without invitation 常接 with/in，如 interfere with someone's plans（干擾某人的計畫），語氣帶負面意味。
w_interference
the act of interfering, or unwanted disturbance affecting a signal or process 常見 radio interference（無線電干擾）；也指他人的不必要介入，如 parental interference。
w_interim

temporary, especially during a period before something permanent is established 常見 an interim manager（臨時經理）、an interim report（期中報告）。 過渡期；中間時期 a temporary period between one event or state and another 常見 in the interim（在此期間），語氣正式，強調事情尚未確定的過渡狀態。
w_interior
situated inside or within; relating to the inside of a place 常見 interior design（室內設計）、the interior of a car（車內），與 exterior（外部的）相對。
w_intermediate

a level or stage between two others, especially in skill or difficulty 常見於課程分級，如 an intermediate（中級學員），與 beginner、advanced 對應。 中間的；中級的 coming between two things in time, place, order, or degree 常見 an intermediate level（中級程度）、an intermediate step（中間步驟）。
w_interminable
seemingly endless, especially because it is tedious or boring 常修飾 meeting、wait 等，如 an interminable meeting，語氣帶負面意味，強調過程令人厭煩。
w_intern

a student or trainee who works, sometimes without pay, to gain practical experience 常見 a summer intern（暑期實習生），常見於商業或醫療領域的實習制度。 拘留；監禁（尤指戰時未經審判） to confine someone, especially in wartime, without trial 多見於歷史或政治語境，如 intern civilians during wartime，語氣正式且帶沉重歷史意涵。
w_interpret
to explain the meaning of something, or to translate spoken language orally 常接 as，如 interpret silence as agreement（把沉默解讀為同意）；也指擔任口譯員。
w_interpretation
an explanation or way of understanding something, or a performer's rendering of a piece of music or art 常見 open to interpretation（可有多種解讀），也指藝術表演上的獨特詮釋方式。
w_interrupt

to stop someone from speaking or an activity from continuing by breaking in 常見 interrupt someone while they are speaking，語氣中性，強調行為造成的干擾。 中斷（電腦術語） a signal that stops a computer's normal processing to attend to an urgent task 電腦科學專業用語，指硬體或軟體發出的中斷訊號，日常口語極少用此名詞義。
w_intersection
a place where two or more roads or lines cross, or the point at which two things meet or overlap 常見 a busy intersection（繁忙的路口）；也可比喻兩個抽象概念的交會，如 the intersection of art and science。
w_intersperse
to scatter or distribute among or between other things 常見被動語態 be interspersed with，如 the speech was interspersed with jokes（演講中穿插著笑話）。
w_intertwine
to twist or twine together, or to become closely connected 常用被動語態 be intertwined with，比喻用法常見，如 our fates are intertwined（我們的命運交織在一起）。
w_interval
a period of time between two events, or a pause between parts of a performance 常見 at regular intervals（定期地）；英式英語中也指戲劇或音樂會的中場休息（美式常用 intermission）。
w_intervene
to become involved in a situation in order to change or influence its outcome 常見 intervene in a conflict（介入衝突），語氣正式，強調為了改變結果而採取行動。
w_intervention
the act of becoming involved in a situation to influence its outcome, especially to help 常見 military intervention（軍事介入）、early intervention（早期介入）。
w_interviewer
a person who conducts an interview 常見於新聞或求職語境，如 the interviewer asked several questions。
w_intimacy
close familiarity or friendship; closeness in a relationship 常見 emotional intimacy（情感上的親密），語氣正面，強調人際或情感上的緊密連結。
w_intimidate
to frighten someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants 常用被動語態 be intimidated by，如 be intimidated by someone's confidence，語氣帶負面意味。
w_intractable
hard to control or deal with; difficult to solve 常修飾 problem、conflict，如 an intractable dispute，語氣正式，強調長期無法解決的困難。
w_intransigent
unwilling to change one's views or agree about something 常修飾人的態度，如 an intransigent attitude，語氣正式且帶負面意味，強調拒絕讓步。
w_intrepid
fearless and adventurous, especially in facing danger 常修飾 explorer、traveler，如 an intrepid explorer，語氣正面，帶英勇冒險的色彩。
w_intrude
to enter or become involved in a place or situation without permission or invitation 常接 on/into，如 intrude on someone's privacy（侵犯某人的隱私）。
w_intuitive

easy to understand or use without being taught, because it works the way people expect 在產品與介面設計中，intuitive 是最高的稱讚之一：使用者不用看說明就會用。但它有個陷阱——直覺是相對於經驗的，對工程師直覺的介面對一般使用者未必如此。因此嚴謹的寫作會說 intuitive to whom。另一個意思是形容人的判斷靠直覺。 intuitive to + somebody counter-intuitive an intuitive interface 直覺的介面 counter-intuitive 反直覺的 not immediately intuitive 不是一看就懂的 self-explanatory instinctive counter-intuitive unintuitive intuition intuitively obvious
w_inundate
to overwhelm someone with things or people to deal with, or to flood a place with water 常用被動語態 be inundated with，如 be inundated with requests（被大量請求淹沒），比喻用法比字面淹水更常見。
w_invade
to enter a country or territory using military force in order to take control of it, or to intrude on someone's privacy 軍事語境常見 invade a country；也可比喻性地指侵犯隱私，如 invade someone's privacy。
w_invaluable
extremely useful; indispensable 注意此詞為正面詞彙，不同於字面「無價值」，常見 invaluable advice（極為寶貴的建議）。
w_invariably
in every case or on every occasion; always 常見於描述固定不變的模式，如 invariably late（總是遲到），語氣正式書面。
w_invasion
an act of invading a country or region with an armed force, or an intrusion into a person's privacy or affairs 軍事語境常見 a military invasion；也可比喻性地指隱私被侵犯，如 an invasion of privacy。
w_inventory
a complete list of goods or items in stock, or the items themselves 常見 take inventory（盤點庫存）；商業用語，常見於零售或倉儲管理語境。 盤點；列清單 to make a complete list of goods or items 及物動詞，較少見用法，多見於商業或倉儲語境。
w_inverse

opposite in effect, order, or direction 常見 an inverse relationship（反向關係，即一者增加另一者減少），數學或科學語境常用。 相反的事物；逆命題 something that is the opposite or reverse of another thing 數學用語，常見 the inverse of a function（函數的反函數），也可泛指某事的相反面。
w_investigate
to carry out a systematic inquiry to discover and examine the facts of a situation 常接名詞受詞，如 investigate a crime（調查一起犯罪案件），語氣正式。
w_invisible
unable to be seen 常見 invisible to the naked eye（肉眼看不見的），比喻用法如 an invisible barrier（無形的障礙）。
w_invoke
to cite or appeal to something as an authority for an action, or to call upon a higher power in prayer 常見 invoke a law（援引一項法律）；也可指請求神靈庇佑，語氣書面正式。
w_involuntary
done without conscious control; not deliberate 常見 an involuntary movement（不由自主的動作），醫學或法律語境也常用，與 voluntary（自願的）相對。
w_irascible
easily made angry; hot-tempered 常修飾人物性格，如 an irascible old man，語氣書面，強調容易發怒的個性。
w_ironic
using or characterized by irony; happening in a way that is contrary to what is expected, often amusingly 常見 it's ironic that...（諷刺的是……），描述結果與預期相反的情況。
w_irony
a situation or use of language that expresses something contrary to what is expected or literally meant 常見 the irony of the situation（這個情況的諷刺之處），文學上也指語言使用中的反話。
w_irrelevant
not connected with or relevant to a particular matter 常接 to，如 irrelevant to the discussion（與討論無關），與 relevant（相關的）相對。
w_irrigation
the supply of water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels 農業用語，常見 irrigation system（灌溉系統），描述人工引水灌溉農作物的方式。
w_isolate
to separate someone or something from others, or to identify a substance in its pure form 常見 isolate a patient（隔離病人）；科學語境指分離出某成分，如 isolate a virus。
w_isolation
the state of being separated from others; the process of isolating something 常見 social isolation（社交孤立）、in isolation（單獨、孤立地），語氣中性偏負面。
w_isotope
one of two or more forms of the same element with the same number of protons but a different number of neutrons 化學或物理學專業用語，常見 radioactive isotope（放射性同位素）。
w_ivory
the hard white substance forming the tusks of elephants and other animals, or a creamy white color 常見 ivory carving（象牙雕刻）；因保育議題，象牙貿易已受到嚴格管制。
w_jade

a hard, typically green stone used for ornaments and jewelry 常見於中華文化脈絡，如 jade jewelry（玉飾）、a jade pendant（玉墜）。 玉綠色的；翡翠綠的 having the color of jade, a shade of green 常修飾顏色描述，如 jade green eyes（玉綠色的眼睛），較少單獨使用，多與 green 連用。
w_jagged
having an uneven, sharply pointed surface or edge 常修飾 edge、rock，如 jagged rocks（嶙峋的岩石），描述表面不平整銳利的特徵。
w_jazz

a type of music of african american origin characterized by improvisation and syncopated rhythms 音樂類型用語，常見 jazz music、a jazz band，起源於美國，帶有即興演奏的特色。 使更生動有趣（常與 up 連用） to make something more exciting or lively, usually followed by "up" 口語用法，常見 jazz up a room（讓房間更有活力），語氣輕鬆隨意。
w_jealous
feeling resentful envy of someone's achievements or advantages, or fearful of losing one's partner's affection 常接 of，如 jealous of her success（嫉妒她的成就）；情感語境也可指對伴侶感到吃醋。
w_jeer
a rude or mocking remark or shout 常見於群眾對表演者或運動員的噓聲，如 jeers from the crowd。 嘲笑；奚落；喝倒采 to shout mocking or derisive remarks at someone 常接 at，如 jeer at the referee（對裁判喝倒采），語氣負面，強調公開的嘲弄。
w_jerk
a quick, sharp movement, or (informally) a stupid or contemptible person 常見 with a jerk（猛然一下）；口語 he's such a jerk 表示某人很討人厭，需留意使用場合。
w_jewel
a precious stone, especially a cut and polished one used for decoration 常見 a jewel box（珠寶盒）；比喻用法如 the jewel of the collection（收藏品中的珍品）。
w_jewelry
personal ornaments made from precious metals or stones, such as rings, necklaces, and bracelets 美式拼法，英式為 jewellery；常見 costume jewelry（人造首飾）與 fine jewelry（貴重珠寶）之分。
w_jockey

a professional rider in horse races 運動用語，特指專業賽馬騎師，常見於賽馬相關語境。 （為爭取優勢而）巧妙運作；競逐 to maneuver or manipulate skillfully, often to gain an advantage over rivals 常見固定片語 jockey for position（爭奪有利位置），比喻用法常見於商業或政治語境。
w_journal
a periodical publication, especially a scholarly one, or a personal diary 常見 an academic journal（學術期刊）；也可指個人書寫的日記本，如 keep a journal。
w_journalism
the activity or profession of writing for newspapers, magazines, or news websites, or preparing news to be broadcast 常見 investigative journalism（調查性新聞報導），泛指從事新聞蒐集與撰寫的專業領域。
w_journalist
a person who writes for newspapers, magazines, or news websites, or prepares news to be broadcast 常見 a freelance journalist（自由記者）、an investigative journalist（調查記者）。
w_judgement
the ability to make considered decisions, or a formal decision made by a court 英式拼法，美式常用 judgment；常見 use good judgement（做出明智的判斷）、a court judgement。
w_judicial
relating to a court of law, judgment, or the administration of justice 常見 the judicial system（司法體系）、judicial review（司法審查），語氣正式，屬法律專業用語。
w_judicious
having, showing, or done with good judgment or sense; sensible and wise 常修飾決策或選擇，如 a judicious decision（明智的決定），語氣正面，強調深思熟慮後的合理判斷。
w_jumble

to mix things together in a confused or disorganized way 常見被動語態 be jumbled together，如 the papers were jumbled on the desk（文件在桌上亂七八糟地堆著）。 雜亂的一堆；混雜物 a confused mixture of things 常見 a jumble of wires（雜亂纏繞的電線），也可比喻思緒或情緒的混亂。
w_junction
a point where two or more things, especially roads or railway lines, join or meet 常見 a road junction（道路交會處）；英式英語常見於高速公路出口編號，如 junction 5。
w_jungle
a dense tropical forest with abundant vegetation, or (figuratively) a chaotic or ruthlessly competitive environment 常見 the amazon jungle（亞馬遜叢林）；比喻用法如 concrete jungle（水泥叢林，指擁擠的城市）、a corporate jungle。
w_junk
old or discarded items regarded as useless or of little value 口語常用，如 clean out the junk in the garage（清理車庫裡的雜物）；junk food 指垃圾食物。
w_jurisdiction
the official power to make legal decisions or judgments, or the geographic area within which such authority applies 常見 fall under the jurisdiction of（屬於……的管轄範圍），法律用語，正式且精確。
w_jurisprudence
the theory or philosophy of law 學術用語，常見 the study of jurisprudence（法理學研究），日常口語極少使用。
w_jury
a group of people sworn to give a verdict in a legal case, or a panel that judges a competition 法律語境常見 the jury reached a verdict（陪審團做出裁決）；也可指比賽評審，如 a panel of judges/jury。
w_justifiable
able to be shown to be right or reasonable 常見 justifiable force（有正當理由使用的武力），法律或倫理語境常用，強調行為合理有據。
w_justification
a good reason or explanation for an action or belief 常見 without justification（毫無正當理由地）、in justification of（為……辯護）。
w_justify
to show or prove that something is right, reasonable, or necessary 常接名詞或子句，如 justify a decision（為決定辯護），語氣正式。
w_juvenile

relating to young people, or (of behavior) childish and immature 常見 juvenile delinquency（青少年犯罪）；也可形容成年人幼稚的行為，如 juvenile behavior。 未成年人；少年 a young person, especially one who is not yet legally an adult 法律用語，常見 tried as a juvenile（以未成年人身分受審），與 adult 相對。
w_juxtapose

to place two things side by side, especially in order to highlight the contrast between them juxtapose 不只是「放在一起」，而是「刻意並置以製造對比效果」。它常用於文學批評、設計評論與資料呈現：juxtapose the two charts 表示把兩張圖並排，讓差異一目了然。多以被動態出現：a is juxtaposed with b。 juxtapose a with b be juxtaposed against + noun juxtapose a with b 把 a 與 b 並置對照 sharply juxtaposed 形成強烈對照 contrast conflate juxtaposition compare
w_keen

having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm, or (of the senses) sharp and perceptive 常接 on，如 keen on the idea（很喜歡這個點子）；也可形容感官敏銳，如 keen eyesight。 哀悼的哭嚎聲（尤指葬禮上） a loud wailing cry expressing grief, especially at a funeral 此用法源自愛爾蘭傳統喪禮習俗，日常口語罕見，多見於文學或民俗文化描述。
w_kettle
a container with a spout, used for boiling water 常見 an electric kettle（電熱水壺），日常生活用品，常見於廚房脈絡。
w_kidney
either of a pair of organs in the body that filter waste from the blood and produce urine 醫學用語，常見 kidney failure（腎衰竭）、kidney stones（腎結石）。
w_kindergarten
a school or class for young children, typically between ages four and six 常見 start kindergarten（開始上幼兒園），教育體系中通常是小學前的階段。
w_kinetic
relating to or resulting from motion 物理學用語，常見 kinetic energy（動能），與 potential energy（位能）相對。
w_kingdom
a country or territory ruled by a king or queen, or a realm or domain 常見 the animal kingdom（動物界），比喻用法非常常見，指某個特定的範疇或分類系統。
w_knead
to work dough or clay with the hands by pressing and folding it 烹飪或工藝用語，常見 knead the dough（揉麵團），描述反覆按壓摺疊的動作。
w_knot
a fastening made by looping and tying a piece of string or rope, or a unit of speed for ships 常見 tie a knot（打結）；航海用語中 knot 也指船速單位，如 the ship traveled at 20 knots。
w_label
a piece of paper, fabric, or other material attached to an object to give information about it 常見 a warning label（警告標籤）、a price label（價格標籤）；也可指音樂唱片公司，如 a record label。
w_lace

a delicate fabric made with open patterns of thread, or a cord used to fasten shoes 常見 lace curtains（蕾絲窗簾）；也指鞋帶，如 tie your shoelaces。 用帶子繫緊；在飲料中摻入（酒或藥物） to fasten something with laces, or to add a small amount of alcohol or another substance to a drink 常見 lace up shoes（繫緊鞋帶）；也可指偷偷在飲料中摻入東西，如 lace a drink with alcohol，帶負面意味。
w_laconic
using very few words; terse or concise 常修飾說話方式，如 a laconic reply（簡短的回答），語氣書面正式，強調惜字如金的風格。
w_laity
ordinary members of a religious organization, as distinct from its clergy 宗教語境常見詞彙，與 clergy（神職人員）相對，日常口語極少使用。
w_lance
to pierce or cut open, especially a boil or abscess, with a sharp instrument 醫學用語，常見 lance a boil（切開膿包），語氣中性技術性。
w_landmark
a recognizable feature of a landscape or town, or an event marking an important stage of development 常見 a famous landmark（著名地標）；比喻用法如 a landmark decision（具有里程碑意義的決定）。
w_landscape
a large area of countryside, especially in terms of its visual appearance, or an overview of a situation or field 常見 a beautiful landscape（美麗的風景）；比喻用法如 the political landscape（政治局勢）。
w_languid
displaying or having a disinclination for physical exertion or effort; slow and relaxed 常修飾 mood、movement 等，如 a languid afternoon（慵懶的午後），語氣中性偏文學。
w_lapse

a brief or temporary failure of memory, judgment, or a standard, or a period of time that passes 常見 a lapse in judgment（一時的判斷失誤）；也可指保單或合約的過期失效。 （逐漸）失效；（合約等）過期作廢 to fail to maintain a standard or condition, especially gradually, or (of a contract or right) to become invalid due to disuse 常見 lapse into silence（陷入沉默）；也指保單、會員資格等因未續約而失效。
w_laser
a device that produces an intense, focused beam of light 科技或醫療用語，常見 laser surgery（雷射手術）、laser printer（雷射印表機）。
w_lash

an eyelash, or a stroke with a whip 常見 false lashes（假睫毛）；也可指鞭刑的一擊，如 receive ten lashes。 鞭打；用繩索緊緊捆綁 to hit forcefully with a whip or similar object, or to fasten something tightly with rope 常見 lash something to a mast（把某物綁在桅杆上）；比喻用法如 lash out（突然發怒或攻擊）。
w_latch

a device for holding a door or gate closed, typically operated by a bar and lever 常見 lift the latch（掀開門閂），描述簡單的門窗鎖具結構。 用門閂扣上；（口語）緊緊依附（想法或人） to fasten something with a latch, or (informally) to become firmly attached to an idea or person 常見固定片語 latch on to（緊抓住、依附），口語用法比字面「扣上門閂」更常見。
w_lately
in the recent past; recently 常見 have you been well lately?（你最近好嗎？），常與現在完成式連用。
w_laud
to praise someone or something highly 語氣正式書面，常用被動語態 be lauded for，強調公開高度的讚美，比 praise 更正式。
w_laudable
deserving praise and commendation 常修飾 effort、goal 等，如 a laudable effort（值得讚揚的努力），語氣正式且正面。
w_laundry
clothes and linens that need to be washed, or the place where washing is done 常見 do the laundry（洗衣服）、a laundry basket（洗衣籃）。
w_lavish

sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious 常見 a lavish party（奢華的派對）、lavish praise（過度的讚美）。 大方給予；揮霍地給予 to give something in generous or extravagant amounts 常接 on，如 lavish attention on someone（對某人傾注大量關注）。
w_lawn
an area of ground covered with grass, kept mowed short 常見 mow the lawn（修剪草坪），日常生活用語，多見於庭院或公園描述。
w_lawsuit
a legal action brought by one party against another in a court of law 法律用語，常見 file a lawsuit（提起訴訟），日常口語也常簡稱 sue someone。
w_layer
a sheet, quantity, or thickness of material covering a surface, or one level of a structure or process 常見 a layer of dust（一層灰塵）、multiple layers of security（多層安全措施）。
w_layout
the way in which the parts of something are arranged or set out 常見 the layout of a room（房間的布局）、page layout（頁面版面），設計或建築語境常用。
w_leaflet
a printed sheet of paper, often folded, giving information or advertising something 常見 hand out leaflets（發放傳單），常用於宣傳或說明用途。
w_leak
a hole or crack that allows liquid or gas to escape, or an unauthorized disclosure of secret information 常見 a gas leak（瓦斯外洩）；比喻用法如 a security leak（安全機密外洩）。
w_lean

thin and healthy-looking, without excess fat, or (of an organization) efficient with minimal waste 常見 lean meat（瘦肉）；商業語境也指 lean management（精實管理），強調效率與少浪費。 傾斜；倚靠；傾向於（某觀點） to be in or move into a sloping position; to rely on or incline toward something 常接 against/on，如 lean against the wall（靠著牆）；比喻用法如 lean toward a decision（傾向某個決定）。
w_leap

a big jump, or a sudden and significant change or increase 常見 a leap of faith（憑信念的躍進）；也可指數量或程度的顯著提升，如 a leap in sales。 跳躍；躍過 to jump a long way, to a great height, or with great force 常接 over，如 leap over a fence；比喻用法如 leap to conclusions（妄下結論）。
w_lease

a contract by which one party conveys property to another for a specified time, usually for rent 常見 sign a lease（簽訂租約），法律或商業語境常用，指明確期限的租賃合約。 出租；租賃 to grant or take property, especially land or a building, on lease 及物動詞，常接 property 作受詞，如 lease an office space（租用一間辦公室）。
w_leather

material made from the skin of an animal, used for clothing, furniture, or other items 常見 leather jacket（皮夾克）、genuine leather（真皮），常見於服飾或家具語境。 用皮革覆蓋（或包覆） to cover or line something with leather 較少見用法，多見於家具或裝訂工藝相關描述。
w_legacy
something handed down from a predecessor, or money or property left to someone in a will 常見 leave a lasting legacy（留下持久的影響），比字面遺產更常見比喻用法。
w_legend
a traditional story regarded as historical but not verified, or a person who is very famous and admired 常見 an urban legend（都市傳說）；也可指備受推崇的名人，如 a sports legend（體育傳奇人物）。
w_legendary
described in legends, or extremely famous and admired 常見 a legendary musician（傳奇音樂家），語氣正面，強調享有盛名且備受推崇。
w_legislature
the branch of government responsible for making laws 政治學用語，常見 state legislature（州立法機構），與行政、司法部門並列討論。
w_legitimate

reasonable and justified, or allowed by the rules legitimate 橫跨兩個語域。法律語境中指「合法的」；日常論述中則指「站得住腳、值得認真對待的」——a legitimate concern 是「合情合理的疑慮」，這個用法在職場溝通中非常實用，因為它承認對方的立場而不必同意其結論。資安語境中則指「正常的、非攻擊的」流量。 a legitimate + noun perfectly legitimate a legitimate concern 合理的疑慮 legitimate traffic 正常流量 perfectly legitimate 完全正當的 a legitimate use case 正當的使用情境 valid lawful illegitimate spurious legitimacy legitimize valid
w_leisure
free time available for relaxation or activities of one's own choosing 常見 leisure activities（休閒活動）、at your leisure（有空時、不趕時間地）。
w_lender
a person or institution that lends money 金融用語，常見 a mortgage lender（房貸放款機構），與 borrower（借款人）相對。
w_lengthy
very long, especially in duration 常修飾 meeting、process，如 a lengthy discussion（冗長的討論），常帶輕微負面意味。
w_lenient
permissive or tolerant; not strict or harsh 常見 a lenient punishment（從輕的處罰），與 strict（嚴格的）相對。
w_lens
a piece of glass or transparent material used to focus light, or a way of viewing or interpreting something 常見 a camera lens（相機鏡頭）；比喻用法如 view something through a different lens（用不同的視角看待某事）。
w_lethal
sufficient to cause death; extremely dangerous 常見 a lethal dose（致命劑量）、a lethal weapon（致命武器），語氣強烈正式。
w_leverage

to use something you already have in order to gain a disproportionately large advantage leverage 來自槓桿原理，核心意思是「用既有的東西撬動更大的成果」。它比 use 多了「以小博大」的意涵，因此若只是普通地使用某物，用 use 更好。這個字在商務簡報中被過度使用到有點陳腐，寫作時值得斟酌。 leverage + noun + to + verb leverage existing infrastructure 善用既有的基礎設施 leverage expertise 運用專業能力 leverage economies of scale 善用規模經濟 影響力；籌碼 the power to influence a situation or a person to get what you want 作名詞時，leverage 指「談判中的籌碼」，是不可數名詞。常見句型是 have leverage over someone。金融語境中它另有「財務槓桿」（借貸比例）的專門意思。 have leverage over + noun gain leverage have leverage over 對……握有籌碼 gain leverage 取得談判優勢 financial leverage 財務槓桿 utilize lever exploit
w_lexical
relating to the words or vocabulary of a language 語言學用語，常見 lexical knowledge（詞彙知識），較為專業，日常口語少用。
w_liability
the state of being legally responsible for something, or a person or thing that causes problems or disadvantage 法律及財務用語，常見 limited liability（有限責任）；也可指造成麻煩的人或事，如 he's a liability to the team。
w_liaison
communication or cooperation between people or organizations, or a person who facilitates this 常見 a liaison officer（聯絡官）；也指部門間的協調溝通，如 maintain close liaison with。
w_liberal

open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values, or generous in giving or spending 常見 liberal views（開明的觀點）；政治語境指自由派立場，與 conservative（保守派）相對。 自由派人士 a person who holds liberal political or social views 政治語境常用，指主張社會改革、個人自由的政治立場者，與 conservative 相對。
w_liberty
the state of being free from oppressive restrictions; freedom 常見 personal liberty（個人自由）、take the liberty of doing something（擅自做某事）。
w_librarian
a person who works in or manages a library 常見於教育或圖書館語境，如 ask the librarian for help（向圖書館員求助）。
w_lick
an act of licking, or a small amount of something 常見 a lick of paint（一層薄薄的油漆），口語用法，強調少量或簡短的動作。 舔 to pass the tongue over something 及物動詞，常接受詞，如 lick an ice cream cone（舔冰淇淋甜筒）。
w_likelihood
the state of being likely or probable; probability 常見 in all likelihood（很有可能地）、the likelihood of success（成功的可能性）。
w_liken
to compare someone or something to another, pointing out a resemblance 常接 to，如 liken something to something else，語氣書面正式，常見於文學或評論性文字。
w_likewise
in the same way; also 常用於承接前句，表示相同的行為或情況，如 do likewise（照樣做），語氣正式書面。
w_limb
an arm or leg of a person or four-legged animal, or a large branch of a tree 常見 lose a limb（失去一肢）；也指樹木的大枝幹，如 a tree limb fell during the storm。
w_limestone
a sedimentary rock composed mainly of calcium carbonate, used in building 地質學用語，常見於建材脈絡，如 limestone quarry（石灰岩採石場）。
w_limitation
a restriction on the size, extent, or amount of something, or a weakness or shortcoming 常見 recognize one's limitations（認清自己的侷限），語氣中性，可指外在規則或內在能力的限制。
w_limp

lacking firmness or strength; not stiff 常修飾 handshake、posture 等，如 a limp handshake（軟弱無力的握手），語氣帶輕微負面。 跛行；一瘸一拐地走 to walk with difficulty because of an injury to a leg or foot 常見於描述受傷後的行走方式，如 limp across the finish line。
w_linear

a room for relaxing, such as in a home, hotel, or airport 常見 an airport lounge（機場貴賓室）、a living room lounge（客廳），依語境不同略有差異。 懶洋洋地躺（或坐）著 to sit, lie, or stand in a relaxed manner 常接 around，如 lounge around all day（整天懶洋洋地待著），語氣輕鬆隨意。

a recurring theme, image, or idea in a work of art, literature, or music 常見於藝術與文學分析，指作品中重複出現、具象徵意義的元素或想法。

the ability to move spontaneously 科學用語，常見 sperm motility，指細胞或微生物自行移動的能力。
w_motion

military weapons, ammunition, and equipment 常用複數 munitions，泛指軍事裝備與彈藥物資，多見於戰爭或國防語境。

dark, cloudy, or difficult to see through, especially liquid; unclear or morally questionable 可形容水或天色昏暗渾濁，也可比喻性地形容情況或動機不清不楚，如 murky details。

w_muster

to gather together courage, strength, or support, or to assemble troops for duty 常見 muster the courage to，也可指軍事上的召集，如 muster troops。 集合；召集 a formal gathering, especially of military personnel 軍事用語，常見 pass muster（達到標準、通過檢驗），源自軍隊點名檢閱的傳統。
w_musty
having a stale, unpleasant smell, often from dampness or age 常形容 an old room／book 等長期潮濕封閉所產生的氣味，也可比喻過時陳舊。
w_mutation
a change in the genetic structure of an organism, or a significant alteration in form 生物學用語，常見 a genetic mutation，也可泛指形式或性質上的顯著改變。
w_mute
silent, or unable or unwilling to speak 常見 remain mute，可指生理上無法言語，也可指選擇保持沉默。 弱音器 a device used to soften or muffle the sound of a musical instrument 音樂用語，常見於銅管或弦樂器演奏，用來降低或改變樂器音色。

a low, indistinct sound made without clearly forming words, often while complaining 常見 a mutter of complaint，指低沉含糊、通常帶抱怨語氣的聲音。

shared or felt equally by two or more people 常見 mutual respect／agreement，強調雙方共同擁有或共同感受的關係。

difficult to understand or explain; strange and puzzling 常見 a mysterious disappearance，強調事物或情況缺乏明確解釋，引發好奇或不安。

something that cannot be explained or understood 常接 solve a mystery（解開謎團）；也可指懸疑小說類型，如 a mystery novel。

a traditional story explaining natural or social phenomena, or a widely held but false belief 可指古代神話故事，也可比喻普遍流傳但不正確的看法，如 a common myth。

showing a lack of experience or judgment, especially believing things too easily 帶輕微負面意味，暗示缺乏世故或容易被騙，常見 naive to think that...。

of small width, especially in relation to length 常修飾 road、gap、margin，也可比喻指思想狹隘，如 narrow-minded。 使變窄；縮小範圍 to become or make something less wide, or to reduce in scope 物理義如 the road narrows；比喻用法如 narrow down the options（縮小選項範圍）。

just coming into existence and beginning to show signs of future development 常修飾 industry、movement，強調處於初期發展階段，語氣正式書面。
w_nasty
unpleasant, unkind, or disgusting in some way 可形容天氣、傷口、態度等，如 a nasty cut、a nasty remark，語氣口語且帶負面情緒。
w_nationality
the legal status of belonging to a particular nation 常見 dual nationality（雙重國籍）；填表格時常見欄位為 nationality。
w_nationwide
extending or applying throughout a whole nation 常修飾 survey、campaign、shortage，強調範圍涵蓋整個國家。
w_naval
relating to a navy or navies 常修飾 base、fleet、officer，專指與海軍相關的事物，不可與 national 混淆。
w_neat
arranged carefully and tidily, or (of a solution or idea) clever and efficient 常形容房間、外表整齊，也可口語表示想法或解決方案很棒，如 a neat trick。
w_necessity
something that is essential or absolutely needed 常見 out of necessity（出於必要）、a necessity for survival，強調不可或缺的重要性。
w_needle

a thin pointed piece of metal used for sewing or medical injections 常見 sewing needle、a needle and thread；medical 情境常指打針用的針頭。 不斷激怒或挑逗（某人） to provoke or irritate someone persistently, often in a teasing way 口語用法，常見 needle someone about something，語氣帶挑釁或調侃意味。
w_needy
lacking basic necessities such as food, money, or shelter, or (informally) emotionally dependent 常見 the needy（貧困者）；口語也可形容人在感情上黏人、缺乏安全感。
w_nefarious
extremely wicked or criminal 語氣正式書面，常修飾 plot、scheme，強調帶有犯罪或不道德的意圖。
w_negate
to make something ineffective or cancel out its effect 常見 negate the effect of，強調某因素完全抵銷或否定另一項效果。
w_neglect

to fail to give proper care or attention to someone or something 常接人或物作受詞，如 neglect a child、neglect one's duties，語氣偏負面且正式。 疏忽；忽視 a lack of proper care or attention 常見 child neglect、suffer from neglect，指長期未受到應有照顧的狀態。
w_negligence
a failure to take proper care, especially resulting in harm or damage 法律用語，常見 medical negligence、negligence lawsuit，強調應盡注意義務卻未盡到。

so small or unimportant that it can reasonably be ignored negligible 不只是「小」，而是「小到在做決策時可以直接不予考慮」。這是它與 small 的關鍵差別：它已經包含了一個判斷。效能分析中很常用：the overhead is negligible. 意思是「這點開銷不值得為它做最佳化」。 be negligible have a negligible effect on + noun a negligible effect 微乎其微的影響 negligible overhead 可忽略的額外開銷 virtually negligible 幾乎可以忽略 a negligible risk 極低的風險 insignificant trivial substantial significant negligibly trivial
w_negotiable
open to discussion or change, especially regarding price or terms 常見 the price is negotiable，也可比喻表示條件或立場仍有討論空間。
w_negotiate
to discuss something with others in order to reach an agreement 常見 negotiate a deal、negotiate with someone，強調透過討論達成共識或交易。
w_negotiation
the process of discussing something to reach an agreement 常見複數 negotiations，如 peace negotiations（和平談判），指正式的協商過程。
w_nemesis
a long-standing rival or an inescapable cause of one's downfall 語氣書面帶戲劇性，常見 arch-nemesis，指難以擊敗的對手或注定帶來失敗的因素。
w_nerve
a fiber or bundle of fibers that transmits signals in the body, or courage in a difficult situation medical 義如 a pinched nerve；口語義如 lose one's nerve（失去勇氣）、have the nerve to（有膽子做某事）。
w_nestle
to settle comfortably within or against something, often in a sheltered position 常見 nestle against/into，也可形容小鎮或建築物坐落於山谷等隱蔽地形。
w_neurosis
a mental or emotional disorder involving anxiety or obsessive behavior, without loss of touch with reality 精神醫學用語，強調患者仍具現實感，與精神病（psychosis）不同，語氣偏學術。
w_neutral

not supporting either side in a conflict or disagreement 常見 remain neutral、a neutral party，強調不偏袒任何一方的立場。 （車輛排檔的）空檔 a gear position in a vehicle in which power is not transmitted to the wheels 汽車用語，常見 put the car in neutral，指引擎與輪胎脫離動力連結的狀態。
w_niche
a specialized segment of the market for a particular kind of product, or a comfortable or suitable position 商業用語常見 find a niche、niche market，指針對特定小眾需求的市場區塊。
w_nick

a small cut or notch in a surface 常見 in the nick of time（千鈞一髮之際），是常見的慣用語表示恰好及時。 刻出小缺口；（英式口語）偷竊 to make a small cut in something, or (informal, british) to steal 物理義如 nick oneself while shaving；英式俚語義指小額偷竊，語氣輕鬆隨意。
w_nickname
an informal, often affectionate or humorous name for a person, place, or thing 常見 give someone a nickname，通常帶親暱或幽默意味，不同於正式名字。
w_nightmare
a frightening dream, or an extremely unpleasant or difficult experience 字面義指睡夢中的惡夢；比喻用法如 a logistical nightmare，形容過程極度混亂或困難。
w_nimble
able to move quickly and easily, or (of the mind) quick to understand and react 可形容身體動作，如 nimble fingers；也可比喻思維反應快，如 a nimble mind。
w_nitrogen
a chemical element that makes up most of the earth's atmosphere, symbol n 化學元素用語，常見 liquid nitrogen（液態氮）、nitrogen gas，語氣中性專業。
w_noble
having high moral qualities, or belonging to a hereditary aristocratic class 常見 a noble cause（崇高的理念）；歷史或社會脈絡下也指世襲貴族身分。
w_nocturnal
active during the night rather than the day 生物學常用語，形容動物在夜間活動，如 nocturnal animals（夜行動物）。
w_noisy
making a lot of noise, or full of noise 常修飾 street、classroom、engine，強調聲音大或環境嘈雜。
w_nominal
in name only, not in reality; or (of a fee) very small 常見 nominal leader（名義上的領導者）、a nominal fee（象徵性的費用），強調與實質不符或極少。
w_nominate
to formally propose someone for a position, award, or election 常見 nominate someone for an award/position，強調正式推薦某人參與競選或角逐獎項。
w_nominee
a person who has been nominated for a position or award 常見 oscar nominee（奧斯卡提名人），指已被正式推薦但尚未確定是否獲選的人。
w_nonconformist

a person who does not follow generally accepted beliefs or behavior 常用來形容拒絕遵循社會傳統或體制規範的人，語氣中性偏正面。 不墨守成規的；特立獨行的 not conforming to generally accepted beliefs or behavior 常修飾 attitude、lifestyle，強調與主流價值或習慣不同。
w_nonetheless
in spite of what has just been said; nevertheless 用於連接前後語意轉折的句子，語氣正式，常置於句首或句中，與 nevertheless 可互換。
w_nonsense
ideas, statements, or behavior that is foolish or has no meaning 常見 talk nonsense、stop this nonsense，語氣可正式可口語，表示不合邏輯或荒謬。
w_noose
a loop of rope that tightens as it is pulled, especially used for hanging 常見 tighten the noose，字面指繩圈；也可比喻處境愈來愈危險或受限。
w_norm
a standard or pattern of behavior that is typical or expected 常見 social norm、the norm，指普遍被接受的行為模式或標準。
w_notable
worthy of attention or notice; remarkable 常修飾 achievement、exception，語氣正式，強調某事物突出或值得一提。
w_notably
used to draw attention to something particularly important 常置於句中或句首，用於列舉時強調其中一項特別重要或值得注意的例子。

a v-shaped cut or indentation in a surface or edge 常見於物理描述，如 a notch in a belt；也用於慣用語 a notch above，表示程度更高。
w_notify

w_notion

an idea or belief about something, especially a general or vague one notion 指「一個概念或想法」，語氣比 idea 正式。它有一個微妙之處：在 the notion that... 這個句型中，作者常常是要「檢視或反駁」這個想法，而不是支持它。因此在學術寫作中看到 reject the notion that... 是很常見的。若只是中性地介紹概念，用 concept 更安全。 the notion of + noun the notion that + clause reject/challenge the notion that + clause the notion that ……這個觀念 reject the notion 駁斥這個想法 have no notion of 完全不了解 a vague notion 模糊的概念 concept idea fact notional concept
w_notorious
famous or well known for something bad 常接 for，如 notorious for corruption，帶明顯負面意味，與 famous 的中性語氣不同。
w_novel
a fictional prose narrative of book length 文學用語，泛指長篇虛構故事作品，與 short story（短篇小說）相對。 新穎的；新奇的 new and original, not resembling something formerly known or used 常修飾 idea、approach、solution，強調前所未見的創新性。
w_nowadays
at the present time, in contrast with the past 常置於句首，用於比較現在與過去的差異，語氣中性口語。
w_noxious
harmful or poisonous, especially to health 常修飾 fumes、gas、substance，強調對健康或環境造成傷害。
w_nuance

a very small difference in meaning, feeling, or quality that is easy to miss nuance 專指「小到需要功力才分辨得出來」的差別，特別常用於語言、藝術與政策討論。形容詞 nuanced 是很高的讚美，表示「考慮周到、能分辨細微差異」：a nuanced argument 就是不流於非黑即白的論述。 the nuances of + noun miss the nuance a nuanced + noun the nuances of ……的細微之處 a subtle nuance 細微的差別 miss the nuance 沒抓到微妙之處 a nuanced view 細膩周全的觀點 subtlety shade nuanced distinction
w_nucleus
the central part of an atom or cell, or the central or most important part of a group 科學用語指原子核或細胞核；也可比喻指團體或系統的核心部分。
w_numb

unable to feel physical sensation, or emotionally unresponsive physical 義如 numb with cold；情感義如 numb with grief，形容因強烈情緒而失去感覺。 使麻木；使失去知覺 to cause a loss of feeling, or to make someone emotionally unresponsive 常用被動 be numbed by，也可指用藥物使部位失去知覺，如 numb the pain。
w_numerous
existing in large numbers; many 語氣較 many 正式，常修飾 occasions、studies、attempts。
w_nurture

to care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something 常接 child、talent、relationship 等，強調長期悉心栽培以促進成長。 養育；培育 the process of caring for and encouraging the growth of someone, especially a child 常見於 nature versus nurture（先天與後天之爭），指環境與教養對成長的影響。
w_nutrient

w_nutrition
the process of providing or obtaining food necessary for health and growth 常見 good nutrition、a degree in nutrition，指攝取食物以維持健康的過程或學科。
w_oasis
a fertile area in a desert where water is found, or a peaceful place amid difficulty 字面指沙漠中有水源之處；比喻用法如 an oasis of calm，指喧囂中一處平靜之地。
w_oath
a formal promise, especially to tell the truth or fulfill a duty 常見 take an oath、under oath（宣誓後作證），語氣正式，常用於法律或就職場合。
w_obdurate
stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action 語氣正式書面，強調即使受到勸說或壓力仍拒絕改變，帶負面意味。
w_obedient
willing to comply with orders or requests; submissive to authority 常修飾 child、dog、citizen，強調願意遵守命令或規範，與 disobedient 相對。
w_obese
having excessive body fat to the extent that it may harm health 醫學用語，比 fat 更正式且中性，常見於健康報告，如 clinically obese。
w_obfuscate

w_objection
a statement expressing disagreement or opposition to something 常見 raise an objection、have no objection，法律情境常用 objection! 表示反對某項證詞。
w_obligation
