w_oblige
to make someone legally or morally bound to do something, or to do a favor for someone 常見被動 be obliged to（有義務做某事）；主動用法如 happy to oblige，表示樂意幫忙。
w_oblique
neither parallel nor at a right angle to something; indirect 字面指幾何角度傾斜；比喻用法如 an oblique reference，指間接、不直說的暗示。
w_oblivious
not aware of or noticing something 常接 to，如 oblivious to the danger，強調完全沒有意識到周遭情況。
w_obnoxious
extremely unpleasant, especially in a way that provokes anger or disgust 語氣比 annoying 更強烈，常形容態度傲慢或行為惹人厭的人。
w_obscure
to make something difficult to see, understand, or discover; to hide 常接具體物（如 obscure the view）或抽象概念（如 obscure the truth），強調刻意或無意地掩蓋。
w_obscurity
the state of being unknown, or the quality of being difficult to understand 常見 fade into obscurity（漸漸沒沒無聞）；也可指文字或概念難以理解的狀態。
w_obsequious
excessively eager to please or obey someone, in an insincere way 語氣負面，強調過度討好、缺乏真誠，常用來形容對上司或有權勢者的態度。
w_observance
the act of following or celebrating a law, custom, or religious occasion 常見 religious observance、observance of the law，語氣正式，強調依照傳統或規定行事。
w_observation
the act of watching something carefully, or a remark based on what has been noticed 常見 under observation（受到觀察）；也可指依觀察提出的看法，如 a keen observation。
w_obsess
to preoccupy someone's mind continually and intrusively 常見被動 be obsessed with，強調某件事持續佔據心思，難以擺脫。
w_obsession
a state in which someone's mind is completely filled with a particular idea or feeling 常見 have an obsession with，語氣可中性描述興趣過度，也可帶病態意味。
w_obsolete

no longer used or useful, because something better has replaced it obsolete 不只是「舊」，而是「因為有更好的東西出現而不再被使用」。這個因果關係是重點：一個技術可以很舊卻不 obsolete（例如 sql）。技術文件中它與 deprecated 有明確分工：deprecated 是「官方宣告不建議使用、但還能用」，obsolete 則是「實際上已無人使用」。 become obsolete render something obsolete become obsolete 變得過時 render obsolete 使……被淘汰 technically obsolete 技術上已過時的 outdated superseded current state-of-the-art obsolescence deprecated
w_obstacle
something that blocks progress or achievement 常見 overcome an obstacle、an obstacle to success，可指實體障礙物或抽象困難。
w_obstruct
to block a path or process, preventing movement or progress 常接具體物（obstruct the road）或抽象過程（obstruct justice），法律上 obstruct justice 指妨礙司法。
w_obviate
to remove or prevent a difficulty or need in advance 語氣正式書面，常見 obviate the need for，強調事先預防使某事變得不再必要。
w_occasional
happening irregularly and infrequently 常修飾 visit、rain shower，強調發生頻率低且無固定規律。
w_occasionally
sometimes but not often 常置於句中，描述發生頻率低，語氣中性口語與正式皆可使用。
w_occupation
a person's job or profession, or the action of occupying a place 常見於表格欄位 occupation（職業）；軍事情境則指 the occupation of a territory（佔領某地）。
w_occupational
relating to a person's job or profession 常見 occupational hazard（職業傷害風險）、occupational therapy（職能治療），修飾與工作相關的事物。
w_occupy
to live in, use, or take control of a place, or to fill a period of time or someone's attention 可指居住、軍事佔領、佔用空間或時間，如 occupy oneself with（讓自己忙於某事）。
w_occurrence
something that happens; an event or incident 常見 a common/rare occurrence，強調事情發生的頻率，語氣中性正式。
w_odor
a distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one 美式拼法，常見 a foul odor、body odor，多用於負面或明顯的氣味。
w_odour
a distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one 英式拼法，與 odor 意義相同，常見於英式英語文本，如 body odour。
w_offbeat

unconventional or unusual in a mildly interesting way 常修飾 humor、style，帶正面或中性意味，強調與眾不同但吸引人。 （音樂的）弱拍；後半拍 an unstressed beat in a musical rhythm 音樂用語，常見於強調節奏重音落在非正拍上，如 reggae 音樂常見 emphasis on the offbeat。
w_offend
to cause someone to feel hurt, angry, or upset 常接人作受詞，如 offend someone by saying something，也可用被動 be offended by。
w_offensive
causing someone to feel deeply hurt or upset, or relating to attacking rather than defending 情感義如 an offensive remark（冒犯的言論）；軍事義如 an offensive strategy（攻勢策略），依語境不同。
w_offspring
a person's child or children, or an animal's young 單複數同形，可用於人類子女或動物後代，語氣中性正式，常見於生物學或法律文本。
w_ominous
giving the impression that something bad is going to happen 常修飾 sky、silence、sign，強調帶來不好預感的氣氛或跡象。
w_omit
to leave out or fail to include something 常接受詞，如 omit a name from a list，強調有意或無意地未列入某項內容。
w_onerous
involving a great deal of effort and difficulty 語氣正式書面，常修飾 task、duty、responsibility，強調負擔沉重、令人吃力。
w_ongoing
continuing to happen or develop; still in progress 常修飾 project、investigation、negotiation，強調事情尚未結束、仍在進行。
w_onset
the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant 常見 the onset of winter、the onset of a disease，強調不好的事情剛開始出現。
w_opaque
not able to be seen through; not transparent, or (of a situation) difficult to understand 字面義形容材質不透光，如 opaque glass；比喻義如 an opaque process，指過程不透明、難以理解。
w_opera
a dramatic work set to music, sung by singers with orchestral accompaniment 藝術用語，常見 go to the opera、an opera house，指結合音樂與戲劇表演的藝術形式。
w_operative
functioning or having effect; in use or operation 常見 the operative word（關鍵字眼）、an operative clause（生效條款），強調正在發揮作用的部分。
w_operator
a person who works or controls a machine, process, or business 常見 machine operator、tour operator，指負責操作設備或經營特定業務的人。
w_opponent
characterized by active hostility or opposition 多用於修飾與對手相關的名詞，如 opponent forces（敵對勢力），強調處於對抗立場。
w_oppose
to disagree with or resist a plan, policy, or action 常接受詞，如 oppose a bill、oppose the decision，強調公開表達不贊同或加以抵制。
w_opposite
positioned or facing away in a different direction, or completely different in nature 常見 the opposite direction、opposite opinions，也可用於描述位置相對或性質完全不同。
w_oppress
to keep someone in a state of subjection through unjust use of power 常見被動 be oppressed by，強調長期以不公正的權力壓制他人，語氣正式且帶強烈負面色彩。
w_optical
relating to vision or the sense of sight, or relating to optics 常見 optical illusion（視覺錯覺）、optical device（光學儀器），依語境指視覺現象或光學技術。
w_optimal

the best possible, given the constraints that apply optimal 是個強字：它宣稱「在這些條件下不可能更好了」，而不只是「很好」。因此嚴謹的技術寫作會說 optimal for what，因為換個目標函數，最佳解就不同了。若只是想說「不錯」，用 good 或 effective 才誠實。片語 sub-optimal 是委婉批評的常用語。 optimal for + noun the optimal + noun sub-optimal the optimal solution 最佳解 optimal for 對……而言最佳 sub-optimal 不夠理想的 near-optimal 接近最佳的 ideal best sub-optimal optimize optimization optimally optimum
w_optimism
a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future 常見 a sense of optimism、cautious optimism，強調對未來抱持正面期待的態度。
w_optimistic
hopeful and confident about the future or the success of something 常接 about，如 optimistic about the future，語氣正面，與 pessimistic 相對。
w_optional
available to be chosen but not compulsory 常見 an optional course、optional extras，與 mandatory/compulsory 相對，強調可自由選擇是否參與。
w_oral
spoken rather than written, or relating to the mouth 語言義如 an oral exam（口試）；醫學義如 oral hygiene（口腔衛生），依語境判斷指涉範圍。
w_orbit
the curved path of an object around a star, planet, or moon 天文用語，常見 in orbit、the moon's orbit，指天體環繞另一天體運行的路徑。
w_orchestra
a large group of musicians who play various instruments together 音樂用語，常見 a symphony orchestra、conduct an orchestra，指演奏古典音樂的大型樂團。
w_ordain
to officially make someone a priest or minister, or to order something by law or decree 宗教義如 ordain a priest；法律或命運義如 fate ordained that...，語氣正式書面。
w_ordnance
military weapons, ammunition, and equipment 軍事用語，語氣正式，常見於官方或軍事文件，如 ordnance depot（軍火庫）。
w_organic
relating to living organisms, or (of food) produced without synthetic chemicals 常見 organic food、organic farming，指未使用人工化學物質生產的農產品，也可指與生物體相關的事物。
w_organism
an individual living thing, such as a plant, animal, or microorganism 生物學用語，泛指任何具備生命特徵的個體，如 a single-celled organism（單細胞生物）。
w_organizer
a person who arranges and coordinates an event or activity 常見 event organizer，指負責規劃、協調活動細節的人員。
w_orientation
the direction in which something is positioned, or an introductory program to familiarize someone with a new situation 常見 new employee orientation（新人培訓）；也可指物體的擺放方向，如 the orientation of a building。
w_origin
the point or place where something begins or is derived from 常見 country of origin（原產國）、the origin of a word（字源），指事物最初開始的地方或根源。
w_originally
in the beginning, before any changes were made 常置於句首或句中，強調事物一開始的狀態，與後來的改變形成對比。
w_originate
to begin or come into existence in a particular place or way 常接 from/in，如 originate from a region，強調事物最初出現的來源或地點。
w_ornate
elaborately decorated, especially with complex designs 常修飾 furniture、architecture，強調外觀極為繁複精美，帶有華麗感。
w_orthodox
following traditional or generally accepted beliefs, especially in religion 常見 orthodox views、orthodox church（東正教會），可指宗教正統派別，也可泛指遵循傳統觀念。
w_oscillate
to move repeatedly back and forth, or to waver between different opinions or states 物理義如 the pendulum oscillates；比喻義如 oscillate between hope and despair，形容心情或立場反覆變化。
w_ostensibly

according to what is stated or appears to be true, although this may not be the real situation ostensibly 是一個帶有懷疑語氣的副詞：它讓讀者知道「這是官方說法，但作者不完全買帳」。使用時通常後面會接一個轉折，或由上下文提供真正的動機。這是英文中表達委婉質疑最優雅的方式之一。 ostensibly + adjective/prepositional phrase ostensibly to + verb ostensibly to 表面上是為了…… ostensibly neutral 表面中立的 ostensibly simple 看似簡單的 seemingly nominally ostensible allegedly
w_oust
to force someone out of a position of power or office 常見 oust someone from office/power，語氣正式，強調透過權力鬥爭或投票使人下台。
w_outbreak
a sudden occurrence of something unwelcome, especially violence or disease 常見 an outbreak of disease/violence/war，強調負面事件突然大規模發生。
w_outcome

the final result of a process, especially one that was uncertain outcome 指「一連串過程走完後的最終結果」，且通常帶有「事前不確定」的前提。它與 output 的差別在管理與產品語境中很關鍵：output 是產出的東西（做了幾份報告），outcome 是那些東西造成的實際改變（決策品質是否提升）。 the outcome of + noun a positive/negative outcome the outcome of ……的結果 a desirable outcome 理想的結果 outcomes rather than outputs 重結果而非產出 an uncertain outcome 難以預料的結果 result consequence income output
w_outfit
a set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion, or (informal) an organization or business 常見 a stylish outfit（一套時髦的服裝）；口語義如 a small outfit（一個小型組織）。
w_outlandish
looking or sounding bizarre or unfamiliar 常修飾 idea、costume，帶輕微負面或詫異的語氣，強調與常態差異極大。
w_outlet
a means of expressing feelings or energy, or a shop/pipe through which something is released 常見 an outlet for stress（抒發壓力的管道）、a retail outlet（零售分店）、a power outlet（電源插座）。
w_outline
a general description or plan of the main features of something, or the outer boundary line of a shape 常見 give an outline of a plan（概述計畫）；也可指物體的外形輪廓，如 the outline of a building。
w_outlook
a person's point of view or attitude, or the future prospects for a situation 常見 a positive outlook on life（對人生的正面態度）；也可指經濟或天氣等未來趨勢，如 economic outlook。
w_outrage
an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation, or an act that provokes such a reaction 常見 public outrage（公眾的憤怒）、an act of outrage（令人髮指的行為），語氣強烈。
w_outrageous
shockingly bad, excessive, or unacceptable 常修飾 price、behavior、claim，語氣強烈，強調超出合理範圍令人無法接受。
w_outset
the beginning or start of something 常見 at/from the outset，強調事情最初的階段，語氣正式。
w_outspoken
direct and forthright in speech, especially in stating opinions others may not want to hear 常修飾 critic、politician，強調不畏懼表達可能引起爭議的看法。
w_outstanding
exceptionally good or notable, or (of a debt or issue) not yet paid or resolved 正面義如 outstanding performance；財務義如 an outstanding balance（未清償餘額），依語境判斷。
w_outstrip
to become greater in amount, degree, or rate than something else 常見 demand outstrips supply（需求超過供給），強調某項指標超越另一項的成長速度。
w_oval
having a rounded shape like an egg or ellipse 常修飾 shape、table、face，描述形狀類似蛋形或橢圓的物體。
w_ovation
an enthusiastic round of applause from an audience 常見 a standing ovation（起立鼓掌），指觀眾對表演或演講的熱情回應。
w_oven
an enclosed compartment used for cooking or baking food 日常用語，常見 preheat the oven（預熱烤箱），指用於烘烤食物的家電或設備。
w_overall

taking everything into account; general rather than specific 常修飾 impression、result、quality，強調綜合考量所有因素後的整體評價。 整體情況；全面來看 a general assessment or view that takes everything into account 常用於片語 on the overall 或作副詞用法 overall（整體而言），總結前述各項細節。
w_overdose
to take a dangerously excessive amount of a drug 醫療用語，常見 overdose on，指服用超過安全劑量的藥物，可能危及生命。
w_overflow

to flow or spread over the brim or limits of a container or area 常見 the river overflowed its banks，也可比喻情感滿溢，如 overflow with joy。 溢出；（多餘的）容量 an instance of a liquid or a crowd spilling beyond capacity, or the excess amount itself 常見 overflow parking（額外停車空間）、an overflow of emotion，指超出原有容量的部分。
w_overhead

positioned above one's head, or (of costs) relating to the ongoing expenses of running a business 物理義如 overhead lighting（頭頂上的照明）；商業義如 overhead costs（營運成本），依語境判斷。 （企業）營運成本；經常性開支 the ongoing operating costs of running a business, such as rent and utilities 常見 reduce overhead、high overhead，指維持營運所需的固定開支，不含直接生產成本。
w_overlap

to partially cover or coincide with something else 常見 schedules overlap（行程重疊）、interests overlap（興趣有重疊之處），強調兩者部分相同或重合。 重疊部分；重複之處 an area or amount in which two or more things coincide 常見 there is some overlap between，指兩件事物之間相同或重合的部分。
w_overlook
to fail to notice or consider something, or to have a view over a place from above 常見 overlook a detail（忽略一個細節）；也可指建築物俯瞰某景色，如 a room overlooking the sea。
w_override
to use one's authority to reject or cancel a decision, or to take precedence over something 常見 override a decision/veto，強調用更高的權力使原本的決定失效。
w_overrule
to reject or reverse a decision by using one's higher authority 法律用語常見 overrule an objection（駁回異議），強調具有更高權力的一方推翻先前的決定。
w_oversee
to supervise a task, project, or organization to ensure it is done correctly 常見 oversee a project/team，強調負責確保工作順利、正確地進行。
w_overshadow
to cast a shadow over something, or to make something seem less important by comparison 字面義指遮蔽陽光；比喻義如 the scandal overshadowed his achievements，強調某事使另一事顯得不重要。
w_oversight
an unintentional failure to notice or do something, or the act of supervising something 常見 due to an oversight（由於疏忽）；也可指正式監督機制，如 regulatory oversight。
w_overstate
to state something in an exaggerated way 常見 cannot be overstated（怎麼強調都不為過，反諷用法），也可指誇大事實的嚴重性。
w_overtake
to catch up with and pass a vehicle or competitor ahead, or to become greater or more successful than 交通義如 overtake a car；比喻義如 overtake a rival in sales，強調在數量或表現上超越對方。
w_overthrow

to remove a government or leader from power by force 政治用語，常見 overthrow a regime/government，強調以武力或革命手段使當權者下台。 （政府或政權的）推翻 the forcible removal of a government or leader from power 常見 the overthrow of a dictator，指政治權力被強制終結的事件本身。
w_overturn
to turn something upside down or on its side, or to reverse a legal decision or ruling 物理義如 overturn a boat；法律義如 overturn a verdict，強調正式撤銷先前的決定。
w_overwhelm
to have such a strong emotional or physical effect on someone that they cannot cope 常見被動 be overwhelmed by/with，形容情緒或工作量過大到難以應付。
w_oxygen
a chemical element essential for respiration, symbol o 化學及生物學用語，常見 oxygen supply、oxygen tank，指維持呼吸作用所需的氣體元素。
w_oyster
a bivalve mollusk, some species of which are edible or produce pearls 常見 oyster farm（牡蠣養殖場）；慣用語 the world is your oyster，比喻機會無限。
w_ozone
a gas made of three oxygen atoms, forming a protective layer in the upper atmosphere 化學及環境用語，常見 the ozone layer（臭氧層）、ozone depletion（臭氧層破洞），與環境保護議題相關。
w_pace

the speed at which someone or something moves or a process happens 常見 keep pace with（跟上⋯的步調）、at a slow pace，可指走路速度或事情進展的節奏。 （因焦慮）來回踱步 to walk back and forth repeatedly in a small area, especially due to nervousness 常見 pace up and down、pace the floor，強調因緊張或焦慮而反覆走動的動作。
w_pack
a group of animals that live and hunt together, or a set of items bundled together 常見 a pack of wolves（一群狼）；也可指包裝成一套的物品，如 a pack of cards（一副撲克牌）。
w_pact
a formal agreement between two or more parties 常見 sign a pact、a peace pact，強調正式且具約束力的合意，常用於國際或政治情境。
w_painstaking
done with or requiring great care and thoroughness 常修飾 effort、research、work，強調過程極度用心、注重細節。
w_palpable
able to be touched or felt, or (of a feeling) so intense as to seem almost physically perceptible 常修飾 tension、excitement、fear，強調情緒強烈到彷彿能被實際感受到。
w_paltry
very small or meager in amount; insignificant 常修飾 sum、amount、excuse，帶輕蔑語氣，強調數量少到不值一提。
w_pamper
to indulge someone with comfort, luxury, or excessive care 常見 pamper oneself with，指以奢侈或過度呵護的方式對待某人，語氣中性偏正面。
w_pandemic
(of a disease) prevalent throughout an entire country, continent, or the whole world 常見 a pandemic outbreak，也常轉作名詞使用（the pandemic），指疾病大範圍跨國、跨洲傳播的情況。
w_pander
to indulge or gratify people's desires or weaknesses, often in a way seen as unprincipled 常見 pander to，帶輕微負面意味，指為了討好或獲利而一味迎合他人（尤指低俗喜好）。
w_panel
a flat, distinct section of a surface, or a group of experts assembled to discuss or judge something 物理義如 a wooden panel（木製鑲板）；也可指評審或討論小組，如 a panel of judges。
w_panic

a sudden overwhelming feeling of fear that disrupts rational thought or behavior 常見 in a panic、mass panic，強調突如其來且難以控制的恐懼感，可能導致失序行為。 恐慌；驚慌失措 to feel or act with sudden uncontrollable fear 常見 don't panic（別慌），強調因突發狀況而失去冷靜、做出不理性的反應。
w_panoramic
providing a wide, unobstructed view of an area 常修飾 view、window，強調視野廣闊、能看見大範圍景色，常見於旅遊或建築描述。
w_pantomime
a form of theatrical entertainment combining music, comedy, and topical jokes, often based on a fairy tale 英式用語，特指聖誕節期間上演的傳統喜劇表演；也可泛指誇張的肢體表演。
w_parade
a public procession celebrating a special event, typically including marching bands or floats 常見 a military parade、a victory parade，指公開展示或慶祝的隊伍行進活動。
w_paradigm

a typical pattern or model of thinking that shapes how a whole field approaches its problems paradigm 指「整個領域共享的一套基本假設與做法」，來自 kuhn 的科學哲學。程式設計中的 programming paradigm（如函數式、物件導向）就是這個意思。片語 a paradigm shift 指「根本典範的轉移」，語氣很重，不該用來形容小改版。注意字尾 g 不發音。 a paradigm shift within the + adjective + paradigm a paradigm shift 典範轉移 the dominant paradigm 主流典範 a programming paradigm 程式設計典範 model framework anomaly paradigmatic framework
w_paradise
a place or state of great happiness, or (in some religions) heaven 宗教義指來世的極樂之地；比喻義如 a tropical paradise，形容美好宜人的地方。
w_paradox
a statement or situation that seems contradictory but may reveal an underlying truth 常見 the paradox of，指表面矛盾卻蘊含道理的現象，語氣正式，常用於哲學或邏輯討論。
w_parallel

extending in the same direction and always the same distance apart; similar and occurring at the same time 幾何義如 parallel lines（平行線）；比喻義如 a parallel development（相似的發展），強調兩者同時存在且相仿。 相似之處；類比 a similarity or comparison between two things 常見 draw a parallel between，指在兩件事物間找出相似或對應之處，語氣正式。
w_parameter
a factor or limit that defines the boundaries of a system or task 常見複數 parameters，用於科學、數學或計畫情境，指界定範圍或條件的因素。
w_paramount
more important than anything else; supreme 常見 of paramount importance，語氣正式強烈，強調某事的重要性凌駕於一切之上。
w_paranoid
unreasonably or obsessively suspicious or fearful, often believing others intend harm 常見 feel paranoid about，語氣可口語形容過度擔心，也可指臨床上的偏執型症狀。
w_paraphrase
to express the meaning of something using different words 常見於學術寫作，指用自己的話重述他人觀點以避免抄襲，語氣中性正式。
w_parasite
an organism that lives on or in another organism and benefits at its host's expense 生物學義指依附宿主生存的生物；比喻義帶負面意味，形容不勞而獲、依賴他人的人。
w_parcel
an item or items wrapped in paper or packaging for mailing or carrying 常見 send a parcel、a parcel of land（一塊地），日常用語，也可用於土地面積的正式表達。
w_pare
to trim off the outer layer of something, or to gradually reduce something 字面義如 pare an apple（削蘋果皮）；比喻義如 pare down costs（削減成本），強調逐步減少。
w_parental
relating to a parent or parents 常見 parental leave（育嬰假）、parental guidance（家長指導），修飾與父母角色相關的事物。
w_parity
the state of being equal, especially in status, pay, or value 常見 pay parity（薪資平等）、achieve parity with，語氣正式，常用於討論待遇或地位的公平性。
w_parliamentary
relating to a parliament or its members and procedures 常見 parliamentary debate、parliamentary system，修飾與議會制度、程序相關的事物。
w_parochial
having a narrow or limited outlook, especially concerned only with local matters 帶負面意味，形容只關心自身周遭事物、缺乏更寬廣視野的態度。
w_parody
an imitation of a style or work, exaggerated for comic or satirical effect 常見 a parody of，指刻意誇張模仿某作品或人物以達到幽默或諷刺效果。
w_partial
existing only in part; incomplete, or (of a judgment) biased in favor of one side 常見 partial success（部分成功）；也可指裁判不公正，如 a partial judge，依語境判斷。
w_partially
to a limited extent; not completely 常修飾動詞或形容詞，如 partially completed，強調程度未達完全狀態。
w_particle
a minute piece of matter, or a very small amount of something 科學義如 a subatomic particle（次原子粒子）；日常義如 not a particle of evidence（一絲一毫的證據都沒有）。
w_partisan
strongly favoring one side, party, or cause in a way that may prevent fair judgment 常見 partisan politics、a partisan issue，帶負面意味，強調過度支持單一立場而失去客觀性。
w_partition
a division of something into parts, or a structure that divides a space into sections 常見 a partition wall（隔間牆）；政治義如 the partition of a country（國家的分裂），依語境判斷。
w_passion
a very strong feeling of enthusiasm or desire for someone or something 常見 a passion for music/cooking，指對某事物投入極大熱忱，也可指強烈的情慾。
w_passionate
having or showing very strong feelings or enthusiasm 常接 about，如 passionate about，強調對某事物投入強烈的情感或興趣。
w_passive
accepting what happens without resisting or actively responding 常見 a passive attitude，語氣中性或帶輕微負面，強調不主動採取行動，與 active 相對。
w_pastor
a christian minister in charge of a church or congregation 宗教用語，特指基督教教會中負責帶領會眾的神職人員。
w_pastry
a dough made with flour, fat, and water, used as a base for baked goods, or a sweet baked food made from it 常見 puff pastry（酥皮）；也可泛指以此麵團製成的甜點，如 french pastry（法式糕點）。
w_pasture
land covered with grass suitable for grazing animals 農業用語，常見 put animals out to pasture，指供牛羊等牲畜吃草放牧的土地。
w_patch
a small piece of material used to mend or cover a hole, or a small distinct area of something 物理義如 a patch on a shirt（衣服上的補丁）；比喻義如 go through a rough patch（經歷一段艱難時期）。
w_patent

an official document granting the exclusive right to make, use, or sell an invention 常見 file a patent、hold a patent，指政府授予發明者的法定獨占權利。 取得專利；申請專利 to obtain a legal right that gives exclusive control over an invention 常接受詞，如 patent an invention，強調透過法律程序保護發明的獨占使用權。
w_pathological
relating to a mental or physical disease, or (informally) compulsive and irrational 醫學義如 a pathological condition；口語義如 a pathological liar（病態說謊者），形容習慣性、難以控制的行為。
w_pathology
the study of the causes and effects of diseases, or the typical behavior of a disease 醫學用語，常見 a pathology report（病理報告），指針對疾病成因與表現的科學研究。
w_patience
the capacity to accept delay, difficulty, or suffering without becoming annoyed 常見 have patience with、lose one's patience，強調在面對等待或困難時保持冷靜的能力。
w_patriotism
love for and loyal devotion to one's country 常見 a sense of patriotism、national patriotism；多用於描述對國家的忠誠與熱愛之情。
w_patrol

a group of people or vehicles sent to watch over an area for security 常見 a police patrol、on patrol（正在巡邏）；指負責監視或警戒某區域的人員或行動。 巡邏；巡視 to walk or travel around an area to check that it is safe 及物或不及物動詞，常接 the streets、the area 等，強調定期來回查看以維持安全。
w_patron
a person who gives financial or other support to a person, cause, or organization 常見 a patron of the arts（藝術贊助人）；也可指餐廳、商店的常客（regular patron）。
w_patronage
the support, especially financial, given by a patron 常接 arts patronage、political patronage；也可指顧客對商店的惠顧（customer patronage）。
w_pavement
a hard-surfaced path for pedestrians beside a road 英式英語常指人行道（sidewalk 為美式用法）；也可泛指道路的鋪設表面。
w_pawn

a chess piece of the lowest value, or a person used by others for their own purposes 常見 a pawn in someone's game，比喻指被他人操控、缺乏自主權的人。 典當；抵押 to leave an item with a pawnbroker as security for money borrowed 常接具體物品，如 pawn a ring、pawn one's watch，指以物品換取短期借款。
w_payable
required to be paid, or able to be paid 常見 payable on demand、payable to（付款對象），多用於財務或合約情境。
w_peak
the point of highest value, achievement, or intensity, or the pointed top of a mountain 常見 at its peak（處於高峰期）、reach a peak（達到頂點），亦可指山的頂端。
w_peck

a quick bite or blow made by a bird's beak, or a quick, light kiss 常見 a peck on the cheek（在臉頰上輕吻一下），語氣隨意親暱。 啄食；啄 (of a bird) to strike or pick up with the beak 主詞通常是鳥類，常接 at，如 peck at the seeds（啄食種子）。
w_peculiar
strange or unusual, or distinctive to a particular person or thing 常見 peculiar to（為……所特有），也可單獨表示「怪異的」，需依上下文判斷語意。
w_peddle
to sell goods, especially by going from place to place, or to spread ideas or rumors 常接具體商品或抽象事物，如 peddle goods、peddle rumors，後者帶有負面貶意。
w_pedestrian

a person walking rather than traveling in a vehicle 常見 pedestrian crossing（行人穿越道）、pedestrian zone（行人徒步區），強調步行的人。 平淡乏味的；缺乏創意的 lacking excitement or imagination; commonplace 常修飾寫作、風格或想法，形容單調無趣、缺乏新意，與行人義項無關。
w_peel
the outer skin or rind of a fruit or vegetable 常見 banana peel、orange peel，指果皮或菜皮本身，而非削皮的動作。
w_peep
to look quickly and secretly, especially through a small gap 常接 at、through，如 peep through the curtains（透過窗簾偷看），語氣帶有隱密、好奇的意味。
w_peer

a person of the same age, status, or ability as another 常見 peer pressure（同儕壓力）、peer review（同儕審查），強調地位或年齡相近的群體。 瞇眼細看；仔細窺視 to look with difficulty or effort, especially at something not clearly visible 常接 at、into、through，如 peer into the darkness（凝視黑暗），強調費力或專注地觀看。
w_pelt
to throw a number of things at someone, or (of rain) to fall heavily 常見 pelt someone with something（用東西連續丟某人）、the rain pelted down（雨勢猛烈）。
w_penalize
to punish someone for breaking a rule or law, or to put someone at a disadvantage 常接 for，如 penalize someone for lateness（因遲到而處罰某人），也可指制度上造成的不公平。
w_penalty
a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or contract 常見 pay a penalty、face a penalty，也用於運動比賽中的罰球或罰分。
w_penance
an act of self-punishment or devotion to show sorrow for wrongdoing 常帶宗教色彩，常見 do penance for（為……做懺悔），強調透過自我懲罰表達悔意。
w_penetrate
to succeed in entering or passing through something, or to gain understanding or access to a market or organization 常接具體物體或抽象目標，如 penetrate the wall、penetrate a market，需依上下文判斷字面或比喻意。
w_penultimate
second to last in a series 常修飾 chapter、syllable 等序列中的項目，強調位置在最後一個之前。
w_perceive
to become aware of or notice something through the senses, or to interpret something in a particular way 常接 as，如 perceive something as（將某事視為……），強調主觀的理解或詮釋。
w_percentage
a rate, number, or amount expressed as a fraction of 100 常接 of，如 a high percentage of，用於描述整體中所占的比例。
w_perception
the way something is regarded, understood, or interpreted, or the ability to notice things through the senses 常見 public perception（公眾看法）、perception of reality（對現實的認知），強調主觀理解方式。
w_perch
a place, typically a branch or bar, where a bird rests, or a high or precarious position 常見 a bird's perch，比喻用法如 a precarious perch（岌岌可危的高位）。
w_percussion
musical instruments played by striking or shaking, such as drums 常見 a percussion instrument、percussion section（打擊樂部），指以敲擊方式發聲的樂器類別。
w_perennial
lasting for a long time or recurring repeatedly; (of a plant) living for several years 常見 a perennial problem（長期存在的問題）、perennial plant（多年生植物），依上下文判斷字面或比喻義。
w_performer
a person who performs for an audience, such as an actor or musician 常見 a live performer、a top performer（也可指表現優異者，見於商業情境），需依語境判斷。
w_perfume

a fragrant liquid typically made from essential oils, used to give a pleasant smell 常接 wear perfume、a bottle of perfume，指用於身體或衣物上的香氛液體。 使芳香；使散發香味 to give a pleasant smell to 常接 the air、a room 等，如 perfume the air（使空氣充滿香氣），文學語氣較重。
w_perfunctory
carried out with minimal effort or reflection, as a routine duty 常修飾 greeting、check、apology 等，形容缺乏誠意或用心的行為。
w_perilous
dangerous or risky 常修飾 journey、situation，語氣較 dangerous 更正式、文學化。
w_perimeter
the outer boundary of an area or figure 常見 the perimeter of a field（田地的周界）、secure the perimeter（守衛外圍），兼有數學與軍事用法。
w_peripheral
of secondary or minor importance, or relating to the outer edge of something 常見 peripheral vision（周邊視覺）、a peripheral issue（次要議題），依上下文判斷字面或比喻義。
w_perish
to die, especially in a sudden or violent way, or (of material) to decay 常見 perish in a fire/accident，也可指橡膠等材質因老化而損壞（the rubber has perished）。
w_permanence
the state of lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely 常接 a sense of permanence，強調事物長久不變的性質，抽象名詞，通常不可數。
w_permanent
lasting or intended to last indefinitely; not temporary 常見 a permanent job、permanent damage，與 temporary 相對，強調不會改變或結束。
w_permeate
to spread throughout something or pass through its substance 常接 through、into，或直接接受詞，如 permeate the room（瀰漫整個房間），可指氣味、思想的擴散。
w_permission
the act of officially allowing someone to do something 常見 ask for permission、give permission，強調正式或明確同意的行為，不可數名詞。
w_permissive
allowing a great deal of freedom in behavior, especially in sexual or social matters 常見 permissive parenting（放任式教養）、a permissive society（開放寬容的社會），常帶有評價性語氣。
w_pernicious
having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way 常修飾 influence、effect，強調傷害是逐漸累積、不易察覺的，語氣正式。
w_perpetual
never ending or changing; continuing indefinitely 常見 perpetual motion、a perpetual state of chaos，強調持續不斷、無止境的狀態。
w_persecute
to treat someone cruelly or unfairly, especially because of their race, religion, or beliefs 常接受詞為人或群體，如 persecute a minority group，強調因身分或信仰而受到的迫害。
w_persistent
continuing firmly despite difficulty or opposition, or continuing to exist over a long time 常見 a persistent cough（持續不斷的咳嗽）、persistent effort（不懈的努力），可修飾人的態度或事物的狀態。
w_personality
the combination of characteristics that form an individual's distinctive character, or a famous or notable person 常見 a strong personality（強烈的個性）、a tv personality（電視名人），需依上下文判斷語意。
w_perspective
a particular attitude toward or way of viewing something, or the technique of representing depth in art 常見 from a different perspective（從不同的角度）、in perspective（依比例、合乎邏輯地），也可指繪畫中的透視技巧。
w_perspicacious
having keen insight or good judgment; perceptive 正式書面用語，形容人具有敏銳的觀察力與判斷力，常見於學術或文學文本。
w_persuade
to cause someone to do or believe something through reasoning or argument 常見 persuade someone to do something、persuade someone of something，強調透過理由或論證使人改變想法或行動。
w_pertain
to be relevant or applicable to something 常接 to，如 pertain to the case（與此案件有關），正式用語，多見於法律或書面文件。
w_pertinent
relevant or applicable to a particular matter 常接 to，如 pertinent to the discussion（與討論相關），常用於正式或學術情境，形容切合主題的內容。
w_peruse
to read something thoroughly or carefully, or (informally) to read casually 正式用語，可指仔細研讀（peruse a document）或口語中隨意瀏覽（peruse a menu），依語境判斷。
w_perverse
deliberately behaving in a way that is unreasonable or contrary to what is expected 常見 perverse pleasure（從錯誤或不當的事中得到快感）、a perverse sense of humor，強調刻意違逆常理。
w_pessimism
a tendency to expect the worst possible outcome 與 optimism 相對，常見 a sense of pessimism、economic pessimism，指對未來抱持負面預期的態度。
w_pester
to annoy someone continually, especially with repeated requests 常接 someone、with，如 pester someone with questions（不斷用問題煩擾某人），語氣帶輕微不滿。
w_pesticide
a chemical substance used to kill insects or other pests 常見 pesticide residue（農藥殘留）、organic without pesticides，多用於農業與環境議題。
w_petition
to make a formal request to an authority, especially by signing a document 常接 for，如 petition for change（請願要求改變），也可接 someone to do something，強調正式提出訴求。
w_petty
of little importance, or (of a person) small-minded and concerned with trivial matters 常見 petty crime（輕微犯罪）、petty argument（無關緊要的爭吵），也可形容人斤斤計較、小家子氣。
w_phantom
seeming to exist but actually not real; illusory 常見 phantom pain（幻肢痛）、a phantom limb，形容看似存在卻實際不存在的事物。
w_pharmaceutical
relating to the manufacture and sale of medicinal drugs 常見 pharmaceutical company（製藥公司）、pharmaceutical industry，用於描述與藥品生產相關的領域。
w_phase
a distinct period or stage in a process of change or development 常見 in phases（分階段）、a new phase（新階段），強調過程中可劃分的時間段落。
w_phenomenal
remarkable or extraordinary, especially in terms of achievement 常修飾 success、growth，語氣強烈，強調程度上超乎尋常，接近口語誇飾用法。
w_phenomenon
a fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen, especially one that is not fully understood 常見 a natural phenomenon（自然現象）、a social phenomenon，指值得注意或尚待解釋的事物或事件。
w_philanthropic
relating to the generous donation of money or help to worthy causes 常見 philanthropic foundation（慈善基金會）、philanthropic work，強調出於善意的捐助或幫助行為。
w_philosopher
a person who studies or writes about fundamental questions of existence, knowledge, and ethics 常見於學術或歷史語境，指從事哲學思考與研究的人，如 greek philosophers（古希臘哲學家）。
w_philosophy
the study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values, or a particular set of beliefs 常見 study philosophy（研讀哲學）、a philosophy of life（人生哲學），可指學術領域或個人信念體系。
w_phlegmatic
having a calm, unemotional temperament 正式或文學用語，形容性情平和、不易激動的人，常見於人物性格描寫。
w_phonetic
relating to speech sounds or their representation in written symbols 常見 phonetic symbol（音標）、phonetic spelling，用於語言學或發音教學情境。
w_phony
not genuine or real; fake 口語用法，常修飾 excuse、smile 等，帶有負面評價，強調表裡不一、不真誠。
w_photosynthesis
the process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize food from carbon dioxide and water 生物學專有名詞，常見於科學課文，描述植物利用陽光、水和二氧化碳製造養分的過程。
w_phrase

a small group of words that together convey meaning, without forming a complete sentence 常見 a common phrase（常用片語）、idiomatic phrase，指語法上不構成完整句子的一組詞。 措辭；用言語表達 to express something in a particular way using words 常接 副詞修飾，如 phrase it carefully（謹慎地措辭），強調選擇特定方式表達想法。
w_physician
a medical doctor, especially one specializing in internal medicine as opposed to surgery 正式用語，常見於美式英語，指持有醫學執照的醫生，尤指非外科醫師。
w_physicist
a scientist who specializes in the study of physics 指專門研究物理學的科學家，常見於學術或科學新聞情境。
w_physiological
relating to the normal functions of living organisms 常見 physiological response（生理反應）、physiological need，用於描述身體機能運作相關的事物。
w_pictorial
relating to or expressed in pictures 常見 pictorial representation（圖像式表現）、a pictorial history，強調以圖片而非文字傳達資訊。
w_pier
a structure built out into the sea or a lake, used as a landing place or promenade 常見 fish off the pier（在碼頭釣魚）、walk along the pier，指延伸入水中供人行走或停靠船隻的建築。
w_pigeon
a stout bird with a small head, common in cities 常見於城市場景，如 feed the pigeons（餵鴿子），指常見的城市鳥類。
w_pigment
a substance that gives color to living tissue, paint, or other materials 常見 skin pigment（皮膚色素）、natural pigment，指使物體或生物組織呈現顏色的物質。
w_pile
a heap of things laid one on top of another 常見 a pile of books、a pile of laundry，指物品堆疊在一起的形狀或數量。
w_pill
a small round tablet of medicine to be swallowed whole 常見 take a pill、a sleeping pill（安眠藥），指口服的固體藥物形式。
w_pillar
a tall vertical structure used as a support for a building, or an important supporting member or part 常見 a pillar of society（社會中堅）、marble pillars，可指建築構件或比喻重要的支持力量。
w_pillow
a cushion used to support the head while sleeping 常見 a soft pillow、fluff a pillow（拍鬆枕頭），指睡覺時支撐頭部用的物品。
w_pine
an evergreen coniferous tree with needle-shaped leaves 常見 pine forest（松樹林）、pine needles（松針），指常綠針葉樹種。
w_pinpoint
to identify or locate something with great precision 常接具體目標，如 pinpoint the cause（準確找出原因）、pinpoint the location，強調精準無誤。
w_pistol
a small handgun designed to be held and fired with one hand 常見於描述武器或犯罪情境，如 fire a pistol，指單手操作的短槍。
w_pitch
the quality of a sound governed by the rate of vibrations, or a sports field, or a persuasive sales talk 常見 perfect pitch（絕對音感）、a football pitch（足球場）、a sales pitch（推銷話術），依上下文判斷語意。
w_pitcher
a large container with a handle and spout for holding and pouring liquids, or (in baseball) the player who throws the ball 常見 a pitcher of water（一壺水），美式英語中也指棒球比賽中負責投球的球員。
w_pitiful
deserving or arousing pity, especially through weakness or inadequacy 常修飾 sight、excuse、performance，可指值得同情的處境，也可帶貶意指表現差勁。
w_pivot

a central point on which something turns or depends 常見 a pivot point（轉折點）、the pivot of the discussion（討論的核心），強調關鍵且具支撐作用的部分。 轉動；（策略）轉向 to turn or rotate on a central point, or to change strategy or approach 常接 on、around，如 pivot on a central idea，也可指企業或個人改變原有方向的比喻用法。
w_placate
to make someone less angry or hostile 常接受詞為人，如 placate an angry customer，強調透過言語或行動使對方情緒平復。
w_placement
the action of placing someone or something, or a job or position, especially temporary 常見 a work placement（實習職位）、product placement（置入性行銷），依上下文判斷具體意涵。
w_placid
calm and peaceful, without much disturbance or excitement 常修飾 lake、person，形容表面平靜、不易受擾動的事物或個性，語氣正面。
w_plague
a contagious disease that spreads widely and causes many deaths, or something regarded as a widespread affliction 常見 the black plague（黑死病）、a plague of locusts，也可比喻大量令人困擾的事物。
w_plaintiff
a person who brings a case against another in a court of law 法律用語，與 defendant（被告）相對，指提出訴訟的一方。
w_planner
a person who plans something, especially as a profession, or a notebook for scheduling 常見 an urban planner（都市規劃師）、a daily planner（每日行事曆本），依上下文判斷指人或物品。
w_plantation
a large estate, especially in a tropical region, where crops are grown for sale 常見 a rubber plantation、a coffee plantation，指大規模種植經濟作物的農場。
w_plasma
the colorless liquid part of blood, or an ionized gas considered a state of matter 常見 blood plasma（血漿）、plasma screen（電漿螢幕），依上下文判斷生物或物理意涵。
w_plaster
a paste used for coating walls and ceilings, or (british english) an adhesive bandage 常見 a plaster wall（灰泥牆）、put a plaster on a cut，英式英語中也指傷口貼的繃帶。
w_platform
a raised level surface, or a system used as a basis for launching something, such as software or a political program 常見 a train platform（火車月台）、a software platform、a political platform，需依語境判斷具體所指。
w_platitude
a remark that has been used too often to be interesting or thoughtful 常帶貶意，指缺乏新意、流於形式的說法，如 offer empty platitudes（說些空洞的場面話）。
w_plausible

seeming reasonable or likely to be true, although not proven plausible 的重點是「聽起來合理」，而不是「已經證實為真」。這個保留讓它在除錯與研究討論中特別好用：a plausible explanation 表示「這是一個值得檢驗的假說」。它偶爾也帶有懷疑意味，暗示「表面說得通，實際上不一定」。 a plausible + noun it seems plausible that + clause a plausible explanation 說得通的解釋 highly plausible 極為可信的 a plausible hypothesis 合理的假說 sound plausible 聽起來合理 credible believable implausible far-fetched plausibility plausibly feasible
w_plea
an emotional request, or a formal statement of guilt or innocence in court 常見 a plea for help（求助的懇求）、enter a plea of guilty（提出認罪答辯），依語境判斷法律或一般用法。
w_plead
to make an emotional appeal, or to state formally in court whether one is guilty 常接 with someone、for something，如 plead for mercy（懇求寬恕），法律上也用 plead guilty（認罪）。
w_pleat
a fold in fabric made by doubling it back on itself 常見於服裝描述，如 a pleated skirt（百褶裙），指布料摺疊而成的紋路。
w_pledge
a solemn promise or undertaking 常見 make a pledge、a pledge of allegiance，強調正式且鄭重的承諾。 承諾；發誓 to solemnly promise to do or give something 常接 to do something 或具體金額，如 pledge to donate $1,000，強調正式且具約束力的承諾。
w_plethora
a large or excessive amount of something 正式用語，常接 of，如 a plethora of options（過多的選擇），強調數量龐大甚至超出需要。

to walk slowly and heavily, or to work slowly and steadily 常接 along、through，如 plod through the mud（艱難地在泥濘中前行），也可比喻費力持續地做某事。
w_plot
the main sequence of events in a story, or a secret plan, or a small piece of land 常見 the plot of a novel（小說情節）、a plot to overthrow the government（推翻政府的陰謀）、a plot of land（一塊地），依語境判斷。
w_plug

a device inserted into a socket to make an electrical connection, or a stopper for a hole 常見 pull the plug（拔插頭；比喻終止某事）、a bath plug（浴缸塞子），依上下文判斷具體所指。 堵住；塞住；（口語）宣傳、推銷 to block a hole with a plug, or to promote something 常接 a hole、a leak，也可口語用法如 plug a new movie（宣傳一部新電影）。
w_plume
a long, soft feather, or a column of smoke or vapor rising into the air 常見 a plume of smoke（一縷煙），也可指鳥類的長羽毛，需依語境判斷。

to choose or vote in favor of one option out of several, or to make something plump by shaking or patting 常接 for，如 plump for the cheaper option（選擇較便宜的選項），也可指 plump up a pillow（拍鬆枕頭）。 重重地；突然地；直接地 straight down, especially heavily or abruptly 常見於 plump down，如 sit down plump（重重地坐下），強調動作突然且沉重。

to jump or fall suddenly and dramatically, or (of prices, temperatures) to decrease sharply 常接 into，如 plunge into the water，也可指抽象事物急遽下降，如 stock prices plunged。
w_poach
to cook food gently in simmering liquid, or to hunt or fish illegally, or to lure away an employee 常見 poach an egg（水煮蛋）、poach animals（非法狩獵）、poach an employee（挖角員工），需依語境判斷。
w_poet
a person who writes poems 指從事詩歌創作的人，常見於文學相關語境，如 a famous poet（知名詩人）。
w_poignant
evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret 常修飾 moment、memory，形容深刻觸動情感、帶有淡淡哀傷的事物，語氣文學化。
w_poise
graceful and calm behavior, especially under pressure 常見 with poise（沉著自若地）、maintain poise，強調在壓力下仍能保持鎮定優雅的舉止。
w_poison

a substance that causes death or harm if it enters the body 常見 a slow-acting poison（慢性毒藥），泛指任何對身體有害甚至致命的物質。 下毒；毒害；（比喻）破壞 to give poison to someone in order to kill or harm them, or to corrupt something 常接受詞為人或抽象事物，如 poison the atmosphere（破壞氣氛），依語境判斷字面或比喻義。
w_poisonous
containing or producing poison; capable of causing harm or death 常修飾 snake、substance，形容具有毒性、可能致命或有害的事物。
w_poke
to jab or prod someone or something with a finger or pointed object 常接 at，如 poke at the fire（撥弄火堆），也可指用手指輕戳他人，語氣輕鬆隨意。
w_polarize
to cause people or opinions to divide into two sharply contrasting groups 常見 political issue that polarizes public opinion（使輿論兩極化的政治議題），強調造成極端對立。
w_poll
a survey of people's opinions, or the process of voting in an election 常見 conduct a poll（進行民調）、go to the polls（去投票），依上下文判斷指調查或選舉活動。
w_pollination
the transfer of pollen from one flower to another, enabling fertilization 生物學用語，常見 bee pollination（蜜蜂授粉），描述植物繁殖過程中花粉傳遞的機制。
w_pollution
the presence or introduction of harmful substances into the environment 常見 air pollution、water pollution，指環境中有害物質的存在或排放，是環境議題的常用詞。
w_pompous
self-important and arrogant, especially in speech or manner 常修飾 tone、manner、person，形容言行過於自以為是、擺架子，帶貶意。
w_ponder
to think about something carefully and thoroughly 常接 on、over 或直接接受詞，如 ponder a question，強調深思熟慮的過程，語氣正式。
w_pony
a small breed of horse 常見於兒童或農場情境，如 ride a pony（騎小馬），指體型較小的馬匹品種。
w_popularity
the state of being liked, admired, or supported by many people 常見 gain popularity（獲得人氣）、lose popularity（失去人氣），常用於描述人物、產品或趨勢的受歡迎程度。
w_populous
having a large population; densely inhabited 常修飾 city、region，如 the most populous country（人口最多的國家），強調人口數量龐大。
w_porous
having small holes that allow liquid or air to pass through, or (figuratively) easily penetrated 常見 porous rock（多孔的岩石），也可比喻邊界或制度不夠嚴密，如 porous borders。
w_portable
able to be easily carried or moved 常修飾 device、computer，形容體積輕巧、方便隨身攜帶的物品。
w_portfolio
a collection of documents, artwork, or investments held by a person or institution 常見 an investment portfolio（投資組合）、a design portfolio（設計作品集），依上下文判斷具體所指。
w_portion
a part or share of a whole, especially of food 常見 a portion of food（一份食物）、a large portion of the population，指整體中的一部分或特定量。
w_portrait
a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person, especially of the face 常見 paint a portrait、a family portrait，指描繪人物（尤其是臉部）的藝術作品或照片。
w_portray
to depict someone or something in a work of art, or (of an actor) to play a role 常接受詞為人物或角色，如 portray a character（飾演一個角色），也可指文學或藝術中的描寫。
w_pose

a particular position of the body, especially one adopted for a photograph or painting 常見 strike a pose（擺姿勢），指刻意為拍照或繪畫所擺出的身體姿勢。 構成（問題、威脅）；擺姿勢；假冒 to present a problem or risk, or to assume a particular position, or to pretend to be someone 常接 a threat、a question，如 pose a risk（構成風險），也可指擺拍姿勢或假冒身分。
w_posit
to put forward an idea or theory as a basis for argument 正式或學術用語，常接 that 子句，如 posit that，指提出一個作為論證基礎的假設或主張。
w_possess
to have or own something, or (of a feeling) to control someone's actions 常見 possess a quality（擁有某種特質），也可指強烈情緒控制某人的行為，如 what possessed you to do that?
w_possession
the state of owning or having something, or (plural) belongings 常見 in possession of（持有……）、personal possessions（個人財物），依上下文判斷抽象或具體意涵。
w_poster
a large printed picture or notice used for decoration or advertising 常見 put up a poster（張貼海報）、a movie poster，指用於裝飾或宣傳的大幅印刷品。
w_posterior
situated at or toward the rear, or coming after in time 正式或學術用語，常見於解剖學（posterior side，後側）或時間序列（posterior to，晚於）。
w_postpone
to arrange for an event to take place at a later time 常接具體事件，如 postpone the meeting，強調將原定時間往後移，語氣中性。
w_posture
the position in which someone holds their body, or an approach or attitude toward something 常見 good posture（良好姿勢）、a defensive posture（防禦性態度），依語境判斷字面或比喻義。
w_postwar
relating to the period after a war, especially world war ii 常見 postwar era（戰後時期）、postwar reconstruction，特指戰爭結束後的一段時期或相關事物。
w_potent
having great power, influence, or effect 常修飾 drug、argument、symbol，形容影響力或效力強大的事物。
w_pottery
objects made from clay hardened by heat, or the craft of making such objects 常見 a piece of pottery（一件陶器）、make pottery，指陶製品本身或製作陶器的工藝，通常不可數。
w_poverty
the state of being extremely poor 常見 live in poverty（生活在貧困中）、poverty rate（貧困率），指缺乏足夠資源維持基本生活水準的狀態。
w_powder
a dry substance made of fine particles 常見 baking powder（發粉）、face powder（粉餅），泛指任何細小顆粒狀的乾燥物質。
w_practically
almost or nearly, or in a way relating to practice rather than theory 常見 practically impossible（幾乎不可能），也可指以實務、可行的方式，如 think practically。
w_practitioner
a person actively engaged in a profession, especially medicine or law 常見 a medical practitioner（醫療從業人員）、a legal practitioner，指實際從事某專業工作的人。
w_pragmatic

dealing with things in a practical way, based on what actually works rather than on theory or principle pragmatic 是正面的評價，指「以能不能行得通為判準」，而不是死守原則或理論。工程文化中常說 be pragmatic about x，意思是接受一個不完美但夠用的做法。要注意它不等於「隨便」——務實仍需理由，只是理由來自實務效果。 a pragmatic + noun be pragmatic about + noun take a pragmatic approach a pragmatic approach 務實的做法 pragmatic about 對……採取務實態度 a pragmatic compromise 務實的折衷 practical realistic dogmatic idealistic pragmatism pragmatically practical
w_prank
to play a mischievous trick on someone 常接受詞為人，如 prank a friend，語氣輕鬆詼諧，通常無惡意，僅為玩笑性質。
w_preach
to deliver a religious or moral sermon, or to advocate a course of action, often insistently 常見 preach a sermon（講道）、preach about honesty，也可帶貶意指過度說教、喋喋不休地勸誡。
w_precarious

not securely held or supported, and therefore likely to fail at any moment precarious 的意象是「搖搖欲墜」：現在還撐著，但隨時可能崩塌。它比 fragile 多了「持續處於危險狀態」的時間感。用於形容處境、平衡與依賴關係時特別傳神：a precarious dependency on one vendor。 a precarious + noun in a precarious position a precarious position 岌岌可危的處境 a precarious balance 脆弱的平衡 increasingly precarious 越來越危險的 unstable fragile robust secure precariously precocious
w_precaution
an action taken in advance to prevent something harmful from happening 常見 take precautions（採取預防措施）、safety precautions，強調事先採取行動以避免風險。
w_precede
to come before something in time, order, or importance 常接具體事件或名詞，如 precede the meeting（在會議之前），強調時間或順序上的先後關係。
w_precedent

an earlier decision or event that is used as an example or justification for later ones precedent 的重點是「這件事之後會被拿來當作依據」。因此職場中說 i don't want to set a precedent，意思是擔心這次的例外以後會變成常規。片語 set a precedent（開先例）與 without precedent（史無前例）都是高頻用法。 set a precedent there is no precedent for + noun without precedent set a precedent 開先例 follow precedent 依循前例 no precedent for 沒有……的前例 a dangerous precedent 危險的先例 prior example unprecedented unprecedented precede president
w_precious
of great value, either financially or emotionally; not to be wasted 常見 precious metal（貴金屬）、precious time（寶貴的時間），可指物質上或情感上的珍貴。
w_precipitate
to cause an event or situation to happen suddenly or prematurely 正式用語，常接具體事件為受詞，如 precipitate a crisis（引發危機），強調驟然造成某事發生。
w_precipitation
rain, snow, sleet, or hail that falls to the ground 氣象學用語，常見於天氣預報，如 heavy precipitation（強降雨），泛指從空中落下的水分。
w_precipitous
dangerously steep, or (of a change) happening suddenly and rapidly 常修飾 cliff、decline，可指地形極為陡峭，也可比喻急遽的下降或變化。
w_precise
exact and accurate 常見 precise instructions（精確的指示）、precise measurement，強調毫無誤差的準確性。
w_precision
the quality of being exact and accurate 常見 with great precision（極其精準地），指動作、測量或描述達到高度準確的程度。
w_preclude

to make something impossible in advance, so that it can never happen preclude 的主詞通常是「某個條件或決定」，而不是人：這個條件一旦成立，某件事就再也不可能發生。最實用的句型是 a does not preclude b，用來澄清「選了 a 不代表不能做 b」，這在技術討論中極為常見。 preclude + noun preclude + somebody + from + doing a does not preclude b does not preclude 並不排除 preclude the possibility of 排除……的可能性 effectively preclude 實質上排除 prevent rule out permit enable preclusion prohibit
w_precocious
(of a child) having developed abilities or characteristics at an earlier age than usual 常修飾 child、talent，形容孩童在心智或能力上比同齡人發展得更早、更成熟。
w_predator
an animal that hunts other animals for food 生物學用語，與 prey（獵物）相對，指以捕食其他動物維生的動物。
w_predecessor
a person who held a job or position before the current holder 常見 his predecessor（他的前任），指在職位或職務上先於當前人選的人。
w_predicament
a difficult or unpleasant situation 常見 be in a predicament（陷入困境），強調處境棘手、難以解決，語氣較 problem 更強烈。
w_predict
to say that something will happen in the future, based on evidence or reasoning 常接 that 子句或具體事件，如 predict the outcome（預測結果），強調依據證據或推理做出的判斷。
w_predictable
able to be predicted, or behaving in a way that is expected and lacks surprise 常修飾 outcome、behavior，可為中性的「可預測」，也可帶貶意指缺乏新意、了無新意。
w_prediction
a statement about what will happen in the future 常接 make a prediction（做出預測），指基於證據或直覺對未來事件的陳述。
w_predilection
a strong preference for something 正式用語，常接 for，如 a predilection for sweets（偏愛甜食），語氣較 preference 更文雅。
w_predisposition
a tendency to behave or react in a particular way, often due to genetic or environmental factors 常見於醫學或心理學語境，如 a genetic predisposition to disease（罹病的遺傳傾向）。

mostly or mainly 常修飾整句或形容詞，如 predominantly rural（主要為鄉村地區），強調占絕大多數的情況。

to take action in order to prevent something from happening, or to take precedence over something 常接具體行動為受詞，如 preempt criticism（搶先化解批評），強調先發制人以防止不利情況發生。
w_preface
an introductory statement at the beginning of a book, or an event that precedes another 常見 write a preface（撰寫序言），指書籍開頭的引言部分，也可比喻某事件先於另一事件發生。
w_preference

a greater liking for one thing or person than for another preference 最關鍵的是介系詞：表示「偏好某物」時用 preference for，表示「勝過某物」時用 over 或 to。這是 b2 學習者最常出錯的地方。名詞形式常見於使用者介面（user preferences，指設定）與問卷調查中。 a preference for + noun a preference for a over b in preference to + noun have a preference for 偏好…… express a preference 表達偏好 a strong preference 強烈的偏好 a personal preference 個人偏好 in order of preference 依偏好排序 inclination liking prefer preferable preferably priority
w_pregnant
(of a woman) carrying a developing fetus, or (of a situation) full of meaning or significance 常見 pregnant woman（孕婦），比喻用法如 a pregnant pause（意味深長的停頓），需依語境判斷。
w_prejudice
to cause someone to have a biased opinion, or to damage or harm someone's rights or interests 常接具體受詞，如 prejudice the case（損害案件公正性），也可指使人形成不公正的看法。

happening before a more important action or event, often to prepare for it; not yet final preliminary 有兩個重點：一是「在正式的事情之前」，二是「結果尚未確定」。因此 preliminary results 意思是「初步結果，之後可能改變」，這在學術與事故報告中是很重要的免責語氣。使用它可以讓陳述保留修正空間。 preliminary + noun a preliminary + noun + suggests that + clause preliminary results 初步結果 a preliminary analysis 初步分析 a preliminary investigation 初步調查 preliminary findings 初步發現 initial provisional final subsequent preliminarily provisional
