w_premium
an amount paid regularly to an insurance company, or an amount above the normal price for extra value 常見 insurance premium（保費）、pay a premium for（為……多付溢價），依上下文判斷具體所指。
w_preposterous
completely contrary to reason or common sense; absurd 常修飾 idea、claim，語氣強烈，形容荒唐到令人難以置信的程度。
w_prescribe
(of a doctor) to recommend and authorize a medicine or treatment, or to state officially that something should be done 常接 medication、treatment 為受詞，也可指法律或規範上明文規定的事項，如 prescribed procedures。
w_prescription
a written instruction from a doctor for the preparation and use of a medicine 常見 write a prescription（開處方）、fill a prescription（領藥），指醫生開立的正式醫療文件。
w_presentation
a talk or lecture given to an audience, or the way something is presented or displayed 常見 give a presentation（做簡報）、a formal presentation，也可指物品的展示或陳列方式。
w_preservation
the act of keeping something in its original or existing state, especially to prevent decay 常見 wildlife preservation（野生動物保育）、food preservation，強調防止腐壞或消失的維護行動。
w_preserve
to maintain something in its original state, or to prepare food to prevent it from decaying 常接具體事物，如 preserve traditions（保存傳統）、preserve fruit（醃漬水果保存），依語境判斷。
w_presidency
the office or term of office of a president 常見 during his presidency（在他的總統任期內），指擔任總統這一職務或其任職期間。
w_prestige
widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something based on their reputation or achievements 常見 gain prestige（贏得聲望）、a job with prestige，指因成就或地位而獲得的尊崇與敬重。
w_prestigious
inspiring respect and admiration; having high status 常修飾 award、university，形容因地位崇高或成就卓越而受人推崇的事物。
w_presumably
used to indicate that something is likely to be true, though not confirmed 常置於句首或修飾整句，表達說話者根據常理或線索所做的合理推測。
w_presume
to suppose that something is the case based on probability, without proof 常接 that 子句，如 presume that，也可用於禮貌用語 i presume（我猜想），強調在缺乏確切證據下的合理推斷。
w_presumption
an idea that is assumed to be true based on likelihood, without proof 常見 the presumption of innocence（無罪推定），指基於合理性而未經證實所做的假設。
w_presupposition
something that is assumed to be true as a basis for an argument, without being explicitly stated 正式或學術用語，指論證中未明言但已被視為理所當然的基礎假設。
w_pretend
to act as if something is true when it is not, in order to deceive or for play 常接 to do something 或 that 子句，如 pretend to be asleep（假裝睡著），也用於兒童遊戲中的想像扮演。
w_pretentious
attempting to impress by affecting greater importance, talent, or knowledge than is actually possessed 常修飾 person、writing、style，帶明顯貶意，形容故作高深或裝腔作勢的態度。
w_prevail
to prove more powerful than opposing forces, or to be widespread or predominant 常接 over，如 prevail over adversity（戰勝逆境），也可指某種情況或看法普遍存在。
w_prevalent

existing very commonly or happening frequently in a particular place or group prevalent 是描述「在某個群體或地區中很常見」的正式用語，常見於研究報告與流行病學。它通常搭配 among（在某群體中）或 in（在某地區）。要注意它多半用來描述問題或現象，較少用於正面事物。 prevalent among + group prevalent in + place become increasingly prevalent increasingly prevalent 日益普遍 prevalent among 在……族群中普遍 widely prevalent 廣泛存在的 ubiquitous widespread rare uncommon prevalence prevail pervasive
w_prevention
the act of stopping something from happening or arising 常見 crime prevention（犯罪預防）、disease prevention，強調事先阻止不良事件發生的行動。
w_prey

an animal that is hunted and killed by another for food 常見 fall prey to（淪為……的獵物；比喻遭受某事所害），生物學上指被掠食者捕食的動物。 捕食；（比喻）欺騙、剝削（弱勢者） to hunt and kill for food, or to take advantage of someone weaker or vulnerable 常接 on/upon，如 prey on the elderly（欺騙老年人），可指生物捕食行為或比喻剝削弱勢群體。
w_prick
a small puncture wound made by a sharp point 常見 a prick of a needle（針扎），指尖銳物造成的細小傷口或刺痛感。 刺；戳 to make a small hole in something with a sharp point 常接具體物體，如 prick a balloon（刺破氣球），強調用尖物造成細小穿孔。
w_primitive
relating to an early stage of development; simple or basic 常修飾 society、tool、conditions，形容發展階段早期、技術簡單或設備簡陋的事物。
w_principal
the head of a school, or the original sum of money invested or lent 常見 the school principal（校長）、pay off the principal（償還本金），依上下文判斷具體所指。
w_prior
a previous criminal conviction, or the head of a religious house ranking below an abbot 常見於法律用語 have a prior（有前科紀錄），較特殊用法，需留意與形容詞 prior（先前的）區分。
w_priority

something that is treated as more important than other things and dealt with first priority 的關鍵在於「相對」：說某件事是 priority，就等於說別的事要往後排。因此如果所有事都是 top priority，這個詞就失去意義了——這也是英文管理語彙中常被點出的矛盾。動詞是 prioritize，介系詞用 over 表示凌駕。 take priority over + noun give priority to + noun a top priority take priority over 優先於…… a top priority 最優先事項 set priorities 訂定優先順序 competing priorities 互相衝突的優先事項 precedence prioritize prior urgency
w_pristine
in its original condition; unspoiled and clean 常修飾 condition、beach、forest，形容未經污染或破壞、保持完好如初的狀態。
w_privilege
a special right, advantage, or immunity granted to a particular person or group 常見 abuse a privilege（濫用特權）、a privilege to do something，指僅特定人或群體享有的權利或好處。
w_probe
a thorough investigation, or a small instrument used to explore or examine something 常見 a criminal probe（刑事調查）、a space probe（太空探測器），依上下文判斷具體所指。
w_proceed
to continue with a course of action, or to move forward or onward 常接 with，如 proceed with the plan（繼續執行計畫），也可指身體上的前進移動。
w_procession
a group of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly formation, especially as part of a ceremony 常見 a funeral procession（送葬隊伍）、a wedding procession，指有秩序地列隊前進的群體，常帶儀式性質。
w_proclaim
to announce something officially or publicly 常接 that 子句或具體事項，如 proclaim independence（宣布獨立），語氣正式、具官方色彩。
w_proclamation
an official public announcement dealing with a matter of great importance 常見 issue a proclamation（發布公告），指涉及重大事務的正式官方聲明。
w_procure
to obtain something, especially with care or effort 正式用語，常見於商業或法律情境，如 procure supplies（採購物資），強調透過努力或程序取得。
w_procurement
the action of obtaining or acquiring something, especially through a formal process 常見 a procurement process（採購流程）、public procurement，多用於企業或政府的物資採購情境。
w_prod
to poke someone or something with a finger or pointed object, or to urge someone into action 常接具體受詞，如 prod someone into action（催促某人採取行動），字面或比喻義皆常見。
w_prodigal
spending money or resources freely and recklessly; wastefully extravagant 常見 the prodigal son（浪子），源自聖經典故，形容揮金如土、不知節制的行為。
w_prodigious
remarkably great in extent, size, or degree 常修飾 talent、amount，形容程度或規模超乎尋常地大，語氣正面且強烈。
w_productive
producing a large amount of goods, results, or work efficiently 常見 a productive meeting（有成效的會議）、productive land（肥沃的土地），強調產出效率高或成果豐碩。
w_productivity
the rate at which goods or services are produced, especially in relation to the resources used 常見搭配 increase/boost productivity、labor productivity；多用於經濟、職場情境，強調產出與投入的比例。
w_profession
an occupation requiring specialized education and training, especially one regarded as respectable 指需要專門訓練或證照的職業，如醫生、律師；常見 by profession（就職業而言）。
w_proffer
to offer something for someone to accept 正式用語，較 offer 更書面；常接建議、意見或協助等抽象事物。
w_proficiency

a good standard of ability and skill, usually gained through training and practice proficiency 指「經過訓練後達到的良好能力水準」，常用於語言能力與專業技能的正式評估。它比 skill 更強調「可被衡量的水準」，因此常與 level 搭配：a high level of proficiency。介系詞用 in。 proficiency in + noun a level of proficiency proficiency in 在……方面的熟練度 language proficiency 語言能力 a high level of proficiency 高度的熟練程度 demonstrate proficiency 展現熟練能力 competence mastery proficient proficiently fluency
w_proficient
competent or skilled in doing something 常搭配 in/at，如 proficient in french；強調經訓練後達到的熟練程度。
w_profile
a brief written description of someone's or something's notable characteristics 常見 a profile of + 人/機構，或 social media profile（社群帳號檔案）。
w_profligate
recklessly wasteful, especially with money 常修飾 spending、lifestyle；語氣帶批評，指毫無節制地花費金錢。
w_profound
very great or intense; having deep insight or meaning 可修飾情感、影響或思想，如 profound effect、profound insight，語氣正式。
w_prognosis
a doctor's judgment about the likely course of a disease 醫學用語，指對疾病未來發展的專業判斷；亦可比喻用於預測經濟情勢等。
w_progressive
favoring new ideas, reform, or gradual social change 常修飾 policy、party，指支持社會改革或現代化的立場，與 conservative 相對。
w_prohibit
to formally forbid something by law or rule 正式用語，常用被動 be prohibited from doing something，或 prohibit smoking 等。
w_projectile
an object that is thrown or launched through the air, especially as a weapon 多見於物理或軍事語境，指子彈、飛彈等被發射出去的物體。
w_projection
an estimate or forecast of a future situation based on current trends 常見 sales projection、population projection，指依現有數據推估未來的結果。
w_proliferate
to increase rapidly in number or spread quickly 常用於描述問題、資訊或物種快速增加，如 weapons proliferate、rumors proliferate。
w_prolong
to make something last longer 常接 life、meeting、agony 等，強調使某事持續更久的時間。
w_prominent
important or well-known; noticeable or conspicuous 可指人（知名人士）或物（明顯的特徵），如 prominent figure、prominent nose。
w_promoter
a person who organizes or provides financial backing for an event 常見於演唱會、拳賽等活動的組織者，強調負責籌辦與宣傳。
w_prompt

to cause someone to do something or to make something happen 常接 sb to do sth，表示某事件引發某人行動或某結果發生。 提示；提詞 a cue given to a performer, or a symbol on a computer screen indicating readiness to receive input 日常語境指演員的提詞，電腦科學語境指命令列的提示符號，如 command prompt。
w_promulgate
to make a law or decree widely known officially 正式用語，多用於法律或政策的正式公告，常見 promulgate a law/decree。
w_prone
likely to suffer from or do something undesirable 常見 prone to + n/ving，如 accident-prone、prone to error，表示某種傾向性。
w_proof
evidence or an argument establishing a fact or the truth of a statement 常見 proof of purchase、burden of proof；強調足以證實某事為真的具體證據。
w_prop
an object used to support or hold something up, or an item used in a play or film 日常語境指支撐物；戲劇、電影語境則指道具，如 stage props。
w_propaganda
information, especially biased or misleading, used to promote a political cause or viewpoint 帶負面意涵，指刻意扭曲事實以影響大眾觀點的訊息，常見於政治語境。
w_propagation
the spreading of something, such as an idea, belief, or plant species, to a wider area 可指生物繁殖（如植物）或抽象概念的擴散，如 propagation of ideas。
w_propel
to drive or push something forward 常接受詞為交通工具或抽象事物，如 propel a boat、propel someone to success。
w_propensity
a natural tendency to behave in a particular way 常見 propensity for/to，語氣較正式，多描述性格或行為上的固有傾向。
w_prophetic
accurately predicting future events 常見於描述某言論或著作後來被證實準確，如 prophetic warning。
w_propitious
favorable or likely to result in success 正式用語，常見 propitious time/moment，指有利於成功的時機或情況。
w_proponent
a person who advocates for a particular cause or theory 常見 a proponent of + 理論/政策，強調積極為某主張辯護或推廣的人。
w_proposition
a statement or suggestion put forward for consideration, especially in business 常見 business proposition，也可指邏輯上可判斷真偽的命題（較正式語境）。
w_proprietary
relating to an owner or ownership, especially of a trademarked product or technology 常修飾 software、technology，指受版權或商標保護、由特定公司擁有的產品。
w_proprietor
the owner of a business, especially a shop or hotel 多指小型商店、餐廳或旅館的業主，語氣較 owner 正式。
w_prosaic
lacking imagination or excitement; dull 常修飾 life、style，指缺乏想像力或詩意，與 poetic 相對。
w_prose
written or spoken language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure 與 poetry（詩）相對，指沒有韻律規則的一般文字寫作形式。
w_prosecute
to bring a criminal charge against someone in a court of law 法律用語，常用被動 be prosecuted for，強調正式提出刑事指控。
w_prosecution
the institution and carrying out of legal proceedings against a defendant 法律用語，也可指檢方一方（the prosecution），與 the defense 相對。
w_prospect
the possibility or likelihood of something happening in the future 常見 job prospects、future prospects，多用複數形式描述未來的機會或展望。
w_prospective
expected or likely to happen or become something in the future 常修飾 buyer、employer、student，指尚未確定但可能成為某身分的人。
w_prosperity
the state of being successful, especially financially 常見 economic prosperity，指整體經濟或生活狀況的富足與成功。
w_protein
an essential nutrient made of amino acids, found in foods such as meat, eggs, and beans 營養學常見詞彙，指身體組織生長修復所需的基本營養素。
w_protocol
a set of official or formal rules governing behavior, or a system of rules for data exchange 外交場合指正式禮儀規則；科技語境則指資料傳輸的技術規範，如 internet protocol。
w_prototype
an original model on which later versions are based, especially of a machine or product 常見於工程、產品開發語境，指正式量產前製作的初步模型。
w_provenance
the place of origin or history of an object, especially of a work of art 常見於藝術品鑑定語境，指作品的來歷與所有權歷史紀錄。
w_province
an administrative division of a country, or an area of responsibility or expertise 地理上指行政區劃；引申義指某人的專業領域，如 that's not my province。
w_provincial
having limited or narrow-minded views, typical of people from rural areas 帶輕微貶意，形容人思想狹隘、不見多識廣，也可單純指「省的、地方的」。
w_provisional
arranged or agreed on a temporary basis, subject to later confirmation 常見 provisional government、provisional agreement，強調尚未正式定案。
w_provoke
to cause a strong reaction, especially anger, or to deliberately annoy someone 常接 anger、reaction 等抽象名詞，或指故意惹怒他人使其反應。
w_prowl
to move around quietly and stealthily, especially while hunting or looking for something 常用於描述動物覓食或人四處遊蕩伺機而動，帶有隱密、警戒的意味。
w_proximity
nearness in space, time, or relationship 常見 in close proximity to，強調空間或關係上的靠近程度。
w_prudence
careful and sensible behavior, especially in managing money or making decisions 正式用語，常見於財務或決策語境，強調小心考量後果。
w_prudent
acting with care and thought for the future; sensible 常修飾 decision、investment，強調基於長遠考量而做出的明智選擇。
w_psalm
a sacred song or poem of praise, especially one from the book of psalms in the bible 多指《舊約聖經》〈詩篇〉中的宗教詩歌，常用於禮拜或讚美儀式。
w_psychiatric
relating to the diagnosis and treatment of mental illness 常修飾 hospital、treatment、disorder，屬醫學正式用語，與 psychological 不同，後者較廣泛指心理層面。
w_psychologist
a person who studies or specializes in the science of the mind and behavior 指以心理學為專業的人，須與 psychiatrist（精神科醫師，可開藥）區分。
w_psychology
the scientific study of the human mind and its functions 學術領域名稱；也可口語指某人或某群體的「心理狀態」，如 team psychology。
w_publication
a book, magazine, or other printed work made available to the public 可數名詞，指具體的書刊；不可數時指出版這項行為，如 the publication of the report。
w_publicity
public attention or media coverage given to someone or something 不可數名詞，常見 get publicity、bad publicity；多指媒體曝光而非刻意的廣告宣傳。
w_puddle
a small pool of liquid, especially rainwater, on the ground 常見 rain puddle；日常用語，指路面積水形成的小水池。
w_puerile
childish and silly in a way that is inappropriate for an adult 帶負面含意，形容成年人的行為或言論不成熟，比 childish 語氣更正式且更貶意。
w_pugnacious
eager or quick to argue or fight 形容人個性或言論帶有攻擊性，常修飾 attitude、manner。
w_pulse
the regular beating of blood through the arteries, felt especially at the wrist or neck 醫學及日常用語，常見 take/feel someone's pulse；也可比喻指事物的節奏或動態，如 the pulse of the city。
w_pummel
to hit someone repeatedly, especially with the fists 口語用法，強調重複、有力的擊打動作，常用於描述拳打或比喻猛烈攻擊（如媒體抨擊）。
w_pump
a device used to move liquid or gas from one place to another, or to force air into something 常見 water pump、bicycle pump；也可作動詞 pump water/air，表示用幫浦輸送或加壓。
w_pumpkin
a large round orange fruit with a thick shell, often used in cooking or as a halloween decoration 常見於萬聖節裝飾（jack-o'-lantern）或秋季料理，如 pumpkin pie。
w_punch
a quick, hard blow with a closed fist 常見 throw a punch、a punch in the face；也可作動詞 punch someone，指用拳頭擊打。
w_punctilious
very careful and precise about details, especially rules of behavior 常修飾 person、attention to detail，語氣正式，強調近乎苛求的謹慎與規矩。
w_puncture
a small hole made by a sharp object, especially in a tire 常見 tire puncture，也可作動詞 puncture a tire/balloon，表示戳破、刺穿。
w_pungent
having a sharp, strong smell or taste 常修飾 smell、odor、taste，形容味道或氣味濃烈刺鼻，如 garlic's pungent aroma。
w_puny
small and weak, especially in a way that seems inadequate 常帶輕視語氣，形容身體弱小或力量、規模不足，如 puny effort。
w_purchase
something bought, or the act of buying something 常見 make a purchase；也可作動詞 purchase something，語氣比 buy 正式。
w_pure
not mixed with anything else; complete and total 常修飾物質（pure gold）或抽象程度（pure luck），強調不含雜質或百分之百的性質。
w_purport
to claim to be or do something, especially when this may not be true 常見 purport to be/do，語氣帶懷疑，暗示所聲稱的內容可能不實。
w_pursue
to follow or work toward achieving a goal, career, or activity over time 常接抽象受詞，如 pursue a career、pursue happiness，強調長期投入努力達成目標。
w_pursuit
an activity that someone spends time on, especially for pleasure; the act of chasing something 常見 leisure pursuits（休閒活動）或 in pursuit of（追求某事）。
w_putative
generally believed or assumed to be the case, though not proven 正式、法律語境常見，如 putative father，指未經證實但普遍被認定的身分或事實。
w_puzzle
a game or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge 常見 jigsaw puzzle、crossword puzzle；也可指令人困惑不解的情況。
w_pyramid
a large stone structure with a square base and four triangular sides, especially those built in ancient egypt 常指埃及古蹟；也可比喻指組織架構，如 pyramid scheme（老鼠會、金字塔騙局）。
w_qualification
a skill, quality, or official record that makes someone suitable for a job or task 常見 job qualifications、academic qualifications，指達成某職位或任務所需的能力或證明。
w_qualify
to have the right skills or meet the requirements needed for something 常見 qualify for/as，如 qualify for a loan、qualify as a doctor。
w_qualitative
relating to the nature or quality of something rather than its quantity 常與 quantitative 相對，用於研究方法語境，如 qualitative research（質性研究）。
w_quantitative
relating to or measured by quantity or amount 與 qualitative 相對，強調可用數字衡量的資料，如 quantitative analysis（量化分析）。
w_quantity
an amount or number of something, especially one that can be measured 常見 a large/small quantity of，強調可測量或計算的「量」，與 quality（品質）相對。
w_quantum
the smallest possible discrete amount of a physical property, or a required amount or portion 物理學術語（quantum physics）；日常用語中也可指「一定的量」，如 a quantum of truth。
w_quarantine
a period of isolation imposed on people or animals to prevent the spread of disease 常見 put someone in quarantine；也可作動詞 quarantine a patient，指強制隔離以防疾病傳播。
w_quarry
to dig stone, sand, or other material out of the ground 常接 stone、marble 等受詞，指從地表挖掘石材；名詞則指採石場。
w_quash
to officially reject a legal decision, or to stop something forcefully 法律語境指撤銷判決（quash a conviction）；一般語境則指強力平息（quash a rumor/rebellion）。
w_queasy
feeling as if you are going to vomit, or feeling uneasy about something 常見 feel queasy，可指生理上的噁心想吐，也可比喻指心理上的不安、緊張。
w_quell
to stop or suppress something, especially a feeling or a disturbance 常接 fear、rebellion、rumor 等，語氣正式，指用力量或行動使某事平息下來。
w_querulous
complaining a lot in an irritable or whining way 形容人習慣性地抱怨、語氣不滿，常修飾 tone、voice。
w_query
a question, especially one expressing doubt or requesting information 常見 a query about，也可作動詞 query something，表示對某事提出質疑或詢問。
w_quest
a long search for something that is difficult to find, often for a specific purpose 常見 quest for + n，如 quest for knowledge/truth，語氣帶有史詩、冒險色彩。
w_questionable
not certain to be true, appropriate, or of good quality; possibly wrong or dishonest 常修飾 decision、ethics、quality，表示對某事的正當性或真實性有所質疑。
w_questionnaire
a set of written questions used to collect information from people 常見 fill out a questionnaire，指用於調查或研究的書面問題表。
w_queue
a line of people or vehicles waiting for something 英式用語（美式常用 line）；電腦科學語境中則指等待處理的工作序列。
w_quilt
a warm bed covering made of two layers of fabric with soft material stitched between them 常見 patchwork quilt（拼布被），強調手工縫製、有厚度的寢具，與薄毯 blanket 不同。
w_quip
a short, clever, and amusing remark 常見 make a quip，強調簡短機智、帶點諷刺幽默的話語。
w_quixotic
having idealistic goals that are impractical or unlikely to succeed 源自唐吉軻德（don quixote），形容理想過於浪漫但脫離現實，常修飾 plan、pursuit。
w_quota
an official limit on the number or amount of something that is allowed 常見 import quota、sales quota，指官方或組織設定的數量上限或目標。
w_quotation
a sentence or phrase taken from a book or speech, or an official price estimate for a job 兩義：文學／演講中的引用語句；商業語境中承包商或供應商提供的價格估算。
w_quote
to repeat exactly what someone else has said or written 常接 sb as saying、quote from a book；也可作名詞 a quote，指引文或報價。
w_rack
a frame or structure with bars or hooks used for holding or storing things 常見 towel rack、luggage rack；片語 rack one's brains 指絞盡腦汁。
w_radar
a system that uses radio waves to detect the position and speed of objects such as aircraft 科技用語，也常見比喻用法 on/off someone's radar，指是否受到注意或關注。
w_radiation
energy given off in the form of waves or particles, especially from radioactive substances or the sun 常見 nuclear radiation、solar radiation；醫學語境中也指放射治療 radiation therapy。
w_radical
favoring extreme or fundamental change, especially in politics or society 常修飾 change、reform、idea，也可修飾人（radical politician），與 moderate 相對。
w_raffle
a way of raising money by selling numbered tickets, some of which win prizes 常見 raffle ticket，多用於募款活動；與 lottery 類似但通常規模較小、獎品非現金。
w_rafter
one of the sloping beams that support a roof 建築用語，指支撐屋頂的斜向樑木；片語 the rafters 可比喻指屋內高處（as if to bring down the rafters）。
w_rage
violent, uncontrollable anger 常見 fly into a rage、road rage；程度比 anger 更激烈、失控。
w_raid
a sudden attack on a place, especially by police or armed forces 常見 police raid、air raid；也可作動詞 raid a building，指出其不意地闖入搜查或攻擊。
w_rail
a horizontal bar, especially one used as part of a fence, track, or support 常見 handrail、guardrail、by rail（搭火車）；片語 go off the rails 指行為脫序、失控。
w_rainbow
an arc of different colors that appears in the sky when sunlight shines through rain 日常用語，也常象徵希望或多樣性，如 rainbow flag。
w_rally
a large public meeting held to support a cause, or a significant recovery in strength, price, or spirits 常見 political rally（政治集會）或 stock market rally（股市反彈），指群眾聚集或情勢好轉。
w_ramp
a sloped surface connecting two different levels 常見 wheelchair ramp、highway ramp；片語 ramp up 指急遽增加或加強（作動詞片語）。
w_rampage
to move around in a wild, violent, and uncontrolled way 常見 go on a rampage，指人或動物失控地破壞、攻擊，語氣強烈。
w_rampant
existing or spreading in an uncontrolled way, especially something bad 常修飾 crime、corruption、disease，強調負面事物大範圍且難以控制地擴散。
w_ranch
a large farm used for raising cattle, horses, or sheep, especially in north america 北美用語，指專門畜養牲畜的大片農場；也可作動詞 ranch，指經營牧場。
w_rancor
a strong, bitter feeling of hatred or resentment 正式用語，強調長期積累、根深柢固的怨恨，常見 without rancor（不帶怨恨）。
w_random
happening or done without a specific plan, pattern, or reason 常見 random selection、random sample，強調不受特定規律或意圖影響。
w_ranger
an official who is responsible for patrolling and protecting a park or forest 常見 park ranger，也可指特種部隊（army ranger），需依上下文判斷。
w_rank
a position in a hierarchy, especially in the armed forces or an organization 常見 military rank、the rank of colonel；也可作動詞 rank，指依某標準排列名次。
w_rare
not occurring or found very often; uncommon 常修飾 disease、opportunity、species，強調發生或出現的頻率極低。
w_ratification
the act of formally approving or confirming an agreement, treaty, or decision 正式法律或外交用語，常見 ratification of a treaty，指官方正式生效的程序。
w_ratify
to give formal approval to an agreement or decision, making it officially valid 常見 ratify a treaty/constitution，多用於政府、國會等正式場合。
w_ratio
a relationship between two numbers or amounts showing how many times one contains the other 常見 ratio of a to b，用於數學、統計或日常比較兩個量的關係。
w_ration
a fixed amount of food or supplies allowed to each person, especially during a shortage 常見於戰爭、災害時期，如 food ration；也可作動詞 ration，指限量分配資源。
w_rational
based on clear thinking and reason rather than emotion 常修飾 decision、explanation，與 emotional、irrational 相對，強調依邏輯推理而非情緒。
w_rationale

the set of reasons that explain why a particular decision or approach was chosen rationale 不是單一個理由，而是「支撐某個決定的整套說法」。技術文件中最典型的用法是架構決策紀錄（adr）裡的 rationale 一節，說明「為什麼選這個方案而不是其他方案」。注意它的重音與發音和形容詞 rational 完全不同。 the rationale for + noun the rationale behind + noun explain the rationale the rationale behind ……背後的理由 the rationale for ……的理由 a clear rationale 清楚的論據 provide a rationale 提出理由說明 justification reasoning whim rational rationalize rational
w_rattle
to make a series of short, sharp knocking sounds, or to shake and make such sounds 常描述物體因鬆動而碰撞出聲，如窗戶、瓶蓋；口語中也可指使人心慌（rattle someone）。
w_raucous
loud and rough sounding, often in a disorderly or unruly way 常修飾 laughter、crowd、voice，強調聲音大且不悅耳，帶有失控、吵鬧的氛圍。
w_rave
to talk about something with great enthusiasm and admiration 常見 rave about/over，語氣熱情正面；名詞 rave review 指極力讚賞的評論。
w_react
to behave or respond in a particular way as a result of something 常見 react to，可指人的情緒反應，也可指化學物質起反應（chemicals react）。
w_reactionary
strongly opposed to political or social change or reform 帶負面意涵，形容人或政策極力抗拒進步或改革，與 progressive 相對。
w_readily
without difficulty or hesitation; quickly 常修飾 available、admit，如 readily available（隨手可得）、readily admit（欣然承認）。
w_realism
an approach that represents things as they actually are, without idealizing them 藝術、文學語境指如實呈現現實的創作手法；一般語境也可指務實看待事物的態度。
w_realization
the moment of becoming fully aware of or understanding something 常見 come to the realization that...，指突然清楚意識到某項事實或真相。
w_realm
a particular area of activity, interest, or knowledge 常見 the realm of possibility、in the realm of science，較抽象、正式，常見於書面語。
w_rear
to bring up and care for a child or young animal until it is fully grown 常接 children、livestock 等受詞，語氣正式，與 raise 意思相近但更常見於書面語。
w_reassure
to say or do something to remove someone's doubts or fears 常接人作受詞，加 that 子句或 about，如 reassure someone that everything is fine。
w_rebellion
an act of organized, often violent resistance against an authority or government 常見 armed rebellion、a rebellion against；也可比喻指子女對父母規範的反抗（teenage rebellion）。
w_rebuff
to reject an offer, suggestion, or person in an unfriendly way 正式用語，強調態度冷淡或不客氣地拒絕，常接人或提議作受詞。
w_recalcitrant
stubbornly resistant to authority or control 正式用語，形容人或動物拒絕服從指示或規則，語氣較 stubborn 更書面。
w_receipt
a written or printed document confirming that money or goods have been received 常見 keep the receipt，多用於購物、付款後作為證明的單據。
w_receiver
a device that receives electronic signals, such as a telephone handset or radio/tv tuner 常見 telephone receiver、radio receiver，指用於接收訊號或聲音的裝置。
w_reception
the way someone or something is greeted or received, or a formal social gathering 兩義常見：對意見／作品的反應（a warm reception）；正式社交場合（wedding reception）。
w_receptive
willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions 常見 receptive to，形容人態度開放，願意考慮不同意見或建議。
w_receptor
a cell structure that responds to a specific stimulus, such as light, chemicals, or pain 生物學、醫學用語，常見 pain receptor、light receptor，指感應特定刺激的細胞構造。
w_recession
a period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced 經濟學術語，常見 economic recession、global recession，指gdp、就業等指標持續下滑的時期。
w_recipe
a set of instructions for preparing a particular dish, or a method for achieving something 常見 recipe for success，字面指烹飪食譜，引申則指達成某結果的方法或要素組合。
w_recipient
a person who receives something, such as an award, gift, or message 常見 recipient of an award、email recipient，正式用語，指接收某物的一方。
w_reciprocal
given, felt, or done in return by both parties involved 常見 reciprocal agreement、reciprocal feelings，強調雙方相互回應或給予。
w_reciprocate
to respond to an action or feeling by doing or feeling the same thing in return 常見 reciprocate a favor/feeling，強調對他人善意或行為做出相應的回應。
w_reckon
to think or believe something, often based on calculation or estimation 口語用法，常見 i reckon (that)...，語氣較隨性，相當於 think 或 estimate。
w_recline
to lean or lie back in a relaxed position 常見 recline in a chair、recline the seat，指身體向後倚靠以放鬆或休息。
w_recognition
acknowledgment or appreciation of someone's achievement, or the ability to identify something already known 兩義常見：對成就的肯定（gain recognition）；辨識能力，如 facial recognition（臉部辨識）。
w_recommend
to suggest that someone or something is good or suitable for a particular purpose 常見 recommend sth to sb、recommend that + 子句（用原形動詞），語氣正面。
w_recommendation
a suggestion about the best course of action, or a statement praising someone's qualities 常見 make a recommendation、a letter of recommendation（推薦信），前者指行動建議，後者指人事推薦文件。
w_reconcile

to find a way of making two different ideas, facts, or demands exist together without conflict reconcile 的核心是「兩個東西看起來互相矛盾，要想辦法讓它們並存」。句型是 reconcile a with b，或 reconcile a and b。分析性寫作中常用來處理表面矛盾的證據；工程語境則常說 reconcile two sources of truth。 reconcile a with b reconcile a and b be hard to reconcile with + noun reconcile a with b 使 a 與 b 一致 difficult to reconcile 難以調和 reconcile differences 化解歧見 對帳；核對（兩份紀錄） to compare two sets of records and make sure they agree 這是會計與資料工程的專門用法：把兩份應該相同的紀錄逐筆比對，找出並解釋差異。名詞 reconciliation 在金融系統中是固定術語，例如 a nightly reconciliation job。 reconcile the accounts 對帳 a reconciliation job 對帳作業 harmonize square conflate reconciliation resolve
w_reconciliation
the restoring of friendly relations between people or groups who have been in conflict 常見 reconciliation between/with，也可用於帳目核對（bank reconciliation），需依上下文判斷。
w_recondite
(of a subject or knowledge) difficult to understand; known only to a few specialists 正式書面用語，形容題材或知識過於專門，一般人難以理解，如 recondite theory。
w_reconnaissance
military observation of a region to gather information about an enemy or area 軍事用語，常見 reconnaissance mission，指為蒐集情報而進行的實地探查。
w_reconstitute
to add water to a dried or concentrated substance to restore it to its original form 常見於食品或化學領域，如 reconstitute powdered milk，指加水還原成原本狀態。
w_reconstruction
the process of rebuilding something that has been damaged or destroyed 常見 post-war reconstruction、reconstruction of a building，強調在毀壞後重新建造。
w_recount
a fresh count of votes in an election, especially when the result is very close 常見於選舉語境，指因票數接近而重新清點選票，如 demand a recount。
w_recover
to return to a normal state of health, strength, or function after an illness or difficulty 常見 recover from an illness/loss，也可指取回失物（recover stolen goods）。
w_recreation
an activity done for enjoyment or relaxation when not working 常見 outdoor recreation，指工作之餘從事的休閒活動，強調放鬆身心。
w_recreational
relating to activities done for enjoyment or relaxation 常修飾 activity、drug、vehicle，如 recreational drug use（娛樂性用藥）。
w_recruit
a person who has recently joined an organization, especially the armed forces 常見 army recruit、new recruit；也可作動詞 recruit staff，指招募新人。
w_rectify
to correct or put right something that is wrong 正式用語，常接 error、situation，如 rectify the situation，強調採取行動使其恢復正確。
w_recycle
to process used materials so they can be used again 常見 recycle paper/plastic，環保語境常用詞，也可比喻指重複利用點子或材料。
w_redeem
to make up for a fault or a bad situation, or to exchange a voucher or coupon for something 常見 redeem oneself（挽回名譽）、redeem a coupon（兌換優惠券），依語境判斷。
w_redistribution
the act of sharing something out again in a different way, especially wealth or resources 常見 redistribution of wealth/income，多用於經濟、政治語境，指資源重新分配以求公平。
w_reduction
the act of making something smaller in size, amount, or degree 常見 price reduction、reduction in staff，指數量、程度上的降低。
w_redundancy
the state of being no longer needed, especially the loss of a job because it is unnecessary 英式用語，常見 be made redundant（被裁員）；也可指語言或系統中不必要的重複。
w_redundant

unnecessary because it repeats something that is already there redundant 在寫作與程式碼審查中都是負面評價：這段內容重複了，可以刪掉。要注意 redundancy 在系統設計中卻是正面的——備援副本正是刻意的重複，用來提高可靠性。同一個字在兩個語境中一褒一貶，要靠上下文判斷。 a redundant + noun make something redundant redundant code 多餘的程式碼 become redundant 變得多餘 redundant checks 重複的檢查 備援的（刻意重複以提高可靠性） duplicated on purpose, so that the system keeps working if one copy fails 在系統設計語境中，redundancy 是設計目標而非缺點：多準備一份，是為了在其中一份故障時仍能運作。raid 中的 r 就是 redundant。判斷褒貶的關鍵是問：這個重複是無意的浪費，還是刻意的保險？ a redundant power supply 備援電源 build in redundancy 建立備援機制 superfluous unnecessary indispensable concise redundancy redundantly duplicate
w_reef
a ridge of rock, sand, or coral lying just below or above the surface of the sea 常見 coral reef（珊瑚礁），指近海面的岩石或珊瑚礁脈，對航行構成危險。
w_reek
to smell strongly and unpleasantly of something 常見 reek of，可指字面上的臭味，也可比喻指明顯帶有某種負面性質，如 reek of corruption。
w_referee
an official who supervises a sports match to ensure the rules are followed 常見於足球、拳擊等運動比賽，強調負責執法、判定犯規的角色。
w_referendum
a vote in which all the people of a country are asked to give their opinion on an important issue 常見 hold a referendum，指就重大政治或社會議題交由全體選民表決。
w_refine
to remove impurities from a substance, or to improve something by making small changes 兩義：物理提煉物質（refine oil）；抽象上使更完善（refine a plan/skill）。
w_reflection
an image seen in a mirror or other shiny surface, or careful thought about something 兩義：物理上的鏡像（see your reflection）；抽象的深思熟慮（on reflection）。
w_reform
a change made to a system or organization in order to improve it 常見 economic reform、education reform，指針對制度、政策所做的改善性變革。
w_refrain
to stop yourself from doing something, especially something you want to do 常見 refrain from doing sth，正式用語，強調自我約束不去做某事。
w_refrigerator
an appliance used to keep food and drink cold 日常家電用詞，常簡稱 fridge；用於保存食物、飲料低溫存放。
w_refuge
a place or state of safety from danger or trouble 常見 take refuge in，指尋求安全躲避的地方或狀態，可指實際場所或比喻意義。
w_refugee
a person forced to leave their country because of war, persecution, or disaster 常見 refugee camp，指因戰爭、迫害或災難被迫離開家園的人。
w_refusal
the act of saying no to something that is offered, requested, or demanded 常見 a flat refusal（斷然拒絕），也可作 refusal to do sth，強調不接受的行為。
w_refute

to prove that a statement or theory is wrong, by giving evidence or argument refute 是很強的字：它宣稱「已經證明對方錯了」，而不只是「不同意」。這是它與 deny（否認）和 dispute（有異議）最重要的差別。若手上沒有證據就說 i refute that，在正式寫作中會被視為用字過當——那種情況應該用 dispute 或 reject。 refute a claim refute the argument that + clause refute a claim 駁倒某項主張 conclusively refute 確鑿地駁倒 difficult to refute 難以反駁的 disprove rebut corroborate substantiate refutation irrefutable deny
w_regal
suitable for or typical of a king or queen; magnificent 正式用語，形容具有王室般的威嚴或華麗氣派，如 regal bearing。
w_regent
a person appointed to rule a country when the monarch is absent, too young, or unable to rule 歷史用語，指代替君主暫時執政的人，常見於君主年幼或缺位時期。
w_regime
a government, especially one considered oppressive or not democratically elected 常帶負面意涵，指專制或不受歡迎的政府，如 authoritarian regime。
w_regiment
a large military unit consisting of several battalions 軍事用語，指介於營與師之間的部隊編制單位。
w_register
an official written record of names, events, or transactions 常見 cash register（收銀機）、attendance register（點名簿），也可作動詞 register，表示登記、註冊。
w_regulate
to control something by means of rules, especially to ensure fairness or safety 常見 regulate an industry/market，指政府或機構透過法規對某活動進行控管。
w_regulatory
relating to the control of an activity or process by rules and regulations 常修飾 body、agency、framework，如 regulatory agency（監管機構）。
w_rehabilitation
the process of helping someone return to a normal life after illness, injury, or imprisonment 常見 physical rehabilitation、drug rehabilitation，指恢復身體機能或協助重新融入社會。
w_rehearsal
a practice session for a performance, such as a play, concert, or speech 常見 dress rehearsal（彩排），指演出前為求熟練所進行的練習。
w_reign
to rule as king, queen, or other monarch 正式用語，常見 reign over/for，也可比喻指某狀態長期主導，如 chaos reigned。
w_reinforce

to make an idea, belief, or feeling stronger reinforce 在抽象語境中表示「讓某個既有的想法或印象變得更強」。注意它的前提是「那個東西本來就存在」，所以 reinforce 不能用來表示「創造」。學術寫作常說 the findings reinforce the view that...，意思是研究結果進一步支持既有觀點。 reinforce + noun reinforce the view/idea that + clause reinforce a stereotype 強化刻板印象 reinforce the message 強化訊息 reinforce the impression 加深印象 mutually reinforcing 相互強化的 加固；補強（實體結構） to make a physical structure stronger by adding material to it 在工程與建築語境中，reinforce 指用額外材料讓結構更堅固，最常見的是 reinforced concrete（鋼筋混凝土）。這個具體義是抽象義的來源，理解它有助於記住「本來就存在、再加強」的核心語感。 reinforced concrete 鋼筋混凝土 strengthen bolster undermine reinforcement strengthen
w_reinstate
to give someone back their former job, position, or rights 常見 reinstate an employee，指恢復先前被撤除的職位、資格或狀態。
w_rejection
the act of refusing to accept, approve of, or believe someone or something 常見 face rejection、rejection letter，指申請、提案或人際關係中被拒絕的情形。
w_rejoice
to feel or show great joy or delight 正式或文學用語，常見 rejoice at/in，強調因好消息而感到極大的喜悅。
w_relapse
to become worse again after a period of improvement, especially in health or behavior 常見 relapse into old habits、the patient relapsed，指病情或壞習慣再度出現。
w_relaxation
the state of being free from tension and anxiety, or an activity that helps achieve this 常見 relaxation technique、for relaxation，指身心放鬆的狀態或方式。
w_relegate
to assign someone or something to a lower or less important position 常見 relegate to，強調將人或事物移往較不重要或較低的位置。
w_relent
to become less strict or severe, eventually agreeing to something after refusing 強調原本堅持拒絕，後來態度轉為寬容或答應，如 finally relent。
w_relevance
the quality of being closely connected to the matter being discussed 常見 have relevance to，指某事物與當前議題的關聯程度。
w_relevant

closely connected to the subject or situation being discussed, and therefore worth considering relevant 不只是「有關係」，而是「與眼前的問題有關，因此值得納入考量」。它天生帶有「對某件事而言」的比較基準，所以最自然的句型是 relevant to + 名詞。學術與商務寫作中，relevant 常用來篩選資訊：relevant data、relevant experience、relevant section。 relevant to + noun be relevant + to + somebody/something relevant to 與……相關 highly relevant 高度相關 relevant experience 相關經驗 relevant data 相關資料 directly relevant 直接相關 pertinent applicable irrelevant relevance irrelevant relevantly applicable
w_reliability
the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well 常見 product reliability，指設備、系統或人始終如一、值得信賴的特質。
w_reliable
able to be trusted to do what is expected consistently 常修飾 source、person、product，強調始終如一、值得信任的特質。
w_reliance
dependence on or trust in someone or something 常見 reliance on，強調對某人事物的依靠程度，語氣較 dependence 正式。
w_relieve
to make pain, distress, or a burden less severe 常接 pain、stress、pressure，如 relieve symptoms，強調使負面感受或負擔減少。
w_relinquish
to give up a possession, right, or control, especially unwillingly 正式用語，常接 power、control、claim，強調不情願地放棄或交出。
w_reluctant
unwilling or hesitant to do something 常見 reluctant to do sth，強調心裡抗拒但可能仍會去做。
w_rely
to depend on someone or something with trust or confidence 常見 rely on/upon，強調在需要時可以信任、仰賴的對象。
w_remainder
the part of something that is left after the rest has been used, removed, or dealt with 常見 spend the remainder of the day，數學語境則指除法後的餘數。
w_remark
a comment expressing an opinion or observation 常見 make a remark about，語氣中性，可正面或負面，強調簡短的意見表達。
w_remarkable
worthy of attention because unusual or impressive 常修飾 achievement、talent，強調事物令人印象深刻的程度。
w_remarkably
in a way that is surprising or worthy of attention 常修飾形容詞，如 remarkably calm，強調程度超乎預期。
w_remedy
a way of solving a problem, or a medicine or treatment for an illness 兩義：抽象問題的解方（remedy for inflation）；具體病痛的藥物（home remedy）。
w_reminder
something that causes someone to remember something 常見 a gentle reminder、send a reminder，指用來喚起記憶的訊息或物品。
w_reminisce
to talk or think fondly about past experiences 常見 reminisce about，語氣帶懷舊情感，強調回想並談論過往的美好時光。
w_remission
a period during which the symptoms of a disease are reduced or disappear 醫學用語，常見 cancer in remission，指疾病症狀暫時減輕或消失的狀態。
w_remnant
a small remaining part of something that once was larger 常見 remnants of + n，指某事物消失後留下的一小部分，如 remnants of an empire。
w_remote
far away in distance, or very unlikely to happen 常見 remote village（偏遠村莊）、remote possibility（渺茫的可能性），依語境有具體或抽象意涵。
w_renaissance
a revival of interest, activity, or vitality in something, or (capitalized) the historical period of cultural rebirth in europe 大寫時特指歐洲十四至十七世紀的文藝復興運動；小寫可泛指任何領域的重新興盛。
w_render
to cause something to be in a particular state or condition 常接受詞+形容詞，如 render useless、render helpless，強調造成某種狀態的結果。
w_rendezvous
a meeting arranged at a particular time and place, or the place itself 常帶浪漫或秘密色彩，如 a secret rendezvous；也可作動詞 rendezvous with sb。
w_renege
to fail to keep a promise or agreement 常見 renege on a deal/promise，語氣帶負面評價，強調不遵守先前的承諾。
w_renew
to extend the period of validity of something, or to start something again with fresh energy 常見 renew a contract/passport；也可指抽象事物的重新展開，如 renew one's efforts。
w_renewal
the act of extending the validity of something, or the process of starting something again 常見 contract renewal、urban renewal（都市更新），指延續有效期或重新振興。
w_renounce
to formally give up a title, right, or belief 正式用語，常接 throne、claim、belief，強調公開、正式地放棄某項權利或立場。
w_renovate
to repair and improve something, especially an old building 常見 renovate a house/kitchen，指對建築物進行修繕以恢復或提升其狀態。
w_rental
an arrangement in which you pay to use something for a period of time, or the item rented 常見 car rental、rental fee；也可作形容詞 rental car（租來的車）。
w_reparation
payment or action made to compensate for wrong or damage done, especially after a war 正式用語，常見複數形式 war reparations，指對受害方作出的正式補償。
w_repeal
to officially cancel a law 法律用語，常見 repeal a law/act，指立法機構正式撤銷某項法規。
w_repent
to feel or express sincere regret for wrongdoing 宗教或道德語境常見，常見 repent of one's sins，強調對過錯的真誠悔悟。
w_repercussion
an unintended and usually unwelcome consequence of an action or event 常用複數 repercussions，強調事件帶來的間接、常為負面的後續效應。
w_repetition
the act of saying or doing something again, or a repeated instance of something 常見 avoid repetition，也可指語言中反覆使用同樣字詞或句型作為修辭手法。
w_replenish
to fill something up again after it has been used or emptied 常接 supplies、stock，如 replenish the shelves，強調恢復到原本充足的狀態。
w_replete
completely filled or supplied with something 正式用語，常見 replete with，後接名詞，表示充滿了某種事物。
w_representation
the act of speaking or acting on behalf of someone, or something that depicts or symbolizes another thing 兩義：政治上代人發言（legal representation）；藝術上的呈現（visual representation）。
w_reprieve
an official postponement or cancellation of a punishment, or a temporary relief from something difficult 法律語境指延緩死刑等處罰；一般語境則指暫時擺脫困境或壓力。
w_reprimand
to criticize someone formally for doing something wrong 正式用語，常見 reprimand sb for sth，語氣比 scold 更正式、公開。
w_reproach
an expression of disapproval or disappointment directed at someone 常見 a look of reproach，語氣較 blame 溫和，強調帶失望意味的批評。
w_reproduce
to produce offspring, or to make a copy of something 兩義：生物學上的生殖（animals reproduce）；製作複製品（reproduce a document）。
w_reproduction
the process by which living things produce offspring, or a copy of an original work 兩義常見：生物繁殖過程；藝術品或文件的複製版本，如 a reproduction of a painting。
w_reproductive
relating to the production of offspring 常見 reproductive system、reproductive health，醫學及生物學語境常用詞。
w_republic
a country governed by elected representatives and a president, rather than a king or queen 政治學術語，與君主制（monarchy）相對，強調國家元首非世襲君主。
w_repudiate
to refuse to accept or support something, or to deny that something is true or valid 正式用語，常見 repudiate a claim/agreement，強調正式拒絕接受或宣告無效。
w_reputation
the general opinion that people have about someone or something's character or quality 常見 build/damage a reputation，強調外界對其可信度或品質的整體評價。
w_request
an act of politely or formally asking for something 常見 make a request、upon request（應要求），語氣較 demand 委婉禮貌。
w_requisite
necessary for a particular purpose 正式用語，常修飾 skills、qualifications，強調達成目的所不可或缺的條件。
w_rescind
to officially cancel a law, decision, or agreement 正式用語，常見 rescind an order/policy，強調正式取消先前的決定或規定。
w_rescue
an act of saving someone or something from danger or harm 常見 rescue mission、come to the rescue，指從危險或困境中拯救出來的行動。
w_resemblance
the state of looking or being similar to someone or something else 常見 bear a resemblance to，強調外貌或特徵上的相似性。
w_resemble
to look like or be similar to someone or something 常直接接受詞，不用介系詞，如 resemble one's mother。
w_resentment
a bitter feeling of anger caused by being treated unfairly 常見 harbor resentment、feel resentment towards，強調因不公平待遇而產生的長期不滿。
w_reserve
an amount of something kept back for future use, or an area protected for wildlife 兩義：儲存備用的資源（cash reserves）；受保護的自然區域（nature reserve）。
w_reservoir
a large natural or artificial lake used to store water for supply to a community 常見 water reservoir，也可比喻指某種大量儲備，如 a reservoir of knowledge。
w_reshuffle
to change the positions or roles of people within an organization, especially a government 常見 cabinet reshuffle（內閣改組），指重新安排職位或人事以求改變。
w_reside
to have one's permanent home in a particular place 正式用語，常見 reside in/at，也可用於抽象語境（power resides in...）。
w_residence
the place where someone lives, especially a large or formal one 比 house 更正式，常見 official residence（官邸），也可用於 in residence（駐居）。
w_residential
relating to areas where people live rather than work 常修飾 area、neighborhood，如 residential district（住宅區），與 commercial 相對。
w_residue
a small amount of something that remains after the main part has been used or removed 常見 chemical residue、pesticide residue，指使用或反應後留下的少量物質。
w_resignation
a formal statement announcing that you are leaving your job 常見 submit/hand in one's resignation，指正式提出離職的行為或文件。
w_resilience
the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or setbacks 常見 emotional resilience，也可指材料的彈性恢復能力，強調挫折後迅速恢復的能力。
w_resilient

able to recover quickly after something goes wrong resilient 的重點是「復原」，不是「不壞」。這與 robust 形成一組重要的對照：robust 系統不容易出錯，resilient 系統出錯後能迅速恢復。分散式系統設計通常兩者都要，因為在足夠大的規模下，故障是必然而非例外。介系詞用 to。 resilient to + noun build resilience into + noun resilient to failure 能承受故障並復原 a resilient system 有韌性的系統 build resilience 建立韌性 robust adaptable fragile precarious resilience robust
w_resist
to refuse to accept or comply with something, or to stop yourself from doing something you want to do 常接 change、temptation，如 resist the urge to，強調對抗外力或克制自身衝動。
w_resistance
the act of opposing something, or the ability of a substance to withstand a force or effect 常見 resistance to change、water resistance；物理學語境指電阻或阻力。
w_resistant
able to withstand the effect of something, or opposed to a particular idea or change 常見 resistant to，後接 disease、change 等，表示不易受影響或抗拒改變。
w_resolution
a firm decision to do or not do something, or a formal decision agreed on by a group 常見 new year's resolution（新年新希望）、pass a resolution（通過決議），兩義依語境判斷。
w_resolve
to find a satisfactory solution to a problem or difficulty 常接 issue、conflict、dispute，強調透過努力找到問題的解答或化解方式。
w_resonant
having a strong, deep, and rich sound, or deeply meaningful and emotionally powerful 常修飾 voice（聲音洪亮）或訊息、主題（resonant message，引起共鳴）。
w_resort
a place people visit for relaxation or recreation, especially on holiday 常見 beach resort、ski resort；片語 as a last resort 指萬不得已的手段。
w_resourceful
able to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties 形容人擅長運用有限資源解決問題，語氣正面，常修飾 person、leader。
w_respective

belonging separately to each of the people or things already mentioned respective 用來把「先前提到的多個對象」與「各自對應的東西」配對起來，避免重複說明。它一定用在複數名詞前，而且句子前面必須已經出現多個主體，否則讀者不知道「各自」指誰。副詞 respectively 則放在句末，用來對應兩組並列項目的順序。 their respective + plural noun a and b are x and y respectively their respective roles 他們各自的角色 in their respective fields 在各自的領域中 respective owners 各自的所有人 respectively respectful
w_respectively
in the order already mentioned, referring to each item in turn 常用於列舉對應關係之後，如 a and b are 10 and 20 respectively。
w_respiration
the process of breathing, or the biological process of producing energy from food 日常語境指呼吸動作；生物學語境指細胞層次釋放能量的化學過程（cellular respiration）。
w_respondent
a person who answers a questionnaire or survey, or the defendant in certain legal cases 問卷調查中指填答者；法律語境（尤其離婚案件）中指答辯的一方。
w_responsiveness
the quality of reacting quickly and positively to something 常見 customer responsiveness，強調對需求、刺激或請求能迅速且適當地做出回應。
w_restitution
the act of giving back something that was lost or stolen, or paying for damage caused 法律用語，常見 make restitution，指恢復原狀或對損失做出補償。
w_restoration
the act of repairing or returning something to its former good condition 常見 restoration of a building/painting，也可指抽象事物的恢復，如 restoration of order。
w_restore
to bring something back to its original or good condition 常見 restore order/confidence，也可指具體事物如古蹟、藝術品的修復。
w_restrain
to prevent someone or something from doing something, or to control a strong emotion 常見 restrain oneself from、restrain anger，強調用力量或意志加以約束。
w_restraint
a rule, force, or feeling that limits or controls behavior 常見 exercise restraint（自我克制）、without restraint（毫無節制），也可指實際的束縛裝置。
w_restrict
to limit the size, amount, or range of something 常見 restrict access/movement，強調對數量、範圍或自由施加限制。
w_restriction
a rule or condition that limits what can be done 常見 travel restriction、age restriction，指官方或制度上設下的限制條件。
w_restrictive
limiting freedom or action, especially in a way seen as excessive 常修飾 policy、law，語氣中性偏負面，強調對自由或選擇的束縛。
w_resume
to begin again after a pause or interruption 常接活動或狀態，如 resume work/talks，強調中斷後的再度進行。
w_resurgence
a renewed increase or growth in something, especially after a period of decline 常見 resurgence of interest/popularity，強調事物在沉寂後重新活躍起來。
w_resurrect
to bring something back into use or existence after it had ended or been forgotten 常見 resurrect an idea/tradition，比喻用法多於宗教語境的字面「復活」。
w_retail
the sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities 常見 retail price、retail industry，與 wholesale（批發）相對。
w_retailer
a business or person that sells goods directly to consumers 常見 online retailer、major retailer，指從事零售業務的商家。
w_retain

to keep something, especially when there is pressure or a reason to lose it retain 是 keep 的正式對應詞，特別強調「在可能失去的情況下仍然保有」。技術文件常用它描述資料保存（retain logs for 30 days）；商務語境用來談留住人才或客戶（retain talent、retain customers）；也可以描述保留某種特質（retain its original meaning）。 retain + noun retain + noun + for + duration retain data 保留資料 retain control 保有控制權 retain customers 留住客戶 retain the right to 保留……的權利 keep preserve eliminate discard retention retainer preserve
w_retaliate
to attack or harm someone in return for a similar act against you 常見 retaliate against，強調以牙還牙式的回應，帶負面色彩。
w_retaliation
an action taken in return for an injury or wrong done to oneself 常見 in retaliation for，指針對先前傷害或攻擊所採取的回應行動。
w_reticent
unwilling to talk about one's thoughts or feelings; reserved 正式用語，常見 reticent about，形容人不願透露想法或個人資訊，語氣中性。
w_retire
to stop working, usually because of reaching a certain age 常見 retire from、retire at 65，指結束職業生涯，也可用於軍事語境指撤退（較少見）。
w_retirement
the period of a person's life after they have stopped working 常見 retirement age、retirement plan，指離開職場後的階段或相關安排。
w_retrace
to go back over a route or sequence of events again 常見 retrace one's steps（原路折返），也可比喻指回顧事件經過。
w_retract
to withdraw a statement, offer, or accusation, admitting it was wrong or untrue 常見 retract a statement/claim，語氣正式，指公開承認先前說法有誤並收回。
w_retreat
the act of withdrawing, especially from a difficult situation, or a quiet place for relaxation 軍事語境指撤退；日常語境指遠離塵囂的休憩場所，如 a mountain retreat。
w_retrieve

to get something back, especially from a place where it has been stored retrieve 的核心是「從儲存的地方把東西拿回來」，因此它天生適合描述資料存取：retrieve a record、retrieve from cache。與 get 相比，retrieve 暗示「東西原本放在某處，需要去找出來」。日常語境中也可以說 retrieve your luggage。 retrieve + noun + from + source retrieve data 擷取資料 retrieve a record 取得一筆紀錄 retrieve from cache 從快取取得 difficult to retrieve 難以取回 fetch recover store discard retrieval recover
w_revelation
a surprising fact that is made known, especially one that was previously secret 常見 shocking revelation，指原本隱藏、後來被公開且令人震驚的訊息。
w_revenge
to harm someone in return for an injury or wrong they have done to you 常見 revenge oneself on、be revenged，語氣較 avenge 更常見於一般口語。
w_revenue
the income that a government or company receives regularly 常見 tax revenue、annual revenue，指政府稅收或公司營業收入。
w_reverberate
to be repeated as an echo, or to have continuing effects that are felt widely 字面指聲音回響（reverberate through the hall）；比喻指事件的影響持續擴散。
w_reverent
showing deep respect, especially for something considered sacred 常修飾 silence、attitude，多用於宗教或莊嚴場合，表達深切的敬意。
w_reverse
the opposite of what has just been stated, or the back side of something 常見 in reverse、quite the reverse，也可指硬幣、紙張等的背面。
w_reversion
a return to a previous state, condition, or type of behavior 正式用語，常見於法律或生物學語境，如 reversion to type（返祖現象）。
w_revert
to return to a previous state, practice, or condition 常見 revert to，指在改變後又回到先前的樣子或做法。
w_revise
to change or update something, such as a text or plan, in order to correct or improve it 常見 revise a manuscript/estimate，強調重新檢視並修改以求更準確或完善。
w_revision
a change made to correct or improve a text, plan, or opinion 常見 make revisions to，也可指修訂後的版本，如 the latest revision。
w_revitalize
to give new energy, strength, or success to something 常見 revitalize an economy/neighborhood，強調為原本衰退的事物注入新的動力。
w_revival
the process of something becoming popular, active, or successful again 常見 economic revival、a revival of interest，指事物再度興盛或重新受到重視。
w_revive
to bring someone or something back to consciousness, health, activity, or popularity 常見 revive a patient（使甦醒）、revive an economy（振興經濟），依受詞判斷字面或比喻義。
w_revolt
to rise up in rebellion against a government or authority 常見 revolt against，也可作名詞 a revolt，指有組織的反抗行動。
w_revolution
a fundamental change in political power or organization, often achieved through force 常見 the french revolution、industrial revolution，也可指徹底的變革，未必涉及武力。
w_revolutionary
involving a great and sudden change, especially one that transforms a field or system 常修飾 technology、idea，強調帶來根本性、突破性的改變。
w_revulsion
a strong feeling of disgust or repugnance 正式用語，常見 a sense of revulsion，形容對某事物產生強烈的厭惡情緒。
w_reward
something given in return for good behavior, service, or achievement 常見 as a reward for，可指金錢、榮譽或抽象的滿足感。
w_rhetoric
persuasive language used in speaking or writing, sometimes without much sincerity 常帶輕微負面意涵，指華麗但可能空洞的政治或宣傳言論，如 political rhetoric。
w_rhyme
a word that has the same final sound as another, or a short poem using such words 常見 nursery rhyme（童謠），也可作動詞 rhyme with，指字詞尾音相似。
w_rhythm
a regular repeated pattern of sound or movement, especially in music 常見 sense of rhythm、the rhythm of life，可指音樂節拍，也可比喻指事物的規律變化。
w_rhythmic
having a regular repeated pattern of sound or movement 常修飾 movement、breathing、music，強調規律性的重複模式。
w_ribbon
a long, narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decoration 常見 tie a ribbon、a ribbon of + n（一條狀的……），也可比喻用於形容細長條狀物。
w_rickety
likely to collapse or break because poorly made or in bad condition 常修飾 chair、staircase、bridge，形容結構不牢固、容易倒塌的物品。
w_rider
a person who rides a horse, bicycle, or other vehicle, or an additional clause attached to a document 日常指騎馬、騎車的人；法律語境則指附加於法案或保單的額外條款。
w_ridge
a long, narrow raised strip of land, especially along the top of a hill or mountain 常見 mountain ridge，指山脈或高地上狹長隆起的部分。
w_ridiculous
deserving or provoking mockery because extremely unreasonable or absurd 常修飾 idea、price、situation，語氣帶輕視，強調事物荒唐到令人發笑或難以置信。
w_rife
very common or widespread, especially something bad 常見 rife with，後接負面事物，如 rumors were rife（謠言四起）。
w_rifle
a gun with a long barrel, held against the shoulder when fired 常見 hunting rifle、assault rifle；也可作動詞 rifle through，指迅速翻找搜刮。
w_rigid
not able to bend or be changed easily; strict 常修飾 material（材質堅硬）或 rules、schedule（規定嚴格、不知變通）。
w_rigorous
extremely thorough, careful, and demanding 常修飾 testing、training、standards，強調過程極為嚴密、一絲不苟。
w_riot
a violent disturbance caused by a large crowd of people 常見 race riot、prison riot，指群眾失控的暴力衝突；片語 a riot of colors 指色彩繽紛。
w_ripe
fully grown and ready to be harvested or eaten, said especially of fruit 常修飾水果、農作物；片語 the time is ripe for 指時機成熟，適合做某事。
w_ripen
to become fully mature and ready to eat, usually said of fruit 常用於描述水果隨時間逐漸成熟的過程，如 ripen on the vine。
w_ripple
a small wave or series of waves on the surface of water, or a spreading effect 字面指水面波紋；比喻指某事引發的連鎖影響，如 a ripple effect。
w_risky
involving the possibility of danger, failure, or loss 常修飾 investment、decision，強調可能帶來損失或失敗的不確定性。
w_ritual
a series of actions performed in a set order, especially as part of a ceremony or habit 宗教語境指正式典禮（religious ritual）；日常語境可指固定習慣，如 morning ritual。
w_rival
a person or group competing with another for the same goal 常見 business rival、political rival，也可作動詞 rival，指足以與……匹敵。
w_rivet
to hold someone's attention completely, or to fasten with metal pins 比喻用法常見 be riveted by（被……深深吸引），字面義則指用鉚釘接合金屬物件。
w_roam
to move around an area freely, without a fixed destination 常見 roam the streets/countryside，強調隨意四處走動，沒有特定目的地。
w_roar
a loud, deep sound made by a lion, engine, or crowd 常見 the roar of the crowd/engine，也可作動詞 roar，指發出巨大而低沉的聲音。
w_robe
a long, loose piece of clothing, often worn for warmth or on formal occasions 常見 bath robe（浴袍）、judge's robe（法官長袍），依語境指日常或正式服裝。
w_robust

able to continue working correctly even under difficult or unexpected conditions robust 的關鍵不是「快」或「功能多」，而是「遇到異常狀況仍然表現良好」。因此它常用來形容系統、流程、統計方法與論證。說 a robust system 是稱讚它抗得住錯誤輸入、網路故障或流量尖峰，而不是說它跑得快。 robust to/against + noun a robust + noun a robust system 穩健的系統 robust error handling 健全的錯誤處理 robust against failure 能抵禦故障 a robust debate 熱烈的辯論 resilient sturdy fragile tenuous robustness robustly resilient
w_rocky
covered with or consisting of rocks, or full of difficulties 字面描述地形多石；比喻指過程艱難不順，如 a rocky relationship（不穩定的關係）。
w_romance
a love affair, or a story involving love and adventure 常見 a summer romance（一段夏日戀情），也可指小說類型（romance novel）。
w_roof
the structure covering the top of a building or vehicle 常見 roof of a house/car；片語 hit the roof 指勃然大怒。
w_rookie
a person who is new to a job, sport, or activity and lacks experience 常見於運動或職場語境，如 rookie season（新人球季），強調缺乏經驗。
w_rosy
having a pink, healthy color, or suggesting a hopeful and positive future 字面指臉頰紅潤（rosy cheeks）；比喻指前景樂觀（rosy future）。
w_rotate
to turn around a central point, or to take turns doing something in a regular sequence 字面指物體轉動（the earth rotates）；比喻指人員或任務按順序輪替（rotate shifts）。
w_rotation
the action of turning around a central axis, or a regular sequence in which people take turns 常見 crop rotation（輪作）、in rotation（輪流），依語境指物理旋轉或人事輪替。
w_rough
having an uneven or bumpy surface; difficult or unpleasant 字面描述觸感不平滑；比喻指經歷困難、不順遂的過程，如 a rough year。
w_roughly
approximately, or in a rough and forceful manner 兩義：表示概略數字（roughly 100 people）；描述動作粗魯（treated roughly）。
w_rout
a decisive and overwhelming defeat 常用於運動賽事或戰爭語境，指一方遭受壓倒性的失敗，程度比 defeat 更嚴重。
w_routine
a regular way or order of doing things, usually the same each time 常見 daily routine、morning routine，強調日常固定重複的一套動作或程序。
w_routinely
as a normal or regular part of a process; habitually 常修飾動詞，表示某動作是固定、常規進行的，不帶特殊性，如 routinely checked。
w_rove
to travel or wander around an area with no fixed destination 與 roam 意義相近，常見於文學語境，指四處遊蕩、居無定所。
w_rowdy
noisy, disorderly, and difficult to control 常修飾 crowd、behavior，形容行為喧鬧失序，帶有輕微負面意涵。
w_royalty
members of a royal family, or a payment made to the owner of a patent, copyright, or resource for its use 兩義：指皇室成員（members of royalty）；創作者或資源所有者因授權使用而獲得的報酬。
w_ruffle
to disturb the smoothness of something, or to make someone annoyed or upset 字面指弄亂頭髮、羽毛（ruffle feathers）；比喻指使人心煩、不悅，常見 ruffle sb's feathers。
w_ruin
severe damage or destruction, or the remains of a building that has been destroyed 常見 in ruins（成為廢墟）、financial ruin（財務破產），依語境指具體建築遺跡或抽象的敗落。
w_rumble
a continuous deep, low sound, such as that made by thunder or a heavy vehicle 常見 the rumble of thunder/traffic，形容持續、低沉的巨大聲響。
w_rumor
information or a story that spreads among people, though not confirmed to be true 常見 rumor has it that...，強調未經證實但廣為流傳的消息。
w_rural
relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities 常修飾 area、community，與 urban（都市的）相對。
w_rustle
to make a soft, dry sound like that of leaves or paper moving 常見 leaves rustle in the wind，形容輕柔、乾燥的摩擦聲。
w_sabotage
deliberate damage or disruption caused to prevent something from succeeding 常見 an act of sabotage，強調刻意破壞設備、計畫或行動以阻礙其成功。
w_sack
a large bag made of strong material, used for carrying or storing goods 常見 a sack of potatoes；口語片語 get the sack 指被解僱。
w_sacred
regarded with great respect and reverence, especially for religious reasons 常修飾 place、text、tradition，也可比喻指極為重要、不可侵犯的事物，如 a sacred promise。
w_sacrifice
the act of giving up something valuable for the sake of something more important 常見 make a sacrifice for，強調為達成某目標而放棄珍貴之物。
w_sadden
to make someone feel unhappy or sorrowful 正式用語，常用被動 be saddened by，強調因某事而感到難過。
w_saddle
a seat placed on the back of a horse or bicycle for a rider 常見 bicycle saddle、horse saddle，指供騎乘者坐的裝置。
w_sadistic
deriving pleasure from causing pain or suffering to others 帶強烈負面意涵，形容人以他人痛苦為樂，常修飾 pleasure、tendency。
w_safeguard
to protect something or someone from harm or damage 常接 rights、interests、data，強調採取措施以防範風險。
w_sage
a person who has great wisdom, especially one respected for their judgment and experience 常見於文學或哲學語境，指因智慧與經驗而受人敬重的長者或思想家。
w_sake
the purpose or benefit of doing something, used to explain the reason for an action 常見 for the sake of，表示做某事的理由或目的，如 for her sake（為了她好）。
w_salient

most noticeable or important, and therefore worth focusing on salient 指「在眾多細節中最突出、最該注意的」。它幾乎總是修飾抽象名詞：the salient points、the salient features。與 important 的差別在於：salient 強調「凸顯出來、抓住注意力」，因此特別適合用在摘要與簡報中。 the salient + plural noun the most salient + noun the salient points 要點 salient features 顯著特徵 the most salient difference 最顯著的差異 prominent notable trivial negligible salience conspicuous
w_salmon
a large fish with pink flesh that lives in the sea and swims upriver to breed 常見於料理或釣魚語境，指這種洄游性魚類，也可指其肉色（淡粉橘色）。
w_salutary
producing good or beneficial effects, especially after something unpleasant 正式用語，常修飾 effect、lesson，強調雖然過程可能不愉快，但結果有益，如 a salutary lesson。
w_salute
to greet someone with a formal gesture of respect, especially by raising the hand to the head 軍事語境常見（salute an officer），也可比喻用於表達敬意或讚賞（salute someone's courage）。
w_salvage
the act of saving goods, a ship, or property from damage, loss, or destruction 常見 salvage operation，指從沉船、火災等災難中搶救出可用的財物或設備。
w_sample
a small amount of something used to show or test what the whole is like 常見 free sample、blood sample，指用來代表整體或供檢測用的小部分。
w_sanction
an official penalty or restriction imposed to enforce compliance, or official approval or permission 兩義常依語境：國際政治指懲罰性措施（economic sanctions）；正式語境指官方許可。
w_sanctuary
a place of safety or protection, especially for those fleeing danger, or a protected area for wildlife 常見 wildlife sanctuary（野生動物保護區）、seek sanctuary（尋求庇護）。
w_sandy
covered with or containing a lot of sand 常修飾 beach、soil，形容表面或土質含有大量沙子。
w_sane
having a healthy and reasonable mind; not mentally ill 常見 stay sane（保持理智），也可指判斷合理，與 insane 相對。
w_sanguine
confidently optimistic, especially about a difficult situation 正式用語，常見 sanguine about，形容人對前景抱持信心，即使情況不明朗。
w_sarcastic
using remarks that clearly mean the opposite of what they say, in order to mock or criticize 常修飾 comment、tone，強調言語帶有反話式的嘲弄意味。
w_sardonic
mocking or scornful in a bitter or dry way 比 sarcastic 語氣更陰冷、輕蔑，常修飾 smile、humor，帶有輕蔑或冷酷的意味。
w_satellite
a device sent into space to orbit the earth or another body, used for communication or observation 常見 communication satellite、weather satellite，也可比喻指依附於某中心的附屬國或機構。
w_satisfaction
a feeling of pleasure or contentment because a need or desire has been fulfilled 常見 job satisfaction、customer satisfaction，強調需求或期望獲得實現後的正面感受。
w_satisfactory
acceptable or good enough to meet a requirement or standard 常見 satisfactory result/performance，強調符合最低期望，但未必特別出色。
w_savvy
practical knowledge and skill in a particular area 常見 business savvy、tech savvy，強調對某領域有敏銳的判斷力與實用技能。
w_scan
to look at something quickly, or to use a device to examine or convert something electronically 常見 scan a document/the room，指快速查看，或用機器將實體轉為數位資料。
w_scandal
a situation or event involving shameful or dishonest behavior that shocks public opinion 常見 political/financial scandal，強調公開後引發輿論譁然的不道德或違法行為。
w_scant
to provide an insufficient or inadequate amount of something 較少見的動詞用法，強調刻意減少或給予不足；更常見的形容詞用法（scant attention）指數量極少。
w_scar
a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed, or a lasting effect of a painful experience 字面指皮膚傷疤；比喻指心理上難以抹滅的創傷，如 emotional scars。
w_scarcely
almost not at all; barely 常見 scarcely + had/could，強調程度極輕微，語氣比 hardly 稍正式。
w_scarcity
a situation in which there is not enough of something needed 常見 water scarcity、food scarcity，指資源供不應求的狀態。
w_scare
a sudden feeling of fear, or an event that causes widespread alarm 常見 health scare、give someone a scare，指突發的恐懼感或引發大眾憂慮的事件。
w_scathing
extremely harsh and critical 常修飾 review、criticism，強調言辭猛烈、毫不留情的批評。
w_scatter
to move or throw things in different directions so they spread out over an area 常見 scatter seeds/papers，也可指人群因驚嚇而四散逃開。
w_scenario
a possible sequence of events or situation that could happen in the future 常見 worst-case scenario（最壞情況），指假設或推演出的一種可能局面。
w_scenery
the natural features of a landscape, especially when considered attractive 常見 mountain scenery，也可指戲劇舞台的布景（stage scenery）。
w_scent
a distinctive smell, especially a pleasant one 常見 the scent of flowers，也可指動物追蹤獵物所依循的氣味痕跡。
w_schedule
a plan of times at which particular events or tasks are intended to happen 常見 tight schedule、on schedule，也可作動詞 schedule a meeting，指安排時間。
w_scholar
a person who has studied a subject in great depth, especially at an academic level 常見 a fulbright scholar（傅爾布萊特學者），也可泛指博學之人。
w_scholarly
relating to serious academic study, or showing a lot of knowledge 常修飾 article、work，強調具有嚴謹學術水準或深厚學問，如 a scholarly journal。
w_scholarship
an amount of money given to a student to help pay for their education, based on merit or need 常見 win/receive a scholarship，指依成績或需求提供的助學補助。
w_scoop
a piece of important or exciting news reported by one journalist or organization before others 新聞語境指搶先報導的重大消息；日常語境也可指用來舀取的工具（ice cream scoop）。
w_scope
the range of things that a subject, activity, or study deals with 常見 within/beyond the scope of，指某事物涵蓋或涉及的界限。
w_scorch
to burn the surface of something slightly, causing discoloration or damage 常接 fabric、grass 等受詞，強調表面因高溫而輕微受損變色。
w_scorn
a strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect at all 常見 treat with scorn，強調對人或事物完全不屑一顧的態度，語氣強烈。
w_scour
to search a place or thing very thoroughly, or to clean something by rubbing it hard 兩義：徹底搜索某地（scour the internet）；用力刷洗表面（scour a pot）。
w_scourge
a cause of great suffering or trouble, especially one affecting many people 正式用語，常見 the scourge of poverty/disease，強調造成廣泛痛苦的根源。
w_scowl
to frown in an angry or disapproving way 常見 scowl at someone，強調因不悅或生氣而露出的凶狠表情。
w_scramble
to move quickly and awkwardly, often using your hands, or to compete hastily for something 常見 scramble to one's feet（匆忙爬起）、scramble for（爭搶），強調動作倉促混亂。
w_scrap
a small piece or amount of something left over, or discarded material such as metal 常見 scrap paper、scrap metal，指剩餘的小片段或可回收的廢棄材料。
w_scrape
to rub something against a rough or hard surface, especially causing damage or removing material 常見 scrape one's knee、scrape paint off，強調摩擦造成損傷或去除表層。
w_scratch
a small cut or mark made on a surface by something sharp 常見 from scratch（從頭開始）、a scratch on the car，指表面的細小損傷。
w_scrawl
to write something quickly and untidily 口語用法，常見 scrawl a note，強調字跡凌亂、缺乏耐心書寫。
w_screw
a metal fastener with a spiral thread, tightened by turning 常見 tighten/loosen a screw，也可作動詞 screw sth in，指鎖入或旋緊物件。
w_scribble
to write something quickly and carelessly, often making it hard to read 常見 scribble a note/reminder，強調匆忙寫下，字跡難以辨認。
w_script
the written text of a play, film, or speech 常見 movie script、read from a script，指供演出或發表使用的完整文字內容。
w_scrutiny

careful and detailed examination, especially in order to find problems scrutiny 是不可數名詞，指「細看到足以找出問題」的檢視。它常帶有壓力感：come under scrutiny 表示「被放大檢視」。一個非常有用的高階句型是 not stand up to scrutiny，意思是「經不起推敲」，用來評價論點或說法非常精準。 come under scrutiny stand up to scrutiny close/careful scrutiny come under scrutiny 受到嚴格檢視 close scrutiny 仔細的審查 not stand up to scrutiny 經不起推敲 public scrutiny 公眾檢視 examination inspection scrutinize oversight
w_sculpt
to create a shape or figure by carving or shaping a material such as stone or wood 常見 sculpt a statue，也可比喻指精心塑造某種形象或成果。
w_sculpture
a three-dimensional work of art created by carving, modeling, or casting 常見 a bronze sculpture，指以雕刻、塑形或鑄造方式製成的立體藝術品。
w_scurry
to move quickly with short, hurried steps, especially out of fear or urgency 常見於描述小動物或人因驚慌、緊急而快速移動，如 scurry away。
w_seal
an official stamp or mark used to authenticate a document, or a device used to close something tightly and prevent leaks 兩義常見：正式文件上的官方印記（official seal）；防止洩漏的裝置（rubber seal）。
w_sear
to burn or scorch the surface of something with sudden intense heat 常見於烹飪語境，如 sear a steak（將牛排表面煎至焦香），強調高溫快速加熱表層。
w_seasonal
happening or needed only at a particular time of year 常見 seasonal work、seasonal allergies，指依季節而變化或僅在特定季節出現的事物。
w_secondary
less important than something else, or coming after or resulting from something primary 常見 secondary concern、secondary school（中學），與 primary（主要的／初等的）相對。
w_secrete
(of a cell, organ, or gland) to produce and release a substance 生物學用語，常見 glands secrete hormones，指器官或細胞產生並釋放物質。
w_secretion
a substance produced and released by a cell, gland, or organ 常見 hormone secretion，指由腺體或細胞產生並釋出的物質，也可指分泌過程本身。
w_secretive
tending to hide one's thoughts, feelings, or activities from others 常修飾 person、about，形容人不願透露資訊，語氣中性偏保留。
w_secular
not connected with religious or spiritual matters 常見 secular society、secular education，與宗教（religious）相對，指與信仰無關的事物。
w_secure
safe from danger, risk, or the possibility of loss 常見 secure job、feel secure，也可作動詞 secure a deal，指取得或確保某事。
w_sedentary
involving a lot of sitting and little physical activity 常見 sedentary lifestyle/job，形容日常活動量低、長時間坐著的生活型態。
w_sediment
solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid, or matter deposited by water, wind, or ice 常見 river sediment，指自然堆積於水底或地表的物質。
w_seemingly
based on what appears to be true, though this may not be the case 常修飾形容詞或整句，如 a seemingly simple task，暗示表象與實際可能不同。
w_seep
(of a liquid) to flow slowly through small holes or spaces 常見 water seeps through，指液體緩慢地穿過縫隙或孔洞流出。
w_seethe
to be extremely angry, though often not showing it openly 常見 seethe with anger/rage，強調內心強烈的憤怒情緒，未必表現於外。
w_segment
one of the parts that something is divided into 常見 market segment（市場區塊）、a segment of the population，指整體中的某一部分。
w_seize
to take hold of something firmly and suddenly, or to take control of something by force 常見 seize an opportunity（把握機會）、seize power（奪取政權），依受詞判斷字面或比喻義。
w_select
to choose someone or something from a group after careful consideration 比 choose 更正式，常見 select a candidate/option，強調經過篩選後做出的選擇。
w_selection
the act of choosing something, or a range of things from which to choose 常見 a wide selection of，指可供挑選的多樣品項，也可指挑選這項行為本身。
w_semblance
an outward appearance that may not reflect the true nature of something 正式用語，常見 a semblance of order/normality，暗示表面看似如此，但實際未必。
w_semester
one of the two main periods into which an academic year is divided 美式教育用語，一學年通常分為 fall semester 和 spring semester 兩學期。
w_seminal
having a strong and lasting influence on later developments, especially in a field of study 正式用語，常修飾 work、study，指對後續發展具有重大且持久影響的作品或研究。
w_seminar
a meeting or class in which a small group discusses or receives training on a particular topic 常見 attend a seminar，指學術或專業訓練場合中的小組討論或講座。
w_senator
a member of a senate, the upper house of a legislative body 政治用語，常見 u.s. senator，指參議院的民選成員。
w_senile
showing a decline in mental or physical abilities associated with old age 帶醫學或負面意涵，形容因高齡導致的心智或身體機能衰退，較 elderly 更負面。
w_sensation
a physical feeling caused by something affecting the body, or a state of great public excitement 兩義：身體上的感受（a burning sensation）；引發大眾興奮的事件（cause a sensation）。
w_sensible
showing good judgment and practical thinking 常修飾 decision、advice，強調符合常理、務實的判斷，與 sensitive（敏感的）不可混淆。
w_sensitive
easily affected, hurt, or offended by things, or requiring careful handling 常見 sensitive topic、sensitive skin，指容易受外界刺激影響或需謹慎處理的事物。
w_sensitivity
the quality of being easily affected by, or responsive to, something 常見 cultural sensitivity（文化敏感度）、skin sensitivity，指對外界刺激或他人感受的敏銳程度。
w_sensual
relating to or giving pleasure through the physical senses, especially in a sexual way 常修飾 pleasure、experience，強調透過身體感官（尤指性方面）獲得的愉悅感。
w_sentiment
a feeling or opinion, especially one based on emotion rather than reason 常見 public sentiment、sentimental value，可指個人情感，也可指群體對某議題的普遍看法。
w_septic
infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to the decay of matter caused by bacteria 醫學語境常見 septic wound（傷口感染化膿）；也可用於 septic tank（化糞池）。
w_sequence
a particular order in which related things follow one another 常見 in sequence、a sequence of events，強調事物依邏輯或時間排列的次序。
w_sequential
following a particular order, one after another 常修飾 steps、process，強調事物按照固定順序逐一發生或進行。
w_seriously
in a way that shows careful thought and genuine concern, or to a great degree 常見 take something seriously、seriously injured，依語境指態度認真或程度嚴重。
w_sever

w_severe
very bad, serious, or intense in degree 常修飾 pain、weather、punishment，強調程度極為強烈或情況非常惡劣。
w_sewage
waste water and human excrement carried away in drains or sewers 常見 sewage treatment plant（汙水處理廠），指經下水道系統排放的髒水。
w_shade
an area of comparative darkness created by something blocking direct sunlight 常見 in the shade（在陰涼處），也可指顏色的深淺變化（a shade of blue）。
w_shaft
a long, narrow vertical or sloping passage, or the long straight handle of a tool or weapon 常見 elevator shaft（電梯井）、mine shaft（礦井），也可指箭、矛等的桿身部分。
w_shallow
not deep, either physically or in terms of thought or feeling 常見 shallow water（淺水），也可比喻指思想或情感不夠深刻，如 a shallow argument。
w_sham
something that is not genuine but is presented as if it were, intended to deceive 常見 expose a sham，強調表面看似真實但實際上是虛假、欺騙性的事物。
w_sharp
having a fine edge or point capable of cutting, or showing quick and clear thinking 字面指刀刃銳利；比喻指頭腦靈敏、反應快，如 a sharp mind。
w_sharply
suddenly and to a great degree, or in a severe and critical manner 常見 rise/fall sharply（急遽上升／下降），也可修飾說話語氣，如 speak sharply。
w_shatter
to break suddenly into many small pieces, or to destroy something completely, such as hope or confidence 字面指玻璃等物品碎裂；比喻指希望、信心等徹底破滅，如 shatter someone's dreams。
w_shave
to remove hair from the skin using a razor 常見 shave one's face/legs，也可比喻指削減少量，如 shave costs（削減成本）。
w_shear
to cut the wool off a sheep, or to cut through something with a sharp force 常見 shear sheep（剪羊毛），物理學語境也指材料受剪力作用而斷裂。
w_sheer
straight up or down, without any slope or interruption 常修飾 rise/drop，強調垂直上升或下降的角度，如 rise sheer from the sea。
w_shell
the hard outer covering of an egg, nut, or certain animals, or a metal case containing explosives fired from a large gun 兩義：生物外殼（egg shell、seashell）；軍事用語指砲彈。
w_shelter
a place that provides protection from danger, weather, or homelessness 常見 homeless shelter、bomb shelter，指提供暫時保護或住所的場所。
w_shelve
to decide to postpone or abandon a plan or project 常見 shelve a plan/project，強調暫時或永久放下某項計畫不予推行。
w_shepherd
a person who takes care of and guides a flock of sheep 字面指看管羊群的人；也可作動詞 shepherd sb through sth，比喻指引導、帶領某人完成某事。
w_sheriff
the chief law enforcement officer of a county, especially in the united states 美式用語，指美國郡級的最高執法官員，與 police officer 不同層級。
w_shield
a protective covering carried to defend against attack, or something that provides protection 字面指士兵持有的防禦裝備；比喻指任何提供保護的事物，如 a shield against criticism。
w_shift
a change in position, direction, or condition, or a scheduled period of work 常見 shift in policy（政策轉變）、night shift（夜班），依語境判斷抽象變化或工作班次。
w_shimmer
to shine with a soft, faint, and flickering light 常見 shimmer in the sunlight，形容光線柔和而不穩定地閃動，常用於描述水面、絲綢等。
w_shiny
reflecting light because smooth, polished, or new 常修飾 surface、hair、shoes，形容表面因光滑或拋光而反光。
w_shiver
to shake slightly, usually because of cold or fear 常見 shiver with cold/fear，強調身體因寒冷或恐懼而微微發抖。
w_shock
a sudden and unpleasant feeling of surprise, or a serious medical condition caused by injury or trauma 常見 in shock、come as a shock，也可指醫學上因創傷導致的生理危急狀態。
w_shore
the land along the edge of the sea, a lake, or another large body of water 常見 on shore、along the shore，指陸地與水域交界的地帶。
w_shortage
a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed 常見 labor shortage、water shortage，強調需求與供給間的落差。
w_shove
to push someone or something roughly and carelessly 常見 shove sb aside，強調動作粗魯、缺乏禮貌的推擠。
w_shred
a very small piece or amount of something 常見 not a shred of evidence（沒有一絲證據），強調數量極少甚至幾乎不存在。
w_shrewd
having sharp judgment, especially in practical or business matters 常修飾 businessman、investor，強調在實務或利益判斷上頭腦清楚、精於算計。
w_shriek
to make a loud, high-pitched cry, especially from fear, pain, or excitement 常見 shriek in terror/delight，強調突發、尖銳的高聲叫喊。
w_shrimp
a small edible shellfish with a long tail and many legs 常見於料理語境，如 shrimp cocktail、fried shrimp，指這種常見的甲殼類海鮮。
w_shrine
a place considered holy because of its association with a sacred person or object 常見於宗教語境，如 a shrine to a saint，指供奉神明或紀念聖者的場所。
w_shrink
to become or make smaller in size, amount, or value 常見 shrink in the wash（洗後縮水），也可比喻指經濟規模、市場等縮減。
w_shroud
to cover or hide something completely, making it difficult to see or understand 常見 shrouded in mystery/secrecy，強調事物被神秘或不明的氣氛所包圍。
w_shrub
a woody plant that is smaller than a tree and has several stems 常見於園藝語境，如 trim the shrubs，指比樹矮小、多分枝的木本植物。
w_shrug
to raise your shoulders slightly to show you do not know or do not care about something 常見 shrug one's shoulders、shrug off（不予理會），表達不在乎或不確定的態度。
w_shun
to deliberately avoid someone or something 常見 shun publicity、be shunned by，強調刻意疏遠或不與某人事物往來。
w_shunt
to move someone or something to a different, usually less important, place or position 常見於鐵路（將列車轉軌）或比喻用法，指把人或事物排擠到次要位置。
w_shuttle
a vehicle that travels regularly back and forth over a short distance between two places 常見 airport shuttle，指往返固定路線的交通工具，強調頻繁往返的特性。
w_sibling
a person's brother or sister 正式或學術用語，常見 sibling rivalry（手足競爭），泛指兄弟姊妹關係，不分性別。
w_sickness
the state of being ill, or a particular illness 常見 morning sickness（孕吐）、motion sickness（暈車），泛指身體不適的狀態。
w_siege
a military operation in which enemy forces surround a place to cut off supplies and force surrender 常見 under siege，也可比喻指持續遭受壓力或攻擊的情況。
w_sigh
a long, deep breath that shows feelings such as sadness, relief, or tiredness 常見 heave a sigh of relief（鬆了一口氣），也可作動詞 sigh，強調透過呼吸表達情緒。
w_signal
a sign, gesture, or sound that conveys information or gives instruction 常見 traffic signal、warning signal，也可作動詞 signal，指發出訊號傳達訊息。
w_signature
a person's name written by their own hand, especially to confirm identity or agreement 常見 sign your signature、a signature dish（招牌菜），後者為比喻用法，指代表性特徵。
w_significance
the importance or meaning of something 常見 historical significance、of great significance，強調某事物在背景脈絡中的重要程度。
w_signify
to be a sign of something, or to indicate or show a meaning 正式用語，常見 signify a change/agreement，強調某事物象徵或代表特定意義。
w_simplicity
the quality of being easy to understand or use, without unnecessary complexity 常見 for simplicity、simplicity of design，強調不繁瑣、易於理解或操作的特質。

w_simultaneously
at the same time as something else 常見 happen simultaneously，強調兩個或多個事件在同一時刻發生。
w_singularity
the quality of being unusual or remarkable, or a point at which normal rules do not apply 日常用語指與眾不同的特質；科學語境（黑洞、人工智慧）則指特殊的臨界點。
w_sink

w_skeleton
the structure of bones that supports a body, or the basic framework of something 字面指人體或動物的骨骼結構；比喻指計畫、故事等的基本架構，如 skeleton of a plan。
w_skeptical
having doubts about whether something is true, good, or right 常見 skeptical of/about，強調對主張、承諾或說法不輕易相信的態度。
w_sketch
a rough or quick drawing that shows the main features of something 常見 make a sketch of，也可指簡短的文字描述（a character sketch）。
w_skew
to distort or bias something so it does not represent the true picture 常見 skew the results/data，強調使數據或觀點因某因素而失去客觀性。
w_skewer

w_skillet
a flat frying pan with a handle, used for cooking on a stove 美式用語，常見 cast-iron skillet（鑄鐵平底鍋），指用於煎炒食物的廚具。
w_skim
to read or look through something quickly without reading every detail 常見 skim an article/report，強調快速瀏覽以掌握大意，而非逐字閱讀。
w_skip
to miss out or omit something, or to move by jumping lightly from one foot to the other 常見 skip a meal/class，也可指身體動作（skip rope），依語境判斷。
w_skirmish
to fight in a brief and minor way, especially between small groups 軍事用語較常見，也可比喻用於一般爭執，如兩派人馬的小衝突。
w_skull
the bony structure of the head that protects the brain 常見 skull and crossbones（骷髏標誌），也可口語泛指「腦袋」，如 knock some sense into his skull。
w_slab
a thick, flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or meat 常見 a slab of concrete/marble，指厚實且平坦的固體塊狀物。
w_slacken
to become or make less tight, fast, or intense 常見 slacken one's pace/grip，強調速度、力道或緊繃程度的降低。
w_slant
a particular way of presenting information that reflects a specific viewpoint or bias 常見 put a slant on，指以特定角度或立場呈現資訊，暗示可能帶有主觀色彩。
w_slap
a quick hit with the flat part of the hand 常見 give sb a slap，也可比喻指嚴厲的批評或懲罰，如 a slap on the wrist（輕微懲戒）。
w_slash
to make a long, deep cut with a sharp object, or to greatly reduce something such as a price or budget 字面指用利器猛烈劃割；比喻指大幅刪減，如 slash prices/budgets。
w_slate

w_slave
a person who is legally owned by another and forced to work for them without pay 常見於歷史語境，也可比喻用於形容過度受某事物控制的人，如 a slave to fashion。
w_slay
to kill someone or something violently, especially deliberately 正式或文學用語，常見於敘事或新聞標題，語氣比 kill 更戲劇化、正式。
w_sleazy
dishonest, low in moral or social standards, and often unpleasant 常修飾 bar、deal、character，形容場所或人帶有不道德、令人反感的氣息。
w_slender
pleasingly thin, or very small in amount 常修飾 figure（身材苗條）或 chance/margin（機會、差距微小），依語境判斷。
w_slice
a thin, flat piece cut from something larger, such as bread or meat 常見 a slice of bread/pizza，也可比喻指某整體中的一部分，如 a slice of the profits。
w_slide
a single image displayed as part of a presentation, or a smooth playground structure children slide down 兩義：簡報中的單張畫面（powerpoint slide）；遊樂場設施。
w_slight
to treat someone with disrespect by ignoring them or failing to give them proper attention 常見 feel slighted，強調因被忽略或不受重視而感到受冒犯。
w_slim
thin in an attractive way, or very small in size or amount 常見 slim chance（機會渺茫）、slim figure（身材苗條），依語境判斷字面或比喻義。
w_sling
a piece of cloth used to support an injured arm, or a device used to throw an object with force 醫療語境指懸吊受傷手臂的三角巾；也可指古代投擲武器（如大衛與歌利亞故事中的投石器）。
w_slip
